senses.gloss_en: the speaker, as the subject of a verb
senses.example_en: I drink coffee in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 我早上喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: the person or people being spoken to
senses.example_en: Are you ready for the train today?
senses.example_cn: 你今天准备好坐火车了吗？

senses.gloss_en: any person, people in general
senses.example_en: If you work hard, you get better.
senses.example_cn: 一个人只要努力，就会变得更好。

senses.gloss_en: a male person or animal already mentioned
senses.example_en: He is my brother in this photo.
senses.example_cn: 他是我哥哥，就在这张照片里。

senses.gloss_en: a female person or animal already mentioned
senses.example_en: My sister is here, and she is smiling.
senses.example_cn: 我姐姐来了，她正在笑。

senses.gloss_en: a thing or animal already mentioned
senses.example_en: I found a key, and it was cold.
senses.gloss_cn: 它（指前面提过的事物或动物）
senses.example_cn: 我找到一把钥匙，它是凉的。

senses.gloss_en: a subject word for weather, time, or distance
senses.example_en: It is raining today, and it is dark.
senses.gloss_cn: 作主语指天气、时间或距离
senses.example_cn: 今天在下雨，天也黑了。

senses.gloss_en: an empty subject, with the real subject later
senses.example_en: It is hard to wake up at six.
senses.gloss_cn: 作形式主语，真正主语在后面
senses.example_cn: 六点起床很难。

senses.gloss_en: the speaker and at least one other person
senses.example_en: We eat lunch here, and we talk softly.
senses.example_cn: 我们在这里吃午饭，说话很轻。

senses.gloss_en: people in general
senses.example_en: We all make mistakes, and we learn.
senses.example_cn: 人人都会犯错，然后从中学习。

senses.gloss_en: the company or organization the speaker represents
senses.example_en: We are open today, and we close at five.
senses.gloss_cn: 我们（指所属的公司或机构）
senses.example_cn: 我们今天营业，五点关门。

senses.gloss_en: Used for people, animals, or things already mentioned
senses.example_en: They are on the table near the door.
senses.example_cn: 它们在门边的桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: Used for people in general, not named
senses.example_en: They say it is cold in winter here.
senses.example_cn: 人们说这里冬天很冷。

senses.gloss_en: Used for one person, gender unknown
senses.example_en: If someone calls, they can leave a message.
senses.gloss_cn: 指性别不明的某人，作主语
senses.example_cn: 如果有人打电话来，可以让他留个话。

senses.gloss_en: Object form of I, for the speaker
senses.example_en: Can you hear me now or not.
senses.example_cn: 你现在到底能不能听见我？

senses.gloss_en: Object form of he, for a male person
senses.example_en: I saw him at the park today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在公园看见他了。

senses.gloss_en: Object form of she, for a female person
senses.example_en: I spoke to her after class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天下课后我跟她说过话。

senses.gloss_en: Belonging to a woman or girl already named
senses.example_en: Her bag is on the chair by me.
senses.example_cn: 她的包在我旁边的椅子上。

senses.gloss_en: Object form of we, for the speaker and others
senses.example_en: Can you help us with this today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这件事你能帮帮我们吗？

senses.gloss_en: Object form of they, for people, animals, or things
senses.example_en: I met them at the station after work.
senses.example_cn: 下班后我在车站见到了他们。

senses.gloss_en: Used for one person, gender unknown
senses.example_en: If a guest arrives, give them the key.
senses.gloss_cn: 指性别不明的某人，作宾语
senses.example_cn: 如果有客人来，就把钥匙给他。

senses.gloss_en: The same person as you, used as an object
senses.example_en: Be careful, or you may hurt yourself.
senses.example_cn: 小心点，不然你会伤到自己。

senses.gloss_en: Alone, without other people or help
senses.example_en: Did you go there by yourself?
senses.example_cn: 你是一个人去那儿的吗？

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize you
senses.example_en: Did you make this video yourself?
senses.example_cn: 这个视频是你自己做的吗？

senses.gloss_en: The same people as we, used as an object
senses.example_en: We taught ourselves English at home.
senses.example_cn: 我们在家自己学会了英语。

senses.gloss_en: Alone, without other people or help
senses.example_en: We did it by ourselves, no help.
senses.example_cn: 这件事是我们自己做的，没人帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize we or us
senses.example_en: We built the website ourselves, not a team.
senses.example_cn: 这个网站是我们自己做的，不是团队做的。

senses.gloss_en: A person not known, named, or mentioned
senses.example_en: Someone left a bag at the door.
senses.example_cn: 有人在门口留下了一个包。

senses.gloss_en: A person not known, named, or mentioned
senses.example_en: Somebody called you, but I missed it.
senses.example_cn: 有人给你打电话，我没接到。

senses.gloss_en: A person who is important or famous
senses.example_en: He thinks he is somebody, a big star.
senses.example_cn: 他觉得自己是个大人物，是个大明星。

senses.gloss_en: A thing not known, named, or mentioned
senses.example_en: I heard something, but I saw nothing.
senses.example_cn: 我听到了什么东西，但什么也没看见。

senses.gloss_en: An amount, number, or time that is not exact
senses.example_en: It is something like ten miles from here.
senses.example_cn: 从这儿过去大概有十英里。

senses.gloss_en: A person or thing worth noticing
senses.example_en: That small win is something, a good start.
senses.example_cn: 这场小胜也算了不起，是个好开头。

senses.gloss_en: Every person, all people
senses.example_en: Everyone in the room smiled and clapped.
senses.example_cn: 房间里的每个人都笑着鼓掌。

senses.gloss_en: every person
senses.example_en: Everybody in the room was quiet.
senses.example_cn: 房间里的所有人都很安静。

senses.gloss_en: all things, not just some
senses.example_en: She put everything on the table.
senses.example_cn: 她把所有东西都放在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: all the other things
senses.example_en: The soup was hot, but everything else was cold.
senses.example_cn: 汤是热的，可其他东西都凉了。

senses.gloss_en: the most important thing in life
senses.example_en: Her children mean everything to her.
senses.example_cn: 孩子就是她的一切。

senses.gloss_en: a person, used in questions or negatives
senses.example_en: Did anyone call you last night?
senses.gloss_cn: 任何人（用于疑问和否定）
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚上有人给你打电话吗？

senses.gloss_en: any person at all
senses.example_en: Anyone can learn this with practice.
senses.example_cn: 只要多练，任何人都能学会。

senses.gloss_en: something, used in questions or negatives
senses.example_en: I did not see anything in the box.
senses.gloss_cn: 任何东西（用于疑问和否定）
senses.example_cn: 我在盒子里什么也没看见。

senses.gloss_en: a thing of any kind
senses.example_en: Do you want anything to drink?
senses.example_cn: 你想喝点什么吗？

senses.gloss_en: at all similar, used with like
senses.example_en: It was not anything like my old job.
senses.example_cn: 这和我以前的工作一点也不像。

senses.gloss_en: no person
senses.example_en: No one was home last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚上家里没有人。

senses.gloss_en: no person
senses.example_en: Nobody knows the answer here today.
senses.example_cn: 这里今天没人知道答案。

senses.gloss_en: Not anything, no single thing
senses.example_en: There is nothing in my bag today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天包里什么都没有。

senses.gloss_en: Not important, not worth noticing
senses.example_en: That noise is nothing, go back to sleep.
senses.example_cn: 那点声音没什么，接着睡吧。

senses.gloss_en: No money is needed
senses.example_en: This app costs nothing, so I will try.
senses.example_cn: 这个应用不要钱，所以我要试试。

senses.gloss_en: Exactly the one mentioned, not a different one
senses.example_en: I live in the same house as my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我和我哥哥住在同一栋房子里。

senses.gloss_en: Having equal size, number, or type
senses.example_en: These two bags are the same size.
senses.gloss_cn: 相同的（大小、数量或种类）
senses.example_cn: 这两个包大小一样。

senses.gloss_en: The same thing or action
senses.example_en: I stood up, and he did the same.
senses.example_cn: 我站了起来，他也照样站了起来。

senses.gloss_en: Different from the one mentioned
senses.example_en: I need other shoes for this trip.
senses.example_cn: 这次出门我需要别的鞋。

senses.gloss_en: The second of two, not the first
senses.example_en: One bag is mine and the other bag is yours.
senses.example_cn: 一个包是我的，另一个包是你的。

senses.gloss_en: The remaining person or thing
senses.example_en: Take one and give the other to me.
senses.example_cn: 你拿一个，剩下的那个给我。

senses.gloss_en: Used after be, do, have, or modal verbs to make something negative
senses.example_en: I am not ready, but I will go.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于 be、do、have 或情态动词后表示否定
senses.example_cn: 我还没准备好，但我会去的。

senses.gloss_en: Used before a word or phrase to make it negative
senses.example_en: I like tea, not coffee, when I work.
senses.gloss_cn: 用在词或短语前表示否定
senses.example_cn: 工作的时候我喜欢喝茶，不是咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: Used in short replies to mean the answer is negative
senses.example_en: Are we leaving now? I'm afraid not.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于简短回答中表示否定
senses.example_cn: 我们现在就走吗？恐怕不走。

senses.gloss_en: used to greet someone, or attract attention
senses.example_en: Hello, I need help with this bag, please.
senses.gloss_cn: 你好（打招呼或引起注意）
senses.example_cn: 你好，我需要人帮我拿一下这个包。

senses.gloss_en: used to show surprise, or say someone is not noticing
senses.example_en: Hello, I have been here for an hour.
senses.gloss_cn: 喂（表示惊讶或提醒对方）
senses.example_cn: 喂，我都在这儿等了一个小时了。

senses.gloss_en: a friendly greeting
senses.example_en: She gave me a big hello at the door.
senses.example_cn: 她在门口热情地跟我打了个招呼。

senses.gloss_en: used to greet someone, informal
senses.example_en: Hi, how are you doing today, Sam?
senses.example_cn: 嗨，萨姆，你今天怎么样？

senses.gloss_en: used to ask politely
senses.example_en: Please close the door and sit down now.
senses.example_cn: 请把门关上，然后坐下。

senses.gloss_en: used to accept an offer politely
senses.example_en: Yes please, I would like some tea.
senses.example_cn: 好的，谢谢，我想喝点茶。

senses.gloss_en: to make someone happy or satisfied
senses.example_en: This song will please him and make him smile.
senses.example_cn: 这首歌会让他高兴，让他笑起来。

senses.gloss_en: feeling bad about something you did
senses.example_en: I am sorry I broke your phone today.
senses.gloss_cn: 对不起（为做错的事道歉）
senses.example_cn: 对不起，我今天把你的手机弄坏了。

senses.gloss_en: feeling sad for someone’s trouble
senses.example_en: I am sorry about your loss, my friend.
senses.gloss_cn: 为别人的不幸感到难过
senses.example_cn: 朋友，对你失去亲人的事我很难过。

senses.gloss_en: used to ask someone to repeat something
senses.example_en: Sorry, what did you say about the time?
senses.example_cn: 不好意思，你刚才说时间是几点？

senses.gloss_en: used to show you are grateful
senses.example_en: Thanks for helping me with my bag today.
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你今天帮我拿包。

senses.gloss_en: used to refuse politely
senses.example_en: No, thanks. I do not want more food.
senses.example_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我不想再吃了。

senses.gloss_en: words that show gratitude
senses.example_en: My thanks go to everybody in this room.
senses.example_cn: 我要向这个房间里的每一个人表示感谢。

senses.gloss_en: used to greet someone who arrives
senses.example_en: Welcome to my home. Come in and sit.
senses.example_cn: 欢迎来我家，进来坐吧。

senses.gloss_en: used as a polite reply to thanks
senses.example_en: You’re welcome. I am happy to help you.
senses.example_cn: 不客气，我很乐意帮你。

senses.gloss_en: to greet someone in a friendly way
senses.example_en: We welcome our guests at the door every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天都在门口迎接客人。

senses.gloss_en: used when leaving someone
senses.example_en: Goodbye, I will see you tomorrow at noon.
senses.example_cn: 再见，明天中午见。

senses.gloss_en: a leaving greeting
senses.example_en: We said our goodbyes and closed the door.
senses.example_cn: 我们互相道了别，然后关上了门。

senses.gloss_en: used to say goodbye, informal
senses.example_en: Bye, see you next week in Kuala Lumpur.
senses.example_cn: 再见，下周在吉隆坡见。

senses.gloss_en: a human being
senses.example_en: She is a kind person in my class.
senses.example_cn: 她是我们班上一个很善良的人。

senses.gloss_en: a human, not named or clearly known
senses.example_en: A person called me, but I did not answer.
senses.example_cn: 有人打电话给我，但我没接。

senses.gloss_en: men, women, and children
senses.example_en: Many people live near the river.
senses.example_cn: 很多人住在河边。

senses.gloss_en: everyone in general
senses.example_en: People say it is hard to learn.
senses.example_cn: 人们都说这个很难学。

senses.gloss_en: all the people in a country or place
senses.example_en: The people of this city love food.
senses.example_cn: 这个城市的人热爱美食。

senses.gloss_en: a number of people or things together
senses.example_en: A group of students waited outside the room.
senses.example_cn: 一群学生在屋外等着。

senses.gloss_en: a number of musicians who play music together
senses.example_en: My brother plays in a rock group.
senses.example_cn: 我哥哥在一个摇滚乐队里演出。

senses.gloss_en: a word that identifies a person or thing
senses.example_en: My name is Leon, and this is my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我叫利昂，这是我弟弟。

senses.gloss_en: to give someone or something a name
senses.example_en: They named the baby Noah after his grandfather.
senses.example_cn: 他们照着孩子爷爷的名字给宝宝取名诺亚。

senses.gloss_en: to say or write the name of someone
senses.example_en: Can you name the animals in this picture?
senses.example_cn: 你能说出图片里这些动物的名字吗？

senses.gloss_en: the number of years someone has lived
senses.example_en: What age are you now, Tom?
senses.example_cn: 汤姆，你现在多大了？

senses.gloss_en: a period of history or human development
senses.example_en: We live in the digital age now.
senses.example_cn: 我们生活在一个数字时代。

senses.gloss_en: to become older
senses.example_en: As he aged, his hair turned white.
senses.example_cn: 随着年纪增长，他的头发变白了。

senses.gloss_en: the time between birth and death
senses.example_en: He wants a long life with his family.
senses.example_cn: 他希望和家人一起活得长长久久。

senses.gloss_en: the way someone lives, daily habits and activities
senses.example_en: City life is busy, but I like it.
senses.example_cn: 城市生活很忙，但我喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: living things, animals and plants
senses.example_en: There is little life in this cold river.
senses.example_cn: 这条冰冷的河里几乎没有生命。

senses.gloss_en: a group of parents and their children
senses.example_en: My family eats dinner together every night.
senses.example_cn: 我们家每天晚上都一起吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: all the people related to you
senses.example_en: All my family came to my wedding.
senses.example_cn: 我所有的家人都来参加了我的婚礼。

senses.gloss_en: connected with family, used to describe life or events
senses.example_en: They had a family trip to the beach.
senses.example_cn: 他们全家去海边旅行了一趟。

senses.gloss_en: a mother or father, or someone who looks after a child
senses.example_en: Her parents are waiting outside the school.
senses.example_cn: 她的父母在学校外面等着。

senses.gloss_en: an animal or plant that produces young
senses.example_en: The parent bird fed the young in the nest.
senses.example_cn: 母鸟在巢中喂养幼鸟。

senses.gloss_en: A parent of your mother or father
senses.example_en: My grandparents live nearby and we visit each weekend.
senses.example_cn: 我的祖父母住得很近，我们每个周末都去看他们。

senses.gloss_en: The father of your mother or father
senses.example_en: My grandfather tells stories and we laugh together.
senses.example_cn: 我爷爷讲故事，我们一起笑。

senses.gloss_en: The mother of your mother or father
senses.example_en: My grandmother cooks dinner and we eat together.
senses.example_cn: 我奶奶做晚饭，我们一起吃。

senses.gloss_en: A male parent of a child or animal
senses.example_en: My father works hard and helps me every day.
senses.example_cn: 我父亲工作很辛苦，每天还帮着我。

senses.gloss_en: A man who invented or started something important
senses.example_en: Descartes is the father of modern philosophy.
senses.example_cn: 笛卡尔是现代哲学之父。

senses.gloss_en: A title for some Christian priests
senses.example_en: I spoke to Father James after the service.
senses.gloss_cn: 神父（对神职人员的尊称）
senses.example_cn: 礼拜结束后我和詹姆斯神父说了话。

senses.gloss_en: A female parent of a child or animal
senses.example_en: My mother calls me and I answer quickly.
senses.example_cn: 我妈妈一喊我，我就赶紧应声。

senses.gloss_en: A title for a woman who leads a convent
senses.example_en: Good morning, Mother, we are ready to work.
senses.gloss_cn: 院长（女修道院的负责人）
senses.example_cn: 早上好，院长，我们准备好干活了。

senses.gloss_en: A word for your father
senses.example_en: My dad drives us home after school.
senses.example_cn: 我爸爸放学后开车送我们回家。

senses.gloss_en: A word for your mother
senses.example_en: My mom phoned last night and I felt happy.
senses.example_cn: 我妈妈昨晚打来电话，我很开心。

senses.gloss_en: The man you are married to
senses.example_en: Her husband cooks dinner and she washes dishes.
senses.example_cn: 她丈夫做晚饭，她洗碗。

senses.gloss_en: a woman married to a man
senses.example_en: My wife is at home with our son.
senses.example_cn: 我妻子在家陪着我们的儿子。

senses.gloss_en: a person's male child
senses.example_en: Our son is six years old today.
senses.example_cn: 我们的儿子今天六岁了。

senses.gloss_en: Used by an older man or a priest to address a boy or young man
senses.example_en: Come on, son, we can go now.
senses.gloss_cn: 小伙子（长辈对年轻男子的称呼）
senses.example_cn: 来吧，小伙子，我们可以走了。

senses.gloss_en: a person's female child
senses.example_en: Their daughter is in school with my son.
senses.example_cn: 他们的女儿和我儿子在同一所学校上学。

senses.gloss_en: a boy or man with the same parents
senses.example_en: My brother and my sister live with us.
senses.example_cn: 我哥哥和我姐姐跟我们住在一起。

senses.gloss_en: A male member of a religious group, especially a Christian group
senses.example_en: Brother Michael lives at the monastery.
senses.gloss_cn: 修士（宗教团体的男性成员）
senses.example_cn: 迈克尔修士住在修道院里。

senses.gloss_en: a man in the same group as you
senses.example_en: My brothers in the union can help me.
senses.gloss_cn: 兄弟（同一团体的男性成员）
senses.example_cn: 工会里的兄弟们能帮我。

senses.gloss_en: a girl or woman with the same parents
senses.example_en: My sister and my brother are at home.
senses.example_cn: 我姐姐和我哥哥都在家。

senses.gloss_en: a woman in the same group as you
senses.example_en: My sisters in the union can help me.
senses.gloss_cn: 姐妹（同一团体的女性成员）
senses.example_cn: 工会里的姐妹们能帮我。

senses.gloss_en: a related company in the same group
senses.example_en: This company has a sister company in town.
senses.gloss_cn: 姊妹（同集团下的关联单位）
senses.example_cn: 这家公司在城里还有一家姊妹公司。

senses.gloss_en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle
senses.example_en: My aunt lives near my uncle and cousin.
senses.example_cn: 我姑姑住在我叔叔和表亲附近。

senses.gloss_en: Used by children with a first name to address a close friend of their parents
senses.example_en: Thanks, Aunt Maria, I can go with you today.
senses.gloss_cn: 阿姨（对父母好友的称呼）
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你，玛丽亚阿姨，我今天可以跟你一起去。

senses.gloss_en: The brother of your father or mother, or the husband of your aunt
senses.example_en: My uncle has a son and a daughter.
senses.example_cn: 我叔叔有一个儿子和一个女儿。

senses.gloss_en: Used by children with a first name to address a close friend of their parents
senses.example_en: Hi, Uncle Ben, can you help me today?
senses.gloss_cn: 叔叔（对父母好友的称呼）
senses.example_cn: 本叔叔好，你今天能帮我一下吗？

senses.gloss_en: The child of your aunt or uncle
senses.example_en: I have cousins in Canada and cousins in Korea.
senses.example_cn: 我在加拿大和韩国都有表亲。

senses.gloss_en: a young person who is not an adult
senses.example_en: The child plays outside after school every day.
senses.example_cn: 这个小孩每天放学后都在外面玩。

senses.gloss_en: a son or daughter, of any age
senses.example_en: Her child lives with his family in Canada.
senses.example_cn: 她的孩子和自己的家人住在加拿大。

senses.gloss_en: A very young child or animal
senses.example_en: The baby sleeps in my arms in silence.
senses.example_cn: 宝宝安安静静地睡在我怀里。

senses.gloss_en: the youngest member of a family or group
senses.example_en: He is the baby of the family.
senses.example_cn: 他是家里最小的孩子。

senses.gloss_en: an older person who cries or acts childish
senses.example_en: Don't be a baby, it will be fine.
senses.example_cn: 别像个小孩一样，会没事的。

senses.gloss_en: a young person between 13 and 19 years old
senses.example_en: The teenager talks with friends after class.
senses.example_cn: 那个青少年下课后和朋友聊天。

senses.gloss_en: An adult male human
senses.example_en: A man waits outside the store in the rain.
senses.example_cn: 有个男人在雨里等在店门外。

senses.gloss_en: a male employee
senses.example_en: Two men fixed the door this morning.
senses.example_cn: 两个男人今早修好了门。

senses.gloss_en: a husband or male romantic partner
senses.example_en: She met her man at a party last year.
senses.example_cn: 去年她在聚会上认识了男朋友。

senses.gloss_en: an adult female human
senses.example_en: A woman smiles and waves at the child.
senses.example_cn: 一个女人笑着朝那个孩子挥手。

senses.gloss_en: a wife or female romantic partner
senses.example_en: He said he has a new woman now.
senses.example_cn: 他说他现在有新的女伴了。

senses.gloss_en: women in general
senses.example_en: The book describes the role of women in art.
senses.example_cn: 这本书讲的是女性在艺术中的作用。

senses.gloss_en: a male child or young male
senses.example_en: The boy runs after the dog in the snow.
senses.example_cn: 那个男孩在雪地里追着狗跑。

senses.gloss_en: a group of male friends
senses.example_en: He plays soccer with the boys on Fridays.
senses.example_cn: 他每周五和哥们儿一起踢足球。

senses.gloss_en: a female child or young woman
senses.example_en: That girl works at the cafe near us.
senses.example_cn: 那个女孩在我们附近的咖啡馆工作。

senses.gloss_en: a daughter
senses.example_en: Their girl is five and likes stories.
senses.example_cn: 他们的女儿五岁了，喜欢听故事。

senses.gloss_en: a group of female friends
senses.example_en: She went out with the girls after work.
senses.example_cn: 她下班后和闺蜜们出去玩了。

senses.gloss_en: a man or boy in a romantic relationship
senses.example_en: Her boyfriend called her after dinner last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚饭后她男朋友给她打了电话。

senses.gloss_en: a girl or woman you have a romantic relationship with
senses.example_en: His girlfriend met us at the cafe.
senses.example_cn: 他女朋友在咖啡馆和我们见了面。

senses.gloss_en: a person you do an activity with
senses.example_en: I need a partner for tennis today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天打网球需要一个搭档。

senses.gloss_en: a husband, wife, or person you live with
senses.example_en: She brought her partner to the party.
senses.example_cn: 她带着伴侣来参加聚会。

senses.gloss_en: one of two people who own a business together
senses.example_en: They are partners in a small company.
senses.example_cn: 他们是一家小公司的合伙人。

senses.gloss_en: a person you know well and like
senses.example_en: He is my friend from school.
senses.example_cn: 他是我学校里的朋友。

senses.gloss_en: a person who supports an organization or idea
senses.example_en: She is a friend of the hospital.
senses.example_cn: 她是这家医院的支持者。

senses.gloss_en: an informal talk between two or more people
senses.example_en: We had a long conversation on the train.
senses.example_cn: 我们在火车上有过一次长谈。

senses.gloss_en: to make it easier for someone to do something
senses.example_en: Can you help me carry this box?
senses.example_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

senses.gloss_en: the act of helping someone
senses.example_en: Thanks for your help with my bags.
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你帮我拿包。

senses.gloss_en: useful support, something that makes things easier
senses.example_en: This map is a big help today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这张地图帮了大忙。

senses.gloss_en: an opinion about what you should do
senses.example_en: My dad gave me advice about the job.
senses.example_cn: 关于这份工作，我爸给了我一些建议。

senses.gloss_en: a fully grown person, legally responsible for actions
senses.example_en: Only an adult can sign this form.
senses.example_cn: 只有成年人才能签这份表格。

senses.gloss_en: fully grown, not a child
senses.example_en: Adult monkeys stay with the group.
senses.example_cn: 成年猴子会留在群里。

senses.gloss_en: relating to adults, not for children
senses.example_en: This course is for adult students.
senses.example_cn: 这门课是给成年学生开的。

senses.gloss_en: the house or apartment where you live
senses.example_en: My home is near the park.
senses.example_cn: 我家离公园很近。

senses.gloss_en: to or at the place where you live
senses.example_en: I walked home after work today.
senses.example_cn: 今天下班后我走着回家。

senses.gloss_en: relating to your home, used before a noun
senses.example_en: My home address is on this form.
senses.example_cn: 这张表上填的是我的家庭住址。

senses.gloss_en: a building where people live, usually for one family
senses.example_en: Their house has three rooms and a small yard.
senses.example_cn: 他们的房子有三个房间和一个小院子。

senses.gloss_en: all the people living in a house
senses.example_en: The baby woke the whole house up last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚孩子把全家人都吵醒了。

senses.gloss_en: a building used for a special purpose, often in the name
senses.example_en: We saw a show at the Opera House.
senses.example_cn: 我们在歌剧院看了一场演出。

senses.gloss_en: a set of rooms for living in one building
senses.example_en: Our apartment has one bedroom and a small kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 我们的公寓有一间卧室和一个小厨房。

senses.gloss_en: part of a building with its own walls, floor, and ceiling
senses.example_en: This room has two windows and a blue door.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间有两扇窗户和一扇蓝色的门。

senses.gloss_en: space for someone or something
senses.example_en: There is room for two bags in here.
senses.example_cn: 这里面有放两个包的空间。

senses.gloss_en: the chance to do something
senses.example_en: There is room to grow in this job.
senses.example_cn: 这份工作有成长的空间。

senses.gloss_en: a room where you sleep
senses.example_en: My bedroom has a bed, two lamps, and a desk.
senses.example_cn: 我的卧室里有一张床、两盏灯和一张书桌。

senses.gloss_en: a room with a toilet, sink, and tub or shower
senses.example_en: The bathroom is small but it has a shower.
senses.example_cn: 卫生间不大，但是有淋浴。

senses.gloss_en: a room where food is prepared and cooked
senses.example_en: We cook dinner in the kitchen every night.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天晚上在厨房做饭。

senses.gloss_en: a bowl you sit on to pass waste
senses.example_en: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
senses.example_cn: 用完请把马桶冲一下。

senses.gloss_en: a room with a toilet, especially in British English
senses.example_en: Where is the toilet near the kitchen?
senses.example_cn: 厨房附近的厕所在哪儿？

senses.gloss_en: A time of washing your body in a tub
senses.example_en: I took a bath after my long run.
senses.example_cn: 长跑之后我泡了个澡。

senses.gloss_en: A large, long container that you fill with water and sit or lie in to wash your body
senses.example_en: He cleaned himself in the bath.
senses.example_cn: 他在浴缸里把身子洗干净了。

senses.gloss_en: A time you wash your body under running water
senses.example_en: I take a shower before work every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天上班前都洗个淋浴。

senses.gloss_en: A place or device for washing under running water
senses.example_en: The shower is broken, so we use the bath.
senses.example_cn: 淋浴器坏了，所以我们用浴缸洗。

senses.gloss_en: A short period of rain
senses.example_en: A shower started, and we ran inside.
senses.example_cn: 突然下了一场阵雨，我们赶紧跑进了屋。

senses.gloss_en: A piece of furniture for sleeping
senses.example_en: The bed is soft.
senses.example_cn: 这张床很软。

senses.gloss_en: The bottom of a river or the sea
senses.example_en: The river bed is dry after summer.
senses.example_cn: 过了夏天，河床都干了。

senses.gloss_en: A piece of ground for growing plants or flowers
senses.example_en: She planted roses in a flower bed.
senses.example_cn: 她在花坛里种了玫瑰。

senses.gloss_en: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
senses.example_en: We eat at the table, and we talk.
senses.example_cn: 我们在桌边吃饭，也在桌边聊天。

senses.gloss_en: The people sitting together at a meal
senses.example_en: The whole table laughed at the story.
senses.example_cn: 那个故事把一桌人都逗笑了。

senses.gloss_en: An arrangement of facts or numbers in rows and columns
senses.example_en: The table shows the price, size, and color.
senses.example_cn: 这个表格列出了价格、尺寸和颜色。

senses.gloss_en: A seat for one person, with a back
senses.example_en: Please sit on the chair near the window.
senses.example_cn: 请坐在窗边的椅子上。

senses.gloss_en: The person in charge of a meeting or group
senses.example_en: The chair called the meeting to order.
senses.gloss_cn: 主席（会议或团体的负责人）
senses.example_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。

senses.gloss_en: To lead a meeting and control the discussion
senses.example_en: She will chair the meeting on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 她周一将主持这场会议。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of wood, glass, etc. that opens and closes as a way of entering or leaving a room, building, car, etc
senses.example_en: Close the door, please, and turn off the light.
senses.example_cn: 请把门关上，再把灯关掉。

senses.gloss_en: A way of achieving something, an opportunity
senses.example_en: This job opens a door to new work.
senses.example_cn: 这份工作为新的工作机会打开了一扇门。

senses.gloss_en: A metal object that opens a lock
senses.example_en: I lost my key, so I cannot enter.
senses.example_cn: 我把钥匙丢了，所以进不去。

senses.gloss_en: Most important, needed for success
senses.example_en: Good sleep is key to a healthy life.
senses.example_cn: 睡好觉是健康生活的关键。

senses.gloss_en: to enter information into a phone or computer using a keyboard or keypad
senses.example_en: He keyed the number into the phone quickly.
senses.example_cn: 他很快把号码输进了手机。

senses.gloss_en: A glass opening in a wall or vehicle
senses.example_en: Open the window, and let fresh air in.
senses.example_cn: 把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。

senses.gloss_en: A separate area on a computer screen
senses.example_en: I closed the window on my computer screen.
senses.example_cn: 我关掉了电脑屏幕上的那个窗口。

senses.gloss_en: A short time to do something, an opportunity
senses.example_en: We have a small window, so act now.
senses.example_cn: 我们的时间窗口很短，所以马上行动。

senses.gloss_en: a vertical side of a room or building
senses.example_en: The picture is on the wall in my room.
senses.example_cn: 画挂在我房间的墙上。

senses.gloss_en: a long brick or stone barrier around an area
senses.example_en: A wall divides our garden from the yard.
senses.example_cn: 一道围墙把我们的花园和院子隔开。

senses.gloss_en: a large mass of people or things blocking the way
senses.example_en: A wall of people stopped us at the door.
senses.example_cn: 门口一堵人墙把我们挡住了。

senses.gloss_en: the flat surface of a room you walk on
senses.example_en: The cat slept on the floor near the door.
senses.example_cn: 猫睡在门边的地板上。

senses.gloss_en: a level of a building, one story
senses.example_en: My apartment is on the third floor, not the first.
senses.example_cn: 我的公寓在三楼，不在一楼。

senses.gloss_en: the bottom surface of the sea or a valley
senses.example_en: They found the ship on the ocean floor.
senses.example_cn: 他们在海底找到了那条船。

senses.gloss_en: land near a home for flowers or vegetables
senses.example_en: We eat lunch in the garden on sunny days.
senses.example_cn: 天晴的时候我们在花园里吃午饭。

senses.gloss_en: a public place with plants for people to enjoy
senses.example_en: We walked through the public garden and saw flowers.
senses.example_cn: 我们穿过那座公共花园，看到了很多花。

senses.gloss_en: lands around a house, usually with grass
senses.example_en: The dog ran in the yard all day.
senses.example_cn: 那只狗在院子里跑了一整天。

senses.gloss_en: a unit of length equal to three feet
senses.example_en: The cloth is two yards long.
senses.example_cn: 这块布有两码长。

senses.gloss_en: an outdoor area used for a business or activity
senses.example_en: The trucks waited in the yard behind the store.
senses.gloss_cn: 场地（干活或做生意的空地）
senses.example_cn: 卡车停在店后面的场地里等着。

senses.gloss_en: a container with a lid for holding things
senses.example_en: I put the keys in a small box.
senses.example_cn: 我把钥匙放进了一个小盒子里。

senses.gloss_en: the amount inside a box
senses.example_en: He ate a whole box of chocolates.
senses.example_cn: 他吃了一整盒巧克力。

senses.gloss_en: a square space on a form or a screen
senses.example_en: Put an X in the box on the form.
senses.example_cn: 在表格的方框里打个叉。

senses.gloss_en: the usual order you follow each day
senses.example_en: My morning routine starts at six every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天早上的安排都从六点开始。

senses.gloss_en: a set of repeated movements in a performance
senses.example_en: She practiced a dance routine for the show.
senses.example_cn: 她为演出练了一套舞蹈动作。

senses.gloss_en: done as a normal part of a job or process
senses.example_en: It was a routine test during the checkup.
senses.example_cn: 那只是体检时的一项常规检查。

senses.gloss_en: move something to a place or position
senses.example_en: Put the key on the table, please.
senses.example_cn: 请把钥匙放在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: write something on a list or on paper
senses.example_en: Put your name on the list today.
senses.example_cn: 今天把你的名字写在名单上。

senses.gloss_en: makes someone in a particular situation
senses.example_en: The news puts her in a bad mood.
senses.example_cn: 这消息让她心情很糟。

senses.gloss_en: hold something and take it to a place
senses.example_en: I carry the bag to the car.
senses.example_cn: 我把包搬到车上。

senses.gloss_en: have something with you in a pocket, bag, or hand
senses.example_en: She carries a key in her bag.
senses.example_cn: 她包里随身带着一把钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: transport people, animals, or things from one place
senses.example_en: The bus carries people to the town.
senses.example_cn: 这趟公交车把人载到镇上。

senses.gloss_en: do something with something for a purpose
senses.example_en: I use this key to open the door.
senses.example_cn: 我用这把钥匙开门。

senses.gloss_en: the act of using something
senses.example_en: The use of this tool is simple.
senses.example_cn: 这个工具的用法很简单。

senses.gloss_en: a purpose or value, something helpful
senses.example_en: This old chair has no use now.
senses.example_cn: 这把旧椅子现在没什么用了。

senses.gloss_en: put food in your mouth, then swallow it
senses.example_en: I eat a big breakfast at home.
senses.example_cn: 我在家吃了一顿丰盛的早饭。

senses.gloss_en: have a meal
senses.example_en: We eat at seven, after work.
senses.example_cn: 我们下班以后七点吃饭。

senses.gloss_en: damage something gradually, so it becomes smaller or weaker
senses.example_en: The acid is eating away at the metal.
senses.example_cn: 那种酸正在慢慢腐蚀金属。

senses.gloss_en: have clothes, shoes, or glasses on your body
senses.example_en: I wear glasses for reading at night.
senses.example_cn: 我晚上看书时戴眼镜。

senses.gloss_en: arrange your hair in a particular way
senses.example_en: She wears her hair in a ponytail.
senses.example_cn: 她把头发扎成马尾。

senses.gloss_en: becomes thin or damaged from being used a lot
senses.example_en: My shoes wear quickly on this road.
senses.example_cn: 走这条路我的鞋磨得很快。

senses.gloss_en: rest with your eyes closed and unconscious
senses.example_en: I sleep eight hours every night.
senses.example_cn: 我每天晚上睡八个小时。

senses.gloss_en: the state of being asleep
senses.example_en: Good sleep helps me feel better.
senses.example_cn: 睡得好让我感觉舒服些。

senses.gloss_en: a period of sleeping
senses.example_en: I need a sleep after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 这趟旅行回来我得睡一觉。

senses.gloss_en: Early part of the day, from waking until noon
senses.example_en: I eat breakfast in the morning at home.
senses.example_cn: 我早上在家吃早饭。

senses.gloss_en: Part of the day from noon until evening
senses.example_en: We talk in the afternoon after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 我们下午吃过午饭以后聊天。

senses.gloss_en: Part of the day between afternoon and bedtime
senses.example_en: I read in the evening after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我晚上吃过饭就看书。

senses.gloss_en: Time spent at an event, during the evening
senses.example_en: We had a fun evening at the theater.
senses.example_cn: 我们在剧院度过了愉快的一晚。

senses.gloss_en: Time when it is dark, between one day and the next
senses.example_en: It is quiet at night in my town.
senses.example_cn: 我住的镇上到了晚上很安静。

senses.gloss_en: One specific dark period, like last Tuesday
senses.example_en: We met one night and talked for hours.
senses.example_cn: 我们有一天晚上见了面，聊了好几个小时。

senses.gloss_en: Time you sleep away from home, usually overnight
senses.example_en: I spent the night at my friend's house.
senses.example_cn: 我在朋友家过了一夜。

senses.gloss_en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the night
senses.example_en: The clock struck midnight and we went home.
senses.example_cn: 钟敲响午夜十二点，我们就回家了。

senses.gloss_en: see and talk to someone for the first time
senses.example_en: I met your sister at the airport today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在机场认识了你的姐姐。

senses.gloss_en: come together with someone, by plan or chance
senses.example_en: We will meet at six outside the house.
senses.example_cn: 我们六点在房子外面见。

senses.gloss_en: connects two things together
senses.example_en: Join the two pipes together with tape.
senses.example_cn: 用胶带把这两根管子接在一起。

senses.gloss_en: become a member of a group or club
senses.example_en: She joined the club last year with her sister.
senses.example_cn: 她去年和妹妹一起加入了这个俱乐部。

senses.gloss_en: do something with someone or go with them
senses.example_en: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚要不要和我们一起吃晚饭？

senses.gloss_en: allow someone to do something or allow something to happen
senses.example_en: My parents let me stay home today.
senses.example_cn: 我父母今天让我待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: used to make a suggestion with
senses.example_en: Let's meet at the house at six.
senses.example_cn: 我们六点在家里见吧。

senses.gloss_en: rent a house or room to someone, in British English
senses.example_en: They let the house to a new family.
senses.example_cn: 他们把房子租给了一个新家庭。

senses.gloss_en: tell someone you are grateful for something
senses.example_en: I thank you for your help today.
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你今天的帮助。

senses.gloss_en: say someone caused a problem, often sarcastic
senses.example_en: You can thank John for this mess at home.
senses.example_cn: 家里这一团糟你得怪约翰。

senses.gloss_en: move your body and feet to music
senses.example_en: We dance in the kitchen after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们在厨房里跳舞。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of moving your body to music
senses.example_en: Dance is fun for me and my sister.
senses.example_cn: 舞蹈对我和我妹妹来说很有意思。

senses.gloss_en: a social event where people dance
senses.example_en: We went to the school dance last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚上我们去参加了学校的舞会。

senses.gloss_en: believes something is true
senses.example_en: I think this is my key.
senses.example_cn: 我觉得这是我的钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: have an opinion about someone or something
senses.example_en: What do you think about my new bed?
senses.example_cn: 你觉得我的新床怎么样？

senses.gloss_en: consider doing something in the future
senses.example_en: I am thinking about a new job.
senses.example_cn: 我在考虑换个新工作。

senses.gloss_en: have information in your mind
senses.example_en: Do you know her name now?
senses.example_cn: 你现在知道她的名字了吗？

senses.gloss_en: be sure something is true
senses.example_en: I know this door is locked.
senses.example_cn: 我知道这门是锁着的。

senses.gloss_en: have met someone and feel familiar with them
senses.example_en: I know that man from our class.
senses.example_cn: 我认识那个人，他跟我们一个班。

senses.gloss_en: knows the meaning of words or language
senses.example_en: I understand this word, not that word.
senses.example_cn: 这个词我懂，那个词我不懂。

senses.gloss_en: knows why something happens or how it works
senses.example_en: Do you understand why the baby is crying?
senses.example_cn: 你明白宝宝为什么哭吗？

senses.gloss_en: know how someone feels and be kind
senses.example_en: I understand how you feel, and I can help.
senses.example_cn: 我理解你的感受，我能帮你。

senses.gloss_en: have a particular meaning
senses.example_en: What does this name mean in English?
senses.example_cn: 这个名字在英语里是什么意思？

senses.gloss_en: refer to someone or something
senses.example_en: I mean you, not your family.
senses.example_cn: 我说的是你，不是你家人。

senses.gloss_en: have a result or effect
senses.example_en: This can mean we go home now.
senses.example_cn: 这可以让我们现在就回家。

senses.gloss_en: gain knowledge or skill
senses.example_en: I learn English with my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我和我哥哥一起学英语。

senses.gloss_en: find out new information
senses.example_en: I learned the name of that person.
senses.example_cn: 我知道了那个人的名字。

senses.gloss_en: put something in your memory by studying
senses.example_en: I must learn these words before class.
senses.example_cn: 上课前我必须记住这些单词。

senses.gloss_en: look at something to find mistakes
senses.example_en: Check the name on the form now.
senses.example_cn: 现在核对一下表格上的名字。

senses.gloss_en: mark an item with a check
senses.example_en: Check this box and sign your name.
senses.example_cn: 在这个方框里打个勾，然后签上名字。

senses.gloss_en: an act of checking something
senses.example_en: Give the door a quick check.
senses.example_cn: 把门快速检查一下。

senses.gloss_en: choose something after thinking carefully
senses.example_en: Decide now, then go home soon.
senses.example_cn: 现在就决定，然后早点回家。

senses.gloss_en: select a person or thing you want
senses.example_en: Choose a chair for the table.
senses.example_cn: 给这张桌子挑一把椅子。

senses.gloss_en: decide what you will do
senses.example_en: I chose to sleep early last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我选择早点睡。

senses.gloss_en: Like one thing better than another
senses.example_en: I prefer tea to coffee at breakfast.
senses.example_cn: 早餐我更喜欢喝茶，不太想喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: Choose to do one thing instead of another
senses.example_en: I prefer to walk and not drive today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我宁愿走路，不想开车。

senses.gloss_en: Use would prefer for a polite choice
senses.example_en: I'd prefer you not to smoke in here.
senses.example_cn: 我希望你不要在这里抽烟。

senses.gloss_en: Bring a fact or person back to mind
senses.example_en: I remember your name and your face.
senses.example_cn: 我记得你的名字，也记得你的样子。

senses.gloss_en: Not forget to do something you must do
senses.example_en: Remember to call your mom after work.
senses.example_cn: 记得下班后给你妈打电话。

senses.gloss_en: Keep something in your mind for later
senses.example_en: Remember this password and write it down.
senses.example_cn: 把这个密码记住，再写下来。

senses.gloss_en: Not be able to remember something
senses.example_en: I forget his name every time.
senses.example_cn: 我每次都记不住他的名字。

senses.gloss_en: Fail to remember to do something
senses.example_en: Don't forget to bring your phone.
senses.example_cn: 别忘了带手机。

senses.gloss_en: Leave something behind by accident
senses.example_en: I forgot my wallet at home today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天把钱包忘在家里了。

senses.gloss_en: Form a picture in your mind
senses.example_en: Imagine a beach with warm water and sun.
senses.example_cn: 你想象一下海滩、暖暖的海水和阳光。

senses.gloss_en: Think something is probably true
senses.example_en: I imagine he is busy this morning.
senses.example_cn: 我猜他今天上午很忙。

senses.gloss_en: Think about a possible situation
senses.example_en: I imagined living in another country someday.
senses.example_cn: 我设想过将来有一天住到别的国家去。

senses.gloss_en: Look at two things for similarities, differences
senses.example_en: Compare these two photos and choose the best.
senses.example_cn: 比较一下这两张照片，挑出最好的。

senses.gloss_en: Say one thing is like another
senses.example_en: People compare my voice to my dad's.
senses.example_cn: 大家都把我的声音比作我爸爸的声音。

senses.gloss_en: Compare prices or numbers to see differences
senses.example_en: We compared prices at three stores yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 我们昨天对比了三家店的价格。

senses.gloss_en: Have the same opinion as someone
senses.example_en: I agree with you about the plan.
senses.example_cn: 关于这个计划，我同意你的看法。

senses.gloss_en: Decide something together with others
senses.example_en: They agreed on a price for the car.
senses.example_cn: 他们就车的价格达成了一致。

senses.gloss_en: Say yes to a suggestion or plan
senses.example_en: We agreed to meet after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我们约定晚饭后见面。

senses.gloss_en: Get pleasure from something
senses.example_en: I enjoy long walks in the evening.
senses.example_cn: 我喜欢在晚上长时间散步。

senses.gloss_en: Have a good time doing something
senses.example_en: We enjoyed ourselves at the party.
senses.example_cn: 我们在派对上玩得很开心。

senses.gloss_en: Have, use, or benefit from something good
senses.example_en: She enjoys good health most of the time.
senses.example_cn: 她大部分时间都享有很好的身体。

senses.gloss_en: Wish to have something
senses.example_en: I want a new phone this year.
senses.example_cn: 我今年想要一部新手机。

senses.gloss_en: Wish to do something
senses.example_en: I want to learn English fast.
senses.example_cn: 我想快点学会英语。

senses.gloss_en: Wish someone to do something
senses.example_en: I want you to sit here with me.
senses.example_cn: 我希望你坐在这儿陪我。

senses.gloss_en: to rest and do something enjoyable
senses.example_en: I relax after work and watch a movie.
senses.example_cn: 我下班后放松一下，看部电影。

senses.gloss_en: to become calm and comfortable, not worried
senses.example_en: Just relax, and you will feel better soon.
senses.example_cn: 你放松点，很快就会好受些。

senses.gloss_en: to make your muscles less tight
senses.example_en: Breathe slowly to relax your shoulders and neck.
senses.example_cn: 慢慢呼吸，放松肩膀和脖子。

senses.gloss_en: to accept something as true
senses.example_en: I believe your story and I trust you.
senses.example_cn: 我相信你说的话，我信任你。

senses.gloss_en: to think something is true, not completely sure
senses.example_en: I believe he is home, but I am not sure.
senses.example_cn: 我相信他在家，不过我也说不准。

senses.gloss_en: to experience an emotion or a physical sensation
senses.example_en: I feel happy when I see my family.
senses.example_cn: 见到家人时我感到很开心。

senses.gloss_en: to touch something to learn what it is like
senses.example_en: Feel the water and tell me if it is cold.
senses.example_cn: 你摸摸水，告诉我凉不凉。

senses.gloss_en: to think or believe something is true
senses.example_en: I feel he is right about this.
senses.example_cn: 我觉得这件事他是对的。

senses.gloss_en: an emotion, like love, hate, or fear
senses.example_en: Sitting by the lake gives me a peaceful feeling.
senses.example_cn: 坐在湖边让我有一种平静的感受。

senses.gloss_en: a physical sense in your body, especially by touch
senses.example_en: I lost feeling in my hand after I slept on it.
senses.example_cn: 我压着手睡了一觉，手就没感觉了。

senses.gloss_en: an idea or belief, not based on facts
senses.example_en: I have a feeling that something will happen today.
senses.example_cn: 我有种预感，今天会出点什么事。

senses.gloss_en: to find someone or something pleasant or enjoyable
senses.example_en: I like this book and I read it.
senses.example_cn: 我喜欢这本书，我在读它。

senses.gloss_en: a click online showing you like something
senses.example_en: This photo got 100 likes on my page.
senses.example_cn: 这张照片在我的主页上获得了一百个赞。

senses.gloss_en: a very strong feeling of liking and caring
senses.example_en: Their love for their child is very strong.
senses.example_cn: 他们对孩子的爱非常深。

senses.gloss_en: to have very strong feelings of liking and caring
senses.example_en: I love my family and I miss them.
senses.example_cn: 我爱我的家人，我很想他们。

senses.gloss_en: great enjoyment of something you do or have
senses.example_en: His love of music grew when he was young.
senses.example_cn: 他对音乐的热爱是从小就有的。

senses.gloss_en: to make sounds and movements when something is funny
senses.example_en: We laugh when the teacher tells a funny story.
senses.example_cn: 老师讲好笑的故事时我们都笑了。

senses.gloss_en: to make fun of someone or something
senses.example_en: Do not laugh at her name.
senses.example_cn: 不要嘲笑她的名字。

senses.gloss_en: the sound you make when you think something is funny
senses.example_en: His laugh is loud and easy to hear.
senses.example_cn: 他的笑声很大，一下就能听出来。

senses.gloss_en: to want something to happen and think it is possible
senses.example_en: I hope we can go home today.
senses.example_cn: 我希望我们今天能回家。

senses.gloss_en: a feeling of wanting and expecting something to happen
senses.example_en: There is still hope for our plan.
senses.example_cn: 我们的计划还有希望。

senses.gloss_en: something you want to happen in the future
senses.example_en: My hope is that my family will have a good life.
senses.example_cn: 我的愿望是家人能过上好日子。

senses.gloss_en: the feeling of wanting to know or learn more
senses.example_en: She showed interest in the new class.
senses.example_cn: 她对这门新课表现出了兴趣。

senses.gloss_en: a hobby or subject you enjoy doing or learning
senses.example_en: Music is my main interest right now.
senses.example_cn: 音乐是我现在最大的爱好。

senses.gloss_en: to attract your attention and make you think about it
senses.example_en: This story interests me and I want to read more.
senses.example_cn: 这个故事让我很感兴趣，我还想往下读。

senses.gloss_en: a thought or belief about someone or something
senses.example_en: In my opinion this is a good idea.
senses.example_cn: 在我看来，这是个好主意。

senses.gloss_en: what a group of people thinks about something
senses.example_en: Public opinion changed after the news came out.
senses.example_cn: 消息传出后，公众舆论变了。

senses.gloss_en: a good or bad view of someone
senses.example_en: I have a good opinion of her work.
senses.example_cn: 我对她的工作评价很高。

senses.gloss_en: to dislike someone or something very much
senses.example_en: I hate cold weather in winter.
senses.example_cn: 我讨厌冬天寒冷的天气。

senses.gloss_en: a very strong feeling of dislike
senses.example_en: His hate for the man grew every day.
senses.example_cn: 他对那个人的恨意与日俱增。

senses.gloss_en: to not want to do something unpleasant
senses.example_en: I hate to interrupt, but we must go.
senses.example_cn: 我不想打断你，但我们得走了。

senses.gloss_en: feeling pleasure, joy, or satisfaction
senses.example_en: I feel happy when I talk with my friends.
senses.example_cn: 和朋友聊天的时候我很开心。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel pleased and satisfied
senses.example_en: It was a happy day for our family.
senses.example_cn: 那天对我们全家来说是个开心的日子。

senses.gloss_en: willing and pleased to do something
senses.example_en: I'm happy to help you with your homework.
senses.example_cn: 我很乐意帮你做作业。

senses.gloss_en: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
senses.example_en: The kids are excited about the trip tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们为明天的旅行感到很兴奋。

senses.gloss_en: nervous or upset, unable to relax
senses.example_en: I felt excited before the test and I was shaking.
senses.example_cn: 考试前我紧张得发抖。

senses.gloss_en: wanting to know more about something
senses.example_en: She is interested in art and music.
senses.example_cn: 她对艺术和音乐很感兴趣。

senses.gloss_en: wanting to do or have something
senses.example_en: I'm interested in buying that camera.
senses.example_cn: 我有意买那台相机。

senses.gloss_en: tired and impatient, not interested in something
senses.example_en: I was bored during the long meeting.
senses.example_cn: 那个长会开得我很无聊。

senses.gloss_en: having strong feelings about something unfair or bad
senses.example_en: Dad got angry when I broke the phone.
senses.example_cn: 我把手机弄坏了，爸爸很生气。

senses.gloss_en: feeling fear, frightened
senses.example_en: I was afraid in the dark room.
senses.example_cn: 我在黑屋子里很害怕。

senses.gloss_en: worried that something bad might happen
senses.example_en: He was afraid he would miss the bus.
senses.example_cn: 他担心自己会赶不上公交车。

senses.gloss_en: used to say something politely, often bad news
senses.example_en: I'm afraid I can't help you today.
senses.example_cn: 恐怕我今天帮不了你。

senses.gloss_en: unhappy or showing unhappiness
senses.example_en: She felt sad after the movie ended.
senses.example_cn: 电影结束后她心里很难过。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel unhappy
senses.example_en: It is a sad story about a lost dog.
senses.example_cn: 这是个关于一只走失小狗的伤心故事。

senses.gloss_en: not satisfactory, not as good as expected
senses.example_en: The room was in a sad state.
senses.example_cn: 那间屋子的状况很糟糕。

senses.gloss_en: loved very much, important to you
senses.example_en: My dog is dear to me.
senses.example_cn: 这只狗对我来说很珍贵。

senses.gloss_en: used before a name in a letter, or to address someone
senses.example_en: I wrote Dear Mom at the top of the letter.
senses.gloss_cn: 亲爱的（信件或称呼用语）
senses.example_cn: 我在信的开头写了：亲爱的妈妈。

senses.gloss_en: expensive, costing a lot of money
senses.example_en: Food is dear now in that store.
senses.example_cn: 那家店现在东西很贵。

senses.gloss_en: having a very high temperature
senses.example_en: The soup is hot, so wait a minute.
senses.example_cn: 汤很烫，等一会儿再喝。

senses.gloss_en: feeling too warm
senses.example_en: I am hot in this jacket today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天穿着这件夹克觉得很热。

senses.gloss_en: having a burning spicy taste
senses.example_en: This curry is hot but I like it.
senses.example_cn: 这个咖喱很辣，不过我喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: at a pleasant temperature, not hot or cold
senses.example_en: It is warm today so we walk outside.
senses.example_cn: 今天挺暖和，我们到外面走走。

senses.gloss_en: friendly, showing kindness or love
senses.example_en: She gave me a warm smile at home.
senses.example_cn: 在家里她对我露出了亲切的笑容。

senses.gloss_en: to make something warmer, or become warmer
senses.example_en: Please warm the soup in the kitchen now.
senses.example_cn: 请把汤在厨房热一下再吃。

senses.gloss_en: slightly cold, not warm or hot
senses.example_en: The water is cool and my hands feel good.
senses.example_cn: 水是凉的，我的手感觉很舒服。

senses.gloss_en: good, stylish, or fashionable
senses.example_en: That hat looks cool on my brother.
senses.example_cn: 那顶帽子我弟弟戴着很酷。

senses.gloss_en: to become cooler, or make something cooler
senses.example_en: Let the tea cool before you drink it.
senses.example_cn: 喝茶前先让它凉一凉。

senses.gloss_en: having a low temperature
senses.example_en: My feet are cold and I need socks.
senses.example_cn: 我的脚很冷，得穿袜子。

senses.gloss_en: cold weather, a low temperature
senses.example_en: I hate the cold in winter at home.
senses.example_cn: 我讨厌家里冬天的寒冷。

senses.gloss_en: a common illness in your nose and throat
senses.example_en: I have a cold so I stay home.
senses.example_cn: 我感冒了，所以待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: wanting to eat food
senses.example_en: I am hungry and I want dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我饿了，想吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: not having enough food to eat
senses.example_en: Many hungry people need food and help.
senses.example_cn: 很多饥饿的人需要食物和帮助。

senses.gloss_en: wanting something very much
senses.example_en: She is hungry for success in her work.
senses.example_cn: 她渴望在工作中取得成功。

senses.gloss_en: needing or wanting a drink
senses.example_en: I am thirsty after dance class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天上完舞蹈课我很渴。

senses.gloss_en: making you want to drink
senses.example_en: Hot weather is thirsty work for my body.
senses.example_cn: 天热干活容易让人口渴。

senses.gloss_en: wanting something very much
senses.example_en: He is thirsty for knowledge about the world.
senses.example_cn: 他渴望了解这个世界。

senses.gloss_en: containing as much as possible
senses.example_en: The box is full of books and paper.
senses.example_cn: 这个箱子装满了书和纸。

senses.gloss_en: having eaten enough food
senses.example_en: I am full so I do not want cake.
senses.example_cn: 我吃饱了，所以不想吃蛋糕。

senses.gloss_en: complete, with nothing missing
senses.example_en: Please write your full name on this form.
senses.example_cn: 请在这张表上写下你的全名。

senses.gloss_en: having good health, not sick
senses.example_en: She is healthy and strong after the walk.
senses.example_cn: 走了这一趟，她依然健康有力。

senses.gloss_en: good for your health
senses.example_en: I eat healthy food at home every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天在家吃健康的食物。

senses.gloss_en: showing good health
senses.example_en: He has a healthy glow in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 早上他的气色看起来很健康。

senses.gloss_en: Not well, ill
senses.example_en: I feel sick today and stay home.
senses.example_cn: 我今天不舒服，待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: Feeling like you will vomit
senses.example_en: The boat made me sick after ten minutes.
senses.example_cn: 坐船十分钟后我就想吐了。

senses.gloss_en: Very bored or annoyed with something
senses.example_en: I am sick of that song on repeat.
senses.example_cn: 那首歌一直放，我听腻了。

senses.gloss_en: Not dirty
senses.example_en: The floor is clean after I wash it.
senses.example_cn: 我擦过以后地板很干净。

senses.gloss_en: Free from dirt, pollution, or bacteria
senses.example_en: We need clean water to drink every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天都需要洁净的水来喝。

senses.gloss_en: Remove dirt from something
senses.example_en: I clean the table before we eat.
senses.example_cn: 吃饭前我把桌子擦干净。

senses.gloss_en: Not clean, covered with dirt or mud
senses.example_en: My shoes are dirty after the rain.
senses.example_cn: 下过雨以后我的鞋很脏。

senses.gloss_en: Having pollution, dirt, or bacteria in it
senses.example_en: Do not drink dirty water in the street.
senses.example_cn: 别喝街上的脏水。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with sex, offensive
senses.example_en: He told a dirty joke at work.
senses.example_cn: 他在单位讲了个下流的笑话。

senses.gloss_en: Not closed
senses.example_en: The door is open and the cat left.
senses.example_cn: 门开着，猫跑出去了。

senses.gloss_en: Ready to provide a service
senses.example_en: The store is open until nine tonight.
senses.example_cn: 这家店今晚营业到九点。

senses.gloss_en: Make something not closed
senses.example_en: Please open the window for fresh air.
senses.example_cn: 请把窗户打开，透透新鲜空气。

senses.gloss_en: Fully prepared to start something
senses.example_en: I am ready to start the test now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在准备好开始考试了。

senses.gloss_en: Finished and available to use
senses.example_en: Dinner is ready and we can eat now.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭做好了，我们现在可以吃了。

senses.gloss_en: Willing to do something
senses.example_en: She is ready to help you today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天愿意帮你。

senses.gloss_en: Having a lot to do
senses.example_en: I am busy today and cannot talk.
senses.example_cn: 我今天很忙，没空聊天。

senses.gloss_en: Full of people and activity
senses.example_en: This street is busy in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 这条街早上人来车往很热闹。

senses.gloss_en: Being used, not available
senses.example_en: The phone is busy so try again later.
senses.example_cn: 电话占线，过一会儿再打吧。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: Not busy, with no plans
senses.example_en: Are you free on Friday evening?
senses.example_cn: 你星期五晚上有空吗？

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: Costing nothing
senses.example_en: The museum is free for children today.
senses.example_cn: 今天博物馆对儿童免费。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: Able to do what you want, not controlled
senses.example_en: People should be free to say what they think.
senses.example_cn: 人们应该可以自由地说出自己的想法。

senses.gloss_en: Making very little noise
senses.example_en: The room is quiet at night.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间夜里很安静。

senses.gloss_en: Without many people or activity
senses.example_en: We walked on a quiet street after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们走在一条冷清的街上。

senses.gloss_en: Not talking much
senses.example_en: He is quiet and listens to everyone.
senses.example_cn: 他话不多，听大家说。

senses.gloss_en: Having a husband or wife
senses.example_en: Is he married, or is he single?
senses.example_cn: 他结婚了，还是单身？

senses.gloss_en: Connected with marriage
senses.example_en: She uses her married name at work now.
senses.example_cn: 她现在在单位用的是婚后的姓。

senses.gloss_en: Very involved in something, with no time for others
senses.example_en: My brother is married to his job all week.
senses.example_cn: 我哥哥整个星期都一心扑在工作上。

senses.gloss_en: Having all parts, with nothing missing
senses.example_en: I need a complete list of your names.
senses.example_cn: 我需要一份写着你们名字的完整名单。

senses.gloss_en: Finished, with no more work needed
senses.example_en: The job is complete, so we can rest.
senses.example_cn: 活儿干完了，我们可以歇一歇了。

senses.gloss_en: To finish something, or make it whole
senses.example_en: I need one more card to complete the set.
senses.example_cn: 我再要一张卡片就能把这套凑齐了。

senses.gloss_en: Needing rest or sleep
senses.example_en: I feel tired after the long day today.
senses.example_cn: 今天忙了一整天，我觉得很累。

senses.gloss_en: bored with something because you have had too much of it
senses.example_en: She is tired of the same food every day.
senses.example_cn: 她厌倦了每天都吃一样的饭菜。

senses.gloss_en: Boring because it is too familiar
senses.example_en: Those tired old jokes make no one laugh now.
senses.example_cn: 那些老掉牙的笑话现在谁也不笑了。

senses.gloss_en: large in size or amount
senses.example_en: We have a big room at home.
senses.example_cn: 我们家有一个大房间。

senses.gloss_en: older, more like an adult
senses.example_en: My big brother meets us at home.
senses.example_cn: 我哥哥在家里跟我们见面。

senses.gloss_en: important or serious
senses.example_en: This is a big problem for my family.
senses.example_cn: 这对我家来说是个大问题。

senses.gloss_en: little in size or amount
senses.example_en: I have a small box in my room.
senses.example_cn: 我房间里有一个小盒子。

senses.gloss_en: very young
senses.example_en: She has two small children at home.
senses.example_cn: 她家里有两个年幼的孩子。

senses.gloss_en: not important or serious
senses.example_en: It was a small mistake, not a big problem.
senses.example_cn: 那只是个小错，不是什么大问题。

senses.gloss_en: big in size or amount
senses.example_en: We live in a large house near town.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在城边一栋很大的房子里。

senses.gloss_en: used for clothes of a big size
senses.example_en: I need a large shirt for my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我要给我弟弟买件大号的衬衫。

senses.gloss_en: important or having a big effect
senses.example_en: She has a large role in the project.
senses.example_cn: 她在这个项目中起了重要作用。

senses.gloss_en: more than average height
senses.example_en: My sister is tall, and my brother is short.
senses.example_cn: 我姐姐个子高，我弟弟个子矮。

senses.gloss_en: having a particular height
senses.example_en: The wall is six feet tall.
senses.example_cn: 这面墙有六英尺高。

senses.gloss_en: not long in length
senses.example_en: I have short hair, not long hair.
senses.example_cn: 我的头发是短的，不是长的。

senses.gloss_en: lasting a small time
senses.example_en: We take a short break, then we work.
senses.example_cn: 我们先短暂休息一下，然后再工作。

senses.gloss_en: not as tall as most people
senses.example_en: My dad is short, but my mom is tall.
senses.example_cn: 我爸爸个子矮，但我妈妈个子高。

senses.gloss_en: not short in length
senses.example_en: I have long hair and long legs.
senses.example_cn: 我头发长，腿也长。

senses.gloss_en: lasting a long time
senses.example_en: It was a long day, but we were happy.
senses.example_cn: 这一天很长，但我们很开心。

senses.gloss_en: for much time
senses.example_en: I did not stay long at the party.
senses.example_cn: 我在聚会上没待多久。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: far above the ground
senses.example_en: The bird is high above the tall trees.
senses.example_cn: 那只鸟高高地飞在大树上方。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: above average in level, price, or amount
senses.example_en: Food is high in price this week.
senses.example_cn: 这周食品价格很高。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, adv. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: to a great height
senses.example_en: The ball goes high, and we all watch.
senses.example_cn: 球飞得很高，我们都看着。

senses.gloss_en: having too much body fat
senses.example_en: The dog is fat, so it needs to eat less.
senses.example_cn: 这只狗太胖了，得少吃点。

senses.gloss_en: thick and wide
senses.example_en: He has a fat book on his desk.
senses.example_cn: 他桌上有一本厚厚的书。

senses.gloss_en: oily substance from animals or plants
senses.example_en: There is fat in meat, but not in fruit.
senses.example_cn: 肉里有脂肪，水果里没有。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, n. A2, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: more than usual, additional
senses.example_en: I need extra time to finish this work.
senses.example_cn: 我需要额外的时间来做完这项工作。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, n. A2, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: something added, usually for more money
senses.example_en: Breakfast is an extra, and we pay more.
senses.example_cn: 早餐要另外收费，我们得多付钱。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A1, n. A2, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: more than usual
senses.example_en: This room is extra cold today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这个房间格外冷。

senses.gloss_en: Very pleasant to look at
senses.example_en: The beach is beautiful at sunset today.
senses.example_cn: 今天日落时的海滩很美。

senses.gloss_en: Very pleasant to hear or experience
senses.example_en: We heard beautiful music in the park today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我们在公园里听到了优美的音乐。

senses.gloss_en: Very good, excellent
senses.example_en: That is a beautiful plan for our trip.
senses.example_cn: 那是我们这次旅行的一个绝妙计划。

senses.gloss_en: Behaving in a kind and pleasant way
senses.example_en: The staff are friendly to my mom today.
senses.example_cn: 那些工作人员今天对我妈妈很友好。

senses.gloss_en: Pleasant and making you feel happy and comfortable
senses.example_en: It is a friendly café, with soft music.
senses.example_cn: 这是一家很温馨的咖啡馆，还放着轻柔的音乐。

senses.gloss_en: Played for pleasure, not to win
senses.example_en: They played a friendly match on Sunday.
senses.example_cn: 周日他们打了一场友谊赛。

senses.gloss_en: Quick at learning and understanding things
senses.example_en: She is smart and remembers every new word.
senses.example_cn: 她很聪明，每个新词都记得住。

senses.gloss_en: Showing good judgment, a good decision
senses.example_en: It was smart to save money for later.
senses.example_cn: 存钱留着以后用，这是明智的做法。

senses.gloss_en: Looking clean and neat, well dressed
senses.example_en: He looks smart in a suit for work.
senses.example_cn: 他上班穿西装，看起来很精神。

senses.gloss_en: used before a noun for a specific known thing
senses.example_en: I found the key, and the door is open.
senses.gloss_cn: 定冠词，指特定的人或物
senses.example_cn: 我找到了那把钥匙，门开了。

senses.gloss_en: used when there is only one of something
senses.example_en: The sun is hot today, and the sky is blue.
senses.gloss_cn: 定冠词，用于独一无二的事物
senses.example_cn: 今天太阳很晒，天空很蓝。

senses.gloss_en: used before superlatives and ordinal numbers
senses.example_en: She is the best dancer in the class.
senses.gloss_cn: 定冠词，用于最高级和序数词
senses.example_cn: 她是全班跳舞最好的人。

senses.gloss_en: used before a singular noun, not known or not specific
senses.example_en: I saw a dog in the yard today.
senses.gloss_cn: 不定冠词，指不确定的一个
senses.example_cn: 我今天在院子里看见一只狗。

senses.gloss_en: used to say what type of person or thing
senses.example_en: He is an engineer and a good teacher.
senses.gloss_cn: 不定冠词，说明身份或种类
senses.example_cn: 他是工程师，也是个好老师。

senses.gloss_en: used to mean one each, for a rate
senses.example_en: I pay a dollar a day for coffee.
senses.example_cn: 我每天花一美元喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: used to refer to a person or thing near you
senses.example_en: This room is small, but this bed is big.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间很小，但这张床很大。

senses.gloss_en: the thing that is near you or just mentioned
senses.example_en: Take this and put it in the box.
senses.gloss_cn: 这（指代近处或刚提到的事物）
senses.example_cn: 拿着这个，把它放进盒子里。

senses.gloss_en: to this degree, so much
senses.example_en: I am this tired after a long day.
senses.example_cn: 忙了一整天，我累成这样。

senses.headword_tail: det., pron., conj. A1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: used to refer to a person or thing not near
senses.example_en: Look at that house across the street.
senses.example_cn: 看街对面那栋房子。

senses.headword_tail: det., pron., conj. A1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: the thing that is not near or mentioned before
senses.example_en: That is my apartment, not your house.
senses.gloss_cn: 那（指代较远或前面提过的事物）
senses.example_cn: 那是我的公寓，不是你的房子。

senses.headword_tail: det., pron., conj. A1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: used to introduce a clause after a verb
senses.example_en: I believe that she is at home today.
senses.example_cn: 我相信她今天在家。

senses.gloss_en: of or belonging to me
senses.example_en: This is my room, and that is my bed.
senses.example_cn: 这是我的房间，那是我的床。

senses.gloss_en: of or belonging to the person you are speaking to
senses.example_en: Is this your phone, or is it mine?
senses.example_cn: 这是你的手机，还是我的？

senses.gloss_en: used to talk about people in general
senses.example_en: Brush your teeth every day to stay healthy.
senses.example_cn: 每天都要刷牙，这样身体才健康。

senses.gloss_en: of or belonging to a man or boy
senses.example_en: His sister and his brother meet him at home.
senses.example_cn: 他姐姐和他哥哥在家里跟他见面。

senses.gloss_en: the one that belongs to him
senses.example_en: This bag is his, not mine.
senses.example_cn: 这个包是他的，不是我的。

senses.gloss_en: of or belonging to a thing or animal
senses.example_en: The dog hurt its paw, so it is sad.
senses.example_cn: 那只狗弄伤了它的爪子，所以很难过。

senses.gloss_en: Belonging to us
senses.example_en: This is our room in the new house.
senses.example_cn: 这是我们在新房子里的房间。

senses.gloss_en: Belonging to them
senses.example_en: Their car is outside the house.
senses.example_cn: 他们的车停在房子外面。

senses.gloss_en: Used for one person, sex not known
senses.example_en: If someone calls, take their name and number.
senses.gloss_cn: 他的或她的（性别不明的人）
senses.example_cn: 要是有人打电话来，记下他的名字和电话号码。

senses.gloss_en: An amount or number, not stated
senses.example_en: I need some water after the long walk.
senses.example_cn: 走了这么远的路，我需要喝一些水。

senses.gloss_en: Certain ones, but not all
senses.example_en: Some people like tea, some people like coffee.
senses.example_cn: 有些人喜欢喝茶，有些人喜欢喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: Some of a group of people or things
senses.example_en: I took some and I left some for you.
senses.gloss_cn: 一些（代指前面说过的东西）
senses.example_cn: 我拿走了一些，也给你留了一些。

senses.gloss_en: One or more, even the smallest amount
senses.example_en: I do not have any money today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天一点钱也没有。

senses.gloss_en: It does not matter which one
senses.example_en: You can pick any seat in this room.
senses.gloss_cn: 任何一个（随便哪个都行）
senses.example_cn: 这个房间里的座位你随便挑。

senses.gloss_en: Any of the people or things
senses.example_en: If you see any, call me right away.
senses.gloss_cn: 任何一个（代指前面说的东西）
senses.example_cn: 要是你看到任何一个，马上给我打电话。

senses.gloss_en: Used to answer in the negative
senses.example_en: No, I cannot go today because I am busy.
senses.example_cn: 不，我今天不能去，因为我很忙。

senses.gloss_en: Not any, not one
senses.example_en: There is no milk in the fridge.
senses.example_cn: 冰箱里没有牛奶。

senses.gloss_en: Used on signs to say something is forbidden
senses.example_en: No smoking in this room during class.
senses.example_cn: 上课期间这间屋子里禁止吸烟。

senses.gloss_en: Each member of a group, without exception
senses.example_en: Every student has a name on the list.
senses.example_cn: 名单上每个学生都有名字。

senses.gloss_en: Repeated at each time period
senses.example_en: We meet every week at this table.
senses.example_cn: 我们每个星期都在这张桌子这儿见面。

senses.gloss_en: Every one separately, one by one
senses.example_en: Each child has a book in their bag.
senses.example_cn: 每个孩子的书包里都有一本书。

senses.gloss_en: Each one of two or more
senses.example_en: Each of them has a key.
senses.example_cn: 他们每个人都有一把钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: For each one
senses.example_en: The apples are two dollars each.
senses.example_cn: 这些苹果每个两美元。

senses.gloss_en: The two together
senses.example_en: Both doors are open in the house.
senses.example_cn: 房子里两扇门都开着。

senses.gloss_en: Both of two people or things
senses.example_en: I like them both very much.
senses.example_cn: 他们两个我都很喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: the whole number, amount, or time
senses.example_en: All my friends are here, and we are happy.
senses.example_cn: 我所有的朋友都来了，我们都很开心。

senses.gloss_en: everyone or everything in a group
senses.example_en: All are ready, and we can start now.
senses.example_cn: 大家都准备好了，我们可以开始了。

senses.gloss_en: completely, in every way
senses.example_en: I am all wet after the rain today.
senses.example_cn: 今天下了雨，我全身都湿透了。

senses.gloss_en: small in size or amount
senses.example_en: We live in a little house near the park.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在公园附近的一间小房子里。

senses.gloss_en: not much, only a small amount
senses.example_en: There is little water in the bottle today.
senses.example_cn: 今天瓶子里的水很少。

senses.gloss_en: not much, only to a small degree
senses.example_en: I sleep little, but I still feel fine.
senses.example_cn: 我睡得很少，但还是觉得挺好。

senses.gloss_en: not many, almost none
senses.example_en: Few people come here in the winter.
senses.gloss_cn: 很少的人或物（几乎没有）
senses.example_cn: 冬天很少有人来这里。

senses.gloss_en: a small number of people or things
senses.example_en: Only a few are ready for the trip.
senses.example_cn: 只有几个人为这次旅行做好了准备。

senses.gloss_en: a large amount of something
senses.example_en: How much water do you need for tea?
senses.gloss_cn: 很多（修饰不可数的东西）
senses.example_cn: 泡茶你需要多少水？

senses.gloss_en: used before comparatives to mean a lot
senses.example_en: This car is much faster than my old one.
senses.example_cn: 这辆车比我的旧车快得多。

senses.gloss_en: to a great extent, a lot
senses.example_en: I don't eat much when I am sick.
senses.gloss_cn: 多（用在动词后表示程度）
senses.example_cn: 我生病的时候吃得不多。

senses.gloss_en: a large number of people or things
senses.example_en: Many people like this movie, and I do too.
senses.example_cn: 很多人喜欢这部电影，我也喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: a large number, not just a few
senses.example_en: Many were tired, but they kept walking.
senses.gloss_cn: 很多（代指前面说的人或物）
senses.example_cn: 很多人都累了，但他们还是继续走。

senses.gloss_en: an additional amount or number
senses.example_en: Do you want more water, or are you full?
senses.example_cn: 你还要水吗，还是已经喝饱了？

senses.gloss_en: a larger amount or number than before
senses.example_en: More people came today than yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 今天来的人比昨天多。

senses.gloss_en: to a greater degree
senses.example_en: I like coffee more than tea today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我比起茶来更喜欢咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: the largest number or amount
senses.example_en: She has the most books in the class.
senses.example_cn: 她的书是班里最多的。

senses.gloss_en: nearly all, almost the whole
senses.example_en: Most people are busy, so the room is quiet.
senses.example_cn: 大多数人都很忙，所以房间里很安静。

senses.gloss_en: used to form superlatives
senses.example_en: This is the most important part of the test.
senses.example_cn: 这是这次考试最重要的部分。

senses.gloss_en: a large number or amount
senses.example_en: A lot of them are here, but a few are late.
senses.example_cn: 他们中很多人都到了，只有几个人迟到。

senses.gloss_en: used before a noun for a large amount
senses.example_en: We have a lot of work today at home.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天在家里有很多活要干。

senses.gloss_en: very much, very often
senses.example_en: I miss my family a lot when I travel.
senses.example_cn: 我旅行的时候非常想念家人。

senses.gloss_en: an amount equal to 50 percent
senses.example_en: Half the milk is gone, so buy more.
senses.example_cn: 牛奶喝掉一半了，再去买点。

senses.gloss_en: one of two equal parts
senses.example_en: Cut the apple in half, then eat half.
senses.example_cn: 把苹果切成两半，然后吃一半。

senses.gloss_en: partly, not completely
senses.example_en: I was half asleep, so I missed the call.
senses.example_cn: 我半睡半醒的，没接到那个电话。

senses.gloss_en: as much or as many as needed
senses.example_en: Do we have enough water for the trip?
senses.example_cn: 这次旅行我们的水够吗？

senses.gloss_en: a sufficient amount
senses.example_en: I have enough, so I will stop now.
senses.example_cn: 我已经够了，所以我现在就停下。

senses.gloss_en: to the needed degree
senses.example_en: Is the soup hot enough for you now?
senses.example_cn: 这汤现在对你来说够热了吗？

senses.gloss_en: one more, an extra one
senses.example_en: Can I have another chair for the table?
senses.example_cn: 能再给这张桌子加一把椅子吗？

senses.gloss_en: different, not the one before
senses.example_en: Let's do it another day, not today.
senses.example_cn: 我们另外挑一天做吧，今天不做。

senses.gloss_en: a different one of the same kind
senses.example_en: This key is broken, so give me another.
senses.example_cn: 这把钥匙坏了，给我另一把。

senses.gloss_en: happening after all others, final
senses.example_en: This is the last bus, so hurry.
senses.example_cn: 这是最后一班公交车，快点吧。

senses.gloss_en: most recent, nearest to the present
senses.example_en: Last week we met and talked at home.
senses.example_cn: 上个星期我们在家见面聊了聊。

senses.gloss_en: only remaining, with no others left
senses.example_en: This is our last key, so be careful.
senses.example_cn: 这是我们仅剩的一把钥匙，小心点。

senses.gloss_en: Linking verb for names, jobs, or qualities
senses.example_en: I am happy and my brother is tired.
senses.gloss_cn: 是（连接名称、身份或性质）
senses.example_cn: 我很开心，我哥哥很累。

senses.gloss_en: To be in a place or position
senses.example_en: The book is on the table.
senses.example_cn: 那本书在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: Used with -ing to form the continuous
senses.example_en: We are eating dinner at home now.
senses.gloss_cn: 与现在分词连用构成进行时
senses.example_cn: 我们现在正在家里吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: Used before a verb for questions, negatives
senses.example_en: I do not like fish at home.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于动词前构成疑问或否定
senses.example_cn: 在家我不喜欢吃鱼。

senses.gloss_en: To perform a task or activity
senses.example_en: I do my work in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 我早上做我的工作。

senses.gloss_en: Used instead of repeating a full verb
senses.example_en: She plays better than she did last year.
senses.gloss_cn: 代替前面出现过的动词
senses.example_cn: 她现在打得比去年好。

senses.gloss_en: Need to do something, no choice
senses.example_en: I have to go to work today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天必须去上班。

senses.gloss_en: Not necessary, with do not have to
senses.example_en: You do not have to pay today.
senses.chunk: do not have to pay today
senses.example_cn: 你今天不必付钱。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say you are certain something is true
senses.example_en: It has to be late now.
senses.example_cn: 现在肯定已经晚了。

senses.gloss_en: Able to do something
senses.example_en: She can swim in the sea today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天能在海里游泳。

senses.gloss_en: Allowed to do something
senses.example_en: You can use my phone for a call.
senses.example_cn: 你可以用我的手机打个电话。

senses.gloss_en: Used to ask or offer help
senses.example_en: Can I help you with that bag today?
senses.example_cn: 今天我帮你拿那个包好吗？

senses.gloss_en: Not able to do something
senses.example_en: I cannot open the door today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天打不开这扇门。

senses.gloss_en: Not allowed to do something
senses.example_en: You cannot park your car here today.
senses.example_cn: 你今天不能把车停在这里。

senses.gloss_en: Impossible or not true
senses.example_en: That cannot be true because I saw it.
senses.example_cn: 那不可能是真的，因为我亲眼看见了。

senses.gloss_en: Necessary, required by a rule or law
senses.example_en: All visitors must report to reception now.
senses.example_cn: 所有来访者现在都必须到前台登记。

senses.gloss_en: Very important to do something
senses.example_en: You must call your mother today.
senses.example_cn: 你今天一定要给你妈妈打个电话。

senses.gloss_en: Very sure something is true
senses.example_en: He must be tired after work today.
senses.example_cn: 他今天上了一天班，一定累了。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say the best thing to do
senses.example_en: You should rest now and drink some water.
senses.example_cn: 你现在应该休息一下，喝点水。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say something is likely to happen
senses.example_en: The bus should arrive soon, but it is late.
senses.gloss_cn: 表示某事很可能会发生
senses.example_cn: 公交车应该快到了，不过它晚了。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say someone did the wrong thing
senses.example_en: You should have called me before you came home.
senses.example_cn: 你回家之前本该给我打个电话。

senses.gloss_en: Used to talk about the future
senses.example_en: I will meet you at the house tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 明天我会在那栋房子那里和你见面。

senses.gloss_en: Used to offer or agree to do something
senses.example_en: I will help you with this box.
senses.example_cn: 我来帮你搬这个箱子。

senses.gloss_en: Strong determination to do something
senses.example_en: Her will is strong, and she never stops.
senses.example_cn: 她意志坚强，从来不停下来。

senses.gloss_en: Used with like to say what you want
senses.example_en: I would like a coffee, please.
senses.gloss_cn: 表示客气地说出想要什么
senses.example_cn: 我想要一杯咖啡，谢谢。

senses.gloss_en: Used as the past form of will
senses.example_en: He said he would meet us after work.
senses.gloss_cn: 表示过去看来将要做的事
senses.example_cn: 他说他下班后会来见我们。

senses.gloss_en: Used to talk about an imagined situation
senses.example_en: I would go home, but I have work.
senses.example_cn: 我本想回家，可是我还有活儿要干。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say someone was able to do something
senses.example_en: When I was young, I could run fast.
senses.example_cn: 我小的时候能跑得很快。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say something is possible
senses.example_en: It could rain today, so take a jacket.
senses.example_cn: 今天可能会下雨，带件外套吧。

senses.gloss_en: Used to ask politely for permission
senses.example_en: Could I use the bathroom please.
senses.example_cn: 我能用一下卫生间吗？

senses.gloss_en: The day after Sunday, before Tuesday, often the first work day
senses.example_en: I work on Monday and I relax at home.
senses.example_cn: 我星期一上班，然后在家休息。

senses.gloss_en: The day of the week after Monday, before Wednesday
senses.example_en: We meet on Tuesday at my apartment.
senses.example_cn: 我们星期二在我的公寓见。

senses.gloss_en: The day of the week after Tuesday, before Thursday
senses.example_en: The class is on Wednesday in the kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 那节课在星期三，在厨房里上。

senses.gloss_en: The day of the week after Wednesday, before Friday
senses.example_en: I have a meeting on Thursday at noon.
senses.example_cn: 我星期四中午有个会。

senses.gloss_en: The day of the week after Thursday, before Saturday
senses.example_en: We dance on Friday and say goodbye.
senses.example_cn: 星期五我们跳了舞，然后互相道别。

senses.gloss_en: The day of the week after Friday, before Sunday
senses.example_en: On Saturday we clean the house then relax.
senses.example_cn: 星期六我们打扫房子，然后放松一下。

senses.gloss_en: The day after Saturday, before Monday, often a rest day
senses.example_en: On Sunday we visit my aunt and uncle.
senses.example_cn: 星期天我们去看姑姑和姑父。

senses.gloss_en: The first month of the year
senses.example_en: In January it is cold so I wear a coat.
senses.example_cn: 一月天冷，所以我穿大衣。

senses.gloss_en: The second month of the year
senses.example_en: In February the air is cold and days are short.
senses.example_cn: 二月空气很冷，白天也短。

senses.gloss_en: The third month of the year
senses.example_en: In March the weather changes and we feel hopeful.
senses.example_cn: 三月天气变了，我们心里也有了希望。

senses.gloss_en: The fourth month of the year
