senses.example_en: In April I open the window and clean my room.
senses.example_cn: 四月里我打开窗户，打扫房间。

senses.gloss_en: The fifth month of the year
senses.example_en: In May we spend more time outside.
senses.example_cn: 五月我们会花更多时间待在外面。

senses.gloss_en: The sixth month of the year
senses.example_en: In June school ends and we start our trip.
senses.example_cn: 六月学校放假，我们的旅行就开始了。

senses.gloss_en: The seventh month of the year
senses.example_en: We moved in July, after the long trip.
senses.example_cn: 我们是七月搬家的，就在那趟长途旅行之后。

senses.gloss_en: The eighth month of the year
senses.example_en: School starts in August, but it is hot.
senses.example_cn: 学校八月开学，可天还很热。

senses.gloss_en: The ninth month of the year
senses.example_en: I start work in September, not in August.
senses.example_cn: 我九月开始上班，不是八月。

senses.gloss_en: The tenth month of the year
senses.example_en: Leaves fall in October and nights get cold.
senses.example_cn: 十月树叶飘落，夜里也变冷了。

senses.gloss_en: The eleventh month of the year
senses.example_en: We travel in November, before winter begins.
senses.example_cn: 我们十一月出去旅行，在冬天开始之前。

senses.gloss_en: The twelfth, last month of the year
senses.example_en: They celebrate in December, near the end of the year.
senses.example_cn: 他们在十二月庆祝，那时快到年底了。

senses.gloss_en: A unit of time, one sixtieth of a minute
senses.example_en: The race ended in five seconds.
senses.example_cn: 这场比赛五秒钟就结束了。

senses.gloss_en: A very short time
senses.example_en: Wait a second, I need my phone.
senses.example_cn: 等一下，我得拿手机。

senses.gloss_en: A unit of time, 60 seconds
senses.example_en: The train leaves in ten minutes.
senses.example_cn: 火车十分钟后开。

senses.gloss_en: A very short time
senses.example_en: Give me a minute, I am busy.
senses.example_cn: 等我一会儿，我正忙着。

senses.gloss_en: A period of 60 minutes
senses.example_en: The class is one hour, not two.
senses.example_cn: 这节课只有一个小时，不是两个小时。

senses.gloss_en: The time a store, office is open
senses.example_en: Our hours are from eight to six.
senses.example_cn: 我们的营业时间是八点到六点。

senses.gloss_en: A period of 24 hours
senses.example_en: I will stay for one more day.
senses.example_cn: 我会再多待一天。

senses.gloss_en: Time between morning and night
senses.example_en: I like long days in summer.
senses.example_cn: 我喜欢夏天白天很长。

senses.gloss_en: Time spent at work or school
senses.example_en: I had a busy day at the office.
senses.gloss_cn: 一天的上班或上学时间
senses.example_cn: 我今天在办公室忙了一天。

senses.gloss_en: A period of seven days
senses.example_en: We will travel next week, not today.
senses.example_cn: 我们下星期去旅行，不是今天。

senses.gloss_en: The days from Monday to Friday when people usually work
senses.example_en: I work during the week and rest on the weekend.
senses.example_cn: 我在工作日上班，周末休息。

senses.gloss_en: One of the 12 parts of a year
senses.example_en: July is my favorite month of the year.
senses.example_cn: 七月是我一年中最喜欢的月份。

senses.gloss_en: A period of about four weeks
senses.example_en: I stayed in Canada for two months.
senses.example_cn: 我在加拿大待了两个月。

senses.gloss_en: A period of 15 minutes (a quarter of an hour)
senses.example_en: It is a quarter to three now.
senses.example_cn: 现在是三点差一刻。

senses.gloss_en: One of four equal parts of something
senses.example_en: I ate a quarter of the pie.
senses.example_cn: 我吃了四分之一个派。

senses.gloss_en: A coin worth 25 cents
senses.example_en: I found a quarter in my pocket.
senses.example_cn: 我在口袋里找到一枚二十五分的硬币。

senses.gloss_en: A period of 12 months
senses.example_en: I lived in Thailand for one year.
senses.example_cn: 我在泰国住了一年。

senses.gloss_en: A person’s age in years
senses.example_en: She is twenty years old today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天二十岁了。

senses.gloss_en: A period of study in school, college
senses.example_en: The school year ends in June.
senses.example_cn: 学年在六月结束。

senses.gloss_en: Used after 1–12 to say the exact hour
senses.example_en: The meeting is at three o’clock this afternoon.
senses.example_cn: 会议在今天下午三点开。

senses.gloss_en: Coming before all others in order or time
senses.example_en: This is my first week at the new job.
senses.example_cn: 这是我在新工作岗位上的第一周。

senses.gloss_en: Before anyone or anything else
senses.example_en: Please wash your hands first, then eat dinner.
senses.example_cn: 请先洗手，然后再吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: The person or thing in first place
senses.example_en: She finished in first place.
senses.example_cn: 她拿了第一名。

senses.gloss_en: Coming after the first, number two
senses.example_en: This is the second time I forgot my keys.
senses.example_cn: 这是我第二次忘带钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: In the second position in a list
senses.example_en: My name is second on the list today.
senses.example_cn: 今天名单上我的名字排第二。

senses.gloss_en: Coming after the second
senses.example_en: This is my third time here.
senses.example_cn: 这是我第三次来这里。

senses.gloss_en: One of three equal parts of something
senses.example_en: I ate a third of the cake last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我吃了三分之一的蛋糕。

senses.gloss_en: The person or thing in third place
senses.example_en: She came in third and she felt happy.
senses.example_cn: 她得了第三名，很高兴。

senses.gloss_en: Coming after the third
senses.example_en: This is my fourth time in Quito.
senses.example_cn: 这是我第四次来基多。

senses.gloss_en: Coming after the fourth
senses.example_en: This is my fifth book.
senses.example_cn: 这是我的第五本书。

senses.gloss_en: Coming after this one in time or order
senses.example_en: The next day we meet at your home.
senses.example_cn: 第二天我们在你家见面。

senses.gloss_en: After that, then
senses.example_en: We relax, and next we meet in the kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 我们先休息一下，接下来在厨房见面。

senses.gloss_en: The person or thing after this one
senses.example_en: You are next in line after me today.
senses.example_cn: 今天你排在我后面，是下一个。

senses.gloss_en: Coming at the end, last
senses.example_en: This is the final day of our week.
senses.example_cn: 这是我们这一周的最后一天。

senses.gloss_en: Not able to change, already decided
senses.example_en: The answer is final so we stop now.
senses.example_cn: 答案是最终的，所以我们现在就到这里。

senses.gloss_en: The last game that decides the winner
senses.example_en: Our team is in the final this year.
senses.example_cn: 我们队今年进了决赛。

senses.gloss_en: Most important or largest
senses.example_en: The main room has a kitchen and a bathroom.
senses.example_cn: 主屋里有厨房和卫生间。

senses.gloss_en: Liked more than all others
senses.example_en: My favorite food is in the kitchen at home.
senses.example_cn: 我最喜欢的食物在家里的厨房里。

senses.gloss_en: A person or thing you like best
senses.example_en: This song is my favorite and I sing it.
senses.example_cn: 这首歌是我最喜欢的，我常常唱。

senses.gloss_en: A person or team expected to win
senses.example_en: Our team is the favorite to win this year.
senses.example_cn: 我们队是今年的夺冠热门。

senses.gloss_en: Of a higher standard, more suitable
senses.example_en: This room is better than that room for us.
senses.example_cn: 对我们来说，这个房间比那个房间好。

senses.gloss_en: Less ill, feeling well again
senses.example_en: I feel better today after a cold.
senses.example_cn: 感冒之后，我今天感觉好些了。

senses.gloss_en: More, or in a more successful way
senses.example_en: I can dance better when I relax at home.
senses.example_cn: 在家放松的时候，我跳舞跳得更好。

senses.gloss_en: Of the highest quality
senses.example_en: This is the best room in our apartment.
senses.example_cn: 这是我们公寓里最好的房间。

senses.gloss_en: Most suitable, the right choice
senses.example_en: The best time is next week for our trip.
senses.example_cn: 我们旅行的最佳时间是下个星期。

senses.gloss_en: In the most excellent way
senses.example_en: She sings best when she is happy.
senses.example_cn: 她高兴的时候唱得最好。

senses.gloss_en: at the present time
senses.example_en: I am busy now, so call later.
senses.example_cn: 我现在很忙，晚点再打给我。

senses.gloss_en: at this moment, without waiting
senses.example_en: Come here now, I need help.
senses.example_cn: 马上过来，我需要帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: because something is true, as a result
senses.example_en: Now that you are here, sit down.
senses.example_cn: 既然你来了，就坐下吧。

senses.gloss_en: at that time, in the past or future
senses.example_en: I lived in Canada then, in 2015.
senses.gloss_cn: 那时（过去或将来的某时）
senses.example_cn: 我那时住在加拿大，就是二〇一五年。

senses.gloss_en: next, after something else happens
senses.example_en: Finish your work, then go home.
senses.example_cn: 先把工作做完，然后再回家。

senses.gloss_en: in that case, so
senses.example_en: If you are sick, then stay home.
senses.example_cn: 你要是病了，那就待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: at a time in the future
senses.example_en: I will call you later, after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我晚点给你打电话，晚饭之后打。

senses.gloss_en: after the time or event mentioned
senses.example_en: Two hours later, the bus arrived.
senses.example_cn: 两个小时后，公交车到了。

senses.gloss_en: coming after something else
senses.example_en: Read the later chapter, not the first.
senses.example_cn: 读后面那一章，别读第一章。

senses.gloss_en: in a short time from now
senses.example_en: I will be ready soon, so wait.
senses.example_cn: 我很快就准备好了，等一下。

senses.gloss_en: a short time after something happens
senses.example_en: Soon after the show, we left.
senses.example_cn: 演出结束后不久，我们就走了。

senses.gloss_en: continuing until now, not finished
senses.example_en: I am still hungry, so I will eat.
senses.example_cn: 我还是饿，所以我要吃点东西。

senses.gloss_en: despite that, even so
senses.example_en: It was late, but we still talked.
senses.example_cn: 时间很晚了，可我们还是聊了很久。

senses.gloss_en: not moving, calm and quiet
senses.example_en: The water is still, so the boat stopped.
senses.example_cn: 水面静止不动，船就停下了。

senses.gloss_en: one more time
senses.example_en: Say your name again for me, please.
senses.example_cn: 请再说一遍你的名字。

senses.gloss_en: back to the previous state
senses.example_en: I feel sick again after the bus ride.
senses.example_cn: 坐了公交车以后我又觉得不舒服了。

senses.gloss_en: many times, repeatedly
senses.example_en: He called again and again all day.
senses.example_cn: 他一整天一遍又一遍地打电话。

senses.gloss_en: before the usual or expected time
senses.example_en: The bus was early, so I ran outside.
senses.example_cn: 公交车来早了，所以我跑到外面去。

senses.gloss_en: near the beginning of a period
senses.example_en: In the early morning, the street was quiet.
senses.gloss_cn: 初期的（一段时间的开头）
senses.example_cn: 清晨的时候，街上很安静。

senses.gloss_en: before the usual time
senses.example_en: I woke up early, then I cleaned the room.
senses.example_cn: 我起得很早，然后打扫了房间。

senses.gloss_en: after the expected or arranged time
senses.example_en: I am late for work, so I will run.
senses.example_cn: 我上班要迟到了，所以我要跑起来。

senses.gloss_en: near the end of a period
senses.example_en: It was late at night, and we slept.
senses.example_cn: 夜已经很深了，我们就睡了。

senses.gloss_en: after the expected time
senses.example_en: We arrived late, so the door was closed.
senses.example_cn: 我们到晚了，所以门已经关了。

senses.gloss_en: before now, in the past
senses.example_en: I met her two years ago, in June.
senses.example_cn: 我两年前的六月认识了她。

senses.gloss_en: at all times, on every occasion
senses.example_en: She always drinks coffee in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 她早上总是喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: for a long time, since you can remember
senses.example_en: We have always lived in this house.
senses.example_cn: 我们一直住在这栋房子里。

senses.gloss_en: used to say you can do something if needed
senses.example_en: You can always take it back tomorrow.
senses.gloss_cn: 总还可以（表示还有办法）
senses.example_cn: 你明天总还可以把它拿回去。

senses.gloss_en: in the normal way, most of the time
senses.example_en: I usually eat lunch at noon.
senses.example_cn: 我通常中午吃午饭。

senses.gloss_en: many times, on many occasions
senses.example_en: We often go to the park after school.
senses.example_cn: 放学后我们经常去公园。

senses.gloss_en: on some occasions, not all of the time
senses.example_en: I sometimes walk to work, and sometimes drive.
senses.example_cn: 我有时走路上班，有时开车。

senses.gloss_en: on one occasion only, one time
senses.example_en: I met her once at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 我在机场见过她一次。

senses.gloss_en: at some time in the past, not now
senses.example_en: This room once belonged to my grandfather.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间曾经是我爷爷的。

senses.gloss_en: when something has happened, after that
senses.example_en: Text me once you arrive at the hotel.
senses.example_cn: 你一到酒店就给我发消息。

senses.gloss_en: two times, on two occasions
senses.example_en: I visit my mom twice a week.
senses.example_cn: 我一星期去看我妈两次。

senses.gloss_en: double in quantity, rate, or size
senses.example_en: This box is twice the size of mine.
senses.example_cn: 这个盒子是我那个的两倍大。

senses.gloss_en: at any time, in questions, negatives, or with if
senses.example_en: If you ever feel tired, take a break.
senses.gloss_cn: 任何时候（用于疑问否定或条件）
senses.example_cn: 要是你什么时候觉得累了，就休息一下。

senses.gloss_en: used for emphasis in comparisons, at any time before
senses.example_en: She runs faster than ever now.
senses.gloss_cn: 以往任何时候（用于比较）
senses.example_cn: 她现在跑得比以往任何时候都快。

senses.gloss_en: not at any time, not on any occasion
senses.example_en: I never see him on Sundays.
senses.example_cn: 星期天我从来见不到他。

senses.gloss_en: used to emphasize a negative statement instead of not
senses.example_en: I never knew you had a sister.
senses.example_cn: 我从来不知道你还有个姐姐。

senses.gloss_en: Stop sleeping, become awake
senses.example_en: I wake at six on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 星期一我六点就醒了。

senses.gloss_en: Make someone stop sleeping
senses.example_en: Please wake me at seven, thank you.
senses.example_cn: 请七点叫我起床，谢谢。

senses.gloss_en: Begin doing something
senses.example_en: We start work at nine every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天九点开始工作。

senses.gloss_en: Begin to happen or exist
senses.example_en: The movie starts at seven tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚的电影七点开始。

senses.gloss_en: The point where something begins
senses.example_en: The start of the week is Monday.
senses.example_cn: 一周的开始是星期一。

senses.gloss_en: Start doing something
senses.example_en: The class begins at eight today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这节课八点开始。

senses.gloss_en: Start to happen or exist
senses.example_en: It began to rain after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后开始下雨了。

senses.gloss_en: Do something first, as the first step
senses.example_en: Begin with the main idea, then add more.
senses.example_cn: 先从主要的想法说起，再补充别的。

senses.gloss_en: Get ready for something
senses.example_en: I prepare for bed at ten.
senses.example_cn: 我十点开始准备睡觉。

senses.gloss_en: Make something ready for use
senses.example_en: We prepare the room for guests.
senses.example_cn: 我们把房间准备好招待客人。

senses.gloss_en: Make food ready to eat
senses.example_en: She prepares dinner in the kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 她在厨房做晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: Make an effort to do something
senses.example_en: I will try to learn English every day.
senses.example_cn: 我会努力每天学英语。

senses.gloss_en: Test something to see if it works
senses.example_en: Try this chair and see if it works.
senses.example_cn: 试试这把椅子，看好不好用。

senses.gloss_en: Taste something to see if you like it
senses.example_en: Try the soup, it is very good.
senses.example_cn: 尝尝这汤，很好喝。

senses.gloss_en: Stay until something happens
senses.example_en: Wait here until I come back.
senses.example_cn: 在这儿等着，直到我回来。

senses.gloss_en: Stay for someone or something
senses.example_en: We wait for the bus every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天都等公交车。

senses.gloss_en: A period of waiting
senses.example_en: The wait was long at the restaurant.
senses.example_cn: 在那家餐馆等了很久。

senses.gloss_en: Take place, occur
senses.example_en: What happened at school today, exactly?
senses.example_cn: 今天学校里到底发生了什么？

senses.gloss_en: Take place to someone, affect them
senses.example_en: It happened to me last week.
senses.example_cn: 这事上星期就发生在我身上。

senses.gloss_en: Do something by chance
senses.example_en: I happened to meet him at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 我碰巧在机场遇到了他。

senses.gloss_en: Fail to catch or be on time
senses.example_en: I missed the bus this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我没赶上公交车。

senses.gloss_en: Fail to notice or see something
senses.example_en: Do not miss the main point.
senses.example_cn: 别漏掉最重要的那一点。

senses.gloss_en: Feel sad because someone is away
senses.example_en: I miss my brother when he is away.
senses.example_cn: 我哥哥不在的时候我很想他。

senses.gloss_en: what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc
senses.example_en: I do not have time for that now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在没时间做那件事。

senses.gloss_en: a particular hour shown by a clock
senses.example_en: What time is it on your clock?
senses.example_cn: 你的钟上现在几点了？

senses.gloss_en: measure how long something takes
senses.example_en: We timed the run at ten seconds.
senses.gloss_cn: 计时（测量用了多长时间）
senses.example_cn: 我们给这次跑步计时，成绩是十秒。

senses.gloss_en: a device for measuring and showing time
senses.example_en: The clock on the wall says three.
senses.example_cn: 墙上的钟显示三点。

senses.gloss_en: a very short period of time
senses.example_en: Wait a moment, I am coming.
senses.example_cn: 等一下，我马上就来。

senses.gloss_en: an exact point in time
senses.example_en: At that moment the door opened.
senses.example_cn: 就在那一刻，门开了。

senses.gloss_en: existing or happening now
senses.example_en: My present job is hard but fun.
senses.example_cn: 我目前的工作很辛苦，但很有意思。

senses.gloss_en: a thing you give to someone as a gift
senses.example_en: I got a present for my friend today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天给朋友买了个礼物。

senses.gloss_en: give something to someone, especially formally
senses.example_en: They will present the prize now.
senses.example_cn: 他们现在就要颁奖了。

senses.gloss_en: something that happens, especially something important
senses.example_en: The event changed my life in one day.
senses.example_cn: 那次事件一天之内就改变了我的人生。

senses.gloss_en: a planned occasion, like a party or race
senses.example_en: The event starts at noon in the park.
senses.example_cn: 活动中午在公园开始。

senses.gloss_en: a length of time
senses.example_en: We lived there for a short period.
senses.example_cn: 我们在那儿住过一小段时间。

senses.gloss_en: a length of time in someone's life or history
senses.example_en: That was a hard period in my life.
senses.example_cn: 那是我人生中一段艰难的时期。

senses.gloss_en: the flow of blood each month
senses.example_en: She has pain during her period.
senses.example_cn: 她来月经的时候会痛。

senses.gloss_en: the time when something starts
senses.example_en: At the beginning I was very nervous.
senses.example_cn: 刚开始的时候我很紧张。

senses.gloss_en: the first part of an event or story
senses.example_en: The beginning of the movie was very slow.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影的开头非常慢。

senses.gloss_en: the last part of something
senses.example_en: We left at the end of class.
senses.example_cn: 我们在课快结束时离开了。

senses.gloss_en: the farthest part of something long
senses.example_en: He lives at the other end of town.
senses.example_cn: 他住在城的另一头。

senses.gloss_en: to stop or finish
senses.example_en: The meeting will end at five today.
senses.example_cn: 今天的会议五点结束。

senses.gloss_en: to complete something
senses.example_en: I will finish my work after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后我就把活儿做完。

senses.gloss_en: to eat or drink all of something
senses.example_en: Finish your soup before you go out.
senses.example_cn: 出去之前把汤喝完。

senses.gloss_en: the last part or end of a race
senses.example_en: She won at the finish of the race.
senses.example_cn: 她在赛跑的终点赢了。

senses.gloss_en: A place where children learn with teachers
senses.example_en: My sister goes to school near our home.
senses.example_cn: 我妹妹在我们家附近的学校上学。

senses.gloss_en: The time you spend learning at school
senses.example_en: I started school at five and I liked it.
senses.example_cn: 我五岁开始上学，而且很喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: All the students and teachers in one school
senses.example_en: The whole school clapped for the new teacher.
senses.example_cn: 全校师生都为这位新老师鼓掌。

senses.gloss_en: Someone whose job is teaching students
senses.example_en: My teacher helps me read, write, and speak.
senses.example_cn: 我的老师教我读、写和说。

senses.gloss_en: A person studying at a college or university
senses.example_en: She is a student at a large university.
senses.example_cn: 她是一所大型大学的学生。

senses.gloss_en: A person studying at a high school, often a teenager
senses.example_en: The student rides the bus to high school.
senses.example_cn: 这个中学生坐公交车去高中上学。

senses.gloss_en: A person very interested in a subject
senses.example_en: He is a student of history and old maps.
senses.example_cn: 他喜欢钻研历史和古地图。

senses.gloss_en: A group of students taught together
senses.example_en: Our class has twenty students and two teachers.
senses.example_cn: 我们班有二十个学生和两位老师。

senses.gloss_en: A period when students learn with a teacher
senses.example_en: I have class at ten so I cannot go.
senses.example_cn: 我十点有课，所以去不了。

senses.gloss_en: A series of meetings to learn a skill
senses.example_en: She takes a cooking class on Saturday night.
senses.example_cn: 她周六晚上上烹饪班。

senses.gloss_en: A room where students are taught
senses.example_en: The classroom is quiet and the students listen.
senses.example_cn: 教室里很安静，学生们都在听。

senses.gloss_en: A period when a teacher teaches a student
senses.example_en: Our lesson starts at nine and it ends at ten.
senses.example_cn: 我们的课九点开始，十点结束。

senses.gloss_en: An activity or text used to learn something
senses.example_en: This lesson teaches the class new words and sounds.
senses.example_cn: 这一课教全班新词和读音。

senses.gloss_en: An experience that teaches you to change behavior
senses.example_en: He learned a lesson from the fall, and he was more careful after that.
senses.example_cn: 他从那次摔倒中得到了教训，后来小心多了。

senses.gloss_en: An area of knowledge studied in school or college
senses.example_en: Math is my favorite subject at school this year.
senses.example_cn: 数学是我今年在学校最喜欢的科目。

senses.gloss_en: A topic being talked about or written about
senses.example_en: Let’s change the subject and talk about food.
senses.example_cn: 我们换个话题，聊聊吃的吧。

senses.gloss_en: Likely to be affected by something
senses.example_en: This plan is subject to change after the test.
senses.example_cn: 这个方案在测试之后可能会有改动。

senses.gloss_en: A set of classes on one subject
senses.example_en: I took a course in English and I learned fast.
senses.example_cn: 我上了一门英语课程，学得很快。

senses.gloss_en: One part of a meal, served separately
senses.example_en: We had soup as the first course at dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭的第一道菜我们喝的是汤。

senses.gloss_en: The direction a ship, river, or event follows
senses.example_en: The river changed course and the town flooded.
senses.example_cn: 这条河改变了路线，镇子被水淹了。

senses.gloss_en: a place to study or train after high school
senses.example_en: She goes to college after high school.
senses.gloss_cn: 学院（高中后就读的学校）
senses.example_cn: 她高中毕业后去上学院。

senses.gloss_en: a part of a university with its own teachers
senses.example_en: He studies history in the college of arts.
senses.example_cn: 他在文学院学历史。

senses.gloss_en: an organization of professionals, often with the same job
senses.example_en: She joined a college of nurses last year.
senses.example_cn: 她去年加入了一个护士学会。

senses.gloss_en: an institution where you study for a degree
senses.example_en: They start university in September, after high school.
senses.example_cn: 他们高中毕业后，九月开始上大学。

senses.gloss_en: a building where people read or borrow books
senses.example_en: I study in the library every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天都在图书馆学习。

senses.gloss_en: a room in a house with many books
senses.example_en: His library has old books and maps.
senses.example_cn: 他的书房里有旧书和地图。

senses.gloss_en: a large collection of books, music, or information
senses.example_en: The school library includes books, films, and music.
senses.example_cn: 学校图书馆的馆藏包括图书、影片和音乐。

senses.gloss_en: a set of printed pages bound together
senses.example_en: This book has pictures on every page.
senses.example_cn: 这本书每一页都有图。

senses.gloss_en: to arrange to have a place at a time
senses.example_en: We book a room for two nights.
senses.example_cn: 我们订了一间房，住两个晚上。

senses.gloss_en: records of a business's money and accounts
senses.example_en: The manager checks the books every month.
senses.example_cn: 经理每个月都查账。

senses.gloss_en: one side or both sides of a sheet in a book
senses.example_en: Turn to page ten and read the title.
senses.example_cn: 翻到第十页，念一下标题。

senses.gloss_en: thin material for writing, drawing, or wrapping
senses.example_en: I write on paper with a pen.
senses.example_cn: 我用笔在纸上写字。

senses.gloss_en: a newspaper, or newspapers, often called papers
senses.example_en: I read the paper on the bus.
senses.example_cn: 我在公交车上看报纸。

senses.gloss_en: the questions in a written exam
senses.example_en: The math paper was hard for my class.
senses.example_cn: 这次数学卷子对我们班来说很难。

senses.gloss_en: a tool for writing with ink
senses.example_en: My pen is blue and my paper is white.
senses.example_cn: 我的笔是蓝色的，纸是白色的。

senses.gloss_en: a small fenced area for animals
senses.example_en: The sheep stay in the pen at night.
senses.example_cn: 羊晚上都待在畜栏里。

senses.gloss_en: a tool for writing or drawing with a dark point
senses.example_en: I draw a map with a pencil.
senses.example_cn: 我用铅笔画了一张地图。

senses.gloss_en: A book or app that explains word meanings
senses.example_en: Use a dictionary to check this new word.
senses.example_cn: 用词典查一下这个新词。

senses.gloss_en: Written words in a book, article, or screen
senses.example_en: The text is small, so I cannot read it.
senses.example_cn: 这段文字太小了，我看不清。

senses.gloss_en: A short message sent to a cell phone
senses.example_en: I got your text, and I will reply soon.
senses.example_cn: 我收到你的短信了，我很快回你。

senses.gloss_en: Send someone a text message
senses.example_en: Text me when you are near the hotel.
senses.example_cn: 你快到酒店的时候给我发个短信。

senses.gloss_en: A section of writing about one main idea
senses.example_en: Write one paragraph about your trip to Kuala Lumpur.
senses.example_cn: 就你去吉隆坡的这次旅行写一个段落。

senses.gloss_en: A group of words that expresses a complete idea
senses.example_en: This sentence has a subject and a verb.
senses.example_cn: 这个句子有主语，也有动词。

senses.gloss_en: A punishment given by a court
senses.example_en: The sentence was three years in prison.
senses.example_cn: 判决是三年有期徒刑。

senses.gloss_en: Officially give someone a punishment in court
senses.example_en: The judge will sentence him to two years in prison.
senses.example_cn: 法官判他入狱两年。

senses.gloss_en: A single unit of language with meaning
senses.example_en: This word has four letters, and it is easy.
senses.example_cn: 这个单词有四个字母，很简单。

senses.gloss_en: Something you say, a remark
senses.example_en: He said one word, and the room got quiet.
senses.example_cn: 他说了一句话，屋里就安静了。

senses.gloss_en: A promise that you will do something
senses.example_en: I gave my word, so I will come.
senses.example_cn: 我已经许下承诺，所以我一定会来。

senses.gloss_en: The ability to form words with correct letters
senses.example_en: Her spelling is good, but mine is poor.
senses.example_cn: 她的拼写很好，我的却很差。

senses.gloss_en: The way a word is written with letters
senses.example_en: The spelling of color is different in British English.
senses.example_cn: “color”这个词在英式英语里的拼法不一样。

senses.gloss_en: A group of words that is part of a sentence
senses.example_en: In the phrase ‘in the morning’, the main word is ‘morning’.
senses.example_cn: 在「in the morning」这个短语里，主要的词是「morning」。

senses.gloss_en: A short group of words with a special meaning
senses.example_en: Nice to meet you is a useful phrase.
senses.example_cn: “很高兴见到你”是一句很有用的短语。

senses.gloss_en: The name of a book, movie, or song
senses.example_en: The title of the video is on the screen.
senses.example_cn: 视频的标题就显示在屏幕上。

senses.gloss_en: A word before a name, like Dr or Mr
senses.example_en: Her title is Dr, and she is a doctor.
senses.example_cn: 她的头衔是“博士”，她是一名医生。

senses.gloss_en: Give a book, song, or movie a name
senses.example_en: They will title the book in English.
senses.example_cn: 他们会给这本书起个英文名。

senses.gloss_en: a thing you talk or write about
senses.example_en: Our topic today is food in Malaysia.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天的话题是马来西亚的食物。

senses.gloss_en: something you say or write that gives information
senses.example_en: Her statement was short and very clear.
senses.example_cn: 她的陈述很短，也很清楚。

senses.gloss_en: an official message, often written for the public
senses.example_en: The company released a statement about the accident.
senses.example_cn: 公司就这起事故发布了一份声明。

senses.gloss_en: a document that shows money in an account
senses.example_en: I checked my bank statement this morning.
senses.example_cn: 我今天早上查了银行对账单。

senses.gloss_en: words that say what someone or something is like
senses.example_en: Give a description of your new house.
senses.example_cn: 描述一下你的新房子。

senses.gloss_en: the act of describing someone or something
senses.example_en: Description takes time when you write slowly.
senses.example_cn: 写得慢的时候，描写是很费时间的。

senses.gloss_en: something that shows what is typical or true
senses.example_en: This photo is an example of my work.
senses.gloss_cn: 例子（能代表整体的样本）
senses.example_cn: 这张照片就是我作品的一个例子。

senses.gloss_en: a thing used to explain something
senses.example_en: Give one example to show the rule.
senses.example_cn: 举一个例子来说明这条规则。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing others should copy
senses.example_en: She is an example to every new student.
senses.example_cn: 她是每个新生的榜样。

senses.gloss_en: a small fact or point about something
senses.example_en: Please add one detail about your trip.
senses.example_cn: 请再补充一个关于你这次旅行的细节。

senses.gloss_en: all the facts about something
senses.example_en: Tell me the details of the plan.
senses.example_cn: 把这个计划的细节告诉我。

senses.gloss_en: to give all the facts about something
senses.example_en: She detailed the problem in an email.
senses.example_cn: 她在邮件中详细说明了问题。

senses.gloss_en: something that is true and can be proved
senses.example_en: It is a fact that the sun is hot.
senses.example_cn: 太阳很热，这是事实。

senses.gloss_en: the truth about a situation, not an opinion
senses.example_en: I want facts and not opinions today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天要的是事实，不是看法。

senses.gloss_en: facts you learn about someone or something
senses.example_en: I need information about this hotel.
senses.example_cn: 我需要这家酒店的信息。

senses.gloss_en: facts given to help people know something
senses.example_en: They gave us information before the trip.
senses.example_cn: 出发之前他们给了我们一些信息。

senses.gloss_en: a thought or suggestion about what to do
senses.example_en: I have an idea for dinner tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚的晚饭我有个主意。

senses.gloss_en: the aim or purpose of something
senses.example_en: The idea is to help students learn faster.
senses.example_cn: 我们的目的是帮学生学得更快。

senses.gloss_en: a general understanding of something
senses.example_en: I have some idea of the plan.
senses.example_cn: 这个计划我大致了解一些。

senses.gloss_en: the idea that a word or sign represents
senses.example_en: What is the meaning of this word?
senses.example_cn: 这个词是什么意思？

senses.gloss_en: the idea that a person wants to express
senses.example_en: I did not understand your meaning in that sentence.
senses.example_cn: 那句话里你的意思我没听明白。

senses.gloss_en: importance or value, not just a word sense
senses.example_en: This gift has meaning for my family.
senses.example_cn: 这份礼物对我家很有意义。

senses.gloss_en: the cause of something
senses.example_en: What is the reason for this problem?
senses.example_cn: 这个问题的原因是什么？

senses.gloss_en: a fact that shows why you should do something
senses.example_en: I have a reason to study today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天有理由要好好学习。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to think clearly and decide
senses.example_en: After the fall, he lost his reason.
senses.example_cn: 摔倒之后，他失去了理智。

senses.gloss_en: a sentence that asks for information
senses.example_en: I have a question about your name.
senses.example_cn: 关于你的名字我有个问题。

senses.gloss_en: a matter that needs discussion or an answer
senses.example_en: The question is, where do we go now?
senses.example_cn: 问题是，我们现在去哪儿？

senses.gloss_en: to ask someone questions, especially officially
senses.example_en: The police questioned him about the fire.
senses.example_cn: 警察就那场火灾盘问了他。

senses.gloss_en: something you say or do as a reply
senses.example_en: I asked, but there was no answer.
senses.example_cn: 我问了，但没人答复。

senses.gloss_en: to reply to a question or a request
senses.example_en: Please answer my question right now.
senses.example_cn: 请你现在就回答我的问题。

senses.gloss_en: to pick up the phone or open the door
senses.example_en: She answered the phone and said hello.
senses.example_cn: 她接起电话说了声“你好”。

senses.gloss_en: conversation written for a book, play, or film
senses.example_en: The book has long dialogue and few pictures.
senses.example_cn: 这本书对白很长，图很少。

senses.gloss_en: formal talks to solve a disagreement or problem
senses.example_en: The two sides began dialogue about the border.
senses.example_cn: 双方开始就边界问题展开对话。

senses.gloss_en: a conversation between two or more people
senses.example_en: We had a short dialogue after class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天课后我们进行了简短的对话。

senses.gloss_en: to give an answer without knowing all the facts
senses.example_en: I guessed the number in one try.
senses.example_cn: 我一次就猜中了那个数字。

senses.gloss_en: an answer you give without being sure
senses.example_en: My guess was wrong in class today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在课上的猜测是错的。

senses.gloss_en: to think something is true, not be sure
senses.example_en: I guess we are late again.
senses.example_cn: 我猜我们又迟到了。

senses.gloss_en: something difficult to deal with or understand
senses.example_en: I have a problem with my phone today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天手机出了问题。

senses.gloss_en: a question that needs an answer, especially in math
senses.example_en: This problem has two answers, not one.
senses.example_cn: 这道题有两个答案，不是一个。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing that causes trouble
senses.example_en: That dog is a problem for my neighbors.
senses.example_cn: 那条狗给我的邻居们添了不少麻烦。

senses.gloss_en: school work on a subject done over time
senses.example_en: My history project is in a big book.
senses.example_cn: 我的历史专题作业写在一个大本子里。

senses.gloss_en: a planned piece of work with a purpose
senses.example_en: Our project starts today and ends next week.
senses.example_cn: 我们的项目今天开始，下周结束。

senses.gloss_en: to estimate or expect a future number or result
senses.example_en: They project high sales for next year.
senses.example_cn: 他们预计明年销量会很高。

senses.gloss_en: a written or spoken account of something
senses.example_en: She wrote a report about the class trip.
senses.example_cn: 她写了一份关于班级旅行的报告。

senses.gloss_en: give people information about something that happened
senses.example_en: They reported the event on TV today.
senses.example_cn: 他们今天在电视上报道了这件事。

senses.gloss_en: tell a person in authority about something wrong
senses.example_en: We reported the theft to the police.
senses.example_cn: 我们把这起盗窃案报了警。

senses.gloss_en: something that happens because of something else
senses.example_en: The result was good after a lot of practice.
senses.example_cn: 练了很多之后，结果很不错。

senses.gloss_en: information or marks from a test or experiment
senses.example_en: I got my test results this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我拿到了考试成绩。

senses.gloss_en: happen because of something or cause something
senses.example_en: The fight resulted from a small mistake.
senses.example_cn: 这场争吵是由一个小失误引起的。

senses.gloss_en: regular training to improve a skill
senses.example_en: We need more practice before the test.
senses.example_cn: 考试前我们还需要多练习。

senses.gloss_en: a usual way of doing something
senses.example_en: It is common practice to start at eight.
senses.example_cn: 通常的惯例是八点开始。

senses.gloss_en: do something regularly to improve a skill
senses.example_en: She practices English every day after work.
senses.example_cn: 她每天下班后都练习英语。

senses.gloss_en: school work that you do at home
senses.example_en: I did my homework after dinner today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天晚饭后写了作业。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of learning about a subject
senses.example_en: Study helps me learn English every day.
senses.example_cn: 学习让我每天都在学英语。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of research that examines a subject
senses.example_en: The study shows good results for this practice.
senses.example_cn: 这项研究表明这种做法效果很好。

senses.gloss_en: learn about a subject in a course
senses.example_en: I study English at night after work.
senses.example_cn: 我下班后晚上学英语。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of reading written words
senses.example_en: Reading helps me learn new words every day.
senses.example_cn: 阅读帮我每天都学到新词。

senses.gloss_en: an act of reading something
senses.example_en: He did one reading of the story.
senses.example_cn: 他把这个故事读了一遍。

senses.gloss_en: the way you understand a text or situation
senses.example_en: My reading of the report was different today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天对这份报告的理解不一样了。

senses.gloss_en: a person who reads written text
senses.example_en: She is a fast reader in class.
senses.example_cn: 她在班上读书读得很快。

senses.gloss_en: a person who reads a certain newspaper or magazine
senses.example_en: Many readers of this paper love travel stories.
senses.example_cn: 这份报纸的很多读者都喜欢旅行故事。

senses.gloss_en: a device that reads printed or digital information
senses.example_en: The card reader read my card today.
senses.example_cn: 读卡器今天把我的卡读出来了。

senses.gloss_en: a diagram that shows information
senses.example_en: The chart shows our sales this month.
senses.example_cn: 这张图表显示了我们这个月的销售额。

senses.gloss_en: a list of the most popular songs
senses.example_en: Her song climbed the chart this week.
senses.example_cn: 她的歌这周登上了排行榜。

senses.gloss_en: to record or follow the progress of something
senses.example_en: They chart his progress from day to day.
senses.example_cn: 他们逐日记录他的康复进展。

senses.gloss_en: a series of names or things written together
senses.example_en: I made a list of things to do.
senses.example_cn: 我列了一张要做的事情的清单。

senses.gloss_en: to write a series of names or things
senses.example_en: Please list the books on your desk.
senses.example_cn: 请把你桌上的书列出来。

senses.gloss_en: a long, thin mark on a surface
senses.example_en: Draw a line under the new word.
senses.example_cn: 在这个新词下面画一条线。

senses.gloss_en: a row of words in writing or print
senses.example_en: Read the first line of the story.
senses.example_cn: 读一下这个故事的第一行。

senses.gloss_en: to cover the inside with another material
senses.example_en: Line the pan with foil before cooking.
senses.example_cn: 下锅前先在烤盘里铺一层锡纸。

senses.gloss_en: an idea or fact someone says or writes
senses.example_en: That point is true for many people.
senses.example_cn: 那个观点对很多人来说都成立。

senses.gloss_en: the sharp end, like on a knife
senses.example_en: The point of the knife is very sharp.
senses.example_cn: 这把刀的刀尖很锋利。

senses.gloss_en: to show where something is with your finger
senses.example_en: Point to the door for me, please.
senses.example_cn: 请给我指一下门在哪儿。

senses.gloss_en: a separate part of a book or document
senses.example_en: I read the section on food today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天读了讲食物的那一节。

senses.gloss_en: one of the parts something is divided into
senses.example_en: This section of the road is closed now.
senses.example_cn: 这段路现在封闭了。

senses.gloss_en: some but not all of something
senses.example_en: We saw part of the show last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我们只看了演出的一部分。

senses.gloss_en: a piece or section of something
senses.example_en: This part of the book is very easy.
senses.example_cn: 这本书的这一部分很简单。

senses.gloss_en: a role in an activity or story
senses.example_en: He had a part in the school play.
senses.example_cn: 他在学校的话剧里演了一个角色。

senses.gloss_en: a thing you can see and touch
senses.example_en: Put the object on the table, not the bed.
senses.example_cn: 把这个东西放在桌上，别放床上。

senses.gloss_en: the person or thing a verb acts on
senses.example_en: In She likes cake, cake is the object.
senses.example_cn: 在「She likes cake」这句里，「cake」是宾语。

senses.gloss_en: to say you disagree with something
senses.example_en: I object to that plan, it is not fair.
senses.example_cn: 我反对这项计划，它不公平。

senses.gloss_en: a type of person, animal, or thing
senses.example_en: What kind of cake do you like?
senses.example_cn: 你喜欢哪种蛋糕？

senses.gloss_en: the basic nature of something
senses.example_en: These two problems are different in kind, not degree.
senses.example_cn: 这两个问题性质不同，不只是程度不同。

senses.gloss_en: a class or group with shared features
senses.example_en: This type of fish lives in warm water.
senses.example_cn: 这种鱼生活在温暖的水里。

senses.gloss_en: to write using a keyboard
senses.example_en: I will type the email now on my phone.
senses.example_cn: 我现在就用手机把这封邮件打出来。

senses.gloss_en: a person with particular qualities
senses.example_en: He is the type who talks a lot.
senses.example_cn: 他是那种话很多的人。

senses.gloss_en: an object you do not name
senses.example_en: Pass me that thing on the chair.
senses.example_cn: 把椅子上那个东西递给我。

senses.gloss_en: a fact or situation you talk about
senses.example_en: The thing is, I do not know.
senses.example_cn: 事情是这样的，我也不知道。

senses.gloss_en: your personal objects, what you own
senses.example_en: Pack your things and put them in the bag.
senses.example_cn: 收好你的东西，装进包里。

senses.gloss_en: an ability learned through practice
senses.example_en: Cooking takes skill, and I need more skill.
senses.example_cn: 做饭需要技术，而我的技术还不够。

senses.gloss_en: study of the natural world through experiments
senses.example_en: Science helps us understand the world around us.
senses.example_cn: 科学帮我们了解身边的世界。

senses.gloss_en: school subject about science and experiments
senses.example_en: I have science class after lunch today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天午饭后有科学课。

senses.gloss_en: a field of study using tests and experiments
senses.example_en: Biology is a science about living things.
senses.example_cn: 生物学是一门研究生物的科学。

senses.gloss_en: study of Earth’s places, land, and people
senses.example_en: Geography shows where countries are on a map.
senses.example_cn: 地理让我们知道各个国家在地图上的位置。

senses.gloss_en: the way features are arranged in a place
senses.example_en: The city’s geography makes travel slow in winter.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市的地形让冬天出行很慢。

senses.gloss_en: study of past events and times
senses.example_en: History class tells stories about the past.
senses.example_cn: 历史课讲的是过去的故事。

senses.gloss_en: the past events of a person, place, or thing
senses.example_en: This town has a long history of trade.
senses.example_cn: 这个镇有很长的贸易历史。

senses.gloss_en: an established record of past actions or events
senses.example_en: Tell the doctor your medical history before surgery.
senses.example_cn: 手术前把你的病史告诉医生。

senses.gloss_en: a formal test of knowledge or skill
senses.example_en: I have an exam in math tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 我明天有一场数学考试。

senses.gloss_en: a medical check done by a doctor
senses.example_en: She had an exam of her eyes today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天做了眼睛检查。

senses.gloss_en: a careful look at something to find facts
senses.example_en: A close exam of the car showed rust.
senses.example_cn: 对汽车的仔细检查发现了锈迹。

senses.gloss_en: an exam to measure what someone knows
senses.example_en: We have a test in English today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天有一场英语考试。

senses.gloss_en: a medical check to find what is wrong
senses.example_en: The doctor did a blood test this morning.
senses.example_cn: 医生今天早上做了血液化验。

senses.gloss_en: check something to see if it works
senses.example_en: Test the new phone before you buy it.
senses.example_cn: 买之前先试试这部新手机。

senses.gloss_en: a short written message
senses.example_en: I left a note on your desk today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在你桌上留了一张便条。

senses.gloss_en: words you write to remember something
senses.example_en: She wrote notes in class, then read them.
senses.example_cn: 她上课时记了笔记，后来又读了一遍。

senses.gloss_en: to notice something carefully
senses.example_en: Note this sign and follow it now.
senses.example_cn: 留意这块牌子，现在就照着做。

senses.gloss_en: something you do for fun or sport
senses.example_en: Reading is my favorite activity after dinner.
senses.gloss_cn: 活动（自己找乐子做的事）
senses.example_cn: 读书是我晚饭后最喜欢的活动。

senses.gloss_en: an organized thing people do together
senses.example_en: The school plans activities for new students.
senses.example_cn: 学校为新生安排了各种活动。

senses.gloss_en: busy action, things happening
senses.example_en: There is a lot of activity in town today.
senses.example_cn: 今天镇上人来人往，很热闹。

senses.gloss_en: a table used for writing, reading, or work
senses.example_en: He sits at his desk and writes every day.
senses.example_cn: 他每天坐在书桌前写东西。

senses.gloss_en: a counter where you get information or service
senses.example_en: Ask at the front desk for a key.
senses.example_cn: 到前台去要一把钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: a department that handles a kind of news
senses.example_en: The sports desk wrote the story this morning.
senses.example_cn: 体育部今天早上写了这篇报道。

senses.gloss_en: the way two things are not the same
senses.example_en: I see a difference between these two pictures.
senses.example_cn: 我看出这两张图之间有差别。

senses.gloss_en: the amount one number is more than another
senses.example_en: What is the difference between ten and seven?
senses.example_cn: 十和七的差是多少？

senses.gloss_en: an effect that changes a situation
senses.example_en: This small change makes a difference in my work.
senses.example_cn: 这个小改动对我的工作确实起了作用。

senses.gloss_en: a system of words people use to communicate
senses.example_en: English is the language I speak at home.
senses.example_cn: 英语是我在家说的语言。

senses.gloss_en: the words and style someone uses
senses.example_en: His language is too formal for this email.
senses.example_cn: 他的措辞对这封邮件来说太正式了。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to speak and understand words
senses.example_en: Children learn language faster than adults.
senses.example_cn: 孩子学语言比大人快。

senses.gloss_en: something you do that is not correct
senses.example_en: I made a mistake and felt bad later.
senses.example_cn: 我犯了个错，后来心里很难受。

senses.gloss_en: a wrong idea or decision
senses.example_en: It is a mistake to think he is angry.
senses.example_cn: 以为他在生气，这就想错了。

senses.gloss_en: to judge someone or something wrongly
senses.example_en: Do not mistake my silence for agreement.
senses.example_cn: 不要把我的沉默当作同意。

senses.gloss_en: Used to ask for information about something
senses.example_en: What is your name at college today?
senses.example_cn: 今天在大学里，你叫什么名字？

senses.gloss_en: Used before a noun to ask about it
senses.example_en: What book do you want for class today?
senses.example_cn: 今天上课你想要什么书？

senses.gloss_en: Said when you did not hear or understand
senses.example_en: What? I did not hear you.
senses.example_cn: 什么？我没听见你说的话。

senses.gloss_en: At what place
senses.example_en: Where is the library in this town?
senses.example_cn: 这个镇上的图书馆在哪里？

senses.gloss_en: In the place that
senses.example_en: Stay where you are in the room.
senses.example_cn: 就待在房间里你现在的位置，别动。

senses.gloss_en: At the point in a situation
senses.example_en: We are at a point where we must choose.
senses.gloss_cn: 引导从句指事情的某个阶段
senses.example_cn: 我们已经到了必须做选择的时候。

senses.gloss_en: At what time
senses.example_en: When is the class at the college?
senses.example_cn: 大学里那门课什么时候上？

senses.gloss_en: At the time that
senses.example_en: Call me when you are at the library.
senses.example_cn: 你到了图书馆就给我打电话。

senses.gloss_en: At, in, or during which
senses.example_en: It was a time when we had no phone.
senses.example_cn: 那是一个我们还没有电话的年代。

senses.gloss_en: What person
senses.example_en: Who is the teacher in your class today?
senses.example_cn: 今天你们班的老师是谁？

senses.gloss_en: The person that, in a clause
senses.example_en: The student who is late must wait outside.
senses.gloss_cn: 引出定语从句，指那个人
senses.example_cn: 迟到的那个学生必须在外面等。

senses.gloss_en: For what reason
senses.example_en: Why are you at the college today?
senses.example_cn: 你今天为什么来大学？

senses.gloss_en: Used to show the reason in a clause
senses.example_en: That is why I am here at school.
senses.example_cn: 这就是我来学校的原因。

senses.gloss_en: In what way
senses.example_en: How do you write this word on paper?
senses.example_cn: 这个词在纸上怎么写？

senses.gloss_en: In what condition
senses.example_en: How are you at the start of class today?
senses.example_cn: 今天刚上课，你感觉怎么样？

senses.gloss_en: To what amount or degree
senses.example_en: How much paper do you need for the project?
senses.gloss_cn: 多少；多么（问程度或数量）
senses.example_cn: 这个项目你需要多少纸？

senses.gloss_en: Used before a noun to ask about a choice
senses.example_en: Which book is on the table in class?
senses.gloss_cn: 哪个（用在名词前问选择）
senses.example_cn: 教室桌子上放的是哪本书？

senses.gloss_en: Used to ask which one
senses.example_en: Which do you want, the pen or the pencil?
senses.example_cn: 你要哪一个，钢笔还是铅笔？

senses.gloss_en: Used to add information about a thing
senses.example_en: I read the book, which was very good.
senses.gloss_cn: 引导定语从句补充说明事物
senses.example_cn: 我读了那本书，那本书非常好。

senses.gloss_en: inside a place, container, or area
senses.example_en: The keys are in my bag today.
senses.example_cn: 钥匙今天在我包里。

senses.gloss_en: during a period of time
senses.example_en: I will see you in two hours.
senses.example_cn: 两个小时后我来见你。

senses.gloss_en: inside, not outside
senses.example_en: Come in, the door is open.
senses.example_cn: 进来吧，门开着呢。

senses.gloss_en: in or near a place
senses.example_en: Meet me at the station after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后在车站等我。

senses.gloss_en: used to say when something happens
senses.example_en: The class starts at nine o'clock today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这节课九点开始。

senses.gloss_en: toward a person or thing
senses.example_en: He looked at the map again.
senses.example_cn: 他又看了一眼地图。

senses.gloss_en: touching, supported by a surface
senses.example_en: The phone is on the table now.
senses.example_cn: 手机现在在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: about a subject or topic
senses.example_en: I read a book on history today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我读了一本关于历史的书。

senses.gloss_en: working, using power
senses.example_en: The light is on so I can read.
senses.example_cn: 灯开着，所以我能看书。

senses.gloss_en: toward a place or person
senses.example_en: I went to the store after work today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天下班后去了商店。

senses.gloss_en: used to show who receives something
senses.example_en: Give the book to your friend now.
senses.example_cn: 把这本书给你的朋友。

senses.gloss_en: used before a verb to form the infinitive
senses.example_en: I want to learn English this year.
senses.gloss_cn: 用在动词前构成不定式
senses.example_cn: 我想今年把英语学好。

senses.gloss_en: starting at a place or time
senses.example_en: I came from the city this morning.
senses.example_cn: 我今天早上从城里过来的。

senses.gloss_en: used to show the origin of something
senses.example_en: This email is from my teacher today.
senses.example_cn: 这封邮件是今天我老师发来的。

senses.gloss_en: away, separated by distance
senses.example_en: Stay away from the edge right now.
senses.example_cn: 现在马上离边上远一点。

senses.gloss_en: to the inside of something
senses.example_en: He walked into the room very quietly.
senses.example_cn: 他很轻地走进了房间。

senses.gloss_en: changing to a new form or state
senses.example_en: The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.
senses.example_cn: 毛毛虫变成了蝴蝶。

senses.gloss_en: divided, cut, or put into parts
senses.example_en: Cut the pizza into eight pieces for us.
senses.example_cn: 把披萨切成八块给我们吃。

senses.gloss_en: not inside, outside
senses.example_en: The dog is out, not in the house.
senses.example_cn: 狗在外面，不在屋里。

senses.gloss_en: away from home, not at home
senses.example_en: My parents are out, so I cook dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我父母出去了，所以我做晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: not burning or working anymore
senses.example_en: The light is out, so the room is dark.
senses.example_cn: 灯灭了，所以房间里很黑。

senses.gloss_en: above something, higher than it
senses.example_en: A plane flew over my house this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上有一架飞机飞过我家上方。

senses.gloss_en: covering something, on top of it
senses.example_en: Put a cover over the food on the table.
senses.example_cn: 给桌上的饭菜盖上一个盖子。

senses.gloss_en: more than a number or amount
senses.example_en: It is over ten miles from my home.
senses.example_cn: 那儿离我家有十英里多。

senses.gloss_en: below something, lower than it
senses.example_en: The cat is under the table at night.
senses.example_cn: 晚上猫在桌子底下。

senses.gloss_en: less than a number or age
senses.example_en: Children under five do not pay today.
senses.example_cn: 五岁以下的孩子今天不用付钱。

senses.gloss_en: covered by something, underneath it
senses.example_en: My feet are under a blanket in bed.
senses.example_cn: 我在床上，脚盖在毯子下面。

senses.gloss_en: in the space separating two things
senses.example_en: The store is between the bank and the park.
senses.example_cn: 那家商店在银行和公园之间。

senses.gloss_en: in the time separating two events
senses.example_en: I work between nine and five each day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天在九点到五点之间工作。

senses.gloss_en: in the space between two things
senses.example_en: The bank is on the left and the park is on the right, with a store in between.
senses.example_cn: 银行在左边，公园在右边，中间夹着一家商店。

senses.gloss_en: from one side to the other
senses.example_en: We walked across the street to the store.
senses.example_cn: 我们穿过马路去了那家商店。

senses.gloss_en: on the opposite side of something
senses.example_en: My friend lives across the river from me.
senses.example_cn: 我朋友住在河对岸。

senses.gloss_en: to the other side
senses.example_en: The dog ran across and came back.
senses.example_cn: 那只狗跑到对面，又跑了回来。

senses.gloss_en: from one side to the other
senses.example_en: The train went through the tunnel.
senses.example_cn: 火车穿过了隧道。

senses.gloss_en: inside a place, moving across it
senses.example_en: We walked through the park after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后我们从公园里走过去。

senses.gloss_en: from beginning to end of a time
senses.example_en: It rained through the night, and we stayed inside.
senses.example_cn: 雨下了整整一夜，我们一直待在屋里。

senses.headword_tail: adj., n., prep. A1, adv. A2
senses.gloss_en: the time before now
senses.example_en: In the past I studied here every day.
senses.example_cn: 过去我每天都在这里学习。

senses.headword_tail: adj., n., prep. A1, adv. A2
senses.gloss_en: used to say how many minutes after the hour it is
senses.example_en: The class starts at half past two today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这节课两点半开始。

senses.headword_tail: adj., n., prep. A1, adv. A2
senses.gloss_en: beyond a place or point
senses.example_en: Walk past the library, then turn left.
senses.example_cn: 走过图书馆再往左拐。

senses.gloss_en: not far from a place
senses.example_en: The hotel is near the airport today.
senses.example_cn: 那家旅馆离机场很近。

senses.gloss_en: close, not far away
senses.example_en: The end is near so we must hurry.
senses.example_cn: 结束的时间近了，我们必须快点。

senses.gloss_en: almost, nearly
senses.example_en: He was near asleep on the bus.
senses.example_cn: 他在公交车上几乎睡着了。

senses.gloss_en: beside, with nothing between
senses.example_en: Sit next to me in the library today.
senses.example_cn: 今天在图书馆坐在我旁边。

senses.gloss_en: following in order or importance after something else
senses.example_en: Next to math, English is my best subject.
senses.example_cn: 除了数学，英语就是我学得最好的科目。

senses.gloss_en: almost, very nearly
senses.example_en: It is next to impossible to finish today.
senses.chunk: It is next to impossible to
senses.example_cn: 今天想干完几乎是不可能的。

senses.gloss_en: at or to the back of something
senses.example_en: The pen is behind the book on my desk.
senses.example_cn: 笔在我桌上那本书的后面。

senses.gloss_en: left in a place after you go
senses.example_en: I left my pencil behind on the table.
senses.example_cn: 我把铅笔忘在桌上了。

senses.gloss_en: less advanced or late than others
senses.example_en: We are behind schedule on this project today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这个项目的进度落后了。

senses.gloss_en: in or to a higher position than
senses.example_en: A picture is above the desk in my room.
senses.example_cn: 我房间里书桌上方挂着一幅画。

senses.gloss_en: in a higher place
senses.example_en: Look above and find the number on the page.
senses.example_cn: 往上面看，找到这一页上的数字。

senses.gloss_en: more than an amount or level
senses.example_en: Children four and above can join the class.
senses.example_cn: 四岁以上的孩子可以参加这个班。

senses.gloss_en: at or to a lower level than
senses.example_en: The shoes are below the bed in my room.
senses.example_cn: 鞋子在我房间的床下面。

senses.gloss_en: in a lower place
senses.example_en: The floor below is quiet today.
senses.example_cn: 下面那一层今天很安静。

senses.gloss_en: less than an amount or level
senses.example_en: The temperature is below zero today.
senses.example_cn: 今天气温在零度以下。

senses.gloss_en: on the other side, facing someone or something
senses.example_en: My house is on the opposite side of the street.
senses.example_cn: 我家在街对面。

senses.gloss_en: as different as possible from something else
senses.example_en: Hot and cold are opposite ideas.
senses.example_cn: 热和冷是两个相反的概念。

senses.gloss_en: on the other side of, facing someone or something
senses.example_en: The bank is opposite the library.
senses.example_cn: 银行在图书馆对面。

senses.gloss_en: close to, next to someone or something
senses.example_en: She sat by me at the table.
senses.example_cn: 在桌边她挨着我坐下了。

senses.gloss_en: using a method, such as a bus or email
senses.example_en: We went by bus to the museum.
senses.example_cn: 我们坐公交车去了博物馆。

senses.gloss_en: showing who does or makes something
senses.example_en: This book was written by my teacher.
senses.example_cn: 这本书是我老师写的。

senses.gloss_en: in the company of someone or something
senses.example_en: I went to the park with my friend.
senses.example_cn: 我和朋友一起去了公园。

senses.gloss_en: using something as a tool or means
senses.example_en: Write with a pen, not a pencil.
senses.example_cn: 用钢笔写，不要用铅笔。

senses.gloss_en: having or carrying something
senses.example_en: A man with a hat is waiting outside.
senses.example_cn: 外面有个戴帽子的男人在等着。

senses.gloss_en: not having or using something
senses.example_en: I left the house without my keys.
senses.example_cn: 我出门时没带钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: not doing an action before another action
senses.example_en: He left without saying goodbye to me.
senses.example_cn: 他没跟我道别就走了。

senses.gloss_en: not including someone or something
senses.example_en: You can start the meeting without me.
senses.example_cn: 没有我你们也可以开始开会。

senses.gloss_en: intended to be given to someone
senses.example_en: There is a letter for you.
senses.example_cn: 有一封信是给你的。

senses.gloss_en: used to show purpose or function
senses.example_en: This room is for studying today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这个房间是用来学习的。

senses.gloss_en: during a period of time
senses.example_en: I lived in Seoul for one year.
senses.example_cn: 我在首尔住了一年。

senses.gloss_en: on the subject of something
senses.example_en: We talked about the exam after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后我们聊了关于考试的事。

senses.gloss_en: a little more or less than
senses.example_en: It costs about ten dollars today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这个大约要十美元。

senses.gloss_en: belonging to someone or something
senses.example_en: The desk of the teacher is near the door.
senses.example_cn: 老师的桌子在门口附近。

senses.gloss_en: showing an amount or part
senses.example_en: A cup of tea is on the desk.
senses.example_cn: 桌上有一杯茶。

senses.gloss_en: made from a material
senses.example_en: The desk is made of wood in my room.
senses.example_cn: 我房间里的桌子是木头做的。

senses.gloss_en: surrounding something, on all sides
senses.example_en: We sat around the table in the classroom.
senses.example_cn: 我们在教室里围着桌子坐。

senses.gloss_en: turning to face the other way
senses.example_en: Turn around and look at the teacher.
senses.example_cn: 转过身来看老师。

senses.gloss_en: approximately, not exact
senses.example_en: The lesson is around ten minutes long.
senses.example_cn: 这节课大约十分钟。

senses.gloss_en: toward a higher place or position
senses.example_en: Look up and point to the chart.
senses.example_cn: 往上看，指一下那张图表。

senses.gloss_en: to a higher place along something
senses.example_en: We walked up the stairs to the classroom.
senses.example_cn: 我们走上楼梯，到了教室。

senses.gloss_en: out of bed, awake
senses.example_en: I am up before school every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天上学前就已经起床了。

senses.gloss_en: to or at a lower place
senses.example_en: Put the book down on the desk now.
senses.example_cn: 现在把书放下，放在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: from a higher place to a lower one
senses.example_en: The ball rolled down the hill to the road.
senses.example_cn: 球从山坡上滚下来，滚到了路上。

senses.gloss_en: in a sitting or lying position
senses.example_en: Sit down and read the text in class.
senses.example_cn: 上课的时候坐下来读这段课文。

senses.gloss_en: not on, removed
senses.example_en: Take your coat off before you sit down.
senses.example_cn: 坐下之前把外套脱掉。

senses.gloss_en: not operating, switched off
senses.example_en: The light is off in the classroom now.
senses.example_cn: 教室里的灯现在是关着的。

senses.gloss_en: away from a surface or place
senses.example_en: The book fell off the desk onto the floor.
senses.gloss_cn: 从某个表面或地方离开
senses.example_cn: 书从桌子上掉到了地板上。

senses.gloss_en: earlier than a time or event
senses.example_en: I finish the lesson before lunch every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天都在午饭前上完课。

senses.gloss_en: earlier than the time when
senses.example_en: Read the text before you write a statement.
senses.example_cn: 在你写陈述之前，先读一遍这段文字。

senses.gloss_en: at an earlier time, already
senses.example_en: I saw this example before in the book.
senses.example_cn: 我以前在书上见过这个例子。

senses.gloss_en: Later than a time or event
senses.example_en: We eat after class and go home.
senses.example_cn: 我们下课后吃饭，然后回家。

senses.gloss_en: Later than the time when something happens
senses.example_en: After I finish, I call you.
senses.example_cn: 我做完就给你打电话。

senses.gloss_en: Later in time, not immediately
senses.example_en: I will call you after, not now.
senses.example_cn: 我过一会儿给你打电话，现在不打。

senses.gloss_en: Throughout a period of time
senses.example_en: I slept during the flight to Canada.
senses.example_cn: 飞往加拿大的途中我一直在睡觉。

senses.gloss_en: Up to a time, not after
senses.example_en: We wait until six, then we eat.
senses.example_cn: 我们等到六点，然后吃饭。

senses.gloss_en: Up to the time that something happens
senses.example_en: Stay here until I come back.
senses.example_cn: 你在这儿待着，直到我回来。

senses.gloss_en: As far as a place, not beyond
senses.example_en: Ride the bus until Central Park, then walk.
senses.example_cn: 坐公交车坐到中央公园，然后走过去。

senses.gloss_en: In the role of, used as
senses.example_en: He works as a teacher at my school.
senses.example_cn: 他在我的学校当老师。

senses.gloss_en: Used to compare two things
senses.example_en: This book is as big as that one.
senses.example_cn: 这本书和那本一样大。

senses.gloss_en: Because, since
senses.example_en: As it was late, we went home.
senses.example_cn: 因为太晚了，我们就回家了。

senses.gloss_en: Similar to someone or something
senses.example_en: Her voice is like my mother's voice.
senses.example_cn: 她的声音像我妈妈的声音。

senses.gloss_en: In the same way as
senses.example_en: Do it like this, with a pencil.
senses.example_cn: 就像这样做，用铅笔。

senses.gloss_en: Such as, for example
senses.example_en: We study languages like English and Spanish.
senses.example_cn: 我们学英语、西班牙语之类的语言。

senses.gloss_en: in, at, or to this place
senses.example_en: I live here with my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我和我弟弟住在这里。

senses.gloss_en: used when giving or showing something to someone
senses.example_en: Here is your pen, take it.
senses.example_cn: 给，你的笔，拿着吧。

senses.gloss_en: now, at this point
senses.example_en: Here the story changes.
senses.example_cn: 故事到这里出现了转折。

senses.gloss_en: used to show that something exists or happens
senses.example_en: There is a book on the table.
senses.example_cn: 桌子上有一本书。

senses.gloss_en: in, at, or to that place
senses.example_en: We go there again in July.
senses.example_cn: 七月我们再去那里一次。

senses.gloss_en: used when you find someone or something
senses.example_en: There you are, I can see you.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于找到某人或某物时
senses.example_cn: 你在这儿呢，我看见你了。

senses.gloss_en: on the side of your body near your heart
senses.example_en: My left hand holds the pencil.
senses.example_cn: 我用左手拿铅笔。

senses.gloss_en: to the left side
senses.example_en: Turn left at the end of the road.
senses.example_cn: 在这条路的尽头向左转。

senses.gloss_en: the left side or direction
senses.example_en: The library is on the left.
senses.example_cn: 图书馆在左边。

senses.gloss_en: correct, not wrong
senses.example_en: Your answer is right, we can finish.
senses.example_cn: 你的答案是对的，我们可以结束了。

senses.gloss_en: on the side opposite left
senses.example_en: My right hand holds the pen.
senses.example_cn: 我用右手拿笔。

senses.gloss_en: the right side or direction
senses.example_en: The bank is on the right.
senses.example_cn: 银行在右边。

senses.gloss_en: on or to a higher floor
senses.example_en: My room is upstairs, near the window.
senses.example_cn: 我的房间在楼上，靠着窗户。

senses.gloss_en: on a higher floor of a building
senses.example_en: The upstairs room is small and quiet.
senses.example_cn: 楼上那间屋子又小又安静。

senses.gloss_en: on or to a lower floor
senses.example_en: The kitchen is downstairs, near the door.
senses.example_cn: 厨房在楼下，靠着门。

senses.gloss_en: on a lower floor of a building
senses.example_en: The downstairs room is dark today.
senses.example_cn: 楼下那间屋子今天很暗。

senses.headword_tail: adv. A1, prep., noun., adj. A2
senses.gloss_en: not inside, outdoors
senses.example_en: Please wait outside, near the desk.
senses.example_cn: 请在外面等，就在桌子旁边。

senses.headword_tail: adv. A1, prep., noun., adj. A2
senses.gloss_en: not in a particular building or room, but near it
senses.example_en: The cat sat outside the door at night.
senses.example_cn: 晚上那只猫坐在门外面。

senses.headword_tail: adv. A1, prep., noun., adj. A2
senses.gloss_en: the outer side or surface of something
senses.example_en: The outside of the box is wet today.
senses.example_cn: 今天箱子的外面是湿的。

senses.gloss_en: to or in a different place
senses.example_en: Please put the book away after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后请把书收起来。

senses.gloss_en: at a distance from a place
senses.example_en: The store is two miles away from here.
senses.example_cn: 那家商店离这里有两英里远。

senses.gloss_en: not at home, absent
senses.example_en: My teacher is away today, so another teacher is teaching us.
senses.example_cn: 我的老师今天不在，所以由另一位老师给我们上课。

senses.gloss_en: a long distance away
senses.example_en: Do not go far from the classroom.
senses.example_cn: 不要离教室太远。

senses.gloss_en: at the most distant end, on the other side
senses.example_en: My desk is at the far end of the room.
senses.example_cn: 我的桌子在房间最远的那一头。

senses.gloss_en: much, to a great extent
senses.example_en: This lesson is far more useful than that one.
senses.example_cn: 这节课比那节有用得多。

senses.gloss_en: the direction opposite south on a map
senses.example_en: The wind comes from the north in winter.
senses.example_cn: 冬天风从北边吹来。

senses.gloss_en: in or toward the north
senses.example_en: They live on the north side of the city.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在城市的北面。

senses.gloss_en: toward the north
senses.example_en: They drove north after the lesson.
senses.example_cn: 下课后他们开车往北走了。

senses.gloss_en: available on the internet, using a computer network
senses.example_en: I have an online course for language study.
senses.example_cn: 我报了一门在网上学语言的课。

senses.gloss_en: connected to a computer network or the internet
senses.example_en: The printer is online and ready for use.
senses.example_cn: 打印机已经联网，可以用了。

senses.gloss_en: onto the internet, using a computer network
senses.example_en: You can buy the book online from home.
senses.example_cn: 你可以在家在网上买这本书。

senses.gloss_en: the earth and all people, places, and things
senses.example_en: People travel around the world for work.
senses.example_cn: 人们为了工作走遍世界各地。

senses.gloss_en: a region on earth
senses.example_en: This animal lives in a cold part of the world.
senses.gloss_cn: 地区（地球上的某一部分）
senses.example_cn: 这种动物生活在地球上寒冷的地区。

senses.gloss_en: the people involved in a particular activity
senses.example_en: She works in the art world now.
senses.example_cn: 她现在在艺术界工作。

senses.gloss_en: an area of land with its own government
senses.example_en: This country has many towns and cities.
senses.example_cn: 这个国家有很多城镇和城市。

senses.gloss_en: land outside towns and cities, with farms, fields, or woods
senses.example_en: We live in the country, near a small town.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在乡下，靠着一个小镇。

senses.gloss_en: the people who live in a country
senses.example_en: The country is proud of its capital city.
senses.example_cn: 全国人民都为自己的首都感到自豪。

senses.gloss_en: the main city of a country where the government is based
senses.example_en: Ottawa is the capital of Canada.
senses.example_cn: 渥太华是加拿大的首都。

senses.gloss_en: money used for investment or for starting a business
senses.example_en: They need more capital to start a business.
senses.example_cn: 他们需要更多资金才能开公司。

senses.gloss_en: written in a capital letter, not a small letter
senses.example_en: Write your name in capital letters, please.
senses.example_cn: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

senses.gloss_en: a large and important town
senses.example_en: This city has a library and a university.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市有图书馆，也有大学。

senses.gloss_en: all the people who live in a city
senses.example_en: The city is happy with the new park.
senses.example_cn: 全城的人都为新公园感到高兴。

senses.gloss_en: the government of a city
senses.example_en: The city plans a new road in this area.
senses.example_cn: 市政府计划在这一带修一条新路。

senses.gloss_en: a place with many houses and shops
senses.example_en: Our town is small but very busy.
senses.example_cn: 我们镇不大，但很热闹。

senses.gloss_en: the people who live in a town
senses.example_en: The whole town knows about the problem.
senses.example_cn: 全镇的人都知道这件事。

senses.gloss_en: the main part of town with many stores
senses.example_en: I go into town after class to buy paper.
senses.example_cn: 下课后我要去市中心买纸。

senses.gloss_en: a particular part of a place or country
senses.example_en: This area is near the city and the town.
senses.example_cn: 这个地区离城市和小镇都不远。

senses.gloss_en: a space used for a special purpose
senses.example_en: The library has a quiet area for study.
senses.example_cn: 图书馆里有一块安静的区域供人学习。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of space a surface covers
senses.example_en: Find the area of this rectangle.
senses.example_cn: 求出这个长方形的面积。

senses.gloss_en: a position, point, or area
senses.example_en: Meet me at that place after the exam.
senses.example_cn: 考完试在那个地方等我。

senses.gloss_en: a building, town, or area where you live or go
senses.example_en: This place is small, but it feels safe.
senses.example_cn: 这个地方不大，但住着让人安心。

senses.gloss_en: put something in a particular position
senses.example_en: Place the phone on the table, please.
senses.example_cn: 请把手机放在桌子上。

senses.gloss_en: a road in a town or city, with buildings
senses.example_en: Cars are parked along the street near my house.
senses.example_cn: 我家附近的街边停着不少车。

senses.gloss_en: details of where a person lives or works
senses.example_en: Write your address on this form, please.
senses.example_cn: 请把你的地址写在这张表上。

senses.gloss_en: a set of letters, numbers, and symbols used for email
senses.example_en: Send the file to my email address today.
senses.example_cn: 今天把文件发到我的邮箱地址。

senses.gloss_en: deal with a problem in a planned way
senses.example_en: We must address the problem before the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 开会之前我们必须处理这个问题。

senses.gloss_en: a structure with walls and a roof
senses.example_en: That building is old, but it is strong.
senses.example_cn: 那栋楼很旧，但很结实。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of making buildings
senses.example_en: Building takes time, so the project will finish next year.
senses.example_cn: 施工需要时间，所以这个项目要到明年才完工。

senses.gloss_en: a public area with grass and trees
senses.example_en: We walked in the park after lunch today.
senses.example_cn: 今天午饭后我们在公园里散步。

senses.gloss_en: leave a vehicle in a place for a time
senses.example_en: Park the car by the store, then come.
senses.example_cn: 把车停在商店旁边，然后过来。

senses.gloss_en: an area of water made for swimming
senses.example_en: The hotel pool is closed today for cleaning.
senses.example_cn: 酒店的游泳池今天清洗，不开放。

senses.gloss_en: a game played on a table with balls
senses.example_en: We played pool for an hour after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们打了一个小时台球。

senses.gloss_en: money or resources collected for shared use
senses.example_en: They put money into a pool for the trip.
senses.example_cn: 他们凑了一笔钱作为这次旅行的共用资金。

senses.gloss_en: The middle point or part of something
senses.example_en: Put the desk in the center of the room.
senses.example_cn: 把桌子放在房间正中间。

senses.gloss_en: The main part of a town or city
senses.example_en: We met in the center of town after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后我们在市中心见了面。

senses.gloss_en: To move something so it is in the middle
senses.example_en: Center the title on the page before you print.
senses.example_cn: 打印之前把标题在页面上居中。

senses.gloss_en: The part of something that faces forward
senses.example_en: The front of the house is white.
senses.example_cn: 这栋房子的正面是白色的。

senses.gloss_en: The area or position nearest the front
senses.example_en: Please sit at the front of the classroom.
senses.example_cn: 请坐到教室前面来。

senses.gloss_en: At the front, not the back
senses.example_en: I left my bag on the front desk.
senses.example_cn: 我把包放在前面的桌子上了。

senses.gloss_en: A direction you go or turn
senses.example_en: This way is east, and that way is west.
senses.example_cn: 这边是东，那边是西。

senses.gloss_en: A method of doing something
senses.example_en: This is a good way to learn English.
senses.example_cn: 这是学英语的好方法。

senses.gloss_en: A distance between two places
senses.example_en: It is a long way from here to school.
senses.example_cn: 从这里到学校有很远的路。

senses.gloss_en: A drawing that shows places, roads, and rivers
senses.example_en: I looked at a map before we went north.
senses.example_cn: 我们往北走之前先看了地图。

senses.gloss_en: A simple plan that shows where things are
senses.example_en: The map shows the classroom and the front desk.
senses.example_cn: 这张示意图标出了教室和前台的位置。

senses.gloss_en: to draw a map of a place
senses.example_en: They mapped the city before the new road was built.
senses.example_cn: 修新路之前，他们绘制了这座城市的地图。

senses.gloss_en: The direction where the sun rises
senses.example_en: The window in our classroom faces east.
senses.example_cn: 我们教室的窗户朝东。

senses.gloss_en: In or toward the east
senses.example_en: We drove to the east side of the city.
senses.example_cn: 我们开车去了城市的东边。

senses.gloss_en: Toward the east
senses.example_en: We walked east along the river.
senses.example_cn: 我们沿着河往东走。

senses.gloss_en: The direction on your right at sunrise
senses.example_en: Birds often fly south in winter.
senses.example_cn: 冬天鸟常常飞往南方。

senses.gloss_en: In or toward the south
senses.example_en: They live on the south coast.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在南部的海岸上。

senses.gloss_en: To or in the south
senses.example_en: We traveled south to the next town.
senses.example_cn: 我们往南走，到了下一个镇。

senses.gloss_en: The direction where the sun sets
senses.example_en: The sun goes down in the west.
senses.example_cn: 太阳从西边落下。

senses.gloss_en: In or toward the west
senses.example_en: They live on the west side of town.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在城的西边。

senses.gloss_en: Toward the west
senses.example_en: The road goes west across the bridge.
senses.example_cn: 这条路过桥后一直往西。

senses.gloss_en: an official document for entering or leaving a country
senses.example_en: I need my passport to enter the country.
senses.example_cn: 我需要护照才能入境。

senses.gloss_en: a paper or card that shows you paid
senses.example_en: My ticket is for the train to the city.
senses.example_cn: 我的票是去城里的火车票。

senses.gloss_en: a paper with numbers for a chance to win
senses.example_en: I bought a ticket for the lottery today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天买了一张彩票。

senses.gloss_en: an official notice that orders you to pay a fine
senses.example_en: He got a ticket for driving too fast.
senses.example_cn: 他因为开得太快被开了罚单。

senses.gloss_en: to go from one place to another, often far away
senses.example_en: We travel to the city by train.
senses.example_cn: 我们坐火车去城里。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of going to different places
senses.example_en: Travel is part of my job every week.
senses.example_cn: 出行是我每周工作的一部分。

senses.gloss_en: to move from one place to another, like light or sound
senses.example_en: Sound can travel through the air very fast.
senses.example_cn: 声音能在空气中传得很快。

senses.gloss_en: a journey to a place and back, usually a short one
senses.example_en: We took a trip to the city last week.
senses.example_cn: 上个星期我们去城里玩了一趟。

senses.gloss_en: to hit your foot and fall or lose your balance
senses.example_en: I can trip on the stairs and fall.
senses.gloss_cn: 绊倒（自己踩到而失去平衡）
senses.example_cn: 我在楼梯上可能会绊倒摔跤。

senses.gloss_en: to make someone fall by catching their foot
senses.example_en: He tried to trip me in the game.
senses.example_cn: 比赛中他想把我绊倒。

senses.gloss_en: a time away from work or school to relax
senses.example_en: We are on vacation for two weeks.
senses.example_cn: 我们正在休两个星期的假。

senses.gloss_en: a person who visits a place for pleasure
senses.example_en: The tourist took pictures near the old bridge.
senses.example_cn: 那个游客在老桥附近拍了照。

senses.gloss_en: a person who comes to see a place or person
senses.example_en: The visitor waited in the lobby for me.
senses.example_cn: 那位来访者在大厅等我。

senses.gloss_en: a person who goes to a website on the internet
senses.example_en: Our website gets 5,000 visitors a day.
senses.example_cn: 我们网站每天有五万访客。

senses.gloss_en: go to see a person for a short time
senses.example_en: I visit my friend after class on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 周一下课后我去看我朋友。

senses.gloss_en: go to a place for pleasure or interest
senses.example_en: We visit the park on Sunday afternoon.
senses.example_cn: 我们周日下午去公园玩。

senses.gloss_en: an occasion when you go to see someone or a place
senses.example_en: Her visit to the school was very short.
senses.example_cn: 她这次来学校待的时间很短。

senses.gloss_en: go away from a place
senses.example_en: We leave the airport at ten o’clock.
senses.example_cn: 我们十点离开机场。

senses.gloss_en: not take something with you when you go
senses.example_en: I leave my keys on the table.
senses.example_cn: 我把钥匙留在桌上了。

senses.gloss_en: a period of time away from work, allowed by an employer
senses.example_en: She is on leave from work for one month.
senses.gloss_cn: 休假（单位批准的离岗时间）
senses.example_cn: 她向单位请了一个月的假。

senses.gloss_en: a place where planes land and take off
senses.example_en: The airport is near the city, not far.
senses.example_cn: 机场离城里很近，不远。

senses.gloss_en: a journey made by air, especially in a plane
senses.example_en: Our flight to Seoul was early this morning.
senses.example_cn: 我们飞往首尔的行程是今天一大早。

senses.gloss_en: a plane carrying passengers on a particular trip
senses.example_en: The flight to Bangkok leaves at nine o’clock.
senses.example_cn: 飞往曼谷的航班九点起飞。

senses.gloss_en: an act of escape, running away from a place
senses.example_en: His flight from the city ended at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 他逃离这座城市，最后停在了机场。

senses.gloss_en: Move through the air using wings
senses.example_en: Birds can fly over the lake in summer.
senses.example_cn: 夏天鸟能飞过这个湖。

senses.gloss_en: Travel in an aircraft
senses.example_en: We fly to the south by plane tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 我们明天坐飞机去南方。

senses.gloss_en: A small flying insect
senses.example_en: A fly sat on my sandwich at lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭时一只苍蝇落在我的三明治上。

senses.gloss_en: A building where people pay to stay
senses.example_en: We stayed in a small hotel near the station.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在车站附近一家小旅馆里。

senses.gloss_en: A place where trains or buses stop
senses.example_en: Meet me at the train station in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 早上在火车站等我。

senses.gloss_en: A building where police work and help people
senses.example_en: We went to the police station after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故之后我们去了警察局。

senses.gloss_en: A company that broadcasts programs on radio or TV
senses.example_en: This station plays music all day on the radio.
senses.example_cn: 这个电台一整天都在广播里放音乐。

senses.gloss_en: A line of connected vehicles that runs on tracks
senses.example_en: The train arrived late at the station today.
senses.example_cn: 今天火车很晚才到站。

senses.gloss_en: Teach someone skills for a job or activity
senses.example_en: They train new drivers for the bus route.
senses.example_cn: 他们为这条公交线路培训新司机。

senses.gloss_en: Prepare for a sport by regular exercise
senses.example_en: I train every day for a long race.
senses.example_cn: 我每天为一场长跑训练。

senses.gloss_en: A large road vehicle that carries passengers
senses.example_en: We took the bus to the hotel after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后我们坐公交车去旅馆。
