senses.example_en: Travel was an experience that changed my life.
senses.example_cn: 那次旅行是一段改变了我人生的经历。

senses.gloss_en: to have something happen to you or feel it
senses.example_en: I experienced strong pain after the fall yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 昨天摔了一跤之后，我感到剧烈的疼痛。

senses.gloss_en: improvement toward a goal or better state
senses.example_en: You made progress in English this month.
senses.example_cn: 你这个月英语有进步。

senses.gloss_en: the process of being done or developed, not finished yet
senses.example_en: The project is in progress at our school.
senses.example_cn: 这个项目在我们学校正在进行中。

senses.gloss_en: to improve or develop over time
senses.example_en: My English progressed quickly with daily practice.
senses.example_cn: 每天练习，我的英语进步得很快。

senses.headword_tail: n. A2, adj. B1, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: the height of something
senses.example_en: The water level is high after the rain.
senses.example_cn: 下过雨以后水位很高。

senses.headword_tail: n. A2, adj. B1, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: the amount or strength of something
senses.example_en: The noise level stayed low during the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 开会期间噪音一直不大。

senses.headword_tail: n. A2, adj. B1, v. B2
senses.gloss_en: someone's ability, compared with others
senses.example_en: Students at this level can read short books.
senses.example_cn: 这个水平的学生能读简短的书。

senses.gloss_en: one part of a larger whole
senses.example_en: Each unit of the course has a quiz.
senses.example_cn: 这门课的每个单元都有一次小测。

senses.gloss_en: a group that works as part of an organization
senses.example_en: A police unit arrived quickly at the house.
senses.example_cn: 一支警察小队很快赶到了那栋房子。

senses.gloss_en: a standard amount for measuring something
senses.example_en: Meters are a unit for measuring length.
senses.example_cn: 米是测量长度的单位。

senses.gloss_en: a word or phrase used as a name
senses.example_en: Doctor is a term in medical English.
senses.example_cn: “医生”是医学英语里的一个术语。

senses.gloss_en: one part of the school year
senses.example_en: The term ends in May at our school.
senses.example_cn: 我们学校这个学期五月结束。

senses.gloss_en: a condition in an agreement
senses.example_en: One term of the contract is that you work weekends.
senses.example_cn: 合同里有一条是要你周末上班。

senses.gloss_en: to write or draw a sign on something
senses.example_en: Mark the box on the form for yes.
senses.example_cn: 在表格上“是”的那个方框里做个标记。

senses.gloss_en: a small area of dirt or damage
senses.example_en: There is a mark on the white wall.
senses.example_cn: 白墙上有一处污渍。

senses.gloss_en: a test result, a score
senses.example_en: She got a high mark on the test.
senses.example_cn: 她这次考试得了高分。

senses.gloss_en: an official paper that gives information or proof
senses.example_en: I showed my travel document at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 我在机场出示了旅行证件。

senses.gloss_en: a computer file with written text
senses.example_en: I saved the document on my computer.
senses.example_cn: 我把文档保存在电脑上了。

senses.gloss_en: to record something in writing, photos, or video
senses.example_en: They document the trip with photos every day.
senses.example_cn: 他们用照片每天记录这次旅行。

senses.gloss_en: a large printed picture or notice on a wall
senses.example_en: He put a poster on the bedroom wall.
senses.example_cn: 他在卧室墙上贴了一张海报。

senses.gloss_en: a substance things are made from
senses.example_en: Wood is a strong material for this table.
senses.example_cn: 做这张桌子，木头是很结实的材料。

senses.gloss_en: information, ideas used to write something
senses.example_en: I collected material for my speech at school.
senses.example_cn: 我为学校的演讲收集了素材。

senses.gloss_en: relating to money, possessions, not feelings
senses.example_en: He wants material things, not love or friendship.
senses.example_cn: 他要的是物质上的东西，不是爱情或友情。

senses.gloss_en: a long flat piece of wood, used for building
senses.example_en: He nailed a board over the broken window.
senses.example_cn: 他在破窗户上钉了一块木板。

senses.gloss_en: a surface for writing, or posting notices
senses.example_en: Write your name on the board at school.
senses.example_cn: 在学校把你的名字写在黑板上。

senses.gloss_en: get on a train, bus, or plane
senses.example_en: We board the bus at seven every morning.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天早上七点上公交车。

senses.gloss_en: an area of land for farming
senses.example_en: Cows are in the field behind the house.
senses.example_cn: 牛在屋后的田地里。

senses.gloss_en: an area where sports are played
senses.example_en: The kids ran across the field after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后孩子们跑过球场。

senses.gloss_en: an area of work or study
senses.example_en: She works in the field of health care.
senses.example_cn: 她在医疗领域工作。

senses.gloss_en: the study of numbers, amounts, and shapes
senses.example_en: Mathematics helps us measure, count, and solve problems.
senses.example_cn: 数学帮我们测量、计数和解决问题。

senses.gloss_en: US short form of mathematics
senses.example_en: I have math homework after dinner every night.
senses.example_cn: 我每天晚饭后都有数学作业。

senses.gloss_en: the scientific study of the life of plants and animals
senses.example_en: Biology helps me learn about plants and animals.
senses.example_cn: 生物学让我了解植物和动物。

senses.gloss_en: the scientific study of substances and their reactions
senses.example_en: She studies chemistry at school every week.
senses.example_cn: 她每周都在学校学化学。

senses.gloss_en: the chemical makeup of something, how it reacts
senses.example_en: Scientists study the chemistry of the air today.
senses.gloss_cn: 化学成分（物质及其反应）
senses.example_cn: 科学家今天在研究空气的化学成分。

senses.gloss_en: a special feeling of connection between two people
senses.example_en: They had chemistry and they talked all night.
senses.example_cn: 他们之间很有默契，聊了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: the scientific study of matter, energy, and forces
senses.example_en: Physics helps us understand light, heat, and sound.
senses.example_cn: 物理学帮我们弄懂光、热和声音。

senses.gloss_en: the art of designing buildings
senses.example_en: He studies architecture at university with his sister.
senses.example_cn: 他和姐姐一起在大学学建筑。

senses.gloss_en: the style and design of buildings
senses.example_en: I love the architecture of this old church.
senses.example_cn: 我很喜欢这座老教堂的建筑风格。

senses.gloss_en: careful study to discover new facts
senses.example_en: Her research helps doctors find new medicine.
senses.example_cn: 她的研究帮助医生找到了新药。

senses.gloss_en: to study something carefully to discover new facts
senses.example_en: They research the problem before they choose.
senses.example_cn: 他们在做选择之前先研究这个问题。

senses.gloss_en: a person who studies a subject to discover facts
senses.example_en: The researcher studies plants in the lab daily.
senses.example_cn: 那位研究人员每天在实验室研究植物。

senses.gloss_en: a scientific test to learn something
senses.example_en: We did an experiment in class today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天在课上做了一个实验。

senses.gloss_en: to try new ideas to see what happens
senses.example_en: She experimented with a new study method.
senses.example_cn: 她尝试了一种新的学习方法。

senses.gloss_en: a new method tried to see if it works
senses.example_en: The project was an experiment in new teaching.
senses.example_cn: 那个项目是新教学法的一次尝试。

senses.gloss_en: a way of doing something
senses.example_en: This method works well for new students.
senses.example_cn: 这个方法对新学生很有效。

senses.gloss_en: a careful plan for doing something
senses.example_en: We need a method for solving this problem.
senses.example_cn: 我们需要一套办法来解决这个问题。

senses.gloss_en: a set of questions to gather information
senses.example_en: The survey asked people about their daily habits.
senses.example_cn: 这份问卷调查问了大家的日常习惯。

senses.gloss_en: to ask many people questions for information
senses.example_en: They surveyed students about the new schedule.
senses.example_cn: 他们对学生们进行了新校期的调查。

senses.gloss_en: to look carefully at the whole of something
senses.example_en: He surveyed the room and sat down.
senses.example_cn: 他环顾了一下房间，然后坐了下来。

senses.gloss_en: to look at something again to study or check
senses.example_en: Please review your notes before the test.
senses.example_cn: 考试前请把你的笔记复习一遍。

senses.gloss_en: a written opinion about a book, movie, or show
senses.example_en: I read a review of the new movie.
senses.example_cn: 我看了一篇关于那部新电影的评论。

senses.gloss_en: a careful examination to decide if changes are needed
senses.example_en: The company did a review of safety rules.
senses.example_cn: 公司对安全规定做了一次审查。

senses.gloss_en: an idea or plan you offer for others to consider
senses.example_en: My suggestion is to take the earlier train.
senses.example_cn: 我的建议是坐更早的那趟火车。

senses.gloss_en: a sign that something might be true
senses.example_en: There was no suggestion of trouble in class.
senses.example_cn: 课堂上没有任何要出乱子的迹象。

senses.gloss_en: the reason why something happens
senses.example_en: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
senses.example_cn: 这场火灾的原因还不清楚。

senses.gloss_en: to make something happen, often something bad
senses.example_en: Heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
senses.example_cn: 大雨造成了城里发洪水。

senses.gloss_en: a reason for having a particular feeling or for doing something
senses.example_en: You have no cause to worry.
senses.example_cn: 你没有理由担心。

senses.gloss_en: a change caused by something
senses.example_en: The new rule had a strong effect on sales.
senses.example_cn: 新规定对销售影响很大。

senses.gloss_en: an impression created to affect people
senses.example_en: He paused for effect and everyone stayed quiet.
senses.example_cn: 他故意停顿了一下制造效果，大家都不出声。

senses.gloss_en: a person’s things, personal belongings
senses.example_en: She packed her effects and left the hotel.
senses.example_cn: 她收拾好随身物品，离开了旅馆。

senses.gloss_en: one thing that influences a result
senses.example_en: Cost was a big factor in our decision.
senses.example_cn: 成本是我们做决定时的一大因素。

senses.gloss_en: a number that divides another exactly
senses.example_en: Two is a factor of ten.
senses.example_cn: 二是十的因数。

senses.gloss_en: an amount used to multiply another amount
senses.example_en: Prices rose by a factor of ten.
senses.example_cn: 价格涨到了原来的十倍。

senses.gloss_en: the regular way something happens or is done
senses.example_en: Her sleep pattern changed after the long flight.
senses.example_cn: 长途飞行之后她的睡眠规律变了。

senses.gloss_en: a design with repeated lines, shapes, or colors
senses.example_en: The shirt has a blue pattern of stars.
senses.example_cn: 这件衬衫上有蓝色的星星图案。

senses.gloss_en: a paper guide for making clothes or models
senses.example_en: I used a pattern to cut the cloth.
senses.example_cn: 我照着纸样把布料裁开了。

senses.gloss_en: the way parts are arranged or organized
senses.example_en: The structure of the essay is clear and simple.
senses.example_cn: 这篇文章的结构清楚又简单。

senses.gloss_en: a building or something built from parts
senses.example_en: The old structure fell during the storm.
senses.example_cn: 那座老建筑在暴风雨中倒了。

senses.gloss_en: arrange something in an organized way
senses.example_en: We structured the lesson into three short parts.
senses.example_cn: 我们把这节课安排成了三个小部分。

senses.gloss_en: the form or outline of something
senses.example_en: The shape of the lake looks like a heart.
senses.example_cn: 这个湖的形状像一颗心。

senses.gloss_en: the condition of something, especially health or fitness
senses.example_en: Now I am in bad shape after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 旅行回来后我现在状态很差。

senses.gloss_en: influence how something develops or happens
senses.example_en: Money shaped his choice and he stayed home.
senses.example_cn: 金钱影响了他的选择，于是他留在了家里。

senses.gloss_en: the smallest unit of a plant or animal
senses.example_en: A cell has a wall or a membrane.
senses.example_cn: 细胞有细胞壁或者细胞膜。

senses.gloss_en: a small room for a prisoner
senses.example_en: He sat in a cell all night.
senses.example_cn: 他在牢房里坐了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: a small group inside a larger organization
senses.example_en: The group formed a cell inside the party.
senses.example_cn: 这些人在党内组成了一个小组。

senses.gloss_en: how fast someone or something moves
senses.example_en: The speed of the train stayed high all day.
senses.example_cn: 火车一整天都保持着很高的速度。

senses.gloss_en: to drive faster than the law allows
senses.example_en: He sped through the town and got a ticket.
senses.example_cn: 他超速穿过镇子，被开了罚单。

senses.gloss_en: to make something happen more quickly
senses.example_en: Please speed the delivery, I need it today.
senses.example_cn: 请加快发货，我今天就要。

senses.gloss_en: the situation that helps you understand something
senses.example_en: Without context, the joke sounded rude to me.
senses.example_cn: 不了解当时的情境，那个玩笑我听着很没礼貌。

senses.gloss_en: the words around a word that show its meaning
senses.example_en: In this sentence, context tells you what it means.
senses.example_cn: 在这个句子里，上下文能告诉你它的意思。

senses.gloss_en: a problem, something wrong
senses.example_en: Something was the matter, the lights went out.
senses.example_cn: 出了点毛病，灯灭了。

senses.gloss_en: a subject or situation you must deal with
senses.example_en: This matter needs a quick decision from the team.
senses.example_cn: 这件事需要团队尽快做决定。

senses.gloss_en: to be important
senses.example_en: It does not matter if we are a little late.
senses.example_cn: 我们稍微晚一点也没关系。

senses.gloss_en: a short piece of writing about one subject
senses.example_en: I wrote an essay about whales for my class.
senses.example_cn: 我为课堂写了一篇关于鲸鱼的作文。

senses.gloss_en: a formal talk given to an audience
senses.example_en: Her speech about safety made everyone listen quietly.
senses.example_cn: 她关于安全的演讲让大家都安静地听着。

senses.gloss_en: the act of speaking, not writing
senses.example_en: This word is common in speech, not writing.
senses.example_cn: 这个词在口语里常见，书面语里少用。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to speak
senses.example_en: After the accident, his speech became slow and unclear.
senses.example_cn: 事故之后，他说话变得又慢又不清楚。

senses.gloss_en: details that make something clear
senses.example_en: The explanation made the rule easy for us.
senses.example_cn: 那番讲解让我们很容易明白这条规则。

senses.gloss_en: a reason you give for something
senses.example_en: Her explanation for being late was the rain.
senses.example_cn: 她迟到的理由是下雨。

senses.gloss_en: something you say or do to show feelings
senses.example_en: Her smile was an expression of joy for us.
senses.example_cn: 她的笑对我们来说是喜悦的表达。

senses.gloss_en: a look on someone's face, showing feelings
senses.example_en: He had a surprised expression on his face.
senses.example_cn: 他脸上带着惊讶的表情。

senses.gloss_en: a word or phrase with a special meaning
senses.example_en: That expression means a difficult situation for me.
senses.example_cn: 那个说法在我这儿指的是困难的处境。

senses.gloss_en: a talk about something, sharing ideas or opinions
senses.example_en: We had a discussion about the plan after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后我们讨论了那个计划。

senses.gloss_en: a speech or piece of writing about a subject
senses.example_en: Her discussion of the book was clear and short.
senses.example_cn: 她对这本书的论述清楚又简短。

senses.gloss_en: a subject that people talk about together
senses.example_en: Money is a common subject for discussion at home.
senses.example_cn: 钱是家里常见的话题。

senses.gloss_en: the first part of a book or speech
senses.example_en: The introduction explains the plan for this book.
senses.example_cn: 前言里说明了这本书的写作安排。

senses.gloss_en: the act of bringing something into use first
senses.example_en: The introduction of new rules changed our work.
senses.example_cn: 新规定的引入改变了我们的工作。

senses.gloss_en: the act of making one person known to another
senses.example_en: She made an introduction at the party last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚在派对上她给大家做了介绍。

senses.gloss_en: information and skills you gain from study or life
senses.example_en: Her knowledge of cooking comes from her mother.
senses.example_cn: 她做菜的知识是从妈妈那儿学来的。

senses.gloss_en: awareness that something exists or happened
senses.example_en: I had no knowledge of the change yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 昨天那个改动我完全不知情。

senses.gloss_en: a fact known by many people
senses.example_en: It is common knowledge in our town now.
senses.example_cn: 这件事在我们镇上现在已经人人都知道了。

senses.gloss_en: knowledge about something, how it works or happens
senses.example_en: I have a good understanding of how the engine works.
senses.example_cn: 我对这台发动机的工作原理有很好的理解。

senses.gloss_en: sympathy for others, forgiving their mistakes
senses.example_en: Her understanding helped me after my mistake.
senses.example_cn: 我犯错之后，她的体谅帮了我。

senses.gloss_en: an idea that comes into your mind
senses.example_en: A strange thought came to me on the bus.
senses.example_cn: 在公交车上我忽然冒出一个奇怪的念头。

senses.gloss_en: careful thinking about something before you act
senses.example_en: Give it thought before you send the email.
senses.example_cn: 这封邮件发出去之前，先好好考虑一下。

senses.gloss_en: your ideas or opinions about something
senses.example_en: What are your thoughts on this new class.
senses.example_cn: 你对这门新课有什么看法？

senses.gloss_en: the process of using your mind
senses.example_en: After class, I did some thinking at home.
senses.example_cn: 下课后我在家里思考了一会儿。

senses.gloss_en: the ideas or opinions someone has
senses.example_en: Her thinking on this topic changed last year.
senses.example_cn: 她对这个话题的看法去年变了。

senses.gloss_en: careful thought before you decide
senses.example_en: I did some careful thinking before I answered.
senses.example_cn: 我认真考虑了一番才回答。

senses.gloss_en: to give full attention to one thing
senses.example_en: Please focus on the main idea for now.
senses.example_cn: 现在请专注在主要意思上。

senses.gloss_en: to adjust eyes or a camera to see clearly
senses.example_en: I cannot focus the camera on your face.
senses.example_cn: 我怎么也没法把相机对焦到你的脸上。

senses.gloss_en: the main thing people pay attention to
senses.example_en: Safety is the focus of our meeting today.
senses.example_cn: 安全是我们今天开会的重点。

senses.gloss_en: to see or become aware of something
senses.example_en: Did you notice the new sign by the door?
senses.example_cn: 你注意到门边的新牌子了吗？

senses.gloss_en: a written sign that gives information
senses.example_en: A notice on the wall said the store closed.
senses.example_cn: 墙上的告示说这家店关门了。

senses.gloss_en: attention given to someone or something
senses.example_en: She took no notice of the loud music.
senses.example_cn: 她根本不理会那吵闹的音乐。

senses.gloss_en: a mistake that makes something wrong
senses.example_en: I made an error in my math homework.
senses.example_cn: 我的数学作业里出了一处错误。

senses.gloss_en: a wrong decision about what to do
senses.example_en: It was an error to leave the keys outside.
senses.example_cn: 把钥匙留在外面是个失误。

senses.gloss_en: a problem in a computer system or program
senses.example_en: The app showed an error and then it closed.
senses.example_cn: 那个应用报了个错，然后就关掉了。

senses.gloss_en: an answer to a problem
senses.example_en: We found a solution after a long talk.
senses.example_cn: 谈了很久之后我们找到了解决办法。

senses.gloss_en: a liquid with something dissolved in it
senses.example_en: Salt water is a simple solution for cleaning.
senses.example_cn: 盐水就是一种简单的清洁溶液。

senses.gloss_en: the correct answer in math
senses.example_en: The solution was 12, so I checked again.
senses.example_cn: 答案是十二，所以我又检查了一遍。

senses.gloss_en: a chance that something might happen
senses.example_en: There is a possibility of rain later today.
senses.example_cn: 今天晚些时候有下雨的可能。

senses.gloss_en: something that could happen or be done
senses.example_en: A trip to the beach is one possibility.
senses.example_cn: 去海边玩是一种可能的安排。

senses.gloss_en: one choice you can consider
senses.example_en: Another possibility is to call her tomorrow morning.
senses.example_cn: 另一个选择是明天早上给她打电话。

senses.gloss_en: the act of deciding between two or more things
senses.example_en: I made a choice between tea and coffee.
senses.example_cn: 我在茶和咖啡之间做了选择。

senses.gloss_en: the right or ability to decide what to do
senses.example_en: You have a choice, so choose the blue one.
senses.example_cn: 你有选择权，那就挑蓝色那个吧。

senses.gloss_en: a range of things you can pick from
senses.example_en: The store has a choice of three cakes today.
senses.example_cn: 这家店今天有三种蛋糕可以挑。

senses.gloss_en: the possibility that something will happen
senses.example_en: There is a chance it will rain today.
senses.example_cn: 今天有可能会下雨。

senses.gloss_en: a time when you can do something
senses.example_en: I did not get a chance to call you.
senses.example_cn: 我一直没机会给你打电话。

senses.gloss_en: events that happen without a clear cause
senses.example_en: It was pure chance that we met at lunch.
senses.example_cn: 我们午饭时碰到，纯属偶然。

senses.gloss_en: the reason something is done or exists
senses.example_en: The purpose of this test is to help you.
senses.example_cn: 这次测试的目的是帮你。

senses.gloss_en: a feeling of being determined to do something
senses.example_en: She worked with purpose and finished the job.
senses.example_cn: 她干得很有劲头，把活儿做完了。

senses.gloss_en: a type of person or thing
senses.example_en: What sort of music do you like best?
senses.example_cn: 你最喜欢哪种音乐？

senses.gloss_en: a person of a particular type
senses.example_en: He is a friendly sort, always ready to help.
senses.example_cn: 他是那种很友善的人，总乐意帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: to put things into groups or in order
senses.example_en: Please sort the papers into two piles.
senses.example_cn: 请把这些文件分成两堆。

senses.gloss_en: several different kinds of the same thing
senses.example_en: We sell a variety of fruit at the market.
senses.example_cn: 我们在市场上卖各式各样的水果。

senses.gloss_en: the quality of not always being the same
senses.example_en: I need variety so I cook new food.
senses.example_cn: 我需要点变化，所以做了新的菜。

senses.gloss_en: one particular type within a larger group
senses.example_en: This variety of apple is sweet and red.
senses.example_cn: 这个品种的苹果又甜又红。

senses.gloss_en: a thing made to be the same as another
senses.example_en: I printed a copy of the form for you.
senses.example_cn: 我给你打印了一份表格的复印件。

senses.gloss_en: make something the same as the original
senses.example_en: Please copy this file to the new folder.
senses.example_cn: 请把这个文件复制到新文件夹里。

senses.gloss_en: do the same thing as someone else
senses.example_en: Kids copy their parents when they talk.
senses.example_cn: 孩子说话时会模仿父母。

senses.gloss_en: a round shape with no corners
senses.example_en: Draw a circle on the paper for me.
senses.example_cn: 在纸上给我画个圆。

senses.gloss_en: draw a circle around something on paper
senses.example_en: Circle the correct word in the sentence.
senses.example_cn: 把句子里正确的那个词圈出来。

senses.gloss_en: a group of people sitting or standing in a ring
senses.example_en: We sat in a circle and told stories.
senses.example_cn: 我们围成一圈坐着讲故事。

senses.gloss_en: a tall post, often supporting part of a building
senses.example_en: The stone column held the roof above us.
senses.example_cn: 那根石柱撑住了我们头顶的屋顶。

senses.gloss_en: a vertical line of words, numbers on a page
senses.example_en: Add the numbers in the first column.
senses.gloss_cn: 列（纵向排列的字或数字）
senses.example_cn: 把第一列的数字加起来。

senses.gloss_en: a regular newspaper article by one writer
senses.example_en: I read her column every Sunday morning.
senses.example_cn: 我每个周日早上都读她的专栏。

senses.gloss_en: the act of finding something for the first time
senses.example_en: The discovery of the cave surprised the town.
senses.example_cn: 那个洞穴的发现让全镇都很惊讶。

senses.gloss_en: something found or learned for the first time
senses.example_en: The new plant was a discovery for scientists.
senses.example_cn: 这种新植物是科学家的一个新发现。

senses.gloss_en: used to ask who something belongs to
senses.example_en: Whose bag is on the bed?
senses.example_cn: 床上那个包是谁的？

senses.gloss_en: meaning the person who owns something
senses.example_en: Whose is this, the blue bag?
senses.example_cn: 这个蓝色的包是谁的？

senses.gloss_en: showing which person or thing has something
senses.example_en: I met the woman whose bike was outside.
senses.gloss_cn: 那个人的（引出定语从句）
senses.example_cn: 我遇到了那位自行车停在外面的女士。

senses.gloss_en: in the inner part of something, not outside
senses.example_en: The cat is inside the box.
senses.example_cn: 猫在盒子里面。

senses.gloss_en: in or into a room or building
senses.example_en: We went inside to get the keys.
senses.example_cn: 我们进屋里去拿钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: the inner part or surface of something
senses.example_en: The inside of the bag is wet.
senses.example_cn: 这个包里面湿了。

senses.gloss_en: in the middle of, surrounded by other things
senses.example_en: He stood among trees near the river.
senses.example_cn: 他站在河边的树丛中。

senses.gloss_en: in a group, included with other people
senses.example_en: She is among friends at the party.
senses.example_cn: 她在派对上和朋友们在一起。

senses.gloss_en: divided so each person gets a share
senses.example_en: We shared the cake among the children.
senses.gloss_cn: 在几个人之间分（各得一份）
senses.example_cn: 我们把蛋糕分给了几个孩子。

senses.gloss_en: from one part of a road or river to another
senses.example_en: We walked along the beach after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后我们沿着海滩散步。

senses.gloss_en: in a line next to something long
senses.example_en: Houses stand along the main road.
senses.example_cn: 房子沿着大路一排排立着。

senses.gloss_en: forward, continuing in the same direction
senses.example_en: We walked along and talked about the trip.
senses.example_cn: 我们一路往前走，边走边聊这次旅行。

senses.gloss_en: in the direction of someone or something
senses.example_en: We drove toward the mountains in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 早上我们开车朝山的方向去了。

senses.gloss_en: near the end of a time period
senses.example_en: The show ended toward the end of June.
senses.example_cn: 这场演出快到六月底时结束了。

senses.gloss_en: relating to feelings or opinions about someone
senses.example_en: His attitude toward work is changing.
senses.example_cn: 他对工作的态度正在改变。

senses.gloss_en: opposed to someone or something
senses.example_en: We are against racism in our school.
senses.example_cn: 我们学校反对种族歧视。

senses.gloss_en: touching something, with no space between
senses.example_en: The bed is against the wall.
senses.example_cn: 那张床紧靠着墙。

senses.gloss_en: not allowed by a rule or law
senses.example_en: It is against the law to leave children alone.
senses.example_cn: 把孩子单独留在家里是违法的。

senses.gloss_en: Having someone or something as part of a whole
senses.example_en: We invited everyone, including my brother.
senses.example_cn: 我们把所有人都请了，包括我弟弟。

senses.gloss_en: To a position on a surface or place
senses.example_en: He stepped onto the bus slowly.
senses.example_cn: 他慢慢地迈上了公交车。

senses.gloss_en: As stated or reported by someone or something
senses.example_en: The store is closed, according to my dad.
senses.example_cn: 据我爸说，那家店关门了。

senses.gloss_en: Following rules, instructions, or a plan
senses.example_en: Everything went according to the plan.
senses.chunk: Everything went according to the plan
senses.example_cn: 一切都按计划进行。

senses.gloss_en: For each person, amount, time, or distance
senses.example_en: Tickets are $20 per person tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚的票每人二十美元。

senses.gloss_en: From a past time until now
senses.example_en: I have lived here since 2020.
senses.example_cn: 我从二〇二〇年起就住在这里。

senses.gloss_en: From the time when something happened in the past
senses.example_en: I have worked here since I left school.
senses.example_cn: 我自从毕业以后就一直在这儿工作。

senses.gloss_en: Because a fact makes something true or necessary
senses.example_en: We should go since it is late.
senses.example_cn: 既然已经很晚了，我们该走了。

senses.gloss_en: in every place
senses.example_en: I see snow everywhere in winter.
senses.example_cn: 冬天我到处都能看见雪。

senses.gloss_en: not in any place
senses.example_en: There is nowhere to sit in this room.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间里没有地方可以坐。

senses.gloss_en: in or to another country
senses.example_en: She works overseas for six months.
senses.example_cn: 她要在国外工作六个月。

senses.gloss_en: from or in another country
senses.example_en: We have many overseas students at this school.
senses.example_cn: 这所学校有很多海外学生。

senses.gloss_en: below the ground
senses.example_en: The tunnel is underground under the city.
senses.example_cn: 那条隧道在城市的地下。

senses.gloss_en: below the ground
senses.example_en: The cable runs underground near the road.
senses.example_cn: 那条电缆在路边埋在地下。

senses.gloss_en: secret and illegal
senses.example_en: They printed an underground newspaper at night.
senses.example_cn: 他们晚上偷偷印一份地下报纸。

senses.gloss_en: toward the front
senses.example_en: Step forward and open the door.
senses.example_cn: 向前一步，把门打开。

senses.gloss_en: toward the future
senses.example_en: From today forward, we save money every week.
senses.example_cn: 从今天起，我们每周都存钱。

senses.gloss_en: in the front part
senses.example_en: The forward seats are close to the door.
senses.example_cn: 前排座位靠近车门。

senses.gloss_en: not bent or curved
senses.example_en: The road is straight for two miles.
senses.example_cn: 这条路有两英里都是直的。

senses.gloss_en: directly without turning
senses.example_en: Go straight home after school today.
senses.example_cn: 今天放学后直接回家。

senses.gloss_en: honest and direct
senses.example_en: Be straight with me about the plan.
senses.example_cn: 关于这个计划请对我坦诚相告。

senses.gloss_en: near in space or time
senses.example_en: My house is close to the park.
senses.example_cn: 我家离公园很近。

senses.gloss_en: near, not far away
senses.example_en: Stay close when we walk at night.
senses.example_cn: 晚上走路的时候跟紧一点。

senses.gloss_en: having a strong relationship
senses.example_en: She is a close friend of my sister.
senses.example_cn: 她是我姐姐的一个亲密好友。

senses.gloss_en: one of the Earth's large land masses
senses.example_en: Africa is a continent with many different countries.
senses.example_cn: 非洲是一个有很多不同国家的大洲。

senses.gloss_en: a large area of land, often without clear borders
senses.example_en: This region has mountains, forests, and cold rivers.
senses.example_cn: 这个地区有山，有森林，还有寒冷的河流。

senses.gloss_en: one of the official areas of a country
senses.example_en: The region has its own government, schools, and laws.
senses.gloss_cn: 行政区（国家的一级区划）
senses.example_cn: 这个行政区有自己的政府、学校和法律。

senses.gloss_en: an area of the body near a part
senses.example_en: He has pain in the lower back region.
senses.example_cn: 他后腰那个部位疼。

senses.gloss_en: a very small town in the countryside
senses.example_en: We stayed in a quiet village near the river.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在河边一个安静的村子里。

senses.gloss_en: the people living in a small countryside town
senses.example_en: The whole village came out to see us.
senses.example_cn: 全村的人都出来看我们。

senses.gloss_en: the official home of a king, queen, or leader
senses.example_en: The palace is the king's official home.
senses.example_cn: 王宫是国王的官方住所。

senses.gloss_en: a very large, impressive house
senses.example_en: They bought a palace, a huge house by sea.
senses.example_cn: 他们在海边买了一座豪宅，房子特别大。

senses.gloss_en: the royal family and advisers
senses.example_en: The Palace said the king will visit tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 王室方面表示国王明天会来访。

senses.gloss_en: a tall, narrow building or structure
senses.example_en: The tower is tall, with a clock on top.
senses.example_cn: 这座塔很高，顶上还有一座钟。

senses.gloss_en: a tall piece of furniture for storing things
senses.example_en: She bought a CD tower for her room.
senses.example_cn: 她给自己房间买了一个光盘收纳架。

senses.gloss_en: the way someone or something moves or points
senses.example_en: The car moved in the wrong direction fast.
senses.example_cn: 那辆车飞快地朝错误的方向开去。

senses.gloss_en: instructions for finding a place or doing something
senses.example_en: The directions to the station are on this map.
senses.example_cn: 去车站怎么走，这张地图上有说明。

senses.gloss_en: control or management of a person or activity
senses.example_en: She works under the direction of her teacher.
senses.example_cn: 她在老师的指导下做事。

senses.gloss_en: In or to the center of a city
senses.example_en: We drove downtown after dinner in the rain.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们在雨里开车去了市中心。

senses.gloss_en: In the central business area of a city
senses.example_en: We found a downtown hotel near the station.
senses.example_cn: 我们在车站附近找到一家市中心的酒店。

senses.gloss_en: The central part of a city or town
senses.example_en: Downtown is busy at night during the festival.
senses.example_cn: 节日期间市中心晚上很热闹。

senses.gloss_en: Having four equal sides and four right angles
senses.example_en: She cut a square piece of paper carefully.
senses.example_cn: 她仔细地剪出一张正方形的纸。

senses.gloss_en: A shape with four equal sides and four right angles
senses.example_en: Draw a square on the page with a pen.
senses.example_cn: 用笔在纸上画一个正方形。

senses.gloss_en: An open area in a town, surrounded by buildings
senses.example_en: We met in the square near the old church.
senses.example_cn: 我们在老教堂旁边的广场上见了面。

senses.gloss_en: A solid piece of material with flat sides
senses.example_en: He lifted a block of ice with gloves.
senses.example_cn: 他戴着手套搬起一块冰。

senses.gloss_en: A group of buildings with streets on all sides
senses.example_en: The cafe is one block from my apartment.
senses.example_cn: 那家咖啡馆离我的公寓只有一个街区。

senses.gloss_en: To stop movement through or past something
senses.example_en: A parked truck blocked the narrow street today.
senses.example_cn: 今天一辆停着的卡车把那条窄街堵住了。

senses.gloss_en: The point where two sides or lines meet
senses.example_en: The corner of the table scratched my arm.
senses.example_cn: 桌角把我的胳膊划伤了。

senses.gloss_en: The place in a room where two walls meet
senses.example_en: A lamp sat in the corner by the bed.
senses.example_cn: 床边的墙角放着一盏灯。

senses.gloss_en: The place where two streets meet
senses.example_en: We waited at the corner for the bus.
senses.example_cn: 我们在街角等公交车。

senses.gloss_en: The left or right part of something
senses.example_en: I sleep on the left side of the bed.
senses.example_cn: 我睡在床的左边。

senses.gloss_en: A flat surface of something, not the top or bottom
senses.example_en: Write your name on the side of the box.
senses.example_cn: 把你的名字写在盒子的侧面。

senses.gloss_en: One edge of something, such as a shape
senses.example_en: A square has four sides.
senses.example_cn: 正方形有四条边。

senses.gloss_en: A structure built over a river or road for crossing
senses.example_en: We crossed the bridge before the sun set.
senses.example_cn: 太阳落山前我们过了桥。

senses.gloss_en: Something that joins or connects different people or things
senses.example_en: The project became a bridge between two teams.
senses.example_cn: 这个项目成了两个团队之间的桥梁。

senses.gloss_en: The top part of the nose, between the eyes
senses.example_en: He broke the bridge of his nose yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 他昨天摔断了鼻梁。

senses.gloss_en: a door in a fence or outside wall
senses.example_en: Please close the gate after you come in.
senses.gloss_cn: 大门（围墙或篱笆上的门）
senses.example_cn: 进来以后请把门关上。

senses.gloss_en: the entrance to a large place, often with doors
senses.example_en: A guard stood at the gate all night.
senses.example_cn: 有个警卫在大门口站了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: the place at an airport where you get on a plane
senses.example_en: We waited at the gate and boarded at noon.
senses.example_cn: 我们在登机口等着，中午登上了飞机。

senses.gloss_en: the area inside the entrance of a building
senses.example_en: I left my shoes in the hall by the door.
senses.example_cn: 我把鞋脱在门厅的门边了。

senses.gloss_en: a passage in a building, with doors to rooms
senses.example_en: Her office is at the end of the hall.
senses.example_cn: 她的办公室在走廊尽头。

senses.gloss_en: a large room or building for meetings, shows, or concerts
senses.example_en: The school hall was full for the concert.
senses.example_cn: 音乐会那天学校礼堂里坐满了人。

senses.gloss_en: the center part of something
senses.example_en: Put the cups in the middle of the table.
senses.example_cn: 把杯子放在桌子中间。

senses.gloss_en: a time between the beginning and the end
senses.example_en: We will meet in the middle of April.
senses.example_cn: 我们四月中旬见。

senses.gloss_en: in a central position, not at the ends
senses.example_en: The middle seat is open near the window.
senses.example_cn: 靠窗那排中间的座位还空着。

senses.gloss_en: the lowest part or surface of something
senses.example_en: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
senses.example_cn: 钥匙在我包的最底下。

senses.gloss_en: the lowest position in a group or list
senses.example_en: He finished at the bottom of the class.
senses.example_cn: 他考了全班最后一名。

senses.gloss_en: in the lowest position
senses.example_en: The bottom shelf is close to the floor.
senses.example_cn: 最下面那层架子挨着地板。

senses.gloss_en: an empty space between two things
senses.example_en: There is a gap between the door and floor.
senses.example_cn: 门和地板之间有一道缝。

senses.gloss_en: a missing part that makes something incomplete
senses.example_en: The story has a gap, a missing year.
senses.example_cn: 这个故事有个空白，缺了一年。

senses.gloss_en: a difference between two groups or situations
senses.example_en: There is a gap between rich and poor people.
senses.example_cn: 富人和穷人之间存在差距。

senses.gloss_en: a system for moving people or goods to places
senses.example_en: Public transportation is cheap in this city.
senses.example_cn: 这个城市的公共交通很便宜。

senses.gloss_en: a vehicle or way of traveling somewhere
senses.example_en: Do you have transportation to the airport today.
senses.example_cn: 你今天有去机场的交通工具吗？

senses.gloss_en: a machine that carries people or goods from place to place
senses.example_en: This vehicle has four wheels and a strong engine.
senses.example_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子，发动机也很强劲。

senses.gloss_en: something used to express an idea or message
senses.example_en: Music is a vehicle for his feelings.
senses.example_cn: 音乐是他表达感情的载体。

senses.gloss_en: the part of a vehicle that produces power
senses.example_en: The engine is loud when the bus starts.
senses.example_cn: 公交车启动时发动机声音很大。

senses.gloss_en: a machine that uses energy to produce movement
senses.example_en: This engine moves water up the hill.
senses.example_cn: 这台发动机把水抽到山上去。

senses.gloss_en: a vehicle that pulls a train
senses.example_en: The engine pulled the train out of the station.
senses.example_cn: 火车头把列车拉出了车站。

senses.gloss_en: a round object that turns under a vehicle
senses.example_en: The front wheel hit a rock on the road.
senses.example_cn: 前轮在路上撞到了一块石头。

senses.gloss_en: the round control you turn to steer a car
senses.example_en: She held the wheel and turned left slowly.
senses.example_cn: 她握着方向盘慢慢向左转。

senses.gloss_en: a round part that turns in a machine
senses.example_en: A wheel turns inside the clock all day.
senses.example_cn: 钟里面有个轮子不停地转动着。

senses.gloss_en: a substance like air, not solid or liquid
senses.example_en: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
senses.example_cn: 氧气是我们呼吸所需要的气体。

senses.gloss_en: a fuel used for cooking and heating
senses.example_en: We cook with gas in our small kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 我们在小厨房里用煤气做饭。

senses.gloss_en: gasoline, fuel for car engines
senses.example_en: I need gas before we drive to school.
senses.example_cn: 开车去学校之前我得加汽油。

senses.gloss_en: the activity or way someone drives a vehicle
senses.example_en: Her driving is careful on busy roads.
senses.example_cn: 在车多的路上她开车很小心。

senses.gloss_en: A company that provides flights for people, goods
senses.example_en: This airline has flights to Canada every day.
senses.example_cn: 这家航空公司每天都有飞加拿大的航班。

senses.gloss_en: A person traveling in a vehicle, not driving or working
senses.example_en: The passenger sat quietly and looked out the window.
senses.example_cn: 那位乘客安静地坐着，望着窗外。

senses.gloss_en: A person who flies an aircraft
senses.example_en: The pilot landed the plane safely in heavy rain.
senses.example_cn: 飞行员在大雨中把飞机安全降落了。

senses.gloss_en: A person who guides a ship in dangerous waters
senses.example_en: A pilot guided the ship into the busy port.
senses.gloss_cn: 领航员（引船过险水的人）
senses.example_cn: 一名领航员把船引进了繁忙的港口。

senses.gloss_en: A single TV show made to test whether a series will be popular
senses.example_en: We watched the pilot and wanted more episodes.
senses.example_cn: 我们看了试播集，还想看更多。

senses.gloss_en: Moving, able to move through the air
senses.example_en: Flying glass cut the passenger near the window.
senses.example_cn: 飞溅的玻璃划伤了靠窗的乘客。

senses.gloss_en: Traveling in an aircraft
senses.example_en: Flying makes the passenger feel sick sometimes.
senses.example_cn: 坐飞机有时会让乘客觉得不舒服。

senses.gloss_en: A large boat that carries people, goods by sea
senses.example_en: The ship carried passengers across the sea at night.
senses.example_cn: 那艘船夜里载着乘客渡海。

senses.gloss_en: To send goods to a place by transport
senses.example_en: They shipped the phones to Malaysia by air.
senses.example_cn: 他们把这些手机空运到了马来西亚。

senses.gloss_en: To make a product available for sale
senses.example_en: The company will ship the new model next month.
senses.gloss_cn: 上市开售（产品开始供货）
senses.example_cn: 公司下个月就会发售新款。

senses.gloss_en: The sport of traveling in a sailboat
senses.example_en: Sailing is fun when the wind is strong.
senses.example_cn: 风大的时候玩帆船很有意思。

senses.gloss_en: An occasion when a ship leaves a port
senses.example_en: The next sailing leaves at six in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 下一班船早上六点开。

senses.gloss_en: tracks where trains run
senses.example_en: A train stopped on the railroad near my house.
senses.example_cn: 一列火车停在我家附近的铁轨上。

senses.gloss_en: a system of trains and tracks for transport
senses.example_en: The railroad connects small towns to the city.
senses.example_cn: 铁路把一些小镇和城市连在了一起。

senses.gloss_en: a company that owns and runs trains
senses.example_en: She works for the railroad and repairs tracks.
senses.example_cn: 她在铁路公司工作，负责修铁轨。

senses.gloss_en: raised area beside tracks for getting on a train
senses.example_en: We waited on the platform until the train arrived.
senses.example_cn: 我们在站台上一直等到火车进站。

senses.gloss_en: raised flat surface for speakers or performers
senses.example_en: The singer stood on the platform and waved.
senses.gloss_cn: 台（供人讲话或表演的高台）
senses.example_cn: 歌手站在台上向大家挥手。

senses.gloss_en: a set of political ideas and promises
senses.example_en: Her platform promised lower taxes and better schools.
senses.example_cn: 她的竞选纲领承诺降低税收、办好学校。

senses.gloss_en: an underground train system in a city
senses.example_en: We took the subway to the museum downtown.
senses.example_cn: 我们坐地铁去了市中心的博物馆。

senses.gloss_en: a tunnel under a road for people
senses.example_en: Use the subway to cross under the road.
senses.example_cn: 走地下通道从路底下穿过去。

senses.gloss_en: a way to get from one place to another
senses.example_en: This route is shorter, but it has traffic.
senses.example_cn: 这条路线近一些，可是会堵车。

senses.gloss_en: a fixed path for buses, trains, or deliveries
senses.example_en: The bus route stops near my office every day.
senses.example_cn: 这条公交线路每天都在我办公室附近停。

senses.gloss_en: a way of achieving something
senses.example_en: College is one route to a good job.
senses.example_cn: 上大学是找到好工作的一条途径。

senses.gloss_en: evidence that something is happening
senses.example_en: Dark clouds are a sign of rain soon.
senses.example_cn: 乌云是快要下雨的迹象。

senses.gloss_en: a notice with words or pictures
senses.example_en: The sign on the door says closed today.
senses.example_cn: 门上的牌子写着今天不营业。

senses.gloss_en: to write your name on a document
senses.example_en: Please sign the form before you leave.
senses.example_cn: 走之前请在这份表格上签名。

senses.gloss_en: leaving a vehicle somewhere for a time
senses.example_en: Parking is not allowed here after nine.
senses.example_cn: 九点以后这里不许停车。

senses.gloss_en: space for leaving vehicles
senses.example_en: This store has free parking behind the building.
senses.example_cn: 这家商店后面有免费的停车位。

senses.gloss_en: a place for one person to sit
senses.example_en: I saved a seat for you on the bus.
senses.example_cn: 我在公交车上给你留了个座。

senses.gloss_en: to sit down or give someone a place to sit
senses.example_en: The host seated us near the window by the door.
senses.example_cn: 主人安排我们坐在靠门的窗边。

senses.gloss_en: to have seats for a particular number of people
senses.example_en: This small plane seats twenty people.
senses.example_cn: 这架小飞机能坐二十个人。

senses.gloss_en: a person who shows visitors around a place
senses.example_en: Our guide showed us the old city at night.
senses.example_cn: 我们的导游晚上带我们看了老城。

senses.gloss_en: to show someone the way to a place
senses.example_en: She guided me to the station after dark.
senses.example_cn: 天黑以后她带我去了车站。

senses.gloss_en: a book that gives information or instructions
senses.example_en: I read a guide to Italy before the trip.
senses.example_cn: 出发前我读了一本意大利旅游指南。

senses.gloss_en: a journey visiting several places for pleasure
senses.example_en: We took a bus tour around the city today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我们坐大巴环城游览了一圈。

senses.gloss_en: a visit around a place to look at it
senses.example_en: The guide gave us a tour of the palace.
senses.example_cn: 导游带我们参观了那座宫殿。

senses.gloss_en: to travel around a place for pleasure
senses.example_en: They toured the island by car for two weeks.
senses.example_cn: 他们开车在岛上游玩了两周。

senses.gloss_en: the business of travel services for visitors on vacation
senses.example_en: Tourism brings jobs to this small town each year.
senses.example_cn: 旅游业每年都给这个小镇带来就业机会。

senses.gloss_en: a person who is traveling or often travels
senses.example_en: The traveler asked for water at the camp.
senses.example_cn: 那个旅行者在营地要了点水。

senses.gloss_en: a place where people live in tents temporarily
senses.example_en: We set up camp near the lake at sunset.
senses.example_cn: 日落时我们在湖边搭起了营地。

senses.gloss_en: to live in a tent for a short time
senses.example_en: We camped by the river for one night.
senses.example_cn: 我们在河边露营了一晚。

senses.gloss_en: a place where soldiers live during training or war
senses.example_en: The army camp was quiet after the long march.
senses.example_cn: 长途行军之后，军营里很安静。

senses.gloss_en: Living in a tent outdoors for a holiday
senses.example_en: We went camping near the lake last weekend.
senses.example_cn: 上周末我们去湖边露营了。

senses.gloss_en: To put clothes, things into a bag for travel
senses.example_en: I packed my clothes and left for the airport.
senses.gloss_cn: 把东西装进箱包，收拾行李
senses.example_cn: 我把衣服装进箱子，就去机场了。

senses.gloss_en: A small container of things sold together
senses.example_en: She bought a pack of gum at the store.
senses.example_cn: 她在店里买了一包口香糖。

senses.gloss_en: A large bag carried on your back
senses.example_en: He carried a pack on his back all day.
senses.example_cn: 他背着背包走了一整天。

senses.gloss_en: A movement made by lifting and placing your foot
senses.example_en: She took a step forward and smiled at me.
senses.example_cn: 她向前走了一步，冲我笑了笑。

senses.gloss_en: A flat surface for your foot between levels
senses.example_en: He sat on the front step and waited.
senses.example_cn: 他坐在门前的台阶上等着。

senses.gloss_en: To move, or put your foot on something
senses.example_en: Be careful not to step on the glass.
senses.example_cn: 小心别踩到玻璃。

senses.gloss_en: To arrive at a place after traveling
senses.example_en: We reached the hotel before dark in winter.
senses.example_cn: 冬天我们在天黑前到了旅馆。

senses.gloss_en: To stretch your arm to touch something
senses.example_en: I reached for the cup on the shelf.
senses.example_cn: 我伸手去拿架子上的杯子。

senses.gloss_en: To make a decision, agreement, or conclusion
senses.example_en: They reached an agreement after long talks.
senses.example_cn: 经过长时间谈判，他们达成了协议。

senses.gloss_en: go past someone or something
senses.example_en: Cars pass our house every day.
senses.example_cn: 每天都有车经过我们家门口。

senses.gloss_en: succeed in a test or exam
senses.example_en: I passed the test on my first try.
senses.example_cn: 我第一次考就通过了。

senses.gloss_en: an official ticket allowing travel or entry
senses.example_en: I bought a bus pass for the week.
senses.example_cn: 我买了一张一周的公交通票。

senses.gloss_en: a vehicle with two wheels and an engine
senses.example_en: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
senses.example_cn: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

senses.gloss_en: an unusual, exciting experience or trip
senses.example_en: Our hike was an adventure in the mountains.
senses.example_cn: 我们那次徒步是一场山里的冒险。

senses.gloss_en: a story about exciting, dangerous events
senses.example_en: The movie is an adventure about a lost city.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影讲的是一个失落城市的冒险故事。

senses.gloss_en: the excitement of doing new, risky things
senses.example_en: She loves adventure and tries new things.
senses.example_cn: 她喜欢冒险，爱尝试新东西。

senses.gloss_en: an unexpected event that causes damage or injury
senses.example_en: He broke his arm in an accident yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 他昨天在一场事故中把胳膊弄断了。

senses.gloss_en: something that happens by chance, not planned
senses.example_en: Their meeting was an accident, not a plan.
senses.example_cn: 他们的相遇是偶然，不是安排好的。

senses.gloss_en: to come or go into a place
senses.example_en: We entered the museum through the front door.
senses.example_cn: 我们从正门进了博物馆。

senses.gloss_en: to put information into a computer or form
senses.example_en: Please enter your name and password on the phone.
senses.example_cn: 请在手机上输入你的名字和密码。

senses.gloss_en: to take part in a competition or race
senses.example_en: She entered the race and won a prize.
senses.example_cn: 她报名参加了那场比赛，还得了奖。

senses.gloss_en: to go from one side to the other
senses.example_en: We crossed the street after the light changed.
senses.example_cn: 灯变了之后我们穿过了马路。

senses.gloss_en: two lines or roads go across each other
senses.example_en: Two roads cross near the bridge in town.
senses.example_cn: 镇上有两条路在桥附近交叉。

senses.gloss_en: a mark made by two lines crossing
senses.example_en: Put a cross on the correct answer here.
senses.example_cn: 在正确的答案上画个叉。

senses.gloss_en: to travel on water in a boat or ship
senses.example_en: They sailed across the lake in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 早上他们坐船横渡了那个湖。

senses.gloss_en: to control a sailboat using the wind
senses.example_en: I learned to sail a small boat last year.
senses.example_cn: 去年我学会了驾小帆船。

senses.gloss_en: a strong cloth on a boat, filled by wind
senses.example_en: The sail caught the wind and the boat moved.
senses.example_cn: 帆兜住了风，船就走起来了。

senses.gloss_en: a series of events that repeats in the same order
senses.example_en: The cycle of seasons repeats every year.
senses.example_cn: 四季每年循环往复。

senses.gloss_en: a bicycle or motorcycle
senses.example_en: He rode his cycle to school after breakfast.
senses.example_cn: 他吃过早饭骑自行车去学校。

senses.gloss_en: to ride a bicycle or travel by bicycle
senses.example_en: We cycled to the beach and back today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天骑自行车去海边，又骑回来了。

senses.gloss_en: To move upward from a lower position
senses.example_en: Smoke rose from the fire into the sky.
senses.example_cn: 烟从火里升上了天空。

senses.gloss_en: To become higher in number, price, or level
senses.example_en: Prices rose again after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨过后价格又涨了。

senses.gloss_en: An increase in amount, number, or level
senses.example_en: There was a rise in rent this year.
senses.example_cn: 今年房租上涨了不少。

senses.gloss_en: To lift something to a higher position
senses.example_en: Raise the box off the floor with care.
senses.example_cn: 小心地把箱子从地上抬起来。

senses.gloss_en: To increase an amount, level, or number
senses.example_en: They raised the price of coffee today.
senses.example_cn: 今天他们把咖啡的价格提高了。

senses.gloss_en: An increase in pay for your job
senses.example_en: She asked for a raise at work today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天在公司提出要加薪。

senses.gloss_en: To let something fall, often by accident
senses.example_en: I dropped my phone on the floor.
senses.example_cn: 我把手机掉在地上了。

senses.gloss_en: To become lower in level, amount, or price
senses.example_en: Sales dropped after the holiday ended.
senses.example_cn: 假期一结束，销售额就下降了。

senses.gloss_en: A small round amount of liquid
senses.example_en: A drop of water fell on my hand.
senses.example_cn: 一滴水落在了我手上。

senses.gloss_en: Of wind, to move and make a current of air
senses.example_en: The wind blew hard all night by the sea.
senses.example_cn: 海边的风整夜刮得很猛。

senses.gloss_en: To send air out from your mouth
senses.example_en: She blew gently to cool the soup.
senses.example_cn: 她轻轻吹气，把汤吹凉。

senses.gloss_en: To move something using air or wind
senses.example_en: The wind blew the papers across the street.
senses.example_cn: 风把那些纸吹到了街对面。

senses.gloss_en: to start to be seen
senses.example_en: A new stain appeared on the white wall.
senses.example_cn: 白墙上出现了一块新污渍。

senses.gloss_en: to seem to be something
senses.example_en: He appeared calm after the long flight.
senses.example_cn: 坐了那么久的飞机，他看上去还挺平静。

senses.gloss_en: very correct, suitable for official or important occasions
senses.example_en: He wore formal clothes to the award ceremony.
senses.example_cn: 他穿着正装去了颁奖典礼。

senses.gloss_en: done or given officially, following accepted rules
senses.example_en: She made a formal complaint to the hotel manager.
senses.example_cn: 她向酒店经理正式投诉了。

senses.gloss_en: done in school or college, not learned alone
senses.example_en: She had formal education, but she learned fast.
senses.example_cn: 她受过正规的学校教育，学起来也很快。

senses.gloss_en: relaxed and friendly, not following strict rules
senses.example_en: We had an informal talk after class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天下课后我们随意聊了聊。

senses.gloss_en: suitable for normal situations, not official or special
senses.example_en: He wore informal clothes to the beach with friends.
senses.example_cn: 他穿着便装和朋友去了海边。

senses.gloss_en: of language, suitable for normal conversation or friends
senses.example_en: I used informal language in my email to you.
senses.example_cn: 我给你写邮件的时候用的是口语化的说法。

senses.gloss_en: connected with or involving two or more countries
senses.example_en: International teams met for a soccer match in July.
senses.example_cn: 七月里几支国际球队踢了一场足球赛。

senses.gloss_en: connected with a country, shared by the whole country
senses.example_en: The national flag flew over the school this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上学校上空飘着国旗。

senses.gloss_en: owned or controlled by the government
senses.example_en: The national airline is owned by the government.
senses.example_cn: 那家国有航空公司归政府所有。

senses.gloss_en: a citizen of a particular country
senses.example_en: Foreign nationals must show a passport at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 外国公民在机场必须出示护照。

senses.gloss_en: provided by the government, for everyone to use
senses.example_en: We use public transportation to get downtown every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天坐公共交通去市中心。

senses.gloss_en: connected with ordinary people in society in general
senses.example_en: Public opinion changed after the report came out.
senses.example_cn: 报告出来以后，公众的看法变了。

senses.gloss_en: ordinary people in society in general
senses.example_en: The museum is open to the public on Sundays.
senses.example_cn: 博物馆星期天对公众开放。

senses.gloss_en: related to a job needing special training or skill
senses.example_en: She got professional advice about taxes from an expert.
senses.example_cn: 她从一位专家那里得到了关于税务的专业建议。

senses.gloss_en: done as a paid job, not as a hobby
senses.example_en: He became a professional golfer after college.
senses.example_cn: 大学毕业后他成了职业高尔夫球手。

senses.gloss_en: a person with special training for a job
senses.example_en: Call a professional to fix the engine today.
senses.example_cn: 叫个专业师傅来修发动机吧。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with society and how it is organized
senses.example_en: Social change can improve life for many people.
senses.example_cn: 社会的变化能让很多人过得更好。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with activities where people meet for pleasure
senses.example_en: We planned a social event after work today.
senses.example_cn: 我们打算今天下班后办个社交活动。

senses.gloss_en: Living naturally in groups, not alone
senses.example_en: Bees are social insects that live in groups.
senses.example_cn: 蜜蜂是群居的昆虫，成群生活。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with illness, injury, and their treatment
senses.example_en: She needs medical care for her broken arm today.
senses.example_cn: 她的胳膊断了，今天需要接受治疗。

senses.gloss_en: Related to serious Western music, like Mozart
senses.example_en: He plays classical music on the piano at night.
senses.example_cn: 他晚上用钢琴弹古典音乐。

senses.gloss_en: Related to ancient Greece and Rome, their culture
senses.example_en: She studies classical literature from ancient Greece and Rome.
senses.example_cn: 她研究古希腊和古罗马的古典文学。

senses.gloss_en: Traditional in style, used for a long time
senses.example_en: They teach classical dance in that school every year.
senses.example_cn: 那所学校每年都教传统舞蹈。

senses.gloss_en: Part of a group's beliefs, customs, or way of life
senses.example_en: We ate traditional food at the family party.
senses.example_cn: 家庭聚会上我们吃了传统食物。

senses.gloss_en: Following older methods and ideas, not modern
senses.example_en: He prefers traditional teaching, not new methods.
senses.example_cn: 他喜欢传统的教法，不喜欢新方法。

senses.gloss_en: from or connected with another country, not your own
senses.example_en: We tried foreign food at the market last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我们在市场上尝了外国菜。

senses.gloss_en: not typical or known, seeming strange
senses.example_en: His calm voice was foreign to me, not normal.
senses.example_cn: 他那平静的声音对我来说很陌生，很不寻常。

senses.gloss_en: used or happening every day, ordinary
senses.example_en: I use everyday words in class with friends.
senses.example_cn: 我在课上和朋友说话都用日常的词。

senses.gloss_en: connected with music, containing music
senses.example_en: She joined a musical group at school last year.
senses.example_cn: 她去年在学校加入了一个音乐团体。

senses.gloss_en: having a natural skill or interest in music
senses.example_en: His children are musical and they sing daily.
senses.example_cn: 他的孩子都有音乐天赋，每天都唱歌。

senses.gloss_en: a play or movie with songs and dancing
senses.example_en: We watched a musical with songs and dancing tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚我们看了一部有歌有舞的音乐剧。

senses.gloss_en: using something as a starting point
senses.example_en: The movie is based on a real event.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影是根据真实事件改编的。

senses.gloss_en: having your main work place in a place
senses.example_en: The team is based in Chicago this year.
senses.example_cn: 这支队伍今年以芝加哥为基地。

senses.gloss_en: Despite the fact that; even though
senses.example_en: Although it was raining, we walked to school.
senses.example_cn: 虽然当时在下雨，我们还是走着去了学校。

senses.gloss_en: But; however; used to add a contrasting fact
senses.example_en: It looked easy, although it took a long time.
senses.example_cn: 这事看着简单，不过花了很长时间。

senses.gloss_en: in fact or really
senses.example_en: I actually live here. I don't work here.
senses.example_cn: 我其实是住在这儿，不是在这儿工作。

senses.gloss_en: used when something is surprising
senses.example_en: She is actually from Peru, not Mexico.
senses.example_cn: 她居然是秘鲁人，不是墨西哥人。

senses.gloss_en: used when you disagree or say no politely
senses.example_en: Actually, I asked for tea, not coffee.
senses.example_cn: 其实我要的是茶，不是咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: in the place of someone or something else
senses.example_en: We drank tea instead of coffee after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们没喝咖啡，改喝了茶。

senses.gloss_en: used to give a more important reason
senses.example_en: I can't afford a car, and I don't need one anyway.
senses.gloss_cn: 反正（补充更重要的理由）
senses.example_cn: 我买不起车，反正我也不需要。

senses.gloss_en: despite that
senses.example_en: He hates carrots, but he ate them anyway.
senses.example_cn: 他讨厌胡萝卜，但还是吃了。

senses.gloss_en: used when returning to an earlier subject
senses.example_en: Anyway, as I said, I'll be away next week.
senses.gloss_cn: 不管怎么说（回到原话题）
senses.example_cn: 总之，像我刚说的，我下周不在。

senses.gloss_en: because of good luck
senses.example_en: Fortunately, the meeting ended early and we got home.
senses.example_cn: 幸运的是，会议提前结束，我们赶回了家。

senses.gloss_en: used to say something is sad or disappointing
senses.example_en: Unfortunately, the store was closed so we left.
senses.example_cn: 可惜商店关门了，我们就走了。

senses.gloss_en: One part in every hundred, shown with %
senses.example_en: Only ten percent of students arrived on time.
senses.example_cn: 只有百分之十的学生按时到了。

senses.gloss_en: For every hundred, used with a number
senses.example_en: We got a 20 percent discount on tickets today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我们买票便宜了百分之二十。

senses.gloss_en: By or out of every hundred
senses.example_en: Sales rose five percent last month.
senses.example_cn: 上个月销售额上涨了百分之五。

senses.gloss_en: A unit for measuring temperature
senses.example_en: It was 30 degrees outside this afternoon.
senses.example_cn: 今天下午外面有三十度。

senses.gloss_en: A university qualification after a course of study
senses.example_en: She earned a degree in biology last year.
senses.example_cn: 她去年拿到了生物学学位。

senses.gloss_en: An amount or level of something
senses.example_en: To a degree, I agree with your plan.
senses.example_cn: 在某种程度上，我同意你的计划。

senses.gloss_en: The amount of space between two places or things
senses.example_en: The distance between our houses is two kilometers.
senses.example_cn: 我们两家之间的距离是两公里。

senses.gloss_en: A far place you can see from here
senses.example_en: We saw a light in the distance at night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里我们在远处看到了一盏灯。

senses.gloss_en: A lack of friendliness between people
senses.example_en: There was distance between them after the argument.
senses.example_cn: 争吵之后他们之间的关系变得疏远了。

senses.gloss_en: How tall or high someone or something is
senses.example_en: What is the height of that building in meters?
senses.example_cn: 那栋楼有多少米高？

senses.gloss_en: The distance above the ground or another surface
senses.example_en: The plane flew at a height of 6,000 meters.
senses.example_cn: 飞机在六千米的高度飞行。

senses.gloss_en: High places, especially the tops of hills or mountains
senses.example_en: She is afraid of heights in tall buildings.
senses.example_cn: 在高楼上她会怕高。

senses.gloss_en: A unit of length equal to 1,000 meters
senses.example_en: The village is five kilometers from the city.
senses.example_cn: 那个村子离城里有五公里。

senses.gloss_en: A coin worth one cent in the US or Canada
senses.example_en: I found a penny under the couch today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在沙发底下找到一枚一分硬币。

senses.gloss_en: A British unit worth one hundredth of a pound
senses.example_en: It cost fifty pence, not one penny more.
senses.example_cn: 这个五十便士，一便士也不多要。

senses.gloss_en: A very small amount of money
senses.example_en: The repair did not cost a penny.
senses.example_cn: 这次修理一分钱都没花。

senses.gloss_en: a person in charge of a business or department
senses.example_en: The manager closed the store after lunch today.
senses.example_cn: 经理今天午饭后就把店关了。

senses.gloss_en: a person who directs a sports team
senses.example_en: Our manager trained the team before the game.
senses.example_cn: 我们的主教练在赛前给球队做了训练。

senses.gloss_en: a person who arranges a performer’s business work
senses.example_en: Her manager booked three shows for next month.
senses.example_cn: 她的经纪人给下个月订了三场演出。

senses.gloss_en: the person who tells workers what to do
senses.example_en: My boss gave me a new job today.
senses.example_cn: 我的上司今天给我派了个新活儿。

senses.gloss_en: the person who makes important decisions
senses.example_en: Mom is the boss in this house.
senses.example_cn: 这个家里妈妈当家。

senses.gloss_en: a person who legally owns something
senses.example_en: The owner of this dog lives next door.
senses.example_cn: 这只狗的主人住在隔壁。

senses.gloss_en: a person who owns a business or property
senses.example_en: The owner sold the store to my cousin.
senses.example_cn: 店主把店卖给了我表哥。

senses.gloss_en: a person or company that pays people to work
senses.example_en: My employer offers health insurance to all employees.
senses.example_cn: 我的雇主给所有员工提供医疗保险。

senses.gloss_en: a person paid to work for a company
senses.example_en: Each employee gets a badge at the front desk.
senses.example_cn: 每位员工都在前台领一张工牌。

senses.gloss_en: a person who helps someone in their job
senses.example_en: My assistant answered calls while I met clients.
senses.example_cn: 我见客户的时候，助理帮我接电话。

senses.gloss_en: a store worker who helps customers
senses.example_en: The assistant showed me shoes in my size.
senses.example_cn: 店员给我拿了我这个尺码的鞋。

senses.gloss_en: below a senior person, helping them at work
senses.example_en: She is assistant manager at a small hotel.
senses.example_cn: 她在一家小旅馆当副经理。

senses.gloss_en: an office worker who organizes tasks for a person
senses.example_en: My secretary scheduled a meeting with the manager.
senses.example_cn: 我的秘书安排了和经理的会面。

senses.gloss_en: an official who keeps records for a group
senses.example_en: She is secretary of the soccer club at school.
senses.example_cn: 她是学校足球俱乐部的秘书。

senses.gloss_en: a government official in charge of a department
senses.example_en: The secretary spoke for the department on TV.
senses.example_cn: 这位部长在电视上代表该部门发言。

senses.gloss_en: a person you work with in a job
senses.example_en: I ate lunch with a colleague from my office.
senses.example_cn: 我和办公室的一位同事一起吃了午饭。

senses.gloss_en: a person who designs buildings
senses.example_en: The architect drew plans for our new house.
senses.example_cn: 那位建筑师给我们的新房子画了图纸。

senses.gloss_en: a person who plans, creates a major idea
senses.example_en: She was the architect of the new school plan.
senses.gloss_cn: 缔造者（重大计划的策划人）
senses.example_cn: 她是这个新校园计划的缔造者。

senses.gloss_en: a person who designs computer systems or software
senses.example_en: The architect designed software for the company system.
senses.example_cn: 那位架构师为公司系统设计了软件。

senses.gloss_en: a person trained to design and build machines or roads
senses.example_en: The engineer fixed the bridge design after tests.
senses.example_cn: 测试之后工程师改了桥的设计。

senses.gloss_en: a person trained to repair machines or electrical equipment
senses.example_en: The engineer repaired the machine at the factory today.
senses.example_cn: 技师今天在工厂里把那台机器修好了。

senses.gloss_en: a person who drives a train
senses.example_en: The engineer stopped the train at the next station.
senses.example_cn: 司机把火车停在了下一站。

senses.gloss_en: a person with special knowledge or skill
senses.example_en: She is an expert in safety at work.
senses.example_cn: 她是工作安全方面的专家。

senses.gloss_en: having special knowledge or skill
senses.example_en: He gave expert advice about the new engine.
senses.example_cn: 他就那台新发动机给出了专业的建议。

senses.gloss_en: a man who works in business, often at a high level
senses.example_en: The businessman traveled to Chicago for a meeting.
senses.example_cn: 那位商人为了开会去了芝加哥。

senses.gloss_en: a man who is skilled in business and money matters
senses.example_en: He is a businessman, good with money and deals.
senses.gloss_cn: 精明的生意人（善于理财）
senses.example_cn: 他是个精明的生意人，很会算钱，也很会谈生意。

senses.gloss_en: A building where goods are made, often by machines
senses.example_en: The factory makes shoes for the local market.
senses.example_cn: 这家工厂给本地市场生产鞋子。

senses.gloss_en: The production of goods for sale, in factories
senses.example_en: Industry grew fast after the new highway opened.
senses.example_cn: 新高速公路通了以后，工业发展得很快。

senses.gloss_en: A type of business, like tourism or technology
senses.example_en: She works in the film industry in Canada.
senses.example_cn: 她在加拿大的电影行业工作。

senses.gloss_en: The habit of working hard, regularly and steadily
senses.example_en: Her industry impressed the whole team at work.
senses.example_cn: 她的勤奋让全组同事都很佩服。

senses.gloss_en: The tools, machines, or supplies needed for an activity
senses.example_en: We bought new equipment for camping in the mountains.
senses.example_cn: 我们买了新的露营器材，准备去山里。

senses.gloss_en: A hand instrument used to make or repair things
senses.example_en: This tool can cut wood with one clean line.
senses.example_cn: 这个工具能把木头切出一道整齐的口子。

senses.gloss_en: Something used to help you do a task
senses.example_en: A map app is a useful tool downtown.
senses.example_cn: 在市中心，地图应用是个很有用的帮手。

senses.gloss_en: The process of learning skills for a job or activity
senses.example_en: She finished training and started work at the factory.
senses.example_cn: 她培训结束后就到工厂上班了。

senses.gloss_en: Practice and exercise to prepare for a sport
senses.example_en: His training includes running every morning in the park.
senses.example_cn: 他的训练包括每天早上在公园跑步。

senses.gloss_en: Fixed pay for a job, usually paid each month
senses.example_en: Her salary is paid on the first day each month.
senses.example_cn: 她的工资每月一号发。

senses.gloss_en: the place where someone or something is
senses.example_en: Your phone is in the same position today.
senses.example_cn: 你的手机今天还在原来的位置。

senses.gloss_en: a job in a company or organization
senses.example_en: She got a new position at the bank.
senses.example_cn: 她在银行得到了一个新职位。

senses.gloss_en: to put someone or something in a place
senses.example_en: We positioned the camera near the door.
senses.example_cn: 我们把摄像机放在门口附近。

senses.gloss_en: a series of actions to achieve a result
senses.example_en: The cooking process takes about ten minutes today.
senses.example_cn: 今天做菜这套流程大约需要十分钟。

senses.gloss_en: a series of changes that happen naturally
senses.example_en: Aging is a slow process for many people.
senses.example_cn: 对很多人来说，衰老是个缓慢的过程。

senses.gloss_en: to deal with a document in an official way
senses.example_en: They processed my visa form in one day.
senses.example_cn: 他们一天就办好了我的签证表格。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of work you have to do
senses.example_en: My first task is to clean the room.
senses.example_cn: 我的第一项任务是打扫房间。

senses.gloss_en: a result you try to achieve
senses.example_en: Our sales target is fifty units this month.
senses.example_cn: 我们这个月的销售指标是五十台。

senses.gloss_en: a person, place, or thing aimed at
senses.example_en: The bridge was the main target last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚那座桥是主要的攻击目标。

senses.gloss_en: to aim something at a particular group
senses.example_en: The ads target young people in the city.
senses.example_cn: 这些广告针对城里的年轻人。

senses.gloss_en: a plan for achieving something important
senses.example_en: Our strategy is to save money every week.
senses.example_cn: 我们的策略是每周都存点钱。

senses.gloss_en: how good or bad something is
senses.example_en: The picture quality is very good today.
senses.example_cn: 今天的画面质量很好。

senses.gloss_en: a high standard, excellence
senses.example_en: We pay more for quality in this store.
senses.example_cn: 在这家店，我们为优质商品多花了钱。

senses.gloss_en: a good part of someone's character
senses.example_en: Patience is a useful quality for teachers.
senses.example_cn: 耐心对老师来说是很有用的品质。

senses.gloss_en: A time or situation to do something
senses.example_en: This trip is an opportunity to meet new people.
senses.example_cn: 这次旅行是认识新朋友的机会。

senses.gloss_en: A chance for a better job or success
senses.example_en: The internship was an opportunity for promotion.
senses.example_cn: 这次实习是个升职的好机会。

senses.gloss_en: One thing you can choose
senses.example_en: We have one option, leave now.
senses.example_cn: 我们只有一个选项，就是现在就走。

senses.gloss_en: The freedom, a choice you are allowed to make
senses.example_en: You always have the option to say no.
senses.example_cn: 你永远有说不的自由。

senses.gloss_en: An extra feature you can add or choose
senses.example_en: The car has a sunroof option.
senses.example_cn: 这辆车有天窗这个选配。

senses.gloss_en: A good thing that helps you succeed
senses.example_en: Knowing English is an advantage in many jobs.
senses.example_cn: 会英语在很多工作里都是优势。

senses.gloss_en: A better position than someone else
senses.example_en: Our team had an advantage after the goal.
senses.example_cn: 进了那个球以后，我们队占了上风。

senses.gloss_en: A benefit, a useful part of something
senses.example_en: One advantage is lower cost for us.
senses.example_cn: 一个好处是对我们来说成本更低。

senses.gloss_en: A good effect that helps you
senses.example_en: Exercise is a benefit for your heart.
senses.example_cn: 运动对你的心脏有好处。

senses.gloss_en: Money or help from a company or government
senses.example_en: She gets benefits from the government now.
senses.example_cn: 她现在领着政府的补助。

senses.gloss_en: To get help or advantage from something
senses.example_en: You can benefit from practice every day.
senses.example_cn: 每天练习，你会从中受益。

senses.gloss_en: A particular situation or example
senses.example_en: In this case, we should wait.
senses.example_cn: 这种情况下，我们应该等一等。

senses.gloss_en: A container or cover that protects something
senses.example_en: Put the phone in its case.
senses.example_cn: 把手机装进保护套里。

senses.gloss_en: A matter in court, a legal dispute
senses.example_en: The lawyer won the case in court.
senses.example_cn: 律师在法庭上打赢了这场官司。

senses.gloss_en: A choice or judgment you make after thinking
senses.example_en: It was a hard decision for him.
senses.example_cn: 对他来说这是个艰难的决定。

senses.gloss_en: The act of deciding something
senses.example_en: She delayed her decision until tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 她把做决定的事推到了明天。

senses.gloss_en: A formal answer made by a court or group
senses.example_en: The court's decision surprised everyone in the room.
senses.example_cn: 法院的裁决让在场的人都很意外。

senses.gloss_en: To ask politely or officially for something
senses.example_en: I request a refund after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 旅行结束后我申请退款。

senses.gloss_en: A polite or official act of asking
senses.example_en: Your request was clear and I said yes.
senses.example_cn: 你的请求说得很清楚，我答应了。

senses.gloss_en: A song someone asks a station to play
senses.example_en: This next song is your request on the radio.
senses.example_cn: 下一首歌就是你在电台点播的那首。

senses.gloss_en: Something said or written as an answer
senses.example_en: Her response came by email that night.
senses.example_cn: 她的答复当晚就发邮件过来了。

senses.gloss_en: Something done as a reaction to something
senses.example_en: His response was a smile and a wave.
senses.gloss_cn: 回应（用动作作出的反应）
senses.example_cn: 他的回应是笑了笑，挥了挥手。

senses.gloss_en: A large formal meeting with talks on a topic
senses.example_en: She spoke at a conference in Chicago.
senses.example_cn: 她在芝加哥的一次大会上发言。

senses.gloss_en: A small private meeting to discuss something
senses.example_en: We had a conference with the coach after practice.
senses.example_cn: 训练结束后我们和教练谈了一次。

senses.gloss_en: A group of sports teams in one league
senses.example_en: They won the conference title last year.
senses.example_cn: 他们去年拿下了联盟冠军。

senses.gloss_en: To agree with and help someone succeed
senses.example_en: I support your plan and we start today.
senses.example_cn: 我支持你的计划，我们今天就开始。

senses.gloss_en: To provide money for someone to live
senses.example_en: He works to support his family every month.
senses.example_cn: 他每个月都工作来养家。

senses.gloss_en: Emotional or practical help in a hard time
senses.example_en: Her support made the long trip easier.
senses.example_cn: 有她的支持，这趟长途容易多了。

senses.gloss_en: To make something behave the way you want
senses.example_en: She can control the car on ice.
senses.example_cn: 在冰面上她也能把车控制住。

senses.gloss_en: Power to decide what happens in a situation
senses.example_en: The new coach has control of the team.
senses.example_cn: 新教练掌控着这支球队。

senses.gloss_en: A button or device used to operate a machine
senses.example_en: I lost the remote control for the TV.
senses.example_cn: 我把电视的遥控器丢了。

senses.gloss_en: Something you can choose instead of another thing
senses.example_en: Tea is an alternative to coffee today.
senses.example_cn: 今天可以选茶来代替咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: Used instead of another plan, method, or thing
senses.example_en: We took an alternative route to the beach.
senses.example_cn: 我们换了另一条路去海边。

senses.gloss_en: Different from what is usual or traditional
senses.example_en: He likes alternative music at night.
senses.example_cn: 他晚上喜欢听另类音乐。

senses.gloss_en: Something you own, often a personal item
senses.example_en: All my possessions fit in one small bag.
senses.example_cn: 我全部的家当装在一个小包里就够了。

senses.gloss_en: The state of having or owning something
senses.example_en: The keys are in my possession now.
senses.example_cn: 钥匙现在在我手里。

senses.gloss_en: Control of the ball or puck in sports
senses.example_en: We kept possession and scored a goal.
senses.example_cn: 我们一直控球并最终进球得分。

senses.gloss_en: a paid notice about a product, service, or job
senses.example_en: I saw an advertisement for a new job today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天看到一则招聘的广告。

senses.gloss_en: the act of advertising something and making it public
senses.example_en: The advertisement of the event started last week.
senses.example_cn: 这场活动的宣传上周就开始了。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing that shows something works well
senses.example_en: He is an advertisement for daily exercise.
senses.example_cn: 他就是每天锻炼的活招牌。

senses.gloss_en: the business of persuading people to buy things
senses.example_en: She works in advertising for a phone company.
senses.example_cn: 她在一家手机公司做广告工作。

senses.gloss_en: a small program you download to a phone
senses.example_en: This app helps me learn words on my phone.
senses.example_cn: 这个应用帮我在手机上背单词。

senses.gloss_en: the area behind the main things in a picture
senses.example_en: I can see a dog in the background.
senses.example_cn: 我能看到背景里有一只狗。

senses.gloss_en: a person's family, education, and past experience
senses.example_en: Her background includes work in a small school.
senses.example_cn: 她的背景里有在一所小学校工作的经历。

senses.gloss_en: past events that help explain a situation
senses.example_en: I need background before I understand the problem.
senses.example_cn: 我得先了解背景情况，才能弄懂这个问题。

senses.gloss_en: a secret system of letters, numbers, or symbols
senses.example_en: The message was in code and I could not read.
senses.example_cn: 那条消息是用密码写的，我看不懂。

senses.gloss_en: a set of rules for how people should behave
senses.example_en: The club has a strict code for members.
senses.example_cn: 这个俱乐部对会员有严格的规章。

senses.gloss_en: computer instructions written in a programming language
senses.example_en: He writes code to build a simple game.
senses.example_cn: 他写代码做一个简单的游戏。

senses.gloss_en: something you say or write that gives an opinion
senses.example_en: His comment about the plan surprised everyone today.
senses.example_cn: 他对这个计划的看法今天让大家都很意外。

senses.gloss_en: to say what you think about something
senses.example_en: She refused to comment on the story.
senses.example_cn: 她拒绝对这件事发表评论。

senses.gloss_en: Facts or information, especially numbers, used to make decisions
senses.example_en: We use data to plan the next trip.
senses.example_cn: 我们用数据来规划下一次出行。

senses.gloss_en: Information stored on a computer, for example text or numbers
senses.example_en: Back up your data before you update the phone.
senses.example_cn: 手机升级之前先把资料备份好。

senses.gloss_en: A piece of equipment made for a particular purpose
senses.example_en: This device measures your heart rate at home.
senses.example_cn: 这个设备能在家里测你的心率。

senses.gloss_en: A method or trick used to get a result
senses.example_en: His joke was a device to change the topic.
senses.example_cn: 他的笑话是个转移话题的手段。

senses.gloss_en: Copy a file from the internet to your device
senses.example_en: I download the song before the flight.
senses.example_cn: 我在上飞机前把那首歌下载好。

senses.gloss_en: A file you get from the internet
senses.example_en: That download is a free game for kids.
senses.example_cn: 那个下载的文件是给小孩玩的免费游戏。

senses.gloss_en: The act of copying a file to your device
senses.example_en: The download took ten minutes on my laptop.
senses.example_cn: 这次下载在我的笔记本上花了十分钟。

senses.gloss_en: An important part or quality of something
senses.example_en: Speed is a key feature of this bike.
senses.example_cn: 速度是这辆自行车的一大特点。

senses.gloss_en: To include someone or something as an important part
senses.example_en: The movie features a famous singer as a doctor.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影由一位著名歌手主演，他饰演一名医生。

senses.gloss_en: One of the parts of a person's face
senses.example_en: Her eyes are her best feature on stage.
senses.example_cn: 在台上她的眼睛是最出彩的部位。

senses.gloss_en: A picture made by a camera, artist, or screen
senses.example_en: I saved an image of the sunset on my phone.
senses.example_cn: 我把那张日落的图片存在手机里了。

senses.gloss_en: A picture in your mind of something
senses.example_en: I have an image of home in winter.
senses.example_cn: 我脑海里有一幅家乡冬天的画面。

senses.gloss_en: The way people think about a person or thing
senses.example_en: The brand built an image of trust over time.
senses.example_cn: 这个品牌多年来建立起了可信的形象。

senses.gloss_en: A new thing, machine, or idea created for the first time
senses.example_en: The light bulb was a famous invention.
senses.example_cn: 电灯泡是一项著名的发明。

senses.gloss_en: The act of creating something new
senses.example_en: The invention of the phone changed daily life.
senses.example_cn: 电话的发明改变了日常生活。

senses.gloss_en: A story that is not true, made up
senses.example_en: His excuse was pure invention, not the truth.
senses.example_cn: 他的借口纯属捏造，并非事实。

senses.gloss_en: A small computer you can carry and use anywhere
senses.example_en: My laptop is in my bag right now.
senses.example_cn: 我的笔记本电脑现在就在包里。

senses.gloss_en: A connection between two people, things, or ideas
senses.example_en: There is a link between sleep and mood.
senses.example_cn: 睡眠和情绪之间有联系。

senses.gloss_en: A word or image you click on a website
