senses.example_en: Click this link to open the map.
senses.example_cn: 点这个链接就能打开地图。

senses.gloss_en: To connect two things or show they are related
senses.example_en: Police linked the two calls to one number.
senses.example_cn: 警方把这两个电话跟同一个号码联系了起来。

senses.gloss_en: TV, radio, newspapers, and the internet as a group
senses.example_en: The story was everywhere in the media today.
senses.example_cn: 今天各家媒体上到处都是这条新闻。

senses.gloss_en: The people and organizations that give news to the public
senses.example_en: The media asked her questions outside the hotel.
senses.gloss_cn: 新闻界（记者和新闻机构）
senses.example_cn: 媒体记者在酒店外向她提问。

senses.gloss_en: The plural of medium: a way of communicating information or ideas
senses.example_en: Video and email are useful media for teaching.
senses.example_cn: 视频和邮件都是很好用的教学媒介。

senses.gloss_en: A system of roads, wires, or lines connected together
senses.example_en: The phone network was down all morning.
senses.example_cn: 手机网络整个上午都断着。

senses.gloss_en: A group of people who share information and help
senses.example_en: She built a network of friends at school.
senses.example_cn: 她在学校建起了自己的朋友关系网。

senses.gloss_en: A group of computers connected to share data
senses.example_en: All our laptops are on the same network.
senses.example_cn: 我们所有的笔记本都连在同一个网络上。

senses.gloss_en: To put words or pictures on paper with a machine
senses.example_en: I printed the ticket at home last night.
senses.example_cn: 我昨晚在家把票打印好了。

senses.gloss_en: To publish a book, newspaper, or magazine in copies
senses.example_en: They print the paper every morning at five.
senses.example_cn: 他们每天早上五点印这份报纸。

senses.gloss_en: Words or pictures printed on paper
senses.example_en: The print is small and hard to read.
senses.example_cn: 这行字太小了，很难辨认。

senses.gloss_en: A machine that prints text or images onto paper
senses.example_en: My printer needs more ink right now.
senses.example_cn: 我的打印机现在得加墨了。

senses.gloss_en: A person or company that prints books, newspapers, or cards
senses.example_en: The printer sent the posters on Friday.
senses.example_cn: 印刷厂星期五把海报寄过来了。

senses.gloss_en: a written account kept for future use
senses.example_en: Keep a record of your spending every week.
senses.example_cn: 每周都要给自己的花销留一份记录。

senses.gloss_en: the best result anyone has achieved
senses.example_en: She set a world record at the meet.
senses.example_cn: 她在那场比赛中创造了世界纪录。

senses.gloss_en: to keep facts by writing, filming, or saving them
senses.example_en: He recorded the meeting on his phone for work.
senses.example_cn: 为了工作，他用手机把会议录了下来。

senses.gloss_en: sound or video saved to a file or disk
senses.example_en: I watched the recording on my phone last night.
senses.example_cn: 我昨晚在手机上看了那段录像。

senses.gloss_en: the act of saving sound or video
senses.example_en: Recording the song took two hours in studio.
senses.example_cn: 这首歌在录音棚里录了两个小时。

senses.gloss_en: the side view outline of a face
senses.example_en: Her profile looked calm in the photo.
senses.example_cn: 照片里她的侧脸看着很平静。

senses.gloss_en: a description that gives useful information
senses.example_en: The report includes a profile of each customer.
senses.example_cn: 报告里有每位客户的简介。

senses.gloss_en: your information page on a website or app
senses.example_en: My profile shows my name and city.
senses.example_cn: 我的个人资料上写着名字和所在城市。

senses.gloss_en: to answer someone by speaking or writing
senses.example_en: Please reply to my email before you leave.
senses.example_cn: 你走之前请回复我的邮件。

senses.gloss_en: to react to something with an action
senses.example_en: He replied with a smile, not words.
senses.example_cn: 他没说话，只是笑了笑作为回应。

senses.gloss_en: something you say or write as an answer
senses.example_en: Her reply was short, but very clear.
senses.example_cn: 她的答复很短，但非常清楚。

senses.gloss_en: the flat surface where images or words appear
senses.example_en: The screen went dark during the video.
senses.example_cn: 看视频的时候屏幕黑了。

senses.gloss_en: to show a movie on TV or in a theater
senses.example_en: They will screen the movie in our town tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚他们会在我们镇上放映这部电影。

senses.gloss_en: to test someone for a disease or risk
senses.example_en: Doctors screen people for cancer at the clinic.
senses.example_cn: 医生在诊所给人做癌症筛查。

senses.gloss_en: an attempt to find someone or something
senses.example_en: The search for my keys ended after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 找钥匙这件事到晚饭后才算结束。

senses.gloss_en: an act of finding information on the internet
senses.example_en: A search found the answer in one minute.
senses.example_cn: 搜索了一下，一分钟就找到了答案。

senses.gloss_en: to look carefully for someone or something
senses.example_en: We searched the room for the cat today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我们在房间里到处找那只猫。

senses.gloss_en: A number of similar events, one after another
senses.example_en: A series of storms hit the coast this week.
senses.example_cn: 这周一连串风暴袭击了海岸。

senses.gloss_en: A group of TV programs, with the same characters
senses.example_en: I watched a new series on my tablet.
senses.example_cn: 我用平板看了一部新剧。

senses.gloss_en: A set of books, about the same story
senses.example_en: She bought the whole series of books last year.
senses.example_cn: 她去年买了一整套这个系列的书。

senses.gloss_en: An internet page with information or services
senses.example_en: Visit the site to download the new app.
senses.example_cn: 去那个网站下载新的应用吧。

senses.gloss_en: The place where a building is, was, or will be
senses.example_en: They checked the site before building the new house.
senses.example_cn: 他们在盖新房子之前先查看了工地。

senses.gloss_en: A place where something important happened
senses.example_en: We stood at the site of the old school.
senses.example_cn: 我们站在那所老学校的旧址上。

senses.gloss_en: A mobile phone, with internet and apps
senses.example_en: My smartphone saves photos and music for my trip.
senses.example_cn: 我的智能手机里存着旅行用的照片和音乐。

senses.gloss_en: A person who gives a talk or speech
senses.example_en: The speaker told a funny story to us.
senses.example_cn: 演讲人给我们讲了个好笑的故事。

senses.gloss_en: A device that plays sound from an audio system
senses.example_en: Turn the speaker down, the baby is sleeping.
senses.example_cn: 把音箱声音关小点，宝宝在睡觉。

senses.gloss_en: A person who speaks a particular language
senses.example_en: She is a Spanish speaker in our class.
senses.example_cn: 她是我们班里讲西班牙语的人。

senses.gloss_en: A set of parts that work together
senses.example_en: The alarm system stopped working after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨过后，报警系统就不工作了。

senses.gloss_en: A way of doing things, using a plan
senses.example_en: My system for notes saves time in class.
senses.example_cn: 我记笔记的这套方法在课上很省时间。

senses.gloss_en: A set of computer programs and equipment
senses.example_en: The system crashed during the update last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚更新的时候系统崩溃了。

senses.gloss_en: A small computer, with a touch screen
senses.example_en: I read the news on my tablet every morning.
senses.example_cn: 我每天早上用平板电脑看新闻。

senses.gloss_en: A small piece of medicine that you swallow
senses.example_en: Take one tablet with water after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后用水服一片药。

senses.gloss_en: A flat piece of stone or clay, with writing
senses.example_en: The museum showed a tablet with ancient writing.
senses.example_cn: 博物馆展出了一块刻有古代文字的石板。

senses.gloss_en: Scientific knowledge used for practical purposes
senses.example_en: Technology helps doctors treat people faster today.
senses.example_cn: 技术让医生今天能更快地治好病人。

senses.gloss_en: Modern machines, equipment, or methods
senses.example_en: This phone uses new technology to save power.
senses.example_cn: 这款手机用了新技术来省电。

senses.gloss_en: A rough path made by people or animals
senses.example_en: We walked along a track through the forest.
senses.example_cn: 我们沿着林间的一条小路往前走。

senses.gloss_en: To record progress or movement over time
senses.example_en: We tracked the package from Seoul to Chicago.
senses.example_cn: 我们一路追踪这个包裹，从首尔到芝加哥。

senses.gloss_en: To find someone by following signs or data
senses.example_en: Police tracked the caller through his phone number.
senses.example_cn: 警方通过电话号码查到了打电话的人。

senses.gloss_en: A person who uses a product, machine, or service
senses.example_en: Each user can change a password in settings.
senses.example_cn: 每位用户都可以在设置里改密码。

senses.gloss_en: The internet system of connected documents, the Web
senses.example_en: I found the photo on the web yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 我昨天在网上找到了那张照片。

senses.gloss_en: A net of thin threads made by a spider
senses.example_en: A spider made a web above my bed.
senses.example_cn: 一只蜘蛛在我床铺上方结了张网。

senses.gloss_en: A complicated set of connections, often hard to escape
senses.example_en: He was caught in a web of lies.
senses.example_cn: 他陷入了一张谎言之网。

senses.gloss_en: A person who collects and reports news
senses.example_en: The reporter asked questions outside the station.
senses.example_cn: 那名记者在车站外提问。

senses.gloss_en: A person who writes or reports news stories
senses.example_en: The journalist wrote a story about the storm.
senses.example_cn: 那位记者写了一篇关于那场暴风雨的报道。

senses.gloss_en: to tell people about something to sell it
senses.example_en: They advertise the new phone on TV every day.
senses.example_cn: 他们每天在电视上给这款新手机做广告。

senses.gloss_en: to put a notice asking for something or someone
senses.example_en: We advertised for a cleaner in the local paper.
senses.example_cn: 我们在本地报纸上登广告招保洁。

senses.gloss_en: to make something known to other people, especially a fact about yourself
senses.example_en: Don’t advertise your mistake to everyone at work.
senses.example_cn: 别把自己的错误在单位里到处宣扬。

senses.gloss_en: to speak angrily because you disagree
senses.example_en: They argued about money all night at home.
senses.example_cn: 他们在家为钱吵了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: to give reasons for or against an idea
senses.example_en: She argued for the plan in class today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天在课上讲了一堆理由支持这个方案。

senses.gloss_en: to talk in a friendly, informal way
senses.example_en: We chatted with neighbors after dinner last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚饭后我们和邻居闲聊了一会儿。

senses.gloss_en: to exchange messages with someone online
senses.example_en: We chatted online until midnight last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我们在网上聊到半夜。

senses.gloss_en: a friendly, informal conversation
senses.example_en: Let’s have a quick chat after the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 会后我们简单聊几句吧。

senses.gloss_en: to share information or ideas with someone
senses.example_en: We communicate by email and text every day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天用邮件和短信交流。

senses.gloss_en: to say you are unhappy or annoyed about something
senses.example_en: Guests complained about the noise all night.
senses.example_cn: 客人抱怨整夜都很吵。

senses.gloss_en: to show a feeling or opinion by words or actions
senses.example_en: She expressed thanks with a smile and a note.
senses.example_cn: 她用一个微笑和一张便条表达了谢意。

senses.gloss_en: to say clearly what you think or feel
senses.example_en: He cannot express himself well in English yet.
senses.example_cn: 他还不能用英语好好表达自己。

senses.gloss_en: Say the sounds of a word or letter
senses.example_en: Can you pronounce my last name correctly?
senses.example_cn: 你能把我的姓念对吗？

senses.gloss_en: Say something officially in public
senses.example_en: The judge will pronounce the sentence in court today.
senses.example_cn: 法官今天将在法庭上宣布判决。

senses.gloss_en: Prepare and sell a book or magazine
senses.example_en: They published a travel book last year.
senses.example_cn: 他们去年出版了一本旅行书。

senses.gloss_en: Make writing available in print or online
senses.example_en: She published her story online for friends.
senses.example_cn: 她把自己的故事发到网上给朋友看。

senses.gloss_en: Make information officially public
senses.example_en: The city published new safety rules today.
senses.example_cn: 市里今天公布了新的安全规定。

senses.gloss_en: Say something is good and choose it
senses.example_en: I recommend this place for lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭我推荐这家店。

senses.gloss_en: Advise someone to do something
senses.example_en: The doctor recommended rest for two days.
senses.example_cn: 医生建议休息两天。

senses.gloss_en: Say someone is suitable for a job
senses.example_en: Her boss recommended her for the new role.
senses.example_cn: 她的上司举荐她担任那个新职位。

senses.gloss_en: Send someone to another person for help
senses.example_en: My doctor referred me to a specialist.
senses.example_cn: 我的医生把我转给了专科大夫。

senses.gloss_en: Talk or write about someone or something
senses.example_en: He referred to his trip in the talk.
senses.example_cn: 他在演讲里提到了自己那次旅行。

senses.gloss_en: Look at something for information
senses.example_en: Please refer to the guide before you start.
senses.example_cn: 开始之前请先查看那本指南。

senses.gloss_en: Answer someone with words or writing
senses.example_en: She responded to my email this morning.
senses.example_cn: 她今天上午回复了我的邮件。

senses.gloss_en: Act as a reaction to something
senses.example_en: Police responded quickly to the call for help.
senses.example_cn: 警方对那通求助电话反应很快。

senses.gloss_en: Change because of treatment or action
senses.example_en: He responded well to the new medicine.
senses.example_cn: 他用了新药以后效果很好。

senses.gloss_en: To make, or cause, a ringing sound
senses.example_en: I rang the doorbell, but nobody answered.
senses.example_cn: 我按了门铃，可是没人应。

senses.gloss_en: To call someone on the phone
senses.example_en: Please ring me tonight after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 今晚饭后给我打个电话。

senses.gloss_en: The sound a bell, phone, or alarm makes
senses.example_en: I heard a ring at the door.
senses.example_cn: 我听到门口有声响。

senses.gloss_en: To offer an idea for others to consider
senses.example_en: I suggest we meet after class today.
senses.example_cn: 我建议我们今天下课后见面。

senses.gloss_en: To say something is a good choice
senses.example_en: Can you suggest a good hotel near here.
senses.example_cn: 你能推荐一家附近的好酒店吗？

senses.gloss_en: To show an idea or feeling without saying it
senses.example_en: Her smile suggests she knows the answer.
senses.example_cn: 她的笑容暗示她知道答案。

senses.gloss_en: To speak or write about briefly
senses.example_en: He mentioned your name in the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 他在会上提到了你的名字。

senses.gloss_en: To name someone as a possible choice
senses.example_en: They mentioned her as a possible leader.
senses.example_cn: 他们提到她可以做领导。

senses.gloss_en: An act of referring to someone or something
senses.example_en: There was no mention of the problem.
senses.example_cn: 文中没有提到这个问题。

senses.gloss_en: To say you will do something for sure
senses.example_en: She promised to call me after work.
senses.example_cn: 她答应下班后给我打电话。

senses.gloss_en: A statement that you will do something
senses.example_en: He broke his promise and left early.
senses.example_cn: 他没守诺言，提前走了。

senses.gloss_en: To show signs of being good or successful
senses.example_en: The trip promises to be fun for us.
senses.example_cn: 这趟旅行看起来会很好玩。

senses.gloss_en: to produce flames and heat
senses.example_en: The candle burned all night on the table.
senses.example_cn: 蜡烛在桌上烧了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: to damage skin or things with heat
senses.example_en: Hot soup burned my hand in seconds.
senses.example_cn: 热汤一下就烫伤了我的手。

senses.gloss_en: an injury caused by fire, heat, or acid
senses.example_en: He has a burn on his arm today.
senses.example_cn: 他今天胳膊上有处烧伤。

senses.gloss_en: to have something inside or as part
senses.example_en: This soup contains no meat or fish.
senses.example_cn: 这道汤不含肉，也不含鱼。

senses.gloss_en: to stop something harmful from spreading
senses.example_en: They contained the fire before it reached houses.
senses.example_cn: 他们在火烧到房子之前把火控制住了。

senses.gloss_en: to control your feelings or actions
senses.example_en: He could not contain his anger at dinner.
senses.example_cn: 吃饭时他没能压住自己的火气。

senses.gloss_en: to damage something so badly it is gone
senses.example_en: The storm destroyed the roof in minutes.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨几分钟就把屋顶摧毁了。

senses.gloss_en: to ruin someone's life, confidence, or plans
senses.example_en: That lie destroyed her confidence at work.
senses.example_cn: 那个谎言毁掉了她工作上的信心。

senses.gloss_en: to grow or change into a stronger form
senses.example_en: The small town developed into a busy city.
senses.example_cn: 那个小镇发展成了一座繁忙的城市。

senses.gloss_en: to create something new over time
senses.example_en: They developed a new app for the school.
senses.example_cn: 他们为学校开发了一个新应用。

senses.gloss_en: to start to have an illness or problem
senses.example_en: He developed a cough after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 那次旅行之后他咳嗽起来了。

senses.gloss_en: to become impossible to see
senses.example_en: The cat disappeared under the bed again.
senses.example_cn: 猫又钻到床底下不见了。

senses.gloss_en: to go missing, not be found
senses.example_en: My keys disappeared from the table this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我的钥匙从桌上不见了。

senses.gloss_en: to stop existing
senses.example_en: The old custom disappeared within one generation.
senses.example_cn: 这种古老的风俗在一代人之后就消失了。

senses.gloss_en: to be real
senses.example_en: Do ghosts exist in this old house?
senses.example_cn: 这座老房子里真有鬼吗？

senses.gloss_en: to be present in a place or situation
senses.example_en: A similar program exists in my town now.
senses.example_cn: 我们镇上现在也有类似的项目。

senses.gloss_en: to live in very difficult conditions
senses.example_en: They existed on bread and water for days.
senses.example_cn: 他们靠面包和水撑了好几天。

senses.gloss_en: Create something new for the first time
senses.example_en: They invent a new game for the class.
senses.example_cn: 他们为这堂课发明了一个新游戏。

senses.gloss_en: Make up a story that is not true
senses.example_en: He invents an excuse to leave early.
senses.example_cn: 他编了个借口，好早点走。

senses.gloss_en: Make someone or something die
senses.example_en: The fire killed two people in the house.
senses.example_cn: 那场火灾让屋里两个人丧了命。

senses.gloss_en: Stop an activity or plan completely
senses.example_en: That joke killed the conversation in seconds.
senses.example_cn: 那个玩笑一下就把谈话搞冷了。

senses.gloss_en: Cause strong pain in a body part
senses.example_en: These boots are killing my feet today.
senses.example_cn: 这双靴子今天把我的脚磨得要命。

senses.gloss_en: Stop something from happening
senses.example_en: A helmet can prevent head injury in crashes.
senses.example_cn: 戴头盔能防止车祸中的头部受伤。

senses.gloss_en: Stop someone from doing something
senses.example_en: The guard prevented us from entering the room.
senses.example_cn: 保安阻止我们进那个房间。

senses.gloss_en: Make goods, usually for sale
senses.example_en: This factory produces parts for cars every day.
senses.example_cn: 这家工厂每天生产汽车零件。

senses.gloss_en: Cause a result or effect
senses.example_en: The new rule produced anger in the crowd.
senses.example_cn: 新规矩引发了人群的愤怒。

senses.gloss_en: Make something naturally, for example fruit or milk
senses.example_en: Bees produce honey in summer, not in winter.
senses.example_cn: 蜜蜂夏天产蜜，冬天不产。

senses.gloss_en: Fix something that is broken or damaged
senses.example_en: I repaired my bike after the long ride.
senses.example_cn: 骑了很久之后我把自行车修好了。

senses.gloss_en: Make a relationship good again
senses.example_en: They repaired their friendship after the argument.
senses.example_cn: 吵架之后他们修复了友谊。

senses.gloss_en: An act of fixing something
senses.example_en: The repairs cost a lot this month.
senses.example_cn: 这个月的修理花了不少钱。

senses.gloss_en: Take something or someone away
senses.example_en: Please remove the cups from the table now.
senses.example_cn: 现在请把杯子从桌上拿走。

senses.gloss_en: Take off clothing or a cover
senses.example_en: She removed her jacket before the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 开会前她把外套脱了。

senses.gloss_en: Get rid of something unwanted, like dirt
senses.example_en: This soap removes stains from shirts easily.
senses.example_cn: 这种肥皂能轻松去掉衬衫上的污渍。

senses.gloss_en: To use something new instead of an old thing
senses.example_en: I replaced my phone after I dropped it.
senses.example_cn: 手机摔了以后我换了个新的。

senses.gloss_en: To take the place of someone or something
senses.example_en: A new driver replaced him on the team today.
senses.example_cn: 今天队里换了个新司机接替他。

senses.gloss_en: To put something back where it was
senses.example_en: Replace the lid after you open the jar.
senses.example_cn: 打开罐子以后把盖子放回去。

senses.gloss_en: To process used materials so they can be used again
senses.example_en: We recycle bottles and paper at home every week.
senses.example_cn: 我们每周在家把瓶子和纸回收利用。

senses.gloss_en: To make something smaller or less in size or amount
senses.example_en: We reduced the price by ten dollars today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天把价格降了十美元。

senses.gloss_en: To become smaller or less
senses.example_en: Traffic reduced after the storm ended.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨过后车流少了。

senses.gloss_en: To find the correct answer to a question or puzzle
senses.example_en: He solved the math problem in class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天他在课上把那道数学题解出来了。

senses.gloss_en: To find a way to deal with a difficult problem
senses.example_en: We solved the conflict with a calm talk.
senses.example_cn: 我们平静地谈了谈，把矛盾解决了。

senses.gloss_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
senses.example_en: Sunscreen protects your skin from the sun.
senses.example_cn: 防晒霜能保护你的皮肤不被太阳晒伤。

senses.gloss_en: To repair something that is broken or not working
senses.example_en: Can you fix the door before dinner today.
senses.example_cn: 你能在今天吃晚饭前把门修好吗？

senses.gloss_en: To decide on a time, place, or plan
senses.example_en: We fixed a date for the meeting next week.
senses.example_cn: 我们把下周开会的日子定下来了。

senses.gloss_en: An easy solution to a problem, often temporary
senses.example_en: A quick fix saved the trip for us.
senses.example_cn: 一个快速补救的办法帮我们度过了难关。

senses.gloss_en: to heat a liquid until it bubbles
senses.example_en: Boil the water before you make tea.
senses.example_cn: 泡茶之前先把水烧开。

senses.gloss_en: to cook food in boiling water
senses.example_en: Boil the eggs for ten minutes then cool them.
senses.example_cn: 把鸡蛋煮十分钟，然后放凉。

senses.gloss_en: to feel extremely angry
senses.example_en: He was boiling with anger after the call.
senses.example_cn: 挂完电话后他怒火中烧。

senses.gloss_en: to put something over something else
senses.example_en: Cover the bowl with a plate to protect it.
senses.example_cn: 用盘子把碗盖上，护住里面的东西。

senses.gloss_en: to include a subject in a talk or book
senses.example_en: The lesson covers travel words and simple questions.
senses.example_cn: 这节课涵盖旅行用语和简单问句。

senses.gloss_en: the outside part of a book or magazine
senses.example_en: The cover of the book is bright red.
senses.example_cn: 这本书的封面是鲜红色的。

senses.gloss_en: to change someone or something
senses.example_en: Cold weather affects my hands and my mood.
senses.example_cn: 天冷会影响我的手，也影响我的心情。

senses.gloss_en: to cause strong feelings in someone
senses.example_en: The story affected her and she cried.
senses.example_cn: 那个故事把她感动得哭了。

senses.gloss_en: to succeed in reaching a goal
senses.example_en: She achieved her goal after months of work.
senses.example_cn: 努力了几个月，她实现了自己的目标。

senses.gloss_en: to join two things or places
senses.example_en: A bridge connects the island and the town.
senses.example_cn: 一座桥把这个岛和城里连了起来。

senses.gloss_en: to join a computer to the internet
senses.example_en: Connect your phone to the internet at home.
senses.example_cn: 在家把你的手机连上网。

senses.gloss_en: to form a good relationship with someone
senses.example_en: I connect with her because we love music.
senses.example_cn: 我和她很有共鸣，因为我们都热爱音乐。

senses.gloss_en: Using electricity for power
senses.example_en: We bought an electric kettle for the hotel room.
senses.example_cn: 我们给酒店房间买了个电热水壶。

senses.gloss_en: Relating to electricity
senses.example_en: The electric bill was high last month.
senses.example_cn: 上个月的电费很高。

senses.gloss_en: Relating to electricity, equipment, or wiring
senses.example_en: An electrical fault shut down the system.
senses.example_cn: 一处电路故障让整个系统停了。

senses.gloss_en: Using microchips to control a small electric current
senses.example_en: An electronic lock opened when I entered the code.
senses.example_cn: 我输入密码以后，电子锁就开了。

senses.gloss_en: Made of wood
senses.example_en: She sat on a wooden bench near the river.
senses.example_cn: 她坐在河边一张木头长椅上。

senses.gloss_en: Stiff, with little natural expression or feeling
senses.example_en: He gave a wooden smile during the interview.
senses.example_cn: 面试的时候他笑得很僵硬。

senses.gloss_en: Using computers, with information as 1 and 0
senses.example_en: Digital maps help me find the hotel fast.
senses.example_cn: 电子地图帮我很快找到了那家酒店。

senses.gloss_en: Showing information as numbers, not hands
senses.example_en: My digital watch shows the time in numbers.
senses.example_cn: 我的电子表用数字显示时间。

senses.gloss_en: Very bad or unpleasant
senses.example_en: The food was awful and we left early.
senses.example_cn: 菜太难吃了，我们就提前走了。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize a large amount or degree
senses.example_en: We waited an awful long time for the bus.
senses.example_cn: 我们等公交等了好久好久。

senses.gloss_en: Calculated by adding values and dividing by the number
senses.example_en: The average price is ten dollars this week.
senses.example_cn: 这周的平均价格是十美元。

senses.gloss_en: Typical or usual, not special
senses.example_en: He is an average student in my class.
senses.example_cn: 他在我们班是个成绩一般的学生。

senses.gloss_en: A number found by dividing a total by count
senses.example_en: The average was five for our test last week.
senses.example_cn: 我们上周考试的平均分是五分。

senses.gloss_en: Most important and necessary
senses.example_en: We need basic food and water for the trip.
senses.example_cn: 这趟行程我们需要基本的食物和水。

senses.gloss_en: Simple, not complicated
senses.example_en: My phone is basic but it works fine.
senses.example_cn: 我的手机很简易，但用起来没问题。

senses.gloss_en: Extremely intelligent or very clever
senses.example_en: She had a brilliant idea and we tried it.
senses.example_cn: 她想出一个绝妙的主意，我们就试了试。

senses.gloss_en: Very good, excellent
senses.example_en: The show was brilliant and the crowd cheered.
senses.example_cn: 演出非常精彩，观众都欢呼起来。

senses.gloss_en: Very bright, full of light or color
senses.example_en: The sky was brilliant blue after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，天空是明亮的蓝色。

senses.gloss_en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
senses.example_en: The instructions are clear and easy to follow.
senses.example_cn: 说明写得很清楚，照着做就行。

senses.gloss_en: Certain and not in doubt
senses.example_en: It is clear that we need help now.
senses.example_cn: 很明显，我们现在需要帮助。

senses.gloss_en: Remove things that block or fill something
senses.example_en: Please clear the table after dinner tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚饭后请把桌子收拾干净。

senses.gloss_en: Completely correct in every detail
senses.example_en: Tell me the exact time of the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 告诉我开会的确切时间。

senses.gloss_en: Not approximate, no more and no less
senses.example_en: The exact distance is ten miles.
senses.example_cn: 确切的距离是十英里。

senses.gloss_en: Exactly the same as the original
senses.example_en: This is an exact copy of the original.
senses.example_cn: 这是和原件一模一样的复制品。

senses.gloss_en: extremely good
senses.example_en: The food was excellent at the small cafe today.
senses.example_cn: 今天那家小咖啡馆的菜非常好吃。

senses.gloss_en: used to show strong approval or pleasure
senses.example_en: Excellent, we can start the trip now.
senses.example_cn: 太好了，我们现在就可以出发了。

senses.gloss_en: acceptable and reasonable
senses.example_en: That seems fair for a small job today.
senses.example_cn: 对一件小活儿来说，这样算合理。

senses.gloss_en: treating people equally and according to rules
senses.example_en: The teacher is fair to every student in class.
senses.example_cn: 这位老师对班上每个学生都很公平。

senses.gloss_en: pale in color, with light hair or skin
senses.example_en: He has fair hair and fair skin in winter.
senses.example_cn: 他一头浅色的头发，冬天皮肤很白。

senses.gloss_en: very great in degree, very strong
senses.example_en: They felt extreme pain after the long hike.
senses.example_cn: 走了很久的山路后，他们感到极度疼痛。

senses.gloss_en: not ordinary or usual, serious or severe
senses.example_en: We took extreme action after the storm last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚风暴之后，我们采取了极端的措施。

senses.gloss_en: one end of a range, opposite to another
senses.example_en: At one extreme, prices are too high for us.
senses.example_cn: 在一个极端上，价格对我们来说太高了。

senses.gloss_en: affecting all or most people or things
senses.example_en: There is general concern about the new rule today.
senses.example_cn: 现在大家对这条新规定普遍感到担心。

senses.gloss_en: normal or usual
senses.example_en: The general rule is to pay before you leave.
senses.example_cn: 一般的规矩是离开前先付钱。

senses.gloss_en: not detailed, not about one specific thing
senses.example_en: I can give a general answer, not details now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在只能给个大致的答复，讲不了细节。

senses.gloss_en: perfect, most suitable for a purpose
senses.example_en: This quiet beach is ideal for children today.
senses.example_cn: 这片安静的海滩今天对孩子们来说很理想。

senses.gloss_en: existing only in imagination, not likely to be real
senses.example_en: In an ideal world nobody is hungry at night.
senses.example_cn: 在理想的世界里，晚上没人会饿着。

senses.gloss_en: a perfect standard or idea worth trying to achieve
senses.example_en: Honesty is an ideal we try to follow daily.
senses.example_cn: 诚实是我们每天努力遵循的理想。

senses.gloss_en: not possible, unable to happen or be done
senses.example_en: It is impossible to finish this work in one day.
senses.example_cn: 一天之内做完这些活是不可能的。

senses.gloss_en: very difficult, hard to do
senses.example_en: This math problem is almost impossible for me.
senses.example_cn: 这道数学题对我来说几乎难得做不出来。

senses.gloss_en: very difficult to deal with, unreasonable
senses.example_en: Traffic is impossible during rush hour in this city.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市高峰期的交通让人受不了。

senses.gloss_en: Difficult or impossible to believe
senses.example_en: An incredible story kept us awake all night.
senses.example_cn: 一个难以置信的故事让我们整夜没睡。

senses.gloss_en: Extremely good, great, or impressive
senses.example_en: Her incredible singing made the room feel alive.
senses.example_cn: 她的歌声棒极了，整个屋子都活了起来。

senses.gloss_en: Having good things happen by chance
senses.example_en: I was lucky to find my keys outside.
senses.example_cn: 我很幸运，在外面找到了钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: Believed to bring good luck
senses.example_en: He wears a lucky charm on every trip.
senses.gloss_cn: 吉利的（据说能带来好运）
senses.example_cn: 每次出门他都戴着一个吉利的护身符。

senses.gloss_en: More important or serious than others
senses.example_en: This is a major decision for our family.
senses.example_cn: 这对我们家来说是个重大的决定。

senses.gloss_en: A main subject in college or university
senses.example_en: My major is biology and I love labs.
senses.example_cn: 我的专业是生物，我很喜欢做实验。

senses.gloss_en: A military officer rank above a captain
senses.example_en: The major spoke to the captain after training.
senses.example_cn: 训练结束后，少校和上尉谈了话。

senses.gloss_en: Needed in order to do or achieve something
senses.example_en: A password is necessary to enter this site.
senses.example_cn: 进这个网站必须要有密码。

senses.gloss_en: Unavoidable, cannot be avoided
senses.example_en: A delay was necessary after the storm hit.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，延期是不可避免的。

senses.gloss_en: Not different or special in any way
senses.example_en: It was an ordinary day at work for me.
senses.example_cn: 对我来说，这只是上班的普通一天。

senses.gloss_en: Not very interesting or impressive
senses.example_en: The movie was ordinary and I forgot it fast.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影平淡无奇，我很快就忘了。

senses.gloss_en: One specific person or thing, not others
senses.example_en: Do you want a particular seat near the window?
senses.example_cn: 你想坐靠窗的某个特定座位吗？

senses.gloss_en: Special or more important than usual
senses.example_en: This offer is of particular interest to students.
senses.example_cn: 这个优惠对学生来说特别有吸引力。

senses.gloss_en: Frightening, making you feel afraid
senses.example_en: That movie was scary, so I covered my eyes.
senses.example_cn: 那部电影很可怕，我都捂住了眼睛。

senses.gloss_en: Easy to understand or do, not complicated
senses.example_en: This app is simple, easy to use.
senses.example_cn: 这个应用很简单，用起来很方便。

senses.gloss_en: Basic or plain, without anything extra
senses.example_en: We ate a simple meal, rice and soup.
senses.example_cn: 我们吃得很简朴，只有米饭和汤。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize one important reason or fact
senses.example_en: I stayed for the simple reason I was sick.
senses.gloss_cn: 单纯的（用于强调唯一原因）
senses.example_cn: 我留下来，原因很单纯，我病了。

senses.gloss_en: Unusual or surprising, hard to understand
senses.example_en: A strange thing happened on my way home.
senses.example_cn: 我回家的路上发生了一件奇怪的事。

senses.gloss_en: Not known or familiar
senses.example_en: Do not talk to strange people at your door.
senses.example_cn: 不要跟上门来的陌生人说话。

senses.gloss_en: Feeling uncomfortable, not normal or right
senses.example_en: My stomach feels strange after that fish.
senses.example_cn: 吃了那条鱼以后，我的胃感觉有点不对劲。

senses.gloss_en: Tasting like sugar, not sour or bitter
senses.example_en: This tea is sweet, with honey in it.
senses.example_cn: 这茶是甜的，里面加了蜂蜜。

senses.gloss_en: Having a pleasant smell
senses.example_en: The flowers smell sweet in the warm air.
senses.example_cn: 暖风里的花香很好闻。

senses.gloss_en: Kind and friendly, showing you care
senses.example_en: It was sweet of you to help me.
senses.example_cn: 你来帮我，真是太贴心了。

senses.gloss_en: Unexpected, causing surprise
senses.example_en: Her answer was surprising to everyone in class.
senses.example_cn: 她的回答让班上每个人都感到意外。

senses.gloss_en: Not common, different from usual
senses.example_en: He has an unusual job in our town.
senses.example_cn: 他在我们镇上做一份少见的工作。

senses.gloss_en: Happening most of the time, normal
senses.example_en: I took my usual bus to work.
senses.example_cn: 我坐平时那趟公交去上班。

senses.gloss_en: Not physically strong, lacking energy
senses.example_en: After the run, I felt weak today.
senses.example_cn: 今天跑完步，我觉得身体很虚弱。

senses.gloss_en: Not strong enough, not powerful or effective
senses.example_en: The weak team lost the game again.
senses.example_cn: 那支实力弱的队又输了比赛。

senses.gloss_en: Not strong in taste, containing little alcohol
senses.example_en: This coffee is weak, add more coffee.
senses.example_cn: 这咖啡太淡了，再加点咖啡粉。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: More unpleasant, more difficult than before
senses.example_en: The weather is worse than yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 天气比昨天更糟。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: More ill, more severe than before
senses.example_en: My cold got worse last night.
senses.example_cn: 我的感冒昨晚加重了。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: Less well, in a more serious way
senses.example_en: He plays worse when he is tired.
senses.example_cn: 他累的时候打得更差。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: Worse than all others, the lowest quality
senses.example_en: This was my worst day at work.
senses.example_cn: 这是我工作以来最糟的一天。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: Most badly, with the most harm
senses.example_en: The storm hit this town worst.
senses.example_cn: 这场风暴对这个镇的破坏最严重。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, adv. B1, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: The most unpleasant thing that can happen
senses.example_en: The worst is over, we are safe.
senses.example_cn: 最坏的时候已经过去，我们安全了。

senses.gloss_en: Related to the body, not the mind
senses.example_en: I need physical exercise every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天都需要做身体锻炼。

senses.gloss_en: Existing in a form you can touch or see
senses.example_en: There is no physical proof of that.
senses.example_cn: 这件事没有实物证据。

senses.gloss_en: Using force with your body, not words
senses.example_en: The fight turned physical after the game.
senses.example_cn: 比赛结束后，争吵变成了动手打架。

senses.gloss_en: Having the usual features of a type
senses.example_en: This is typical food in my town.
senses.example_cn: 这是我们镇上典型的食物。

senses.gloss_en: Behaving as expected, often in an annoying way
senses.example_en: He forgot again, typical of him.
senses.example_cn: 他又忘了，他就是这样。

senses.gloss_en: relating to one particular person, thing, or situation
senses.example_en: I need specific details about your plan.
senses.example_cn: 我需要你计划里的具体细节。

senses.gloss_en: clear and exact, with details
senses.example_en: Please be specific about the time and place.
senses.example_cn: 请把时间和地点说得具体一些。

senses.gloss_en: usual, typical, and not strange
senses.example_en: A normal day starts with coffee and music.
senses.example_cn: 平常的一天从咖啡和音乐开始。

senses.gloss_en: healthy, not showing illness or problems
senses.example_en: His heart rate is normal again today.
senses.example_cn: 他今天的心率又恢复正常了。

senses.gloss_en: the usual or average level
senses.example_en: Things returned to normal after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后一切恢复了正常。

senses.gloss_en: following a pattern, with equal time or space
senses.example_en: The train comes at regular intervals each hour.
senses.example_cn: 火车每小时准时到站。

senses.gloss_en: done or happening often
senses.example_en: She takes regular breaks during long drives.
senses.example_cn: 长途开车时她会定时休息。

senses.gloss_en: usual, the one you often use
senses.example_en: I saw my regular doctor on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 我星期一看的是我常去的那位医生。

senses.gloss_en: not in danger, protected from harm
senses.example_en: The kids are safe with their uncle.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们跟着叔叔很安全。

senses.gloss_en: not likely to cause harm or danger
senses.example_en: This helmet is safe for bike rides.
senses.example_cn: 骑车戴这个头盔很安全。

senses.gloss_en: not likely to be lost or stolen
senses.example_en: Keep your passport safe in the hotel room.
senses.gloss_cn: 妥善保管的（不会丢或被偷）
senses.example_cn: 把护照在酒店房间里放好，别丢了。

senses.gloss_en: known by only a few people, kept hidden
senses.example_en: They held a secret meeting in the basement.
senses.example_cn: 他们在地下室开了一场秘密会议。

senses.gloss_en: information only a few people know
senses.example_en: Please keep my secret until next week.
senses.example_cn: 请帮我保守这个秘密，到下周再说。

senses.gloss_en: the best way to do something
senses.example_en: Practice is the secret to better speaking.
senses.example_cn: 多练是把话说得更好的秘诀。

senses.gloss_en: achieving what you wanted
senses.example_en: The experiment was successful, so we repeated it.
senses.example_cn: 实验很成功，所以我们又做了一次。

senses.gloss_en: popular and making a lot of money
senses.example_en: He built a successful business in his hometown.
senses.example_cn: 他在家乡办起了一家红火赚钱的公司。

senses.gloss_en: sure, with no doubt
senses.example_en: I am certain that this is my bag.
senses.example_cn: 我确信这就是我的包。

senses.gloss_en: sure to happen
senses.example_en: Rain is certain to come tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚肯定会下雨。

senses.gloss_en: particular, not named
senses.example_en: Certain people like quiet places at night.
senses.example_cn: 某些人晚上喜欢安静的地方。

senses.gloss_en: expected to happen
senses.example_en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
senses.example_cn: 今天下午很可能会下雨。

senses.gloss_en: seeming true, believable
senses.example_en: His story sounded likely to me.
senses.example_cn: 我觉得他的说法听起来挺可信。

senses.gloss_en: seeming suitable or probable
senses.example_en: This looks like a likely place to park.
senses.example_cn: 这里看着像是个合适的停车地方。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, v. B1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: straight, without stopping or changing direction
senses.example_en: We took the direct road to the beach.
senses.example_cn: 我们走了直通海边的那条路。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, v. B1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: saying what you mean, not hiding feelings
senses.example_en: Please be direct with me about the problem.
senses.example_cn: 关于这个问题，请你跟我直说。

senses.headword_tail: adj. A2, v. B1, adv. B1
senses.gloss_en: to control and organize an activity or work
senses.example_en: She will direct the team on this job.
senses.example_cn: 这项工作将由她来指挥团队完成。

senses.gloss_en: living in nature, not kept by people
senses.example_en: We saw wild horses near the river today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天在河边看到了野马。

senses.gloss_en: uncontrolled, very excited or noisy
senses.example_en: The crowd went wild when the song began.
senses.example_cn: 歌一响起，人群就疯了一样。

senses.gloss_en: not sensible, not based on facts
senses.example_en: I made a wild guess about the price.
senses.example_cn: 价格我是胡乱猜的。

senses.gloss_en: having the skill or chance to do something
senses.example_en: I was able to finish the work today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天能把这份工作做完。

senses.gloss_en: skilled at doing a job
senses.example_en: She is an able teacher in our school.
senses.example_cn: 她是我们学校一位很能干的老师。

senses.gloss_en: safe, not hurt or ill
senses.example_en: You look all right now to me.
senses.chunk: You look all right now to
senses.gloss_cn: 平安无事（没受伤、没生病）
senses.example_cn: 在我看来你现在没什么事了。

senses.gloss_en: satisfactory, reasonably good
senses.example_en: The food was all right in that cafe.
senses.chunk: food was all right in that
senses.example_cn: 那家小咖啡馆的东西还不错。

senses.gloss_en: in a satisfactory way
senses.example_en: She did all right on the test today.
senses.chunk: She did all right on the
senses.example_cn: 她今天考得还不错。

senses.gloss_en: Cooking instructions, ingredients and steps for a dish
senses.example_en: This recipe uses eggs, milk, and sugar.
senses.example_cn: 这个食谱要用鸡蛋、牛奶和糖。

senses.gloss_en: A method, likely to produce a certain result
senses.example_en: No sleep is a recipe for trouble.
senses.example_cn: 不睡觉就是自找麻烦。

senses.gloss_en: A professional cook, often the head cook
senses.example_en: The chef cooked pasta for the family.
senses.example_cn: 厨师给这家人做了意大利面。

senses.gloss_en: A heated box, used to bake or roast food
senses.example_en: Put the bread in the oven for ten minutes.
senses.example_cn: 把面包放进烤箱烤十分钟。

senses.gloss_en: A kitchen cooker, with burners and often an oven
senses.example_en: Turn off the stove after you cook.
senses.example_cn: 做完饭把灶关掉。

senses.gloss_en: A heating device, used to warm a room
senses.example_en: The wood stove kept the cabin warm.
senses.example_cn: 那个柴火炉让小木屋一直很暖和。

senses.gloss_en: A cold appliance, used to keep food fresh
senses.example_en: Put the fish in the refrigerator now.
senses.example_cn: 现在就把鱼放进冰箱。

senses.gloss_en: A deep round dish, used for food or liquid
senses.example_en: She ate soup from a bowl at lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭她用碗喝了汤。

senses.gloss_en: The amount a bowl holds, one serving
senses.example_en: He drank a bowl of soup after work.
senses.example_cn: 下班后他喝了一碗汤。

senses.gloss_en: The round basin, part of a toilet
senses.example_en: Clean the toilet bowl after the party.
senses.example_cn: 派对结束后把马桶刷干净。

senses.gloss_en: flat, usually round dish for eating or serving
senses.example_en: Put the rice on a clean plate.
senses.example_cn: 把米饭盛在一个干净的盘子里。

senses.gloss_en: amount of food served on a plate
senses.example_en: He ate a plate of noodles for lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭他吃了一盘面。

senses.gloss_en: metal sign on a vehicle with numbers, letters
senses.example_en: I forgot my license plate number for my car.
senses.example_cn: 我忘了自己车的车牌号。

senses.gloss_en: sharp blade with a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon
senses.example_en: Cut the apple with a sharp knife.
senses.example_cn: 用一把快刀把苹果切开。

senses.gloss_en: tool with prongs, used for picking up food
senses.example_en: She ate the salad with a fork.
senses.example_cn: 她用叉子吃了那份沙拉。

senses.gloss_en: garden tool with metal prongs, used for digging
senses.example_en: He used a garden fork to dig in the yard.
senses.example_cn: 他用园艺叉在院子里翻土。

senses.gloss_en: place where a road or river divides into two
senses.example_en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
senses.example_cn: 在岔路口往左拐。

senses.gloss_en: tool with a handle and a shallow bowl
senses.example_en: Stir the soup with a spoon.
senses.example_cn: 用勺子把汤搅一搅。

senses.gloss_en: amount that a spoon can hold
senses.example_en: Add one spoon of sugar to your tea.
senses.example_cn: 往你的茶里加一勺糖。

senses.gloss_en: metal container for food or drinks
senses.example_en: He opened a can of soup for dinner.
senses.example_cn: 他开了一罐汤做晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: amount of food or drink in a can
senses.example_en: She drank a can of soda after work.
senses.example_cn: 她下班后喝了一罐汽水。

senses.gloss_en: container for carrying liquids, often with a handle
senses.example_en: Fill the can with water for the plants.
senses.example_cn: 装一桶水去浇花。

senses.gloss_en: thick liquid found underground, petroleum
senses.example_en: They drilled for oil near the coast.
senses.example_cn: 他们在海岸附近钻井采石油。

senses.gloss_en: petroleum used in machines, especially car engines, to make them run smoothly
senses.example_en: The car needs oil before the long trip.
senses.example_cn: 长途出行前这辆车得加机油。

senses.gloss_en: liquid from plants or animals, used in cooking
senses.example_en: Add oil to the pan before the eggs.
senses.example_cn: 放鸡蛋之前先往锅里倒点油。

senses.gloss_en: a thick liquid eaten with food for flavor
senses.example_en: I poured sauce on the rice and chicken.
senses.example_cn: 我把酱汁浇在米饭和鸡肉上。

senses.gloss_en: alcohol (informal, old-fashioned)
senses.example_en: He quit the sauce and felt better.
senses.example_cn: 他戒了酒，人也觉得舒服多了。

senses.gloss_en: rude talk or behavior, showing no respect (old-fashioned)
senses.example_en: Don't give me that sauce in class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天上课别对我这么没大没小。

senses.gloss_en: a sweet food made from fruit and sugar
senses.example_en: I spread jam on bread with butter.
senses.example_cn: 我在面包上涂了果酱和黄油。

senses.gloss_en: a crowded situation stopping people or vehicles moving
senses.example_en: We got stuck in a jam near the bridge.
senses.gloss_cn: 拥堵（人或车挤住动不了）
senses.example_cn: 我们在桥附近堵住了，车动不了。

senses.gloss_en: a difficult situation that is hard to deal with
senses.example_en: I was in a jam because I lost my wallet and my phone.
senses.example_cn: 我钱包和手机都丢了，陷入了困境。

senses.gloss_en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice
senses.example_en: I squeezed lemon juice on the fish today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我在鱼上挤了柠檬汁。

senses.gloss_en: a pale yellow color (also lemon yellow)
senses.example_en: I chose lemon for the kitchen walls because it looks bright.
senses.example_cn: 我给厨房墙壁选了淡黄色，因为看着亮。

senses.gloss_en: a thing that does not work properly
senses.example_en: My new camera was a lemon and broke.
senses.example_cn: 我的新相机是个次品，用坏了。

senses.gloss_en: meat from a cow, eaten as food
senses.example_en: We cooked beef with onions and rice.
senses.example_cn: 我们做了牛肉，配上洋葱和米饭。

senses.gloss_en: a complaint about someone or something
senses.example_en: I have a beef with that new rule.
senses.example_cn: 我对那条新规定有意见。

senses.gloss_en: a seed or pod from a bean plant, eaten as food
senses.example_en: This bean is green and ready to eat.
senses.example_cn: 这个豆子是绿色的，可以吃了。

senses.gloss_en: a seed used to make coffee, cocoa, or vanilla
senses.example_en: I ground a coffee bean for my drink.
senses.example_cn: 我磨了咖啡豆来冲我的饮料。

senses.gloss_en: a hard fruit or seed with a hard shell
senses.example_en: I ate a nut after dinner last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚饭后我吃了一颗坚果。

senses.gloss_en: a small metal piece screwed onto a bolt
senses.example_en: Tighten the nut on the bolt now.
senses.example_cn: 现在把螺栓上的螺母拧紧。

senses.gloss_en: a person very interested in something
senses.example_en: She is a music nut and loves concerts.
senses.gloss_cn: 迷（对某事特别着迷的人）
senses.example_cn: 她是个音乐迷，特别喜欢听演唱会。

senses.gloss_en: The flavor of food or drink
senses.example_en: The soup has a strong taste of garlic.
senses.example_cn: 这汤有很浓的蒜味。

senses.gloss_en: To have a particular flavor
senses.example_en: This soup tastes salty, but the bread tastes sweet.
senses.example_cn: 这汤有点咸，不过面包是甜的。

senses.gloss_en: To try food or drink, to know its flavor
senses.example_en: Taste the sauce, then add more salt.
senses.example_cn: 尝一下酱汁，再加点盐。

senses.gloss_en: A small flat sweet cake, baked until dry
senses.example_en: I baked a cookie, then shared it with friends.
senses.example_cn: 我烤了一块饼干，然后分给了朋友。

senses.gloss_en: a small file of information saved on your computer by a website
senses.example_en: This website saved a cookie on my computer.
senses.gloss_cn: 网站存在电脑里的小文件
senses.example_cn: 这个网站在我电脑上存了一个小文件。

senses.gloss_en: Sweet food made from sugar, often with chocolate
senses.example_en: She bought candy at the store after school.
senses.example_cn: 放学后她在店里买了糖。

senses.gloss_en: A thin fried piece of potato, eaten as a snack
senses.example_en: He ate a chip, and he smiled.
senses.example_cn: 他吃了一片薯片，笑了。

senses.gloss_en: A long thin piece of potato, fried in oil
senses.example_en: She ordered fish and chips at the cafe.
senses.example_cn: 她在咖啡馆点了炸鱼薯条。

senses.gloss_en: A small piece broken off something hard
senses.example_en: A chip fell off the cup edge.
senses.example_cn: 杯口磕掉了一小块。

senses.gloss_en: Sweet food, eaten at the end of a meal
senses.example_en: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们吃冰淇淋当甜点。

senses.gloss_en: a store that sells food and other things used in the home
senses.example_en: I stopped at the grocery before dinner.
senses.example_cn: 我晚饭前顺路去了食品杂货店。

senses.gloss_en: food and other things bought at a grocery store
senses.example_en: I carried groceries up the stairs alone.
senses.example_cn: 我一个人提着食品杂货爬上了楼梯。

senses.gloss_en: part of an organization for one kind of work
senses.example_en: The sales department closed early on Friday.
senses.example_cn: 销售部周五提早下班了。

senses.gloss_en: part of a large store selling one kind of goods
senses.example_en: The shoe department is next to the elevator.
senses.example_cn: 鞋区就在电梯旁边。

senses.gloss_en: machine carrying people or goods between building levels
senses.example_en: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.
senses.example_cn: 坐电梯到十楼。

senses.gloss_en: area near the entrance where visitors go first
senses.example_en: Please wait at reception while I get the keys.
senses.example_cn: 我去拿钥匙，你先在前台等一下。

senses.gloss_en: formal party to welcome someone or celebrate something
senses.example_en: We met at the reception after the wedding.
senses.example_cn: 婚礼之后我们在招待会上见了面。

senses.gloss_en: type of welcome given to someone or something
senses.example_en: Her idea got a cold reception from the team.
senses.example_cn: 她的想法在团队里反响冷淡。

senses.gloss_en: worker who keeps records or accounts and does routine duties in an office or store
senses.example_en: The clerk checked my account and printed a form.
senses.example_cn: 那位职员查了我的账户，还打印了一张表格。

senses.gloss_en: worker who serves customers in a store
senses.example_en: A clerk showed me where the bread was.
senses.example_cn: 一位店员告诉我面包在哪儿。

senses.gloss_en: official in charge of records for a town or court
senses.example_en: The clerk filed the papers at the court.
senses.example_cn: 书记员把文件在法院登记归档了。

senses.gloss_en: system providing something the public needs
senses.example_en: The bus service stops here every twenty minutes.
senses.example_cn: 这条公交线路每二十分钟在这儿停一班。

senses.gloss_en: help given to customers in shops, hotels, or restaurants
senses.example_en: The service was quick and friendly today.
senses.example_cn: 今天的服务又快又热情。

senses.gloss_en: religious ceremony held in a church
senses.example_en: We went to a service at the church.
senses.example_cn: 我们去教堂参加了一场礼拜。

senses.gloss_en: say you will do something for someone
senses.example_en: I can offer help if you need it.
senses.example_cn: 你要是需要，我可以帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: ask someone if they would like something
senses.example_en: She offered me tea, but I said no.
senses.example_cn: 她问我要不要茶，我说不用了。

senses.gloss_en: a question asking if someone wants something
senses.example_en: Thanks for the offer, but I do not want it.
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你的好意，不过我不需要。

senses.gloss_en: the act of selling something
senses.example_en: The sale of the house took three months.
senses.example_cn: 这栋房子卖了三个月才成交。

senses.gloss_en: a time when goods are sold cheaper
senses.example_en: I bought these shoes in the sale today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我趁打折买了这双鞋。

senses.gloss_en: an event where things are sold
senses.example_en: We went to a book sale at school.
senses.example_cn: 我们去参加了学校的图书售卖会。

senses.gloss_en: one thing on a list
senses.example_en: Milk is the first item on my list.
senses.example_cn: 牛奶是我清单上的第一项。

senses.gloss_en: a single object or article
senses.example_en: Each item has a price tag on it.
senses.example_cn: 每件商品上都贴着价签。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of news in media
senses.example_en: I saw an item about the storm on TV.
senses.example_cn: 我在电视上看到一条关于暴风雨的新闻。

senses.gloss_en: how big or small something is
senses.example_en: What is the size of this box?
senses.example_cn: 这个箱子有多大？

senses.gloss_en: a standard measurement for clothes or shoes
senses.example_en: What size shoes do you wear?
senses.example_cn: 你穿多大码的鞋？

senses.gloss_en: something you give to someone
senses.example_en: I bought a gift for my sister today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我给妹妹买了一份礼物。

senses.gloss_en: a natural ability or skill
senses.example_en: She has a gift for design and art.
senses.example_cn: 她在设计和艺术上很有天赋。

senses.gloss_en: money given to help a person or group
senses.example_en: They gave a gift to the school last year.
senses.example_cn: 他们去年给学校捐了一笔钱。

senses.gloss_en: letters and packages you send or receive
senses.example_en: My mail arrived this morning at the office.
senses.example_cn: 我的邮件今天上午送到办公室了。

senses.gloss_en: the system for sending letters and packages
senses.example_en: Send it by mail, not by hand.
senses.example_cn: 通过邮政寄出去，不要亲手送。

senses.gloss_en: send a letter or package using the postal system
senses.example_en: Please mail the form to me today.
senses.example_cn: 请今天把表格寄给我。

senses.gloss_en: A small paper label used to send mail
senses.example_en: I need a stamp for this letter.
senses.example_cn: 这封信我需要一张邮票。

senses.gloss_en: A tool or mark used to print on something
senses.example_en: Use the stamp on the form, then sign.
senses.example_cn: 在表格上盖上章，然后签名。

senses.gloss_en: A hard movement of the foot on the ground
senses.example_en: He left with a stamp of his foot.
senses.example_cn: 他跺了一下脚就走了。

senses.gloss_en: Rings, necklaces, or earrings worn for decoration
senses.example_en: She lost her jewelry at the beach today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天在海滩上把首饰丢了。

senses.gloss_en: A round piece of jewelry worn on a finger
senses.example_en: He bought a ring with a small stone.
senses.example_cn: 他买了一枚镶着小宝石的戒指。

senses.gloss_en: A group of people sitting or standing in a circle
senses.example_en: The children sat in a ring around the teacher.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们围成一圈坐在老师身边。

senses.gloss_en: A group working together in illegal activity
senses.example_en: Police stopped a drug ring in the city.
senses.gloss_cn: 团伙（一伙干违法事的人）
senses.example_cn: 警方打掉了城里一个贩毒团伙。

senses.gloss_en: Clothes, especially a particular type
senses.example_en: Winter clothing keeps you warm in cold weather.
senses.example_cn: 冬天的衣服能让你在寒冷天气里保暖。

senses.gloss_en: Special clothes worn by members of a group
senses.example_en: The nurse put on her uniform for work.
senses.example_cn: 护士穿上制服去上班。

senses.gloss_en: A set of clothes with a jacket and pants
senses.example_en: He wore a suit to the job interview.
senses.example_cn: 他穿着西装去面试。

senses.gloss_en: Be right for someone or a situation
senses.example_en: This job suits her and her skills well.
senses.example_cn: 这份工作很适合她，也很配她的本领。

senses.gloss_en: Be convenient, cause the least difficulty
senses.example_en: Two o'clock suits me, so we can meet then.
senses.example_cn: 两点我方便，我们就那时候见吧。

senses.gloss_en: highest part or point of something
senses.example_en: The cat sat on the top shelf.
senses.example_cn: 那只猫坐在最上层的架子上。

senses.gloss_en: cover for a container or end of something
senses.example_en: Put the top back on the bottle.
senses.example_cn: 把瓶盖盖回去。

senses.gloss_en: highest in rank, level, or importance
senses.example_en: She got the top job at the hospital.
senses.example_cn: 她在那家医院拿到了最高的职位。

senses.gloss_en: strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist
senses.example_en: He tightened his belt before the long walk.
senses.example_cn: 走远路之前他把腰带系紧了。

senses.gloss_en: moving band in a machine that carries things
senses.example_en: Boxes move on the belt to the truck.
senses.example_cn: 箱子通过传送带被运到卡车上。

senses.gloss_en: narrow area, often around something
senses.example_en: A belt of trees surrounds the small field.
senses.example_cn: 一条林带环绕着这块小田地。

senses.gloss_en: fasten with string, rope, or a knot
senses.example_en: Please tie the bag so it stays closed.
senses.example_cn: 请把袋子系好，别让它敞着。

senses.gloss_en: long narrow cloth worn around the neck
senses.example_en: He wore a tie with his white shirt.
senses.example_cn: 他穿着白衬衫，还打了条领带。

senses.gloss_en: game result with the same score
senses.example_en: The game ended in a tie after overtime.
senses.example_cn: 加时赛后比赛以平局收场。

senses.gloss_en: soft clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe
senses.example_en: I lost one sock under the bed.
senses.example_cn: 我有一只袜子丢在床底下了。

senses.gloss_en: strong hit, especially with the fist
senses.example_en: He gave him a sock on the jaw.
senses.example_cn: 他朝他下巴狠狠来了一拳。

senses.gloss_en: a light sports shoe, usually with a rubber sole
senses.example_en: My sneaker is wet from the rain today.
senses.example_cn: 我的运动鞋今天被雨淋湿了。

senses.gloss_en: a small cloth bag, inside clothing for carrying things
senses.example_en: My phone is in my pocket in my jeans.
senses.example_cn: 我的手机在牛仔裤口袋里。

senses.gloss_en: the money you have with you to spend
senses.example_en: I didn’t have enough money in my pocket for the taxi.
senses.example_cn: 我身上的钱不够付出租车费。

senses.gloss_en: a small area, different from what is around it
senses.example_en: There is a pocket of cold air today.
senses.gloss_cn: 一小片（与周围不同的区域）
senses.example_cn: 今天有一小片冷空气。

senses.gloss_en: a small fastener, sewn on clothing to close it
senses.example_en: One button fell off my shirt this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我衬衫上掉了一颗纽扣。

senses.gloss_en: a small switch, pressed to control a device
senses.example_en: Press the button to start the washing machine.
senses.example_cn: 按这个按钮启动洗衣机。

senses.gloss_en: an object for children to play with
senses.example_en: The baby played with a toy in bed.
senses.example_cn: 宝宝在床上玩玩具。

senses.gloss_en: made as a copy, for a child to play with
senses.example_en: He drove a toy car across the floor.
senses.example_cn: 他把玩具车在地板上开来开去。

senses.gloss_en: Give someone something they need or want
senses.example_en: The clinic provides free care to local families.
senses.example_cn: 这家诊所为当地家庭提供免费医疗。

senses.gloss_en: Give useful information or help to someone
senses.example_en: This guide provides clear steps for your new job.
senses.example_cn: 这本指南为你的新工作提供了清晰的步骤。

senses.gloss_en: Make something possible by giving what is needed
senses.example_en: The new road provides a safe way home.
senses.example_cn: 新修的这条路提供了一条安全的回家之路。

senses.gloss_en: Get something that is sent or given
senses.example_en: I received your letter and read it twice.
senses.example_cn: 我收到了你的信，读了两遍。

senses.gloss_en: Welcome guests in a formal way
senses.example_en: She received guests at the door and smiled.
senses.example_cn: 她在门口迎接客人，面带微笑。

senses.gloss_en: Be given a punishment or an injury
senses.example_en: He received a warning after the fight.
senses.example_cn: 打架之后他受到了一次警告。

senses.gloss_en: Let someone use something for a short time
senses.example_en: He lent me his pen during class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天上课的时候他把笔借给了我。

senses.gloss_en: Give someone money to be paid back
senses.example_en: The bank lent her money for a small car.
senses.example_cn: 银行借给她一笔钱买了一辆小车。

senses.gloss_en: Give public support to an idea, plan, or person
senses.example_en: Several experts lent support to the plan.
senses.example_cn: 几位专家对该计划表示了支持。

senses.gloss_en: Take something and return it later
senses.example_en: I borrowed his jacket and returned it later.
senses.example_cn: 我借了他的外套，后来还了。

senses.gloss_en: Get money now and pay it back
senses.example_en: She borrowed money from her sister for rent.
senses.example_cn: 她跟姐姐借钱付房租。

senses.gloss_en: Get money for work you do
senses.example_en: I earned money washing cars on weekends.
senses.example_cn: 我周末靠洗车挣钱。

senses.gloss_en: Make profit or interest from something
senses.example_en: This account earns interest every month.
senses.example_cn: 这个账户每个月都能生利息。

senses.gloss_en: Stop someone from being killed or injured
senses.example_en: The doctor saved his life after the crash.
senses.example_cn: 车祸之后医生救了他的命。

senses.gloss_en: Store information on a computer
senses.example_en: Save your work often and close the file.
senses.example_cn: 记得经常保存，然后再关掉文件。

senses.gloss_en: get and keep things as a hobby
senses.example_en: She collects coins from many countries.
senses.example_cn: 她收集很多国家的硬币。

senses.gloss_en: bring things or information together from places
senses.example_en: We collected information from friends at the market.
senses.example_cn: 我们在市场上向朋友们收集了信息。

senses.gloss_en: receive or take money, for example taxes
senses.example_en: The city collects taxes to pay for schools.
senses.example_cn: 市政府征收税款用于建设学校。

senses.gloss_en: give someone food or drink, especially in a restaurant
senses.example_en: They served soup and bread for lunch today.
senses.example_cn: 今天午饭他们上了汤和面包。

senses.gloss_en: help customers by selling things in a store
senses.example_en: A clerk served me at the front desk.
senses.example_cn: 一位店员在前台接待了我。

senses.gloss_en: be useful as something for a purpose
senses.example_en: This table serves as a desk at night.
senses.example_cn: 到了晚上，这张桌子就当书桌用。

senses.gloss_en: give food to a person or animal
senses.example_en: I feed the dog before we leave home.
senses.example_cn: 我们出门前我先喂狗。

senses.gloss_en: meal for a baby or animal
senses.example_en: The baby wakes for a feed at night.
senses.example_cn: 宝宝夜里醒来要吃奶。

senses.gloss_en: web page showing new posts or information
senses.example_en: My news feed shows new photos every morning.
senses.example_cn: 我的新闻流每天早晨推送新照片。

senses.gloss_en: take something without permission and keep it
senses.example_en: Someone stole my phone on the bus today.
senses.example_cn: 今天有人在公交车上偷了我的手机。

senses.gloss_en: use someone else's ideas as your own
senses.example_en: He stole her idea and used it again.
senses.example_cn: 他盗用了她的想法。

senses.gloss_en: move secretly and quietly so others do not notice
senses.example_en: We stole into the room and closed the door.
senses.example_cn: 我们悄悄溜进房间关上门。

senses.gloss_en: be in the right place or situation
senses.example_en: These plates belong in the kitchen, not here.
senses.example_cn: 这些盘子该放在厨房，不是放这儿。

senses.gloss_en: feel comfortable and happy with a group
senses.example_en: I finally belong here with these people.
senses.example_cn: 和这些人在一起，我终于有了归属感。

senses.gloss_en: recently made or picked, not frozen or dried
senses.example_en: We bought fresh bread and fruit this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我们买了新鲜的面包和水果。

senses.gloss_en: smelling clean, pleasantly cool
senses.example_en: Open the window for fresh air in here.
senses.example_cn: 把窗户打开，让屋里透点新鲜空气。

senses.gloss_en: new or different from before
senses.example_en: We need fresh ideas for the next class.
senses.example_cn: 下节课我们需要一些新的点子。

senses.gloss_en: from a short time ago
senses.example_en: I read a recent report about travel costs.
senses.example_cn: 我读了一份最近关于旅行费用的报告。

senses.gloss_en: aged 13 to 19, about this age
senses.example_en: My teenage brother plays soccer after school.
senses.example_cn: 我十几岁的弟弟放学后去踢足球。

senses.gloss_en: from long ago in history, thousands of years old
senses.example_en: We visited ancient ruins near the river today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我们参观了河边的古代遗址。

senses.gloss_en: very old, existing for a very long time
senses.example_en: This phone is ancient, and it barely works.
senses.example_cn: 这手机太老了，几乎不能用了。

senses.headword_tail: adj., adv., prep. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: Shaped like a circle or ball
senses.example_en: The plate is round, not square.
senses.example_cn: 这个盘子是圆的，不是方的。

senses.headword_tail: adj., adv., prep. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: Around something, surrounding it
senses.example_en: Trees grow round the lake in summer.
senses.example_cn: 夏天湖的四周长着树。

senses.headword_tail: adj., adv., prep. A2, n. B2
senses.gloss_en: A stage in a competition or process
senses.example_en: They lost in the first round of voting.
senses.example_cn: 他们在第一轮投票中落选了。

senses.gloss_en: Level and smooth, not curved or sloping
senses.example_en: The ground is flat so the ball rolls.
senses.example_cn: 地面很平，所以球能滚起来。

senses.gloss_en: Wide and thin, with little thickness
senses.example_en: Coins are round and flat, easy to carry.
senses.example_cn: 硬币又圆又扁，好带在身上。

senses.gloss_en: Not containing enough air, usually because of a hole
senses.example_en: We got a flat tire after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 旅行回来后我们的轮胎瘪了。

senses.gloss_en: Having curls, with a curved shape
senses.example_en: She has curly hair today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天是一头卷发。

senses.gloss_en: giving a lot of light
senses.example_en: The bright sun warmed the street at noon.
senses.example_cn: 正午明亮的阳光晒暖了街道。

senses.gloss_en: having a strong color, easy to notice
senses.example_en: She wore a bright red hat in town.
senses.example_cn: 她进城时戴着一顶鲜红的帽子。

senses.gloss_en: quick to learn and understand
senses.example_en: He is bright and learns new words fast.
senses.example_cn: 他很聪明，学新单词很快。

senses.gloss_en: the organ in your head that controls thought and movement
senses.example_en: His brain controls his thoughts and his movements.
senses.example_cn: 他的大脑控制着他的思维和动作。

senses.gloss_en: your mind, the ability to think
senses.example_en: Use your brain and think before you speak.
senses.example_cn: 动动脑子，说话之前先想想。

senses.gloss_en: a very intelligent person
senses.example_en: She is a real brain.
senses.example_cn: 她真是个绝顶聪明的人。

senses.gloss_en: the part of your body between head and shoulders
senses.example_en: She wore a scarf around her neck today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天脖子上围了条围巾。

senses.gloss_en: the part of clothing that fits around the neck
senses.example_en: The neck of the shirt is too tight.
senses.example_cn: 这件衬衫的领口太紧了。

senses.gloss_en: a long narrow part, at one end of something
senses.example_en: He held the bottle by the neck.
senses.example_cn: 他捏着瓶颈把瓶子拿了起来。

senses.gloss_en: the part of your body where your arm joins it
senses.example_en: I carried the bag on my shoulder.
senses.example_cn: 我把包挎在肩膀上。

senses.gloss_en: the part of clothing that covers the shoulder
senses.example_en: The shoulder of the coat has a stain.
senses.example_cn: 这件外套的肩上有一块污渍。

senses.gloss_en: the area beside a road, where cars can stop
senses.example_en: We stopped on the shoulder to check the tire.
senses.gloss_cn: 路肩（路边可停车的地带）
senses.example_cn: 我们停在路肩上检查轮胎。

senses.gloss_en: the natural outer layer that covers your body
senses.example_en: His skin is dry after the long swim.
senses.example_cn: 游了那么久，他的皮肤很干。

senses.gloss_en: the thin outer layer of a fruit or vegetable
senses.example_en: I took the skin off the apple.
senses.example_cn: 我把苹果皮削掉了。

senses.gloss_en: the skin removed from an animal, used as leather
senses.example_en: They cleaned the skin and made a bag.
senses.example_cn: 他们把兽皮处理干净，做成了一个包。

senses.gloss_en: one of the hard parts that form the skeleton
senses.example_en: He broke a bone in his arm.
senses.example_cn: 他胳膊上有一根骨头断了。

senses.gloss_en: a hard part in meat or fish
senses.example_en: Be careful, there is a bone in it.
senses.example_cn: 小心一点，里面有骨头。

senses.gloss_en: the hard material that bones are made of
senses.example_en: The handle is made of bone, not wood.
senses.example_cn: 这个把手是骨制的，不是木制的。

senses.gloss_en: the red liquid that flows in people and animals
senses.example_en: Blood came from his cut and stained his shirt.
senses.example_cn: 他伤口流出的血染在了衬衫上。

senses.gloss_en: family origin, the people you are related to
senses.example_en: She is proud of her blood and her name.
senses.example_cn: 她为自己的血统和姓氏感到自豪。

senses.gloss_en: The organ that pumps blood in your chest
senses.example_en: Her heart beats fast after the run.
senses.example_cn: 跑完之后她的心脏跳得很快。

senses.gloss_en: A person's feelings or kind character
senses.example_en: I spoke from the heart, not to impress you.
senses.example_cn: 我说的是真心话，不是为了讨你欢心。

senses.gloss_en: The most important part of something
senses.example_en: They met in the heart of the city.
senses.example_cn: 他们在市中心见了面。

senses.gloss_en: The organ inside your body where food goes
senses.example_en: My stomach hurts after I eat too fast.
senses.example_cn: 我吃得太快，胃就疼。

senses.gloss_en: The front part of your body below the chest
senses.example_en: He was hit in the stomach during the game.
senses.example_cn: 比赛中他肚子上被打了一下。

senses.gloss_en: The joint where your leg bends
senses.example_en: She hurt her knee when she fell down.
senses.example_cn: 她摔倒的时候把膝盖弄伤了。

senses.gloss_en: The top part of your legs when sitting
senses.example_en: The child sat on my knee and laughed.
senses.example_cn: 孩子坐在我的膝上笑着。

senses.gloss_en: The part of pants that covers the knee
senses.example_en: There is a hole at the knee of my pants.
senses.example_cn: 我裤子膝盖处破了一个洞。

senses.gloss_en: The joint between your foot and your leg
senses.example_en: I twisted my ankle and I could not walk.
senses.example_cn: 我把脚踝扭了，走不了路。

senses.gloss_en: One of the long parts at the end of your hand
senses.example_en: I cut my finger on the knife last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚上我被刀割到了手指。

senses.gloss_en: The part of a glove that covers a finger
senses.example_en: This glove finger is torn, so my hand is cold.
senses.example_cn: 这手套的指头破了，我的手好冷。

senses.gloss_en: A long narrow piece of something
senses.example_en: A finger of land reaches into the sea.
senses.example_cn: 一条狭长的陆地伸进海里。

senses.gloss_en: Cause pain or injury to someone or yourself
senses.example_en: Be careful, you could hurt your back.
senses.example_cn: 小心点，你可能会伤到背。

senses.gloss_en: Feel pain in a part of your body
senses.example_en: My finger hurts when I hold this bowl.
senses.example_cn: 我端这个碗的时候手指会疼。

senses.gloss_en: Cause emotional pain to someone
senses.example_en: I did not mean to hurt your feelings.
senses.example_cn: 我不是有意要伤你的心。

senses.gloss_en: unpleasant feeling in your body from injury or illness
senses.example_en: I felt pain in my knee after soccer.
senses.example_cn: 踢完足球我膝盖疼。

senses.gloss_en: strong sadness from something bad that happened
senses.example_en: She felt pain after her dog died.
senses.example_cn: 狗死了以后她心里很痛苦。

senses.gloss_en: annoying person, thing, or task
senses.example_en: Filling out forms is a pain for me.
senses.example_cn: 填表格对我来说太烦人了。

senses.gloss_en: pain you feel inside your head
senses.example_en: I have a headache after a long day.
senses.example_cn: 忙了一整天，我头痛。

senses.gloss_en: problem that causes worry or trouble
senses.example_en: Parking downtown is a headache every weekend.
senses.example_cn: 周末市中心停车是个难题。

senses.gloss_en: medical condition, high body temperature from sickness
senses.example_en: He has a fever and feels cold all day.
senses.example_cn: 他发烧了，一整天都觉得冷。

senses.gloss_en: illness causing a high temperature and weakness
senses.example_en: The child had a fever for two days.
senses.example_cn: 那个孩子发热病烧了两天。

senses.gloss_en: time of strong excitement about something
senses.example_en: Election fever spread through the city last week.
senses.example_cn: 上周选举热潮席卷了全城。

senses.gloss_en: infectious illness like a very bad cold
senses.example_en: I got the flu and missed work today.
senses.example_cn: 我得了流感，今天没去上班。

senses.gloss_en: disease of the body or mind
senses.example_en: She has an illness that makes her very tired.
senses.example_cn: 她得了一种病，让她非常疲倦。

senses.gloss_en: state of being ill
senses.example_en: He stayed home because of illness.
senses.example_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: illness affecting people, animals, or plants
senses.example_en: This disease spreads fast in crowded rooms.
senses.example_cn: 这种病在拥挤的房间里传播很快。

senses.gloss_en: serious illness, often in one body part
senses.example_en: Heart disease runs in my family.
senses.example_cn: 我们家有心脏病史。

senses.gloss_en: harm to someone's body, often in an accident
senses.example_en: He got an injury to his knee today.
senses.example_cn: 他今天膝盖受了伤。

senses.gloss_en: damage to your reputation, career, or feelings
senses.example_en: The lie caused injury to her reputation at work.
senses.example_cn: 那个谎言损害了她在单位的名声。

senses.gloss_en: the state someone or something is in, its quality
senses.example_en: This bike is in good condition for its age.
senses.example_cn: 这辆自行车按车龄来说成色不错。

senses.gloss_en: an illness, a health problem
senses.example_en: He has a heart condition and needs medicine.
senses.example_cn: 他有心脏病，得吃药。

senses.gloss_en: a rule that must be accepted before something happens
senses.example_en: One condition is that you pay before you leave.
senses.example_cn: 有一个条件，你走之前要先付钱。

senses.gloss_en: a tiny living thing that causes infectious disease
senses.example_en: A virus can spread quickly in a crowded room.
senses.example_cn: 病毒在拥挤的房间里传播得很快。

senses.gloss_en: an illness caused by a virus
senses.example_en: I have a virus and I feel sick.
senses.example_cn: 我得了病毒引起的病，很不舒服。

senses.gloss_en: a computer program that harms or destroys data
senses.example_en: The virus deleted my files after I opened mail.
senses.example_cn: 我打开邮件以后，病毒把我的文件删掉了。

senses.gloss_en: a person receiving medical care, especially in a hospital
senses.example_en: The patient waited to see the dentist today.
senses.example_cn: 那位病人今天在等着看牙医。

senses.gloss_en: able to wait, without becoming angry or upset
senses.example_en: Be patient with him because he is learning fast.
senses.example_cn: 对他要耐心一点，他学得很快。

senses.gloss_en: a person who treats people's teeth
senses.example_en: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow morning.
senses.example_cn: 我明天上午和牙医有预约。

senses.gloss_en: a drug or liquid used to treat an illness
senses.example_en: Take this medicine with water after dinner tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚饭后用水把这个药服下。

senses.gloss_en: the study and treatment of disease and injury
senses.example_en: He works in medicine and helps sick people.
senses.example_cn: 他从事医学工作，帮助病人。

senses.gloss_en: Help and protection for someone's health or safety
senses.example_en: He needed care after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故之后他需要人照护。

senses.gloss_en: Feel worried, interested, or loving toward someone or something
senses.example_en: I care about my brother and my mom.
senses.example_cn: 我很在乎我弟弟和我妈妈。

senses.gloss_en: Attention to do something well, avoid mistakes or damage
senses.example_en: Handle the glass with care please.
senses.example_cn: 请小心搬这块玻璃。

senses.gloss_en: A period of sleep or relaxation
senses.example_en: We took a short rest after the hike.
senses.example_cn: 徒步之后我们短暂休息了一下。

senses.gloss_en: Relax or sleep because you are tired or sick
senses.example_en: Rest here for ten minutes then stand up.
senses.example_cn: 在这儿歇十分钟再站起来。

senses.gloss_en: An act of moving your body or part of it
senses.example_en: One quick movement and the bird flew away.
senses.example_cn: 一个快动作，鸟就飞走了。

senses.gloss_en: A change of position or place
senses.example_en: His sudden movement made the chair fall.
senses.example_cn: 他突然一动，椅子就倒了。

senses.gloss_en: A change or development in ideas or behavior
senses.example_en: There is a movement toward smaller families today.
senses.gloss_cn: 趋势（观念或行为的变化）
senses.example_cn: 现在有一种趋势，家庭规模越来越小。

senses.gloss_en: A small paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking
senses.example_en: He put out his cigarette and went inside.
senses.example_cn: 他把香烟掐灭，然后走进了屋里。

senses.gloss_en: Gray gas from something burning
senses.example_en: Smoke rose from the fire and filled the room.
senses.example_cn: 烟从火里升起来，弥漫了整个房间。

senses.gloss_en: Breathe in and blow out gases from a cigarette
senses.example_en: Do not smoke near the baby in here.
senses.example_cn: 不要在这儿靠近宝宝的地方吸烟。

senses.gloss_en: Give off gas from burning
senses.example_en: The engine began to smoke after the crash.
senses.example_cn: 撞车之后，发动机开始冒烟。

senses.gloss_en: The activity or habit of using cigarettes
senses.example_en: Smoking is not allowed in this building.
senses.example_cn: 这栋楼里不允许吸烟。

senses.gloss_en: have a particular smell
senses.example_en: The room smells clean after the rain.
senses.example_cn: 雨后房间闻起来很清爽。

senses.gloss_en: notice a smell with your nose
senses.example_en: I can smell smoke in the kitchen now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在能闻到厨房里有烟味。

senses.gloss_en: quality you notice with your nose
senses.example_en: That smell of garlic stayed in my bag.
senses.example_cn: 大蒜的气味一直留在我包里。

senses.gloss_en: sounds made when a person speaks or sings
senses.example_en: Her voice was soft, but everyone heard.
senses.example_cn: 她声音很轻，但大家都听见了。

senses.gloss_en: ability to speak
senses.example_en: He lost his voice after the long concert.
senses.example_cn: 那场长时间的演唱会之后，他嗓子哑了。

senses.gloss_en: the way someone or something looks
senses.example_en: His appearance changed after he cut his hair.
senses.example_cn: 他剪了头发以后，外貌变了。

senses.gloss_en: an occasion when someone is seen in public
senses.example_en: Her first appearance on TV was last night.
senses.example_cn: 她第一次上电视露面是昨天晚上。

senses.gloss_en: the fact of becoming visible or available
senses.example_en: The sudden appearance of fog slowed our drive.
senses.example_cn: 突然出现的大雾让我们开车慢了下来。

senses.gloss_en: the time when a baby is born
senses.example_en: The birth was quick and the baby cried.
senses.example_cn: 孩子出生得很快，一生下来就哭了。

senses.gloss_en: the process of being born, or of a mother giving birth
senses.example_en: The birth took eight hours.
senses.example_cn: 这次分娩持续了八个小时。

senses.gloss_en: the place or parents you were born to
senses.example_en: He is Italian by birth, but lives in Canada.
senses.example_cn: 他是意大利出身，不过住在加拿大。

senses.gloss_en: the end of life
senses.example_en: Death is part of life for every animal.
senses.example_cn: 对每种动物来说，死亡都是生命的一部分。

senses.gloss_en: the fact of someone dying or being killed
senses.example_en: The accident caused one death on the highway.
senses.example_cn: 那场事故在高速公路上造成一人死亡。

senses.gloss_en: the end of something important or useful
senses.example_en: The new road was the death of that park.
senses.example_cn: 那条新路让那个公园就此消失了。

senses.gloss_en: substance used as a medicine
senses.example_en: This drug helps with pain after surgery.
senses.example_cn: 这种药对术后的疼痛有帮助。

senses.gloss_en: illegal substance taken for pleasure
senses.example_en: Police found drugs in his bag yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 昨天警察在他包里发现了毒品。

senses.gloss_en: the planet we live on
senses.example_en: Life on the earth depends on water and air.
senses.example_cn: 地球上的生命离不开水和空气。

senses.gloss_en: the ground, not the sea or sky
senses.example_en: I sat on the earth and felt the cold.
senses.example_cn: 我坐在地上，觉得一阵凉。

senses.gloss_en: soil, in which plants grow
senses.example_en: We planted seeds in earth near the house.
senses.example_cn: 我们在房子旁边的土里种下了种子。

senses.gloss_en: a large round body moving around a star
senses.example_en: Mars is a planet that circles the sun.
senses.example_cn: 火星是一颗围绕太阳运转的行星。

senses.gloss_en: the world we live on, Earth
senses.example_en: We must protect the planet for future children.
senses.example_cn: 我们必须为后代保护这颗星球。

senses.gloss_en: all plants, animals, and things not made by people
senses.example_en: We walked in nature and heard birds singing.
senses.example_cn: 我们在大自然里散步，听见鸟儿在叫。

senses.gloss_en: a person's character or way of behaving
senses.example_en: Her kind nature helped the new student.
senses.example_cn: 她性格善良，帮了那个新同学。

senses.gloss_en: the natural world of air, water, and land
senses.example_en: We should protect the environment from smoke and trash.
senses.example_cn: 我们应该保护环境，不排烟、不乱扔垃圾。

senses.gloss_en: the conditions around you, where you live or work
senses.example_en: A quiet environment helps me study at night.
senses.example_cn: 安静的环境有助于我晚上学习。

senses.gloss_en: the usual weather conditions of a place
senses.example_en: This climate is hot and dry all year.
senses.example_cn: 这里的气候全年又热又干。

senses.gloss_en: the general situation and feelings at a time
senses.example_en: The political climate changed after the election.
senses.example_cn: 选举之后政治氛围发生了变化。

senses.gloss_en: the area above the earth, where you see clouds
senses.example_en: The sky turned dark before the storm arrived.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨来之前天空变暗了。
