senses.example_en: The band has worldwide fans now.
senses.example_cn: 这支乐队现在全世界都有粉丝。

senses.gloss_en: in all parts of the world
senses.example_en: This video is watched worldwide every day.
senses.example_cn: 这个视频每天在世界各地都有人看。

senses.gloss_en: separated by distance, not close together
senses.example_en: The two houses are far apart on this road.
senses.example_cn: 这条路上那两栋房子相隔很远。

senses.gloss_en: in different places, not together
senses.example_en: My parents live apart but still talk daily.
senses.example_cn: 我父母分开住，但每天还会通话。

senses.gloss_en: into pieces, breaking or coming loose
senses.example_en: The old book fell apart in my bag.
senses.example_cn: 那本旧书在我的包里散架了。

senses.gloss_en: toward the back, behind you
senses.example_en: Take one step backward, then open the door.
senses.example_cn: 往后退一步，然后开门。

senses.gloss_en: in reverse order, not the usual order
senses.example_en: He counted backward from ten to one.
senses.example_cn: 他从十倒数到一。

senses.gloss_en: with back at the front, by mistake
senses.example_en: I wore my shirt backward, so I changed.
senses.example_cn: 我把衬衫穿反了，就换了一件。

senses.gloss_en: In or near the middle of a place
senses.example_en: We stayed in a central hotel near the station.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在车站附近一家市中心的酒店。

senses.gloss_en: In the middle of a town or city, so it is easy to get to places
senses.example_en: We stayed in a central hotel near the station.
senses.example_cn: 我们住在一家靠近车站的市中心酒店。

senses.gloss_en: Controlled or organized from one main place
senses.example_en: A central office runs all services in the city.
senses.example_cn: 一个中央机构管理全市的各项服务。

senses.gloss_en: In or from the north part of an area
senses.example_en: They live in northern Canada near a lake.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在加拿大北部的一个湖边。

senses.gloss_en: In or from the south part of an area
senses.example_en: We drove to southern Italy for two weeks.
senses.example_cn: 我们开车去意大利南部玩了两周。

senses.gloss_en: In or from the east part of an area
senses.example_en: The river is on the eastern edge of town.
senses.example_cn: 那条河在小镇的东边。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with the people or countries of the East, especially Asia
senses.example_en: She likes Eastern art and Eastern religion a lot.
senses.gloss_cn: 东方的（指亚洲等东方国家）
senses.example_cn: 她非常喜欢东方艺术和东方宗教。

senses.gloss_en: In or from the west part of an area
senses.example_en: We visited the western coast in summer.
senses.example_cn: 夏天我们去了西海岸。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with Western Europe and North America
senses.example_en: Western music and Western movies are popular here.
senses.example_cn: 西方的音乐和电影在这里很受欢迎。

senses.gloss_en: Affecting the whole world
senses.example_en: Climate change is a global problem for us.
senses.example_cn: 气候变化是我们面临的全球性问题。

senses.gloss_en: Considering all parts together as one whole
senses.example_en: We need a global view of the plan.
senses.example_cn: 我们需要从整体上看这个计划。

senses.gloss_en: far away from where most people live
senses.example_en: They live in a remote village near the mountains.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在山边一个偏远的村子里。

senses.gloss_en: far away in time, long ago
senses.example_en: In the remote past, people traveled on foot.
senses.example_cn: 在遥远的过去，人们靠步行旅行。

senses.gloss_en: done from far away using the internet or phone
senses.example_en: She has a remote job and works from home.
senses.example_cn: 她做远程工作在家办公。

senses.gloss_en: connected with a society's customs, ideas, and beliefs
senses.example_en: Cultural differences can cause problems at work.
senses.example_cn: 文化差异会在工作中造成麻烦。

senses.gloss_en: about love or a sexual relationship
senses.example_en: They planned a romantic dinner by the river.
senses.example_cn: 他们计划在河边吃一顿浪漫的晚餐。

senses.gloss_en: showing strong feelings of love
senses.example_en: He wrote a romantic note for his wife.
senses.example_cn: 他给妻子写了一张充满爱意的便条。

senses.gloss_en: beautiful, making you think of love
senses.example_en: The lights made the street look romantic at night.
senses.example_cn: 灯光让这条街在夜里显得很浪漫。

senses.gloss_en: belonging to a king, queen, or their family
senses.example_en: The royal family lives in the old palace.
senses.example_cn: 王室成员住在那座古老的宫殿里。

senses.gloss_en: used in names of groups supported by a king or queen
senses.example_en: He joined the Royal Navy after school.
senses.example_cn: 毕业以后他加入了皇家海军。

senses.gloss_en: very grand, like something for a king or queen
senses.example_en: We got a royal welcome at the small hotel.
senses.example_cn: 在那家小旅馆，我们受到了隆重的欢迎。

senses.gloss_en: following a style popular at a particular time
senses.example_en: Fashionable clothes change fast in big cities.
senses.example_cn: 大城市里时髦的衣服变得很快。

senses.gloss_en: expensive, connected with an expensive way of life
senses.example_en: They stayed in a fancy hotel downtown.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在市中心一家豪华酒店。

senses.gloss_en: unusually complicated, often unnecessary
senses.example_en: I want plain food, nothing fancy today.
senses.example_cn: 我想吃简单的，今天不要花哨的。

senses.gloss_en: decorated, with many small details
senses.example_en: She bought fancy cakes for the party.
senses.example_cn: 她为派对买了精致的蛋糕。

senses.gloss_en: Not modern, no longer fashionable
senses.example_en: Her dress looks old-fashioned, but she loves it.
senses.example_cn: 她的裙子看起来过时了，但她很喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: Preferring old ideas, not modern ones
senses.example_en: My dad is old-fashioned, and he likes quiet evenings.
senses.example_cn: 我爸比较守旧，喜欢安静地过晚上。

senses.gloss_en: Secret power to make impossible things happen
senses.example_en: The story says she uses magic every night.
senses.example_cn: 故事里说她每晚都会施魔法。

senses.gloss_en: Clever tricks that seem impossible, for entertainment
senses.example_en: The magician did magic for the children at school.
senses.example_cn: 魔术师在学校给孩子们表演了魔术。

senses.gloss_en: Having special powers
senses.example_en: He used a magic spell, and the box opened.
senses.example_cn: 他念了一句有魔力的咒语，盒子就打开了。

senses.gloss_en: Inside a building, not outside
senses.example_en: We play indoor games when the rain starts.
senses.example_cn: 一下起雨，我们就玩室内游戏。

senses.gloss_en: Happening or used outside, not in a building
senses.example_en: They have an outdoor pool near the park.
senses.example_cn: 他们在公园附近有一个户外泳池。

senses.gloss_en: In a particular place, found there
senses.example_en: Our office is located in the city center.
senses.example_cn: 我们的办公室位于市中心。

senses.gloss_en: Only for one person or group, not everyone
senses.example_en: This is private property, and we cannot enter.
senses.example_cn: 这是私人地产，我们不能进去。

senses.gloss_en: Kept secret, not shared with other people
senses.example_en: I keep private notes in my bag at home.
senses.example_cn: 我把私密的笔记放在家里的包里。

senses.gloss_en: Paid for or owned by a person or company, not government
senses.example_en: She goes to a private school near her house.
senses.example_cn: 她在家附近上一所私立学校。

senses.gloss_en: Approved by someone in authority
senses.example_en: This is the official plan for the new road.
senses.example_cn: 这是新修那条路的官方方案。

senses.gloss_en: Related to your work, not your private life
senses.example_en: I sent an official email from my work account.
senses.example_cn: 我用工作邮箱发了一封公函。

senses.gloss_en: A person with responsibility in an organization
senses.example_en: A government official spoke to the crowd today.
senses.example_cn: 一位政府官员今天向人群讲话。

senses.gloss_en: Related to school, college, or university study
senses.example_en: She got academic support at the university.
senses.example_cn: 她在大学里得到了学业上的帮助。

senses.gloss_en: Interested in studying, successful at school work
senses.example_en: He is academic but he hates sports.
senses.example_cn: 他很会读书，但讨厌运动。

senses.gloss_en: About ideas, not useful in real life
senses.example_en: The debate was academic and changed nothing.
senses.example_cn: 这场辩论毫无实际意义。

senses.gloss_en: Related to education or schools
senses.example_en: The city improved educational services for children.
senses.example_cn: 市里改善了面向儿童的教育服务。

senses.gloss_en: Teaching you something, giving you new knowledge
senses.example_en: Travel can be educational for a young person.
senses.example_cn: 对年轻人来说，旅行是很有教育意义的。

senses.gloss_en: Related to science, using science methods
senses.example_en: They used scientific tests to study the water.
senses.example_cn: 他们用科学的检测方法研究了这些水。

senses.gloss_en: Careful and systematic, using a clear method
senses.example_en: Please be scientific and write the steps in order.
senses.example_cn: 请严谨一点，把步骤按顺序写下来。

senses.gloss_en: Needing special skills or knowledge
senses.example_en: This is a technical job, so you need special training.
senses.example_cn: 这是技术性的工作，所以你需要专门的培训。

senses.gloss_en: About machines, science, or industrial methods
senses.example_en: He reads technical books about engines and tools.
senses.example_cn: 他看的是讲发动机和工具的技术书籍。

senses.gloss_en: Related to practical skill in an activity
senses.example_en: Her dancing is technical and very precise.
senses.example_cn: 她的舞蹈技巧性强，动作非常精准。

senses.gloss_en: Related to air, land, and water on Earth
senses.example_en: The plan reduces environmental damage near the river.
senses.example_cn: 这个方案减少了河边的环境破坏。

senses.gloss_en: connected with trade, industry, or money
senses.example_en: Economic growth can change jobs in a city.
senses.example_cn: 经济增长会改变一座城市的就业情况。

senses.gloss_en: making a profit, not losing money
senses.example_en: This plan is economic if sales stay strong.
senses.example_cn: 只要销量不错，这个计划就有利可图。

senses.gloss_en: using little money, time, or fuel
senses.example_en: A small car is economic on long trips.
senses.example_cn: 小车跑长途很省油。

senses.gloss_en: related to money, or managing money
senses.example_en: We need financial help to pay the bill.
senses.example_cn: 我们需要经济上的帮助来付这笔账。

senses.gloss_en: related to business, buying and selling goods
senses.example_en: The street has many commercial stores and cafes.
senses.example_cn: 这条街上有很多商业店铺和咖啡馆。

senses.gloss_en: intended to make money, done for profit
senses.example_en: The app became a commercial success very quickly.
senses.gloss_cn: 商业上的（以赚钱为目的）
senses.example_cn: 这个应用很快就在商业上取得了成功。

senses.gloss_en: a TV or radio advertisement
senses.example_en: We watched a commercial before the next video.
senses.example_cn: 看下一个视频之前，我们先看了一段广告。

senses.gloss_en: connected with the law
senses.example_en: She asked for legal advice after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故之后她去咨询了法律意见。

senses.gloss_en: allowed by the law
senses.example_en: Is it legal to park here at night?
senses.example_cn: 晚上在这儿停车合法吗？

senses.gloss_en: related to politics, government, or public affairs
senses.example_en: Political leaders met to discuss health care plans.
senses.example_cn: 政界领导人开会讨论医疗方案。

senses.gloss_en: trying to gain power in a group
senses.example_en: That was a political decision inside the company.
senses.example_cn: 那是公司内部争权的决定。

senses.gloss_en: interested in politics, active in politics
senses.example_en: He became political during college and voted often.
senses.example_cn: 他上大学时开始关心政治，经常去投票。

senses.gloss_en: having shared power between states and a central government
senses.example_en: The country has a federal system with strong states.
senses.example_cn: 这个国家实行联邦制，各州权力很大。

senses.gloss_en: related to the national government, not state government
senses.example_en: Federal laws apply to every state in the country.
senses.example_cn: 联邦法律适用于这个国家的每一个州。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with the mind, involving the process of thinking
senses.example_en: Mental math is hard after a long day.
senses.example_cn: 忙了一整天，心算就很吃力了。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with sex, the physical activity
senses.example_en: They learned about sexual health in school today.
senses.example_cn: 他们今天在学校学了性健康的知识。

senses.gloss_en: Not allowed by the law
senses.example_en: It is illegal to drive without a license.
senses.example_cn: 没有驾照开车是违法的。

senses.gloss_en: Involving speaking rather than writing
senses.example_en: Spoken English sounds different from written English.
senses.example_cn: 英语口语听起来和书面英语不一样。

senses.gloss_en: Expressed in writing rather than in speech
senses.example_en: Please give a written reply by Friday.
senses.example_cn: 请在周五之前给出书面答复。

senses.gloss_en: During the time that something happens
senses.example_en: I listened while you talked on the phone.
senses.example_cn: 你打电话的时候我一直在听着。

senses.gloss_en: Used to show a contrast between two facts
senses.example_en: I like tea while my brother likes coffee.
senses.example_cn: 我爱喝茶，而我弟弟爱喝咖啡。

senses.gloss_en: A period of time, not very long
senses.example_en: Wait a while, then we can go.
senses.example_cn: 等一会儿，我们就能走了。

senses.gloss_en: Despite the fact that
senses.example_en: I went out though I was very tired.
senses.example_cn: 尽管很累，我还是出去了。

senses.gloss_en: But, used to add a contrasting fact
senses.example_en: They're coming, though I don't know the day.
senses.example_cn: 他们要来，不过我不知道是哪天。

senses.gloss_en: Despite this, however
senses.example_en: I miss her a lot, though.
senses.example_cn: 不过，我真的很想她。

senses.gloss_en: Except if something is true
senses.example_en: We will go unless it rains tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 除非明天下雨，否则我们就去。

senses.gloss_en: Every time or at any time that
senses.example_en: Call me whenever you have time.
senses.example_cn: 你什么时候有空都可以打给我。

senses.gloss_en: No matter when something happens
senses.example_en: Come whenever, I will be ready.
senses.example_cn: 你随便什么时候来都行，我都会准备好。

senses.gloss_en: If something is true or not
senses.example_en: I don't know whether he is home.
senses.example_cn: 我不知道他在不在家。

senses.gloss_en: Used to introduce two possibilities
senses.example_en: I will go whether you like it or not.
senses.example_cn: 不管你愿不愿意，我都要去。

senses.gloss_en: used after neither to add a second negative idea
senses.example_en: She neither called nor texted me last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨天晚上她既没打电话，也没给我发消息。

senses.gloss_en: used to say not either after a negative statement
senses.example_en: She doesn't like cats, nor do I.
senses.gloss_cn: 也不（承接前面的否定句）
senses.example_cn: 她不喜欢猫，我也不喜欢。

senses.gloss_en: for that reason, as a result
senses.example_en: It was raining, therefore we stayed indoors.
senses.example_cn: 当时在下雨，因此我们就待在屋里。

senses.gloss_en: at the same time, while something else happens
senses.example_en: I cooked dinner. He, meanwhile, cleaned the room.
senses.example_cn: 我做饭，他同时把房间打扫了。

senses.gloss_en: in the time between two events
senses.example_en: The train was late. Meanwhile, we waited by the entrance.
senses.example_cn: 火车晚点了。在此期间，我们在入口处等着。

senses.gloss_en: in almost the same way
senses.example_en: The twins smiled similarly and waved at us.
senses.example_cn: 这对双胞胎笑得差不多，还向我们挥手。

senses.gloss_en: used to say another fact is the same
senses.example_en: Cars must stop. Similarly, bikes must stop too.
senses.example_cn: 汽车必须停下。同样，自行车也必须停。

senses.gloss_en: really, used to emphasize what you say
senses.example_en: It was indeed difficult, but we finished the test.
senses.example_cn: 确实很难，但我们还是做完了考试。

senses.gloss_en: used to show you agree, or it is true
senses.example_en: Is this your key? Indeed it is.
senses.example_cn: 这是你的钥匙吗？没错，就是我的。

senses.gloss_en: used after very to add emphasis
senses.example_en: Thank you very much indeed for your help.
senses.example_cn: 真的非常感谢你的帮助。

senses.gloss_en: used to give your own opinion
senses.example_en: Personally, I prefer the second option for us.
senses.example_cn: 就我个人来说，我更倾向于给我们选第二个方案。

senses.gloss_en: by yourself, not by someone else
senses.example_en: I will handle it personally, not my assistant.
senses.example_cn: 这件事我会亲自处理，不交给我的助理。

senses.gloss_en: in a way that affects you, not others
senses.example_en: I wasn’t hurt personally, but I felt it was unfair.
senses.example_cn: 我本人并没有受到伤害，但我觉得这不公平。

senses.gloss_en: Tell someone what you think they should do
senses.example_en: My doctor advised me to rest for two days.
senses.example_cn: 医生建议我休息两天。

senses.gloss_en: To officially tell someone about something
senses.example_en: Please advise us of any change of address.
senses.example_cn: 地址如有变动，请通知我们。

senses.gloss_en: Tell someone about possible danger or trouble
senses.example_en: They warned us about the strong wind at sea.
senses.example_cn: 他们提醒我们海上风很大。

senses.gloss_en: Tell someone to be careful or stop an action
senses.example_en: She warned me not to touch the hot pan.
senses.example_cn: 她告诫我别碰那个烫锅。

senses.gloss_en: Say something bad will happen in the future
senses.example_en: Experts warned that prices would rise again this year.
senses.example_cn: 专家警告说今年物价还会上涨。

senses.gloss_en: Tell people something officially and publicly
senses.example_en: They announced the new plan on the radio today.
senses.example_cn: 他们今天在广播里宣布了新计划。

senses.gloss_en: Say something publicly, often to a group
senses.example_en: A voice announced our train and the doors opened.
senses.example_cn: 广播报出我们那趟列车，车门就开了。

senses.gloss_en: Say you are sorry for doing something wrong
senses.example_en: I apologized to her for the late reply today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天为回复晚了向她道歉。

senses.gloss_en: Say or show that something is true
senses.example_en: Tests confirmed that the water was safe to drink.
senses.example_cn: 检验证实水是安全的。

senses.gloss_en: Make an arrangement certain, often by phone or writing
senses.example_en: Please confirm the meeting time by email today.
senses.example_cn: 请通过电子邮件确认会议时间。

senses.gloss_en: Make a decision or agreement officially final
senses.example_en: The court confirmed the decision.
senses.example_cn: 法院确认了这一决定。

senses.gloss_en: Help someone remember to do something
senses.example_en: Remind me to call my mom after work today.
senses.example_cn: 提醒我下班后给妈妈打电话。

senses.gloss_en: Tell someone again about something important
senses.example_en: Please remind him about the payment date tomorrow morning.
senses.example_cn: 请明天早上提醒他付款日期。

senses.gloss_en: Explain the meaning of a word or phrase
senses.example_en: Please define this word for my class.
senses.example_cn: 请给我们班解释一下这个词的意思。

senses.gloss_en: Say what something is, and set its limits
senses.example_en: The map defines the area of the park.
senses.example_cn: 这张地图划定了公园的范围。

senses.gloss_en: Show a line, shape, or edge clearly
senses.example_en: The bright light defined her face in the dark.
senses.example_cn: 明亮的灯光让她的脸在黑暗中轮廓分明。

senses.gloss_en: Teach someone at a school, college, or university
senses.example_en: She was educated in Canada and learned English.
senses.example_cn: 她在加拿大上学，学会了英语。

senses.gloss_en: Give people information so they understand something better
senses.example_en: The video educates people about safe food.
senses.example_cn: 这个视频向大家普及食品安全知识。

senses.gloss_en: Train someone to think, behave, or act well
senses.example_en: Parents educate children to share and be kind.
senses.example_cn: 父母教导孩子要分享、要善良。

senses.gloss_en: Give someone support, courage, or hope
senses.example_en: Her words encouraged me during the hard test.
senses.example_cn: 她的话在艰难的考试中给了我鼓励。

senses.gloss_en: Persuade someone to do something, by making it easier
senses.example_en: The teacher encouraged us to speak in class.
senses.example_cn: 老师鼓励我们在课堂上发言。

senses.gloss_en: Make something more likely to happen or develop
senses.example_en: Warm weather encourages flowers to grow fast.
senses.example_cn: 温暖的天气促使花朵快速生长。

senses.gloss_en: Make someone do something by giving good reasons
senses.example_en: I persuaded my brother to take the bus.
senses.example_cn: 我说服弟弟坐公交车去。

senses.gloss_en: Make someone believe something is true or right
senses.example_en: She persuaded me that the plan would work.
senses.example_cn: 她让我相信这个计划行得通。

senses.gloss_en: Make yourself believe something, even without strong proof
senses.example_en: He persuaded himself that he was ready.
senses.example_cn: 他让自己相信已经准备好了。

senses.gloss_en: Make someone believe that something is true
senses.example_en: The facts convinced me that she was right.
senses.example_cn: 这些事实让我相信她是对的。

senses.gloss_en: Persuade someone to do something after discussion
senses.example_en: I convinced him to come home early.
senses.example_cn: 我说服他早点回家。

senses.gloss_en: Show that something is true with facts or evidence
senses.example_en: Can you prove you paid the bill?
senses.example_cn: 你能证明你付了账单吗？

senses.gloss_en: Show your ability by actions, not only words
senses.example_en: She proved herself to be a leader in the crisis.
senses.example_cn: 她在危机中证明了自己是位领袖。

senses.gloss_en: Turn out to be true, good, or bad
senses.example_en: The trip proved to be longer than we planned.
senses.example_cn: 结果这趟旅行比我们原先计划的要长。

senses.gloss_en: change words into a different language
senses.example_en: Can you translate this letter into Spanish for me?
senses.example_cn: 你能帮我把这封信翻译成西班牙语吗？

senses.gloss_en: change into a different form, lead to a result
senses.example_en: Good ideas do not translate into action fast.
senses.example_cn: 好主意不会很快转化为行动。

senses.gloss_en: understand as something, give a meaning to it
senses.example_en: I translated his smile as a yes.
senses.example_cn: 我把他的笑理解成了同意。

senses.gloss_en: help sell something by advertising it
senses.example_en: They promoted the new show on the radio.
senses.example_cn: 他们在电台宣传新节目。

senses.gloss_en: help something happen or develop
senses.example_en: These lessons promote growth in your English.
senses.example_cn: 这些课程能促进你的英语进步。

senses.gloss_en: raise someone to a higher job or rank
senses.example_en: Her boss promoted her to manager last week.
senses.example_cn: 老板上周把她提拔为经理。

senses.gloss_en: give the main points of something
senses.example_en: Please summarize the article in five short sentences.
senses.example_cn: 请用五句短话概括这篇文章。

senses.gloss_en: show that something is true or exists
senses.example_en: Dark clouds indicate rain later today.
senses.example_cn: 乌云预示着晚些时候会有雨。

senses.gloss_en: point to something, show where it is
senses.example_en: He indicated the door with his hand.
senses.example_cn: 他用手指了指门。

senses.gloss_en: state something, in a slightly indirect way
senses.example_en: She indicated her wish to leave early.
senses.example_cn: 她表示想早点走。

senses.gloss_en: agree that something is true, often unwillingly
senses.example_en: I admit that this plan is too hard.
senses.example_cn: 我承认这个计划太难了。

senses.gloss_en: say you did something wrong or illegal
senses.example_en: He admitted stealing money from the bag.
senses.example_cn: 他承认偷了袋子里的钱。

senses.gloss_en: allow someone to enter a place
senses.example_en: This ticket admits one adult into the museum.
senses.example_cn: 这张票允许一名成人进入博物馆。

senses.gloss_en: show a connection between two things
senses.example_en: I cannot relate these facts to the report.
senses.example_cn: 我没法把这些事实和这份报告联系起来。

senses.gloss_en: tell a story, describe events
senses.example_en: He related a funny story about his trip.
senses.example_cn: 他讲了一个旅途中的趣事。

senses.gloss_en: speak to God, ask for help or thanks
senses.example_en: They pray for their family every night.
senses.example_cn: 他们每晚都为家人祈祷。

senses.gloss_en: hope very much that something will happen
senses.example_en: We pray that the rain stops before noon.
senses.example_cn: 我们祈盼雨在中午前停下。

senses.gloss_en: All the people who work for an organization
senses.example_en: The hotel staff were friendly to every guest.
senses.example_cn: 酒店的员工对每位客人都很友好。

senses.gloss_en: A long, strong stick used for support when walking
senses.example_en: He climbed the path with a wooden staff.
senses.example_cn: 他拿着一根木杖爬上了那条山路。

senses.gloss_en: Five lines and spaces where musical notes are written
senses.example_en: She wrote the notes on the staff carefully.
senses.example_cn: 她把音符仔细写在五线谱上。

senses.gloss_en: A scheduled period of work
senses.example_en: I work the night shift at the hospital.
senses.example_cn: 我在医院上夜班。

senses.gloss_en: A change in ideas, plans, or behavior
senses.example_en: There was a sudden shift in public mood.
senses.gloss_cn: 转变（指观念或态度的改变）
senses.example_cn: 公众情绪发生了突然的转变。

senses.gloss_en: Move something to a different place or position
senses.example_en: She shifted the chair closer to the table.
senses.example_cn: 她把椅子挪到了桌子旁边。

senses.gloss_en: A person paid to work in someone's home
senses.example_en: In the past, the servant cleaned the house.
senses.example_cn: 过去都是仆人打扫房子。

senses.gloss_en: A person who represents another person or company
senses.example_en: Our agent in Mexico arranged the hotel rooms.
senses.example_cn: 我们在墨西哥的代理人安排好了酒店房间。

senses.gloss_en: A person who finds work for an actor or writer
senses.example_en: Her agent booked three talks for next week.
senses.example_cn: 她的经纪人给她定了下周三场讲座。

senses.gloss_en: A person who secretly collects information for a government
senses.example_en: The agent sent messages in code at night.
senses.example_cn: 那名特工在夜里用密码发送消息。

senses.gloss_en: A person who pays for professional services or advice
senses.example_en: The lawyer met a new client after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 律师午饭后见了一位新客户。

senses.gloss_en: A customer who regularly uses a business service
senses.example_en: We call every client before the appointment.
senses.example_cn: 每次约见之前我们都会打电话联系客户。

senses.gloss_en: A computer that gets data from a server
senses.example_en: This email client connects to the server every hour.
senses.example_cn: 这个邮件客户端每小时连接一次服务器。

senses.gloss_en: A person who plans and arranges an event
senses.example_en: The organizer checked tickets at the door today.
senses.example_cn: 今天组织者在门口检票。

senses.gloss_en: A part of a tree that grows from the trunk
senses.example_en: A bird sat on a low branch.
senses.example_cn: 一只鸟停在低处的树枝上。

senses.gloss_en: A local office of a big company
senses.example_en: I went to the bank branch after work.
senses.example_cn: 下班后我去了银行的分行。

senses.gloss_en: A part of a larger organization or system
senses.example_en: Medicine is a branch of science.
senses.example_cn: 医学是一门科学分支。

senses.gloss_en: A type of product sold under one company name
senses.example_en: This brand of coffee tastes very strong today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这个牌子的咖啡味道很浓。

senses.gloss_en: To give a product a clear name and image
senses.example_en: They brand the store as modern and friendly.
senses.example_cn: 他们把这家店打造成现代又亲切的形象。

senses.gloss_en: To describe someone as bad, often unfairly
senses.example_en: The media branded him as a liar.
senses.example_cn: 媒体给他扣上了骗子的名声。

senses.gloss_en: A person or team trying to win against others
senses.example_en: Each competitor ran fast in the final race.
senses.example_cn: 决赛里每位参赛者都跑得很快。

senses.gloss_en: A company that tries to beat another in sales
senses.example_en: Our main competitor lowered prices this month.
senses.example_cn: 我们最大的竞争对手这个月降价了。

senses.gloss_en: A person who buys goods or uses services
senses.example_en: Consumers want lower prices and better service.
senses.example_cn: 消费者希望价格更低、服务更好。

senses.gloss_en: The work of promoting and selling a product
senses.example_en: Good marketing helps people buy the new phone.
senses.example_cn: 好的营销能让大家愿意买这款新手机。

senses.gloss_en: The people in a company who promote its products
senses.example_en: The marketing team planned a new campaign.
senses.example_cn: 营销团队策划了一场新的推广活动。

senses.gloss_en: A general direction in which something changes
senses.example_en: There is a trend toward smaller cars.
senses.example_cn: 现在有一种趋势是车越造越小。

senses.gloss_en: A new style or idea that becomes popular
senses.example_en: This dance trend is popular on social media.
senses.example_cn: 这种舞蹈潮流在社交媒体上很火。

senses.gloss_en: the process of growing, becoming bigger or older
senses.example_en: Her growth was slow during the first year.
senses.example_cn: 她第一年的生长比较慢。

senses.gloss_en: an increase in size, number, or amount
senses.example_en: We saw rapid growth in sales this summer.
senses.example_cn: 今年夏天我们看到销量快速增长。

senses.gloss_en: the gradual growth or change into something better
senses.example_en: Child development depends on good food and sleep.
senses.example_cn: 孩子的发育要靠好的饮食和睡眠。

senses.gloss_en: a new event that changes a situation
senses.example_en: The latest development surprised everyone in the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 最新的进展让会上所有人都很意外。

senses.gloss_en: an area with new houses, stores, or offices
senses.example_en: They live in a new development near the highway.
senses.example_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一个新小区里。

senses.gloss_en: the process of becoming better, a positive change
senses.example_en: There was real improvement in his English this month.
senses.example_cn: 这个月他的英语有了实实在在的进步。

senses.gloss_en: a change that makes something better
senses.example_en: We made an improvement to the kitchen last week.
senses.example_cn: 上周我们对厨房做了一处改进。

senses.gloss_en: something useful that helps you do something
senses.example_en: This website is a great resource for practice.
senses.example_cn: 这个网站是很好的练习资源。

senses.gloss_en: money, materials, or time that you can use
senses.example_en: Small schools often have few resources for science.
senses.example_cn: 小学校在科学方面往往资源不足。

senses.gloss_en: useful things from nature, like oil or wood
senses.example_en: The country sells natural resources, mainly oil and gas.
senses.example_cn: 这个国家出口自然资源，主要是石油和天然气。

senses.gloss_en: the system of trade, jobs, and money in a country
senses.example_en: Tourism helps the economy in many small towns.
senses.example_cn: 旅游业带动了许多小镇的经济。

senses.gloss_en: careful use of money, time, or materials
senses.example_en: For economy, we turned off the lights early.
senses.example_cn: 为了省钱，我们早早就把灯关了。

senses.gloss_en: paid work, or the state of having a job
senses.example_en: She found employment after college and moved away.
senses.example_cn: 她大学毕业后找到了工作，然后就搬走了。

senses.gloss_en: the state of not having a paid job
senses.example_en: He worried about unemployment after he lost his job.
senses.example_cn: 丢了工作后，他很担心失业。

senses.gloss_en: the number of people without paid jobs
senses.example_en: Unemployment rose, the number without jobs increased.
senses.example_cn: 失业人数上升了，没工作的人更多了。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of running and controlling an organization
senses.example_en: Better management improved the hotel service and fixed problems.
senses.example_cn: 管理改善之后，酒店服务变好了，问题也解决了。

senses.gloss_en: the people who run and control an organization
senses.example_en: The management met today, they agreed on new rules.
senses.example_cn: 管理层今天开了会，商定了新规定。

senses.gloss_en: the act or process of making plans for something
senses.example_en: Careful planning helped us travel cheaply and safely.
senses.example_cn: 细心的规划让我们既省钱又安全地完成了旅行。

senses.gloss_en: a job requiring advanced education or training
senses.example_en: Teaching is her profession, she loves her students.
senses.example_cn: 教书是她的职业，她很爱她的学生。

senses.gloss_en: all the people in a particular kind of job
senses.example_en: The medical profession asked for better safety rules.
senses.example_cn: 医疗界要求制定更好的安全规定。

senses.gloss_en: a public statement of what you believe or feel
senses.example_en: His profession of love surprised everyone at dinner.
senses.example_cn: 他在饭桌上表白爱意，让所有人都吃了一惊。

senses.gloss_en: an exam or course that proves your ability
senses.example_en: She earned a qualification after a two-year course.
senses.example_cn: 读完两年的课程后，她拿到了资格证。

senses.gloss_en: a skill or experience needed for a job
senses.example_en: Spanish is a qualification for this travel job.
senses.example_cn: 会西班牙语是这份旅游工作的一个条件。

senses.gloss_en: information that you add to a statement to limit its effect or how it is applied
senses.example_en: I agree but with the qualification that the cost is high.
senses.example_cn: 我同意，但要补充一点：成本很高。

senses.gloss_en: something you must do because it is right or required
senses.example_en: It is my duty to help my parents.
senses.example_cn: 帮助父母是我应尽的义务。

senses.gloss_en: the work you must do as part of your job
senses.example_en: Her duty today is cleaning, then closing the store.
senses.example_cn: 她今天的职责是打扫，然后关店。

senses.gloss_en: a tax you pay on goods, especially imports
senses.example_en: They paid duty on wine at the airport.
senses.example_cn: 他们在机场为葡萄酒交了关税。

senses.gloss_en: a duty to take care of something
senses.example_en: It is my responsibility to clean the kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 打扫厨房是我的责任。

senses.gloss_en: the fact of being to blame for something
senses.example_en: He took responsibility for the broken window.
senses.example_cn: 窗户碎了，他承担了责任。

senses.gloss_en: the job of making decisions for others
senses.example_en: She has responsibility for thirty students in class.
senses.example_cn: 她负责班上的三十个学生。

senses.gloss_en: the chance that something bad might happen
senses.example_en: There is a risk of rain this evening.
senses.example_cn: 今天傍晚有下雨的风险。

senses.gloss_en: to do something though you may lose something
senses.example_en: She risked her life to save the child.
senses.example_cn: 她冒着生命危险救了那个孩子。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing likely to cause harm
senses.example_en: That broken step is a serious risk.
senses.example_cn: 那级坏了的台阶是个严重的隐患。

senses.gloss_en: an important topic people talk or argue about
senses.example_en: Money is a major issue for many families.
senses.example_cn: 对很多家庭来说，钱是个大议题。

senses.gloss_en: a problem that needs attention or a solution
senses.example_en: We had an issue with the internet again.
senses.example_cn: 我们的网络又出问题了。

senses.gloss_en: to officially give or announce something
senses.example_en: The company issued a statement about the accident.
senses.example_cn: 公司就这起事故发布了一份声明。

senses.gloss_en: a plan or promise people decide together
senses.example_en: We reached an agreement to meet on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 我们约定好周一见面。

senses.gloss_en: a written contract that people sign
senses.example_en: Read the agreement before you sign it.
senses.example_cn: 签之前先把协议看一遍。

senses.gloss_en: the state of having the same opinion
senses.example_en: They were in agreement about the new rules.
senses.example_cn: 他们对新规定的意见一致。

senses.gloss_en: to try to achieve something
senses.example_en: We aim to finish the work by Friday.
senses.example_cn: 我们打算在周五之前完成这项工作。

senses.gloss_en: the purpose of doing something
senses.example_en: The aim is to learn English faster.
senses.example_cn: 目标是更快地学会英语。

senses.gloss_en: to point something at a target
senses.example_en: He aimed the camera at the mountain.
senses.example_cn: 他把相机对准了那座山。

senses.gloss_en: to say something is true without proof
senses.example_en: He claimed he saw the thief last night.
senses.example_cn: 他声称昨晚看见了那个小偷。

senses.gloss_en: a statement that something is true without proof
senses.example_en: Her claim was false and everyone knew it.
senses.example_cn: 她的说法是假的，大家都知道。

senses.gloss_en: to ask for money you have a right to
senses.example_en: You can claim a refund at the desk.
senses.example_cn: 你可以到柜台申请退款。

senses.gloss_en: Collection of papers about a person, or topic
senses.example_en: His file has letters, photos, and notes.
senses.example_cn: 他的档案里有信件、照片和笔记。

senses.gloss_en: Document saved on a computer with a name
senses.example_en: Save the file before you close the computer.
senses.example_cn: 关电脑之前先把文件保存好。

senses.gloss_en: Put papers in order, in a file
senses.example_en: She filed the papers after the meeting.
senses.gloss_cn: 归档（指将文件整理存放）
senses.example_cn: 会后她把文件归档了。

senses.gloss_en: Pay to use something for a short time
senses.example_en: We hired a car for the weekend.
senses.example_cn: 我们周末租了一辆车。

senses.gloss_en: Give someone a job
senses.example_en: The company hired her last month.
senses.example_cn: 公司上个月雇用了她。

senses.gloss_en: Payment to use something for a short time
senses.example_en: Car hire is cheaper in the countryside.
senses.example_cn: 乡下的租车费用更便宜。

senses.gloss_en: Act of giving something, and receiving something else
senses.example_en: The exchange of ideas helped us understand more.
senses.example_cn: 想法的交流让我们理解得更多。

senses.gloss_en: Give something, and get something else back
senses.example_en: They exchanged gifts at the end of class.
senses.example_cn: 下课的时候他们互相交换了礼物。

senses.gloss_en: Change money for money in another currency
senses.example_en: I exchanged dollars for pesos at the bank.
senses.example_cn: 我在银行把美元换成了比索。

senses.gloss_en: Product brought into a country from abroad
senses.example_en: These cars are imports from Japan.
senses.example_cn: 这些车是从日本进口的。

senses.gloss_en: Bring goods into a country from abroad
senses.example_en: They import food from nearby countries.
senses.example_cn: 他们从周边国家进口食品。

senses.gloss_en: Bring in ideas, or customs from another place
senses.example_en: The city imported new ideas from abroad.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市从国外引进了新观念。

senses.gloss_en: Selling and sending goods to another country
senses.example_en: Export of fruit helps the local economy.
senses.example_cn: 水果出口有助于当地经济。

senses.gloss_en: Sell and send goods to another country
senses.example_en: They export coffee to the United States.
senses.example_cn: 他们把咖啡出口到美国。

senses.gloss_en: Goods sold to another country, exports
senses.example_en: Oil exports are important for this country.
senses.example_cn: 石油出口对这个国家很重要。

senses.gloss_en: Buying and selling goods, or services
senses.example_en: Trade between countries can grow quickly.
senses.example_cn: 国与国之间的贸易可以增长得很快。

senses.gloss_en: Buy and sell goods, especially between countries
senses.example_en: They trade with neighbors across the border.
senses.example_cn: 他们和边境另一边的邻国做贸易。

senses.gloss_en: Skilled job, working with your hands
senses.example_en: She learned a trade, a useful skill.
senses.example_cn: 她学了一门手艺，是很有用的技能。

senses.gloss_en: An amount of something available to use
senses.example_en: Our water supply is low after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，我们的供水不足了。

senses.gloss_en: Things needed for a particular purpose
senses.example_en: They packed medical supplies for the trip.
senses.example_cn: 他们为这趟行程装好了医疗物资。

senses.gloss_en: Provide something needed, often in large amounts
senses.example_en: They supply clean water to the school daily.
senses.example_cn: 他们每天给学校供应干净的水。

senses.gloss_en: Something difficult you succeed in doing well
senses.example_en: Finishing the marathon was a proud achievement for her.
senses.example_cn: 跑完全马对她来说是一项值得骄傲的成就。

senses.gloss_en: The act of achieving something
senses.example_en: Hard work leads to achievement in school and life.
senses.example_cn: 努力学习会在学校和生活中取得成功。

senses.gloss_en: The work of designing and building machines, roads, or bridges
senses.example_en: She studied engineering and built a small bridge.
senses.example_cn: 她学的是工程，还建了一座小桥。

senses.gloss_en: The work of planning, organizing, and running an organization
senses.example_en: She works in hospital administration and answers calls.
senses.example_cn: 她在医院做行政工作，负责接电话。

senses.gloss_en: The people who run a company, school, or government
senses.example_en: The administration changed the rules after the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 开完会以后，管理层就把规定改了。

senses.gloss_en: The act of giving a drug, test, or medicine
senses.example_en: The nurse checked the administration of the medicine.
senses.example_cn: 护士核对了这次给药的情况。

senses.gloss_en: A device that produces electricity for a machine
senses.example_en: My camera battery died during the trip.
senses.example_cn: 我的相机电池在旅途中没电了。

senses.gloss_en: The electricity stored in a battery
senses.example_en: My phone battery is low, so I will charge it.
senses.example_cn: 我手机电量低了，我要去充电。

senses.gloss_en: A large set of similar things used together
senses.example_en: The doctor ordered a battery of tests today.
senses.gloss_cn: 一系列（指同类事物的大套）
senses.example_cn: 医生安排了一系列检查。

senses.gloss_en: Wires in a plastic cover for power or data
senses.example_en: Plug the cable into the computer and turn it on.
senses.example_cn: 把线插到电脑上，然后开机。

senses.gloss_en: Television programs sent through cables to homes
senses.example_en: We watched the game on cable last night.
senses.example_cn: 我们昨晚在有线电视上看了比赛。

senses.gloss_en: A thick strong rope made of metal wires
senses.example_en: The bridge cable snapped and cars stopped.
senses.example_cn: 大桥的钢索断了，车都停了下来。

senses.gloss_en: A link between two people, events, or ideas
senses.example_en: There is a connection between sleep and mood.
senses.example_cn: 睡眠和情绪之间是有联系的。

senses.gloss_en: A link that lets a device reach the internet
senses.example_en: Our connection is slow, so videos will not load.
senses.example_cn: 我们的网络连接很慢，视频加载不出来。

senses.gloss_en: A person you know who can help you
senses.example_en: His connection got him an interview at the bank.
senses.example_cn: 他靠人脉获得了银行的面试机会。

senses.gloss_en: A television or radio station and its programs
senses.example_en: I changed the channel to watch the news.
senses.example_cn: 我换到了新闻频道。

senses.gloss_en: A way of sending information to people
senses.example_en: Email is our main channel for updates.
senses.example_cn: 邮件是我们发布消息的主要渠道。

senses.gloss_en: A passage that water flows along
senses.example_en: Water ran through the channel after the rain.
senses.example_cn: 下雨之后水从沟渠里流过。

senses.gloss_en: A set of keys for using a computer
senses.example_en: My keyboard is dirty, so I will clean it.
senses.example_cn: 我的键盘脏了，我要擦一擦。

senses.gloss_en: The row of keys on a piano
senses.example_en: She practiced scales on the keyboard every day.
senses.example_cn: 她每天在钢琴键上练音阶。

senses.gloss_en: An electronic instrument played with piano-style keys
senses.example_en: He played the keyboard in the band at school.
senses.example_cn: 他在学校的乐队里弹电子琴。

senses.gloss_en: Computer programs that tell a computer what to do
senses.example_en: This software edits video and saves files fast.
senses.example_cn: 这个软件能剪辑视频，存文件也很快。

senses.gloss_en: give someone the most recent information
senses.example_en: Please update me on the plan tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚请把计划的最新情况告诉我。

senses.gloss_en: make something more modern or suitable now
senses.example_en: They updated the website with new photos.
senses.example_cn: 他们用新照片更新了网站。

senses.gloss_en: a report or new version with recent information
senses.example_en: The app needs an update before it works.
senses.example_cn: 这个应用得先更新才能用。

senses.gloss_en: a form of something, slightly different from another
senses.example_en: I want the cheap version, not the new one.
senses.example_cn: 我要便宜的那款，不要新的那款。

senses.gloss_en: someone’s story of what happened
senses.example_en: His version of the story was very different.
senses.example_cn: 他讲的那套说法很不一样。

senses.gloss_en: a type of software with small changes
senses.example_en: This version of the app works on my phone.
senses.example_cn: 这个版本的应用在我手机上能用。

senses.gloss_en: the right or chance to use something
senses.example_en: Students have access to free Wi-Fi at school.
senses.example_cn: 学生在学校可以免费用无线网。

senses.gloss_en: a way of entering or reaching a place
senses.example_en: There is easy access to the building from the street.
senses.example_cn: 从街上进这栋楼很方便。

senses.gloss_en: reach, enter, or use something
senses.example_en: You can access the files online with a password.
senses.example_cn: 你可以用密码在线访问这些文件。

senses.gloss_en: communication with someone, staying in touch
senses.example_en: I stay in contact with my family every week.
senses.example_cn: 我每周都和家里保持联系。

senses.gloss_en: call or write to someone
senses.example_en: Please contact me today by email.
senses.example_cn: 请今天用邮件联系我。

senses.gloss_en: a person you can ask for help
senses.example_en: Ask my main contact at the office for help.
senses.example_cn: 有事去找我在办公室的那位熟人帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: a gesture or sound giving information or an order
senses.example_en: She gave a signal and we started running.
senses.example_cn: 她一发信号，我们就开始跑。

senses.gloss_en: radio or phone strength for sending messages
senses.example_en: My phone has no signal in this building.
senses.example_cn: 在这栋楼里我的手机没有信号。

senses.gloss_en: make a gesture or sound to send a message
senses.example_en: He signaled to me to stop the car.
senses.example_cn: 他向我示意，让我把车停下。

senses.gloss_en: an advertisement in a newspaper, online, or on TV
senses.example_en: I saw an ad for the job online today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天在网上看到一则这份工作的广告。

senses.gloss_en: Title of a news story in large letters
senses.example_en: The headline said the storm hit our coast.
senses.example_cn: 标题上说风暴袭击了我们的海岸。

senses.gloss_en: The main news stories on TV or radio
senses.example_en: The headlines were about the election this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上的重要新闻都是关于选举的。

senses.gloss_en: Public news attention, being reported widely
senses.example_en: Her photo was in the headlines all week.
senses.example_cn: 她的照片整周都上着头条。

senses.gloss_en: Ideas or information in a book, speech, or video
senses.example_en: The content of the talk was clear and simple.
senses.example_cn: 那场讲话的内容清楚又简单。

senses.gloss_en: Amount of a substance in something
senses.example_en: This milk has a low fat content.
senses.example_cn: 这种牛奶脂肪含量低。

senses.gloss_en: Things inside something, pl. contents
senses.example_en: Check the contents before you close the box.
senses.example_cn: 封箱之前先检查里面装的东西。

senses.gloss_en: Push something firmly, usually with your fingers
senses.example_en: Press the button and the door will open.
senses.example_cn: 按一下按钮，门就会开。

senses.gloss_en: Newspapers, TV news, and journalists
senses.example_en: The press asked the mayor about the plan.
senses.example_cn: 记者们就这个计划向市长提问。

senses.gloss_en: Try hard to persuade or demand an answer
senses.example_en: They pressed him for a clear answer.
senses.example_cn: 他们追问他，要一个明确的答复。

senses.gloss_en: Set someone free, allow them to leave
senses.example_en: They released the prisoner after two years.
senses.example_cn: 两年之后他们把这名囚犯放了。

senses.gloss_en: Make a film, song, or report available
senses.example_en: They released a new video on Friday.
senses.example_cn: 他们周五发布了一个新视频。

senses.gloss_en: The act of setting someone free
senses.example_en: His release from prison surprised the whole town.
senses.example_cn: 他从监狱获释，让全镇的人都很意外。

senses.gloss_en: Producing words, pictures, or patterns on paper
senses.example_en: Printing this book took days at the factory.
senses.example_cn: 在工厂印这本书花了好几天。

senses.gloss_en: A set number of copies printed at one time
senses.example_en: The first printing sold out in one month.
senses.example_cn: 第一版印次一个月就卖光了。

senses.gloss_en: A narrow strip with glue, used for sticking things
senses.example_en: I used tape to fix the broken box.
senses.example_cn: 我用胶带修好了那个破盒子。

senses.gloss_en: Magnetic material used for recording sound, video, or data
senses.example_en: Old computers stored data on magnetic tape.
senses.example_cn: 旧电脑把数据存在磁带上。

senses.gloss_en: A recording on tape, for example a cassette
senses.example_en: She made a tape of the lesson.
senses.example_cn: 她把这堂课录成了一盘录音带。

senses.gloss_en: A computer-controlled machine that does work automatically
senses.example_en: The factory uses a robot to pack boxes.
senses.example_cn: 工厂用机器人装箱。

senses.gloss_en: A person who watches television or online video
senses.example_en: Viewers watched the news on my phone tonight.
senses.example_cn: 今晚观众们用我的手机看了新闻。

senses.gloss_en: A person who looks at something, especially art
senses.example_en: The viewers stared at the painting for a long time.
senses.example_cn: 参观者们盯着那幅画看了很久。

senses.gloss_en: A device for looking at photographs or slides
senses.example_en: I used a viewer to see the old slides.
senses.example_cn: 我用看片器看了那些旧幻灯片。

senses.gloss_en: A person in charge of a newspaper or magazine
senses.example_en: The editor approved the story before it was printed.
senses.example_cn: 这篇报道付印之前，主编批准了。

senses.gloss_en: A person who corrects writing for publication
senses.example_en: The editor corrected my essay before the class report.
senses.example_cn: 班级汇报之前，编辑改了我的文章。

senses.gloss_en: A newspaper or magazine about a subject or profession
senses.example_en: She published her study in a medical journal.
senses.example_cn: 她把研究成果发表在一本医学期刊上。

senses.gloss_en: A book for writing daily experiences and thoughts
senses.example_en: I write in my journal after dinner every day.
senses.example_cn: 我每天晚饭后都会写日记。

senses.gloss_en: The study and use of computers to store and send information
senses.example_en: Our IT team fixed the network in one hour.
senses.example_cn: 我们的信息技术团队一小时就修好了网络。

senses.gloss_en: cook food in an oven, using dry heat
senses.example_en: We bake chicken in the oven for dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭我们用烤箱烤鸡。

senses.gloss_en: make bread, cakes, or cookies by cooking in an oven
senses.example_en: I bake a cake for my brother's birthday.
senses.example_cn: 我给弟弟的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

senses.gloss_en: make clay or earth hard by heating it
senses.example_en: They bake the clay to make strong bricks.
senses.example_cn: 他们把黏土烧硬，做成结实的砖。

senses.gloss_en: cook food in hot oil or fat
senses.example_en: I fry eggs in a small pan at home.
senses.example_cn: 我在家用一个小锅煎蛋。

senses.gloss_en: become hard, often ice, because of very cold weather
senses.example_en: Water can freeze at night when the air is cold.
senses.example_cn: 天冷的时候，水到了夜里会结冰。

senses.gloss_en: keep food for a long time by making it very cold
senses.example_en: We freeze soup and we eat it later.
senses.example_cn: 我们把汤冻起来，以后再吃。

senses.gloss_en: stop moving suddenly because you are afraid or surprised
senses.example_en: I freeze when the dog runs toward me.
senses.example_cn: 狗朝我跑过来时，我吓得一动都不敢动。

senses.gloss_en: move your body so it is not straight
senses.example_en: Bend your knees and lift the box slowly.
senses.example_cn: 弯下膝盖，慢慢把箱子抬起来。

senses.gloss_en: make something become curved or not straight
senses.example_en: Bend the wire into a small circle.
senses.example_cn: 把这根铁丝弯成一个小圆圈。

senses.gloss_en: a curve in a road, river, or pipe
senses.example_en: The car slows down at the bend in the road.
senses.example_cn: 车开到路上的弯道就减速了。

senses.gloss_en: attach something to a surface with a sticky substance
senses.example_en: Stick the tape to the back of it.
senses.example_cn: 把胶带贴到它的背面。

senses.gloss_en: push a pointed object into something and leave it there
senses.example_en: Stick a pin into the map for fun.
senses.example_cn: 图个好玩，往地图上插一根针吧。

senses.gloss_en: become fixed, unable to move or open easily
senses.example_en: The window sticks and I cannot shut it.
senses.example_cn: 窗户卡住了，我关不上。

senses.gloss_en: close clothing, a bag, or a seat belt
senses.example_en: Please fasten your seat belt before we start.
senses.example_cn: 出发前请系好安全带。

senses.gloss_en: attach something to something else so it stays
senses.example_en: Fasten the rope to the post outside.
senses.example_cn: 把绳子系在外面那根柱子上。

senses.gloss_en: become closed or joined together
senses.example_en: This jacket will not fasten in the front.
senses.example_cn: 这件夹克前面扣不上。

senses.gloss_en: Fasten or join one thing to another
senses.example_en: Attach the tag to your bag with tape.
senses.example_cn: 用胶带把标签贴到你的包上。

senses.gloss_en: Add a file or document to a message
senses.example_en: Please attach the photo to the email for me.
senses.example_cn: 请把照片附在邮件里发给我。

senses.gloss_en: Believe something has value or importance
senses.example_en: They attach great importance to good service.
senses.gloss_cn: 看重（指认为有价值或重要）
senses.example_cn: 他们非常重视优质服务。

senses.gloss_en: Join things together to form one thing
senses.example_en: Combine the sugar and butter in a bowl.
senses.example_cn: 把糖和黄油放在碗里搅在一起。

senses.gloss_en: Exist or work together as one group
senses.example_en: The two teams combined and won the game.
senses.example_cn: 两支队伍联合起来，赢了这场比赛。

senses.gloss_en: Do two activities at the same time
senses.example_en: She combines work with study during the week.
senses.gloss_cn: 兼顾（指同时进行两项活动）
senses.example_cn: 她在工作日兼顾学习和工作。

senses.gloss_en: Become larger in size, number, or amount
senses.example_en: Hot air expands and fills the balloon quickly.
senses.example_cn: 热空气膨胀，很快就充满了气球。

senses.gloss_en: Make something larger in size or amount
senses.example_en: They expanded the store and added two rooms.
senses.example_cn: 他们扩建了商店，又加了两个房间。

senses.gloss_en: Give more details, make something longer
senses.example_en: Can you expand your answer with more details.
senses.gloss_cn: 展开说明（指提供更多细节）
senses.example_cn: 你能否对你的回答补充更多细节。

senses.gloss_en: Open things out so they cover a larger area
senses.example_en: Spread the map on the table and look.
senses.example_cn: 把地图在桌上摊开看看。

senses.gloss_en: Move to more places, or affect more people
senses.example_en: The fire spread to three homes during the night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里火势蔓延到了三户人家。

senses.gloss_en: Increase to a wider area or more people
senses.example_en: The spread of flu closed the school for days.
senses.example_cn: 流感蔓延开来，学校停课了好几天。

senses.gloss_en: Change from one thing to another
senses.example_en: I switched to a new phone last month.
senses.example_cn: 上个月我换了一部新手机。

senses.gloss_en: Turn a machine or light on or off
senses.example_en: Switch the light off before you leave the room.
senses.example_cn: 出房间之前把灯关掉。

senses.gloss_en: A small device that turns power on or off
senses.example_en: The switch is by the door, next to me.
senses.gloss_cn: 开关（指通电断电的小装置）
senses.example_cn: 开关就在门旁边，挨着我。

senses.gloss_en: Harm that makes something less useful or valuable
senses.example_en: The storm caused damage to the roof at night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里那场风暴对屋顶造成了损坏。

senses.gloss_en: Cause harm to something or someone
senses.example_en: Smoke can damage your lungs over many years.
senses.example_cn: 长年累月，烟雾会损害你的肺。

senses.gloss_en: Money paid for harm, loss, or injury
senses.example_en: The judge awarded damages for the damage to my car.
senses.example_cn: 法官判了赔偿金，赔我车子的损坏。

senses.gloss_en: to hurt a person or animal physically
senses.example_en: He injured his knee in a fall.
senses.example_cn: 他摔了一跤，膝盖受伤了。

senses.gloss_en: to damage someone’s reputation, interests, or feelings
senses.example_en: His words injured her feelings in public.
senses.example_cn: 他的话当众伤了她的感情。

senses.gloss_en: to change writing or a plan to improve it
senses.example_en: I revised the email before I sent it.
senses.example_cn: 我把邮件改了一遍才发出去。

senses.gloss_en: to change an opinion after thinking again
senses.example_en: She revised her decision after the new facts.
senses.example_cn: 了解到新情况后，她改变了决定。

senses.gloss_en: to become trained and pass exams for a job
senses.example_en: She qualified as a nurse last year.
senses.gloss_cn: 取得资格（受训并考试合格）
senses.example_cn: 她去年取得了护士资格。

senses.gloss_en: to be allowed to do or have something
senses.example_en: You qualify for a discount if you are 18.
senses.example_cn: 如果你满十八岁，就符合打折的条件。

senses.gloss_en: to limit a statement by adding details
senses.example_en: I must qualify my praise with one small problem.
senses.gloss_cn: 修饰（指对评价加以限定）
senses.example_cn: 我对他的赞扬必须加上一个小问题。

senses.gloss_en: to stay alive after danger or an accident
senses.example_en: He survived the crash and walked away.
senses.example_cn: 他在那场车祸中活了下来，还自己走开了。

senses.gloss_en: to continue to exist for a long time
senses.example_en: These old stories survived for many years.
senses.example_cn: 这些老故事流传了很多年。

senses.gloss_en: to live with very little money or food
senses.example_en: They survived on rice and water for days.
senses.example_cn: 他们靠米饭和水撑了好几天。

senses.gloss_en: to break apart violently with a loud noise
senses.example_en: The bomb exploded near the station at night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里炸弹在车站附近爆炸了。

senses.gloss_en: to suddenly show strong anger or emotion
senses.example_en: She exploded when he took her phone.
senses.example_cn: 他拿走她手机时，她一下就发火了。

senses.gloss_en: to increase suddenly and very quickly in number
senses.example_en: Prices exploded after the new tax.
senses.example_cn: 新税出台以后，物价暴涨。

senses.gloss_en: to give off or reflect bright light
senses.example_en: The sun shines on the water all day.
senses.example_cn: 太阳整天照在水面上。

senses.gloss_en: to point a light at something
senses.example_en: He shined a flashlight under the bed.
senses.example_cn: 他用手电筒往床底下照。

senses.gloss_en: to do very well, be better than others
senses.example_en: She shines in math when she studies.
senses.example_cn: 她一用功，数学就特别出色。

senses.gloss_en: make someone interested, wanting to look or learn more
senses.example_en: Bright colors attract attention in the store window.
senses.example_cn: 鲜艳的颜色能吸引商店橱窗里的目光。

senses.gloss_en: make people come to a place, event, or business
senses.example_en: The festival attracts visitors worldwide each year.
senses.example_cn: 这个节日每年都吸引世界各地的游客。

senses.gloss_en: make someone like, admire, or desire someone
senses.example_en: She attracts him, but he is too shy.
senses.example_cn: 她吸引着他，但他太害羞了。

senses.gloss_en: make someone slightly angry
senses.example_en: The loud music annoys me every night.
senses.example_cn: 那吵闹的音乐每天晚上都让我心烦。

senses.gloss_en: make someone uncomfortable, unable to relax
senses.example_en: This tight shoe annoys me all day.
senses.example_cn: 这只鞋太紧，磨得我一整天都难受。

senses.gloss_en: make someone feel worried or annoyed
senses.example_en: It bothers me when you arrive late again.
senses.example_cn: 你又迟到了，这让我很烦。

senses.gloss_en: interrupt someone when they are doing something
senses.example_en: Do not bother her while she is on a call.
senses.example_cn: 她在打电话时别去打扰她。

senses.gloss_en: spend time or energy doing something
senses.example_en: I did not bother to file the papers.
senses.example_cn: 我懒得去整理那些文件。

senses.gloss_en: make someone suddenly afraid
senses.example_en: That noise frightened the baby in the dark.
senses.example_cn: 那个声音在黑暗里把宝宝吓到了。

senses.gloss_en: make someone unable to understand or think clearly
senses.example_en: These rules confuse me, so I make mistakes.
senses.example_cn: 这些规则让我很困惑，所以我老出错。

senses.gloss_en: think one person or thing is another
senses.example_en: I confused the new version with the old one.
senses.example_cn: 我把新版本和旧版本弄混了。

senses.gloss_en: the lowest part of something, where it rests
senses.example_en: The base of the statue was covered with dust.
senses.example_cn: 雕像的底座上盖了一层灰。

senses.gloss_en: main place you live or work, a starting point
senses.example_en: This hotel is a good base for our trip.
senses.example_cn: 这家酒店是我们这趟旅行的好落脚点。

senses.gloss_en: use something as the main reason for a plan
senses.example_en: We based the plan on real data from last year.
senses.example_cn: 我们这个计划是以去年的真实数据为依据的。

senses.gloss_en: A state of equal or correct amounts
senses.example_en: We need a balance between work and rest each day.
senses.example_cn: 我们每天都需要在工作和休息之间找到平衡。

senses.gloss_en: Ability to stay steady and not fall
senses.example_en: She lost her balance and fell on the path.
senses.example_cn: 她失去平衡，在小路上摔倒了。

senses.gloss_en: Amount of money in a bank account
senses.example_en: My bank balance is low after I pay rent.
senses.example_cn: 付了房租之后，我银行账户的余额就不多了。

senses.gloss_en: Be made of the things mentioned
senses.example_en: The soup consists of rice, fish, and salt.
senses.example_cn: 这道汤是由米、鱼和盐做成的。

senses.gloss_en: Have something as a main part
senses.example_en: The job consists in helping people with email.
senses.example_cn: 这份工作主要就是帮人处理邮件。

senses.gloss_en: Put a dead body in the ground
senses.example_en: They buried her in a quiet place near town.
senses.example_cn: 他们把她葬在城边一个安静的地方。

senses.gloss_en: Put something in a hole and cover it
senses.example_en: The dog buried a bone in the yard.
senses.example_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在院子里。

senses.gloss_en: Cover completely so it cannot be seen
senses.example_en: The car was buried under snow after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雪过后，那辆车被雪埋住了。

senses.gloss_en: related to chemicals or chemistry
senses.example_en: Chemical waste can pollute rivers and soil.
senses.example_cn: 化学废料会污染河流和土壤。

senses.gloss_en: a substance used in a chemical process
senses.example_en: Keep these chemicals away from food and kids.
senses.example_cn: 把这些化学品放在远离食物和孩子的地方。

senses.gloss_en: made with chemicals, not natural
senses.example_en: She avoids chemical cleaners in her small kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 她在自己的小厨房里不用含化学成分的清洁剂。

senses.gloss_en: hard or firm, not liquid or gas
senses.example_en: Ice becomes solid when the temperature drops.
senses.example_cn: 温度下降的时候，冰会变成坚硬的固体。

senses.gloss_en: a substance that is not liquid or gas
senses.example_en: Water is a liquid, ice is a solid.
senses.example_cn: 水是液体，冰是固体。

senses.gloss_en: good, strong, and likely to succeed
senses.example_en: We need solid reasons before we change the plan.
senses.example_cn: 改计划之前，我们需要充分可靠的理由。

senses.gloss_en: using energy produced by splitting atoms
senses.example_en: They built a nuclear plant near the coast.
senses.example_cn: 他们在海边建了一座核电站。

senses.gloss_en: relating to nuclear weapons
senses.example_en: The treaty limits nuclear weapons in the region.
senses.example_cn: 这项条约限制该地区的核武器。

senses.gloss_en: relating to the nucleus of an atom or cell
senses.example_en: Scientists studied nuclear DNA in the lab.
senses.example_cn: 科学家在实验室里研究了细胞核中的脱氧核糖核酸。

senses.gloss_en: containing alcohol
senses.example_en: They served alcoholic drinks at the party.
senses.example_cn: 聚会上他们供应含酒精的饮料。

senses.gloss_en: drinking too much alcohol and unable to stop
senses.example_en: Her alcoholic uncle cannot stop drinking every day.
senses.example_cn: 她那个嗜酒的叔叔每天都戒不掉酒。

senses.gloss_en: a person who drinks too much alcohol and cannot stop
senses.example_en: He got help because he is an alcoholic.
senses.example_cn: 他去求助了，因为他是个酗酒的人。

senses.gloss_en: easy to see, notice, or recognize
senses.example_en: The answer was obvious to everyone in class.
senses.example_cn: 班上每个人都觉得答案很明显。

senses.gloss_en: easy to understand or know, very clear
senses.example_en: It is obvious that he is very upset.
senses.example_cn: 显然他非常难过。

senses.gloss_en: able to control people, events, or decisions
senses.example_en: She is powerful in the company and politics.
senses.example_cn: 她在公司和政界都很有权势。

senses.gloss_en: having great strength or force
senses.example_en: A powerful wind pushed the small boat backward.
senses.example_cn: 一阵强风把小船往后推。

senses.gloss_en: having a very strong effect
senses.example_en: His powerful speech changed my opinion about it.
senses.example_cn: 他那番有力的演讲改变了我对此的看法。

senses.gloss_en: worth a lot of money
senses.example_en: This ring is valuable, so keep it safe.
senses.example_cn: 这枚戒指很值钱，你要好好保管。

senses.gloss_en: very useful or important
senses.example_en: Her advice was valuable for my new job.
senses.example_cn: 她的建议对我的新工作很有帮助。

senses.gloss_en: important because it is limited
senses.example_en: Do not waste valuable time before the exam.
senses.example_cn: 不要浪费考前宝贵的时间。

senses.gloss_en: modern, using the newest ideas or methods
senses.example_en: They use advanced technology in the new laboratory.
senses.example_cn: 他们在新实验室里使用先进的技术。

senses.gloss_en: at a high, difficult level
senses.example_en: She is in an advanced English class now.
senses.example_cn: 她现在在上高级英语班。

senses.gloss_en: far along, at a late stage
senses.example_en: The disease was advanced, so he stayed home.
senses.gloss_cn: 晚期的（指疾病发展到后期）
senses.example_cn: 疾病已到晚期的阶段，所以他待在家里。

senses.gloss_en: made of many connected parts
senses.example_en: The complex system has many parts and rules.
senses.gloss_cn: 复杂的，由许多部分构成
senses.example_cn: 这个系统很复杂，有很多部件和规则。

senses.gloss_en: difficult to understand or explain
senses.example_en: This is a complex problem, not a simple one.
senses.example_cn: 这是个棘手的难题，不是简单的问题。

senses.gloss_en: a group of related buildings in one place
senses.example_en: They built a sports complex near the highway.
senses.gloss_cn: 建筑群（指一组相连的建筑）
senses.example_cn: 他们在高速公路附近建了一座体育建筑群。

senses.gloss_en: enjoyable, giving pleasure or comfort
senses.example_en: We had a pleasant evening at home together.
senses.example_cn: 我们一起在家过了一个愉快的晚上。

senses.gloss_en: friendly and easy to like
senses.example_en: He is pleasant, always calm and kind to people.
senses.example_cn: 他很和气，待人总是平心静气又亲切。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel calm and less worried
senses.example_en: A warm bath is relaxing after a long day.
senses.example_cn: 忙了一整天，泡个热水澡很放松。

senses.gloss_en: not severe or strong
senses.example_en: He has a mild cold, so he stayed home.
senses.example_cn: 他有点轻微感冒，就待在家里了。

senses.gloss_en: not very cold, pleasant for the season
senses.example_en: We had a mild winter and walked outside daily.
senses.example_cn: 那年冬天很温暖，我们每天都到外面走走。

senses.gloss_en: not spicy, not having a strong taste
senses.example_en: I want mild curry, not very hot food.
senses.example_cn: 我要不辣的咖喱，不要很辣的东西。

senses.gloss_en: having a hot taste from added spices
senses.example_en: This spicy soup is too hot for me.
senses.example_cn: 这个汤对我来说太辣了。

senses.gloss_en: exciting and slightly shocking, often about sex
senses.example_en: The news had a spicy story about stars.
senses.example_cn: 新闻里有一条关于明星的香艳报道。

senses.gloss_en: causing physical pain
senses.example_en: The cut was painful and I stopped running.
senses.example_cn: 伤口很疼，我就不跑了。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel upset or embarrassed
senses.example_en: That painful memory made her cry at night.
senses.example_cn: 那段痛苦的回忆让她夜里哭了起来。

senses.gloss_en: very bad, unpleasant, or disgusting
senses.example_en: We had horrible weather and stayed inside all day.
senses.example_cn: 天气很糟糕，我们一整天都待在屋里。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel very shocked and frightened
senses.example_en: They heard a horrible scream and ran away.
senses.example_cn: 他们听到一声可怕的尖叫，就跑开了。

senses.gloss_en: using physical force to hurt or kill
senses.example_en: The violent man hit a stranger in the street.
senses.example_cn: 那个凶暴的男人在街上打了一个陌生人。

senses.gloss_en: showing very strong feelings, especially anger
senses.example_en: He had a violent reaction and shouted at me.
senses.example_cn: 他反应很激烈，对我大喊大叫。

senses.gloss_en: sudden and very strong, causing damage
senses.example_en: A violent storm broke trees and damaged our roof.
senses.example_cn: 一场猛烈的暴风雨折断了树，还损坏了我们的屋顶。

senses.gloss_en: not right or fair, treating people unequally
senses.example_en: It is unfair to blame her for this mistake.
senses.example_cn: 把这个错误怪在她头上不公平。

senses.gloss_en: not needed, more than needed
senses.example_en: Buying a new phone now is unnecessary.
senses.example_cn: 现在买新手机没有必要。

senses.gloss_en: not pleasant or comfortable
senses.example_en: The unpleasant smell filled the small room.
senses.example_cn: 难闻的气味充满了这个小房间。

senses.gloss_en: not as good as you hoped
senses.example_en: The movie was disappointing, so we left early.
senses.example_cn: 那部电影让人失望，我们就早早离场了。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel shy, awkward, or ashamed
senses.example_en: Forgetting her name was embarrassing in class today.
senses.example_cn: 今天在课上忘了她的名字，真尴尬。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel slightly angry
senses.example_en: That loud noise is annoying at night.
senses.example_cn: 那么大的噪音，夜里真烦人。

senses.gloss_en: very scary, making you feel afraid
senses.example_en: The noise was frightening in the dark house.
senses.example_cn: 黑漆漆的房子里，那个声音很可怕。

senses.gloss_en: extremely interesting, holding your attention
senses.example_en: The fascinating story kept me awake all night.
senses.example_cn: 这个故事太有意思了，让我整夜没睡。

senses.gloss_en: very good or large, causing admiration
senses.example_en: Her impressive work made the whole class clap.
senses.example_cn: 她那出色的作品让全班都鼓起掌来。

senses.gloss_en: not real, existing only in your mind
senses.example_en: He drew an imaginary animal on the wall.
senses.example_cn: 他在墙上画了一只想象出来的动物。

senses.gloss_en: not common, not happening often
senses.example_en: Snow is rare in this town in April.
senses.example_cn: 四月这个镇上很少下雪。

senses.gloss_en: existing in small numbers, hard to find
senses.example_en: They found a rare coin under the old bed.
senses.example_cn: 他们在那张旧床底下发现了一枚稀有的硬币。

senses.gloss_en: not done directly, done through someone else
senses.example_en: I got an indirect message through a friend today.
senses.example_cn: 今天我通过一个朋友间接收到了消息。

senses.gloss_en: not clear or obvious, not saying something directly
senses.example_en: He gave an indirect answer, not a clear one.
senses.example_cn: 他给了个含糊的回答，没有明说。

senses.gloss_en: not straight, not in a direct line
senses.example_en: We took an indirect route to the quiet beach.
senses.example_cn: 我们绕道去了那个安静的海滩。

senses.gloss_en: Certain, not likely to change
senses.example_en: We need a definite plan for tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 明天的事我们需要一个确定的计划。

senses.gloss_en: Clear, easy to see or understand
senses.example_en: She gave a definite answer, not a maybe.
senses.example_cn: 她给了个明确的答复，没有说“可能吧”。

senses.gloss_en: Firm, having strong opinions
senses.example_en: She is definite about rules, no exceptions.
senses.example_cn: 她对规矩态度很坚定，不容例外。

senses.gloss_en: Not expected to happen
senses.example_en: It is unlikely to rain today.
senses.example_cn: 今天不太可能下雨。

senses.gloss_en: Not what you would normally expect
senses.example_en: He was an unlikely friend but very kind.
senses.example_cn: 他是个意想不到的朋友，但人非常好。

senses.gloss_en: Not able to do something
senses.example_en: I was unable to sleep last night.
senses.example_cn: 我昨晚睡不着。

senses.gloss_en: Having a value in money
senses.example_en: This watch is worth fifty dollars.
senses.example_cn: 这块表值五十美元。

senses.gloss_en: Good enough to do or have
senses.example_en: This book is worth reading on the train.
senses.example_cn: 这本书值得在火车上读一读。

senses.gloss_en: The value or importance of someone or something
senses.example_en: He forgot his worth and felt very small.
senses.example_cn: 他迷失了自我，觉得自己渺小极了。

senses.gloss_en: Causing illness or death if swallowed
senses.example_en: That plant is poisonous, so do not eat it.
senses.example_cn: 那种植物有毒，别吃。

senses.gloss_en: Able to put poison into another animal
senses.example_en: The snake is poisonous and can hurt you.
senses.example_cn: 这条蛇有毒，会伤到你。

senses.gloss_en: Very unpleasant or unkind
senses.example_en: He made some poisonous comments.
senses.example_cn: 他说了几句很恶毒的话。

senses.gloss_en: Strange or unusual
senses.example_en: That is an odd sound in the night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里那个声音很奇怪。

senses.gloss_en: Various small jobs, not a regular job
senses.example_en: He does odd jobs on weekends.
senses.example_cn: 他周末干些零活。

senses.gloss_en: One of a pair, with the other missing
senses.example_en: I found an odd sock under the bed.
senses.example_cn: 我在床底下找到一只没有配对的袜子。

senses.gloss_en: the measurement from one end to the other
senses.example_en: The length of the table is six feet.
senses.example_cn: 这张桌子的长度是六英尺。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of time something lasts
senses.example_en: The length of the movie is two hours.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影时长两个小时。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of writing in a book or document
senses.example_en: The length of the report is ten pages.
senses.example_cn: 这份报告的篇幅是十页。

senses.gloss_en: a unit of weight, 2,000 pounds in the US
senses.example_en: The truck carries one ton of sand.
senses.example_cn: 这辆卡车能运一吨沙子。

senses.gloss_en: a unit of ship size, equal to 100 cubic feet
senses.example_en: The ship has 600 tons of space.
senses.example_cn: 这艘船有六百吨的舱容。

senses.gloss_en: a lot of something
senses.example_en: We have tons of work today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天有一大堆工作。

senses.gloss_en: a part of a whole, shown as a number out of 100
senses.example_en: A high percentage of people live in the city.
senses.example_cn: 很大比例的人住在城市里。

senses.gloss_en: a share of profits, paid for sales
senses.example_en: He gets a percentage for every car sold.
senses.example_cn: 他每卖出一辆车就拿一笔提成。

senses.gloss_en: one thing used to make food or a product
senses.example_en: Salt is an ingredient in this soup.
senses.example_cn: 盐是这道汤里的一种配料。

senses.gloss_en: a part that helps something succeed
senses.example_en: Patience is an ingredient for success in school.
senses.example_cn: 耐心是在学校取得好成绩的一个要素。

senses.gloss_en: powder from grain, used for baking
senses.example_en: I need flour to make bread at home.
senses.example_cn: 我需要面粉，好在家做面包。

senses.gloss_en: a seed of wheat, rice, or other food plants
senses.example_en: Rice is a grain many people eat every day.
senses.example_cn: 大米是很多人每天都吃的谷物。

senses.gloss_en: a very small piece, like sand
senses.example_en: A grain of sand fell into my shoe.
senses.example_cn: 一粒沙子掉进了我的鞋里。

senses.gloss_en: the natural lines in wood or cloth
senses.example_en: This table shows a dark grain in wood.
senses.example_cn: 这张桌子的木纹颜色很深。

senses.gloss_en: a tall plant with large yellow seeds
senses.example_en: We saw corn growing in the field.
senses.example_cn: 我们看见田里长着玉米。

senses.gloss_en: the yellow seeds, eaten as food
senses.example_en: I cooked corn with salt and butter.
senses.example_cn: 我用盐和黄油煮了玉米。

senses.gloss_en: a small painful area of hard skin on a toe
senses.example_en: He has a corn on his toe today.
senses.example_cn: 他脚趾上长了个鸡眼。

senses.gloss_en: a dry substance in very small pieces
senses.example_en: This drink mix comes as a white powder.
senses.example_cn: 这种冲饮是白色粉末状的。

senses.gloss_en: a soft dry substance put on the face
senses.example_en: She used powder on her face before work.
senses.example_cn: 她上班前在脸上拍了点粉。

senses.gloss_en: an explosive powder, used in bombs or fireworks
senses.example_en: Old guns used powder to shoot bullets.
senses.example_cn: 老式枪靠火药把子弹打出去。

senses.gloss_en: a round metal container for cooking on a stove
senses.example_en: Heat the soup in a small pan.
senses.example_cn: 用小锅把汤热一下。

senses.gloss_en: a metal dish used to bake food in an oven
senses.example_en: Put the cake in a pan and bake it.
senses.example_cn: 把蛋糕放进烤盘里烤。

senses.gloss_en: Deep, round container used for cooking food
senses.example_en: I boiled soup in a big pot today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天用一口大锅煮了汤。

senses.gloss_en: Container used for growing a plant
senses.example_en: Put the flower in a pot by the window.
senses.example_cn: 把这花栽到花盆里，放在窗边。

senses.gloss_en: Amount held in a pot
senses.example_en: We drank a pot of tea after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后我们喝了一壶茶。

senses.gloss_en: Combine things so they join together
senses.example_en: Mix the eggs with milk in a bowl.
senses.example_cn: 把鸡蛋和牛奶在碗里搅在一起。

senses.gloss_en: Have two or more things together
senses.example_en: He mixes work with travel and stays calm.
senses.gloss_cn: 把两样事情结合在一起
senses.example_cn: 他把工作和旅行结合起来，心态还挺从容。

senses.gloss_en: Combination of different things or people
senses.example_en: The class has a good mix of ages.
senses.example_cn: 这个班里各个年龄的人搭配得很好。

senses.gloss_en: Substance made by mixing other things
senses.example_en: Stir the mixture until it feels smooth.
senses.example_cn: 把混合物搅到细滑为止。

senses.gloss_en: Combination of different things in one place
senses.example_en: The city is a mixture of old and new.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市是新与旧的混合体。

senses.gloss_en: Thin, flat piece cut from food
senses.example_en: I ate a slice of bread with soup.
senses.example_cn: 我就着汤吃了一片面包。

senses.gloss_en: Cut food into thin, flat pieces
senses.example_en: Slice the tomato and put it on bread.
senses.example_cn: 把西红柿切成片放在面包上。

senses.gloss_en: Cut into something with a sharp blade
senses.example_en: I sliced my finger on the knife.
senses.example_cn: 我被刀划伤了手指。

senses.gloss_en: Drinks like beer or wine that can make you drunk
senses.example_en: He does not drink alcohol at dinner.
senses.example_cn: 他吃饭时不喝酒。

senses.gloss_en: Clear liquid in drinks, medicine, and cleaning products
senses.example_en: This cleaner has alcohol, so keep it away.
senses.example_cn: 这种清洁剂含酒精，要放远一点。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of paper on something, giving information
senses.example_en: The label on the jar says salt.
senses.example_cn: 罐子上的标签写着盐。

senses.gloss_en: to attach a label to something
senses.example_en: Please label the box before you mail it.
senses.example_cn: 寄出之前请给箱子贴上标签。

senses.gloss_en: to describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.example_en: Do not label her lazy after one bad day.
senses.example_cn: 不要因为她一天表现不好就给她贴上懒惰的标签。

senses.gloss_en: something wrapped or boxed for sending or carrying
senses.example_en: A package arrived this morning from my aunt.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我收到姑姑寄来的一个包裹。

senses.gloss_en: a set of things sold or offered together
senses.example_en: We bought a package with flights and a hotel.
senses.example_cn: 我们买了一个包含机票和酒店的套餐。

senses.gloss_en: to put something in a box or wrapper
senses.example_en: They package the cookies in a small box.
senses.gloss_cn: 包装（装进盒子或包装纸）
senses.example_cn: 他们把饼干包装在一个小盒子里。

senses.gloss_en: a level of quality that is acceptable
senses.example_en: The food is not up to our standard.
senses.gloss_cn: 标准（可接受的质量水平）
senses.example_cn: 这些食物达不到我们的标准。

senses.gloss_en: a rule for good behavior
senses.example_en: Their standards of behavior are very high.
senses.example_cn: 他们的行为准则很高。

senses.gloss_en: usual, normal, not special
senses.example_en: This room has standard beds and standard chairs.
senses.example_cn: 这个房间里是普通的床和普通的椅子。

senses.gloss_en: money taken off the usual price
senses.example_en: We got a discount on the two tickets.
senses.example_cn: 我们买那两张票时打了折。

senses.gloss_en: to reduce the price of something
senses.example_en: They discount the jacket by ten percent today.
senses.example_cn: 今天这件夹克打九折。

senses.gloss_en: to consider something unimportant or unlikely to be true
senses.example_en: Do not discount his story and listen carefully.
senses.gloss_cn: 轻视（当成不重要或不可信）
senses.example_cn: 别轻视他说的话，要仔细听。

senses.gloss_en: great comfort from expensive and beautiful things
senses.example_en: They live in luxury near the sea.
senses.example_cn: 他们在海边过着奢华的生活。

senses.gloss_en: an expensive thing that is pleasant to have but not necessary
senses.example_en: A new car is a luxury for us.
senses.gloss_cn: 奢侈品（贵而非必需的东西）
senses.example_cn: 对我们来说，买新车是一种奢侈。

senses.gloss_en: a pleasure or advantage you do not often have
senses.example_en: We had the luxury of time and good weather.
senses.example_cn: 我们难得有充裕的时间和这么好的天气。

senses.gloss_en: a statement that something is wrong or not good
senses.example_en: I made a complaint about the loud music.
senses.example_cn: 我对吵闹的音乐提出了投诉。

senses.gloss_en: a reason for being unhappy about something
senses.example_en: My only complaint is the slow service.
senses.example_cn: 我唯一不满的是服务太慢。

senses.gloss_en: a health problem, usually not very serious
senses.example_en: He has a stomach complaint today.
senses.example_cn: 他今天胃不舒服。

senses.gloss_en: a soft hat with a curved front part
senses.example_en: He wore a cap to block the sun.
senses.example_cn: 他戴着一顶遮阳的鸭舌帽。

senses.gloss_en: a cover on the top of a bottle or pen
senses.example_en: Put the cap back on the bottle.
senses.example_cn: 把瓶盖盖回去。

senses.gloss_en: the highest allowed amount or limit
senses.example_en: The city set a cap on taxi fares.
senses.example_cn: 市里给出租车车费设了上限。

senses.gloss_en: a covering for the hand with separate fingers
senses.example_en: Wear gloves in winter to keep hands warm.
senses.example_cn: 冬天戴手套，手才暖和。

senses.gloss_en: clothes worn under other clothes, next to the skin
senses.example_en: Pack clean underwear before the long trip.
senses.example_cn: 长途旅行前请收拾干净的内衣。

senses.gloss_en: connected metal rings used to pull or fasten things
senses.example_en: A heavy chain held the gate closed.
senses.example_cn: 一根粗铁链把大门锁着。

senses.gloss_en: a group of similar stores owned by one company
senses.example_en: They own a chain of coffee shops.
senses.example_cn: 他们拥有一家连锁咖啡店。

senses.gloss_en: fasten someone or something to something with a chain
senses.example_en: I chained my bike to the post.
senses.example_cn: 我把自行车用链子锁在了柱子上。

senses.gloss_en: a thin piece of metal used to fasten cloth
senses.example_en: Use a pin to hold the paper.
senses.example_cn: 用别针把纸固定住。

senses.gloss_en: a small object fastened to clothes as jewelry
senses.example_en: She wore a gold pin on her jacket.
senses.example_cn: 她在夹克上戴了一枚金色胸针。

senses.gloss_en: attach something to another thing with a pin
senses.example_en: Pin the photo to the wall.
senses.example_cn: 把照片用别针固定在墙上。

senses.gloss_en: Have enough money to buy or pay for something
senses.example_en: I can't afford a new phone right now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在买不起新手机。

senses.gloss_en: Have enough time to do something
senses.example_en: We can't afford to wait another hour.
senses.example_cn: 我们再等一个小时可耽误不起。
