senses.gloss_en: Provide someone with something, often in formal writing
senses.example_en: This job affords me time for my family.
senses.example_cn: 这份工作中我有时间陪伴家人。

senses.gloss_en: Put money into a business, hoping for profit
senses.example_en: They invest in stocks for the future.
senses.example_cn: 他们为了将来投资股票。

senses.gloss_en: Spend money on something to make it better
senses.example_en: The city invests in new buses each year.
senses.example_cn: 这座城市每年都投资购置新车。

senses.gloss_en: Spend time or effort on something important
senses.example_en: I invest time in my English every day.
senses.gloss_cn: 投入（指付出时间或精力）
senses.example_cn: 我每天花时间在英语学习上。

senses.gloss_en: Use a lot of fuel, energy, or time
senses.example_en: Video games consume my time at night.
senses.example_cn: 电子游戏耗掉了我晚上的时间。

senses.gloss_en: Eat or drink something
senses.example_en: He consumed three beers at the party.
senses.example_cn: 他在聚会上喝了三杯啤酒。

senses.gloss_en: Fill someone with a strong feeling
senses.example_en: She was consumed with worry all day.
senses.gloss_cn: 使充满（指强烈的情绪占据内心）
senses.example_cn: 她一整天都沉浸在忧虑之中。

senses.gloss_en: Take goods or letters to a person or place
senses.example_en: They deliver food to my apartment each day.
senses.example_cn: 他们每天把饭送到我的公寓。

senses.gloss_en: Help a woman give birth to a baby
senses.example_en: The doctor delivered the baby at 3 a.m.
senses.example_cn: 医生在凌晨三点接生了这个孩子。

senses.gloss_en: Give a speech to an audience
senses.example_en: She delivered a speech to the class today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天向全班发表了演讲。

senses.gloss_en: Give money or goods to help a person
senses.example_en: We donated clothes to the shelter last week.
senses.example_cn: 上周我们把衣服捐给了收容所。

senses.gloss_en: Give blood or body parts for medical use
senses.example_en: She donates blood at the hospital every month.
senses.example_cn: 她每个月都去医院献血。

senses.gloss_en: Have a particular weight
senses.example_en: My suitcase, with the books, weighs ten kilos.
senses.example_cn: 我的箱子装上书，有十公斤重。

senses.gloss_en: Measure how heavy someone or something is
senses.example_en: We weighed the fish on a small scale.
senses.example_cn: 我们用一个小秤称了称那条鱼。

senses.gloss_en: Consider something carefully before deciding
senses.example_en: Weigh both options then decide today.
senses.gloss_cn: 权衡（指慎重考虑后再决定）
senses.example_cn: 认真权衡两种选择，然后做出决定。

senses.gloss_en: extremely important and completely necessary
senses.example_en: Sleep is essential for good health.
senses.example_cn: 睡眠对身体健康必不可少。

senses.gloss_en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation
senses.example_en: This jacket is suitable for cold weather.
senses.example_cn: 这件夹克适合冷天穿。

senses.gloss_en: connected with real situations, not ideas or theories
senses.example_en: She has practical experience in a busy kitchen.
senses.example_cn: 她在繁忙的厨房里有实际经验。

senses.gloss_en: likely to work, right or sensible
senses.example_en: A small car is practical for city life.
senses.example_cn: 小车对城市生活来说很实用。

senses.gloss_en: useful or suitable, made for everyday use
senses.example_en: These are practical shoes for long walks.
senses.example_cn: 这些鞋适合长时间走路，很实用。

senses.gloss_en: producing the result you want
senses.example_en: This simple plan is effective for me.
senses.example_cn: 这个简单的办法对我很有效。

senses.gloss_en: in use or in force, starting to apply
senses.example_en: The new law is effective on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 新法律从周一开始生效。

senses.gloss_en: real in fact, not officially intended
senses.example_en: She has effective control of the office.
senses.example_cn: 她实际上掌控着这间办公室。

senses.gloss_en: right or appropriate, following rules or standards
senses.example_en: Use the proper form and sign your name.
senses.example_cn: 用正确的表格，然后签上你的名字。

senses.gloss_en: socially acceptable, polite
senses.example_en: It is not proper to laugh at people.
senses.example_cn: 嘲笑别人是不得体的。

senses.gloss_en: real and satisfactory, not small or simple
senses.example_en: I need a proper meal after work.
senses.example_cn: 下班以后我得吃一顿像样的饭。

senses.gloss_en: useful and easy, not causing problems
senses.example_en: It is convenient to pay by card.
senses.example_cn: 刷卡付款很方便。

senses.gloss_en: near to a place, easy to get to
senses.example_en: The hotel is convenient to the station.
senses.example_cn: 这家酒店离车站很近。

senses.gloss_en: working by itself, with little human control
senses.example_en: The car has automatic lights at night.
senses.example_cn: 这辆车夜里有自动车灯。

senses.gloss_en: done without thinking, by habit
senses.example_en: His reply was automatic, he did not think.
senses.example_cn: 他的回答是下意识的，根本没想。

senses.gloss_en: always happening because of a rule or situation
senses.example_en: A fine is automatic after that mistake.
senses.example_cn: 犯了那个错之后，罚款是必然的。

senses.gloss_en: Happening now, of the present time
senses.example_en: I like my current job in Kuala Lumpur.
senses.example_cn: 我喜欢我现在在吉隆坡的工作。

senses.gloss_en: Movement of water or air in one direction
senses.example_en: The boat moved fast with the current.
senses.example_cn: 船在水流的推动下行驶得很快。

senses.gloss_en: Flow of electricity through a wire
senses.example_en: Turn off the current before you change bulbs.
senses.example_cn: 换灯泡前请关掉电源。

senses.gloss_en: Happening or done without delay
senses.example_en: We need immediate help after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故发生后，我们需要立即的救助。

senses.gloss_en: Closely related to you, like parents or children
senses.example_en: My immediate family lives near my house.
senses.example_cn: 我的直系亲属都住在我家附近。

senses.gloss_en: In the present, or very soon
senses.example_en: We have no immediate plans for a move.
senses.example_cn: 我们近期没有搬家的打算。

senses.gloss_en: Expected to happen or arrive at a time
senses.example_en: The bus is due at six o'clock.
senses.example_cn: 公交车预计六点到。

senses.gloss_en: Owed, deserved as a right
senses.example_en: Our thanks are due to the staff.
senses.example_cn: 我们应该好好感谢这些工作人员。

senses.gloss_en: Caused by something, because of something
senses.example_en: The delay was due to heavy rain.
senses.example_cn: 这次延误是因为大雨。

senses.gloss_en: Believed likely to happen or arrive
senses.example_en: An expected message came this morning.
senses.example_cn: 一条早就料到会来的消息今天早上到了。

senses.gloss_en: Believed to be what should happen
senses.example_en: Polite words are expected in this class.
senses.example_cn: 这门课上大家说话应该有礼貌。

senses.gloss_en: Happening quickly and without warning
senses.example_en: A sudden storm stopped our walk.
senses.example_cn: 一场突如其来的暴风雨打断了我们的散步。

senses.gloss_en: Continuing without stopping or being interrupted
senses.example_en: I hear a continuous noise from the fan.
senses.example_cn: 我听到风扇发出持续不断的噪音。

senses.gloss_en: Happening again and again
senses.example_en: He ignored repeated calls from me all week.
senses.example_cn: 他一整个星期都无视我一再打来的电话。

senses.gloss_en: Broadcast while the event is happening
senses.example_en: We watched a live show on TV tonight.
senses.example_cn: 我们今晚在电视上看了一场直播节目。

senses.gloss_en: Broadcast at the time an event happens
senses.example_en: They reported live from the street during the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨中他们从街上做现场直播报道。

senses.gloss_en: Played or recorded at an actual performance
senses.example_en: The band played live at the small club.
senses.example_cn: 那支乐队在小酒吧现场演出。

senses.gloss_en: Important in history, likely to be remembered
senses.example_en: It was a historic day for our country.
senses.example_cn: 那对我们国家来说是具有历史意义的一天。

senses.gloss_en: Very old and important, about a building or place
senses.example_en: We toured a historic house near the river.
senses.example_cn: 我们参观了河边一座历史悠久的老宅。

senses.gloss_en: Connected with history or the study of the past
senses.example_en: She reads historical books about art and war.
senses.example_cn: 她读关于艺术和战争的历史书。

senses.gloss_en: Based on real events in the past
senses.example_en: The film tells a historical story about a king.
senses.example_cn: 这部电影讲了一个关于国王的真实历史故事。

senses.gloss_en: From the past, used to compare with now
senses.example_en: We checked historical prices from the last ten years.
senses.example_cn: 我们查了过去十年的历史价格。

senses.gloss_en: having a particular color or different colors
senses.example_en: The room had colored lights all night.
senses.example_cn: 那间屋子整晚都亮着彩灯。

senses.gloss_en: having a particular color or different colors
senses.example_en: She bought colored paper for the project.
senses.example_cn: 她为这个项目买了彩色的纸。

senses.gloss_en: old-fashioned offensive word for a person with dark skin
senses.example_en: The sign said colored, a word now offensive.
senses.gloss_cn: 有色人种（旧时说法，带侮辱性）
senses.example_cn: 牌子上写着“有色人种”，这个词现在是带侮辱性的。

senses.gloss_en: having very light skin or less color than usual
senses.example_en: After the run, his face looked pale.
senses.example_cn: 跑完之后，他的脸色发白。

senses.gloss_en: light in color, not bright or strong
senses.example_en: She wore a pale blue shirt today.
senses.example_cn: 她今天穿了一件浅蓝色的衬衫。

senses.gloss_en: weak, not as good as the real thing
senses.example_en: This copy is a pale imitation of it.
senses.example_cn: 这份复制品不过是原版的拙劣模仿。

senses.gloss_en: having a thin edge or point, able to cut
senses.example_en: This sharp knife can cut tomatoes easily.
senses.example_cn: 这把锋利的刀能轻松切番茄。

senses.gloss_en: sudden and very large, a change or increase
senses.example_en: There was a sharp rise in rent last month.
senses.example_cn: 上个月租金大幅上涨。

senses.gloss_en: severe and not gentle, often in speech
senses.example_en: He gave me sharp criticism after my mistake.
senses.example_cn: 我出错后，他给了我尖刻的批评。

senses.gloss_en: Good physical health and strength
senses.example_en: Running every day improved my fitness and sleep.
senses.example_cn: 每天跑步改善了体力和睡眠。

senses.gloss_en: Suitability for a purpose or job
senses.example_en: Her fitness for the job is not in question.
senses.example_cn: 她胜任这份工作没有问题。

senses.gloss_en: Physical power to lift, push, or pull
senses.example_en: She used all her strength to lift it.
senses.example_cn: 她用尽全身力气才把它举起来。

senses.gloss_en: Ability of a thing to resist damage or breaking
senses.example_en: The bridge has enough strength to hold trucks.
senses.example_cn: 这座桥的强度足以承受卡车。

senses.gloss_en: A good quality or ability in a person
senses.example_en: Patience is his greatest strength at work.
senses.example_cn: 耐心是他工作中最大的长处。

senses.gloss_en: Something done to cure illness or improve appearance
senses.example_en: The doctor changed my treatment for the flu.
senses.example_cn: 医生给我换了治流感的疗法。

senses.gloss_en: The way you behave toward someone
senses.example_en: He complained about unfair treatment at the office.
senses.example_cn: 他抱怨在办公室受到不公平的对待。

senses.gloss_en: A process that improves something, like water
senses.example_en: The water treatment made it safe to drink.
senses.example_cn: 经过处理，这些水就能安全饮用了。

senses.gloss_en: A change that shows you may be ill
senses.example_en: Fever is a symptom of the flu.
senses.example_cn: 发烧是流感的一个症状。

senses.gloss_en: A sign that a problem exists
senses.example_en: High prices are a symptom of low supply.
senses.example_cn: 价格高是供应不足的一个征兆。

senses.gloss_en: A medical procedure to repair or remove body parts
senses.example_en: He had an operation on his knee last year.
senses.example_cn: 他去年做了膝盖手术。

senses.gloss_en: The way a machine or system works
senses.example_en: The machine is in operation so stay back.
senses.example_cn: 机器正在运转，请退后。

senses.gloss_en: A planned activity to achieve something
senses.example_en: The rescue operation saved three people in the river.
senses.example_cn: 那次救援行动从河里救出了三个人。

senses.gloss_en: The act of taking air in and out
senses.example_en: Slow breathing helped me relax before sleep.
senses.example_cn: 缓慢的呼吸帮助我在睡前放松下来。

senses.gloss_en: Air that goes in and out of your lungs
senses.example_en: Cold air made my breath look like smoke.
senses.example_cn: 冷空气让他的呼吸变成了一团白雾。

senses.gloss_en: One act of breathing, one intake of air
senses.example_en: Take one deep breath then open the door.
senses.example_cn: 深呼吸一次，然后开门。

senses.gloss_en: Smell from your mouth when you breathe out
senses.example_en: His breath smelled of garlic after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 他晚饭后嘴里有股大蒜味。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to see
senses.example_en: Her sight got worse after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故之后她的视力变差了。

senses.gloss_en: the act of seeing or looking
senses.example_en: At the sight of smoke, we ran outside.
senses.example_cn: 一看到烟我们就跑了出去。

senses.gloss_en: a thing you see, often impressive or unusual
senses.example_en: The old ship was a strange sight.
senses.example_cn: 那艘旧船是一个奇特的景象。

senses.gloss_en: the front part of the body, between neck and stomach
senses.example_en: He held the box close to his chest.
senses.example_cn: 他把箱子紧紧抱在胸前。

senses.gloss_en: a large strong box for storing or moving things
senses.example_en: She packed clothes in a wooden chest.
senses.example_cn: 她把衣服装进一只木箱里。

senses.gloss_en: the passage in the neck, used for food and air
senses.example_en: My throat hurt after I shouted all day.
senses.example_cn: 喊了一整天后我的嗓子疼。

senses.gloss_en: the soft part in your mouth for tasting and speaking
senses.example_en: He burned his tongue on hot soup.
senses.example_cn: 他被热汤烫伤了舌头。

senses.gloss_en: a language, especially one you speak
senses.example_en: Spanish is her first tongue at home.
senses.example_cn: 在家里她讲的是西班牙语。

senses.gloss_en: the tongue of an animal, used as food
senses.example_en: They served tongue with rice at dinner.
senses.example_cn: 他们晚餐吃了配上米饭的牛舌。

senses.gloss_en: one of the two soft edges around your mouth
senses.example_en: She bit her lip and looked away.
senses.example_cn: 她咬着嘴唇转过头去。

senses.gloss_en: the edge of a container or a hole
senses.example_en: Coffee spilled over the lip of the cup.
senses.example_cn: 咖啡从杯沿溢了出来。

senses.gloss_en: one of the five parts at the end of your foot
senses.example_en: These tight shoes hurt my toes all day.
senses.example_cn: 这双鞋太紧了，磨得我脚趾疼。

senses.gloss_en: the front part of a sock or shoe
senses.example_en: There is a hole in the toe of my sock.
senses.example_cn: 我袜子脚尖处破了一个洞。

senses.gloss_en: a body tissue that tightens to produce movement
senses.example_en: A sore muscle made it hard to walk.
senses.example_cn: 一块酸痛的肌肉让他走路都很困难。

senses.gloss_en: physical strength, especially for hard work
senses.example_en: You need muscle to move this table.
senses.example_cn: 搬动这张桌子需要力气。

senses.gloss_en: power to make people do what you want
senses.example_en: The group used muscle to change the plan.
senses.example_cn: 那个团体用势力改变了计划。

senses.gloss_en: a thin metal tool for sewing with thread
senses.example_en: She used a needle to sew a button.
senses.example_cn: 她用针缝了一颗纽扣。

senses.gloss_en: a thin hollow tube, used to put medicine into the body
senses.example_en: The nurse used a needle to give a shot.
senses.example_cn: 护士用针头给我打了针。

senses.gloss_en: a long thin leaf on a pine tree
senses.example_en: A pine needle fell on my jacket.
senses.example_cn: 一根松针落在了我的夹克上。

senses.gloss_en: a substance that can kill or make you sick
senses.example_en: Rat poison can make a cat very sick.
senses.example_cn: 老鼠药能让猫病得很重。

senses.gloss_en: to kill or harm someone by giving them poison
senses.example_en: Someone poisoned the dog by putting poison in its food.
senses.example_cn: 有人在狗的食物里下毒，把它毒死了。

senses.gloss_en: to put poison or harmful chemicals into food or water
senses.example_en: The factory poisoned the river with dirty waste.
senses.gloss_cn: 污染（把毒物排进水或食物）
senses.example_cn: 那家工厂把污水排进河里，污染了河水。

senses.gloss_en: Sudden shaking of the ground
senses.example_en: An earthquake shook the city during the night.
senses.example_cn: 夜里一场地震摇动了这座城市。

senses.gloss_en: Violent storm with very strong winds
senses.example_en: A hurricane hit the coast and trees fell.
senses.example_cn: 飓风袭击了海岸，树都倒了。

senses.gloss_en: Large water covering land that is usually dry
senses.example_en: Heavy rain caused a flood in our town.
senses.example_cn: 大雨在我们镇上引发了洪水。

senses.gloss_en: Cover a place with water, often causing damage
senses.example_en: The river flooded the road after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨过后，河水淹没了道路。

senses.gloss_en: Fill a place with a lot of something
senses.example_en: People flooded the store after the big sale.
senses.example_cn: 大甩卖后，人们涌进了商店。

senses.gloss_en: Land along the side of a river
senses.example_en: We sat on the bank and watched the river.
senses.example_cn: 我们坐在河岸上看河水。

senses.gloss_en: Outside or top layer of something
senses.example_en: The table surface was smooth and clean.
senses.example_cn: 桌面又光滑又干净。

senses.gloss_en: Top of land, water, or the ground
senses.example_en: The boat stayed on the surface of the water.
senses.example_cn: 那条船一直浮在水面上。

senses.gloss_en: Outward appearance, not the real feelings
senses.example_en: On the surface, he seemed calm and happy.
senses.gloss_cn: 表面上（指外在表现而非真实感受）
senses.example_cn: 表面上看他显得很镇定快乐。

senses.gloss_en: Top layer of earth where plants grow
senses.example_en: These flowers grow well in rich soil.
senses.example_cn: 这些花在肥沃的土壤里长得很好。

senses.gloss_en: A country, or land you belong to
senses.example_en: He competed on foreign soil for the first time.
senses.example_cn: 他首次在海外参赛。

senses.gloss_en: Wet earth mixed with water, soft and sticky
senses.example_en: My shoes were covered in mud after the rain.
senses.example_cn: 下雨过后我的鞋上全是泥。

senses.gloss_en: very small grains of rock, on beaches or in deserts
senses.example_en: The kids played in the sand near the water.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们在水边的沙子上玩。

senses.gloss_en: dust, mud, or other matter that makes things dirty
senses.example_en: There was dirt on my shoes after the walk.
senses.example_cn: 走完路后我鞋子上全是泥。

senses.gloss_en: soil on the ground, especially when loose
senses.example_en: Put the plant in dirt and add water.
senses.example_cn: 把植物种到土里，再浇上水。

senses.gloss_en: unpleasant facts about someone, used to harm them
senses.example_en: He tried to find dirt on his boss online.
senses.gloss_cn: 丑闻（指用来损害他人的黑料）
senses.example_cn: 他试图在网上搜集老板的黑料。

senses.gloss_en: a small hard part of a plant that can grow
senses.example_en: I planted a seed in a pot yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 我昨天在花盆里种了一粒种子。

senses.gloss_en: the beginning of something that later develops
senses.example_en: That talk planted the seed of a new idea.
senses.example_cn: 那次谈话播下了一个新想法的种子。

senses.gloss_en: a flat green part of a plant
senses.example_en: A leaf fell from the tree onto my bag.
senses.example_cn: 一片叶子从树上落到我的包上。

senses.gloss_en: a sheet of paper in a book, a page
senses.example_en: He turned each leaf and read the story.
senses.example_cn: 他一页一页地翻着读故事。

senses.gloss_en: an extra part added to a table to make it longer
senses.example_en: We added a leaf to make the table longer.
senses.example_cn: 我们加了一块活页板，把桌子加长了。

senses.gloss_en: the hard outer covering of eggs, nuts, or animals
senses.example_en: I found a shell on the beach this morning.
senses.example_cn: 今天早上我在海滩上捡到了一个贝壳。

senses.gloss_en: the outside part of something, with little inside
senses.example_en: After the fire, the house was a shell.
senses.example_cn: 火灾过后，那所房子只剩下一具空壳。

senses.gloss_en: a small ball of air or gas in liquid
senses.example_en: Bubbles rose in the water as it boiled.
senses.example_cn: 水烧开的时候冒出了气泡。

senses.gloss_en: a light ball of air in a thin soap film
senses.example_en: She blew a bubble and it floated away.
senses.example_cn: 她吹出一个泡泡，泡泡飘走了。

senses.gloss_en: a small feeling that suddenly rises inside you
senses.example_en: A bubble of hope rose when he smiled.
senses.example_cn: 他一笑，我心里就涌起一丝希望。

senses.gloss_en: a kind of material, solid, liquid, or gas
senses.example_en: This substance is a thick liquid that smells sweet.
senses.example_cn: 这种物质是一种闻起来很甜的黏稠液体。

senses.gloss_en: an illegal drug, controlled by law
senses.example_en: Police found an illegal substance in his bag at work.
senses.example_cn: 警察在他上班时的包里发现了违禁药物。

senses.gloss_en: A hard black mineral burned for heat or power
senses.example_en: We heat the house with coal in winter.
senses.example_cn: 冬天我们烧煤给房子取暖。

senses.gloss_en: A piece of coal, usually burning and very hot
senses.example_en: The fire still had red coals under the ash.
senses.example_cn: 灰底下还有烧红的煤块。

senses.gloss_en: A substance like coal, gas, or oil burned for energy
senses.example_en: Coal and gas are common fuel in many homes.
senses.example_cn: 煤和天然气是很多家庭常用的燃料。

senses.gloss_en: To put fuel into a vehicle or machine
senses.example_en: We fueled the car before the long trip.
senses.gloss_cn: 加油（指给车辆或机械添加燃料）
senses.example_cn: 长途旅行前我们给车加了油。

senses.gloss_en: To make a feeling or problem grow stronger
senses.example_en: The rumors fueled fear in the town.
senses.gloss_cn: 助长（指使情绪或问题加剧）
senses.example_cn: 谣言加剧了城镇里的恐慌情绪。

senses.gloss_en: Cloth made from fibers from the cotton plant
senses.example_en: I like cotton shirts because they feel light.
senses.example_cn: 我喜欢棉布衬衫，因为穿起来很轻。

senses.gloss_en: A plant grown for its soft fibers
senses.example_en: Cotton grows well in warm and dry places.
senses.example_cn: 棉花在温暖干燥的地方长得好。

senses.gloss_en: Thread used for sewing, often made from cotton
senses.example_en: I need cotton thread to fix this shirt.
senses.example_cn: 我需要棉线来缝这件衬衫。

senses.gloss_en: The thick hair of a sheep or similar animal
senses.example_en: Sheep give wool every year on the farm.
senses.example_cn: 农场上的羊每年都产羊毛。

senses.gloss_en: Cloth or material made from wool
senses.example_en: This sweater is wool, so it feels warm.
senses.example_cn: 这件毛衣是羊毛的，所以穿着很暖。

senses.gloss_en: Animal skin treated for shoes, bags, and other things
senses.example_en: He bought a leather belt at the market.
senses.example_cn: 他在市场上买了一条皮带。

senses.gloss_en: animal skin treated in order to preserve it, and used to make shoes, bags, clothes, and equipment
senses.example_en: She wore a leather jacket when she rode her motorcycle.
senses.example_cn: 她骑摩托车时穿了一件皮夹克。

senses.gloss_en: A very hard clear stone used in jewelry
senses.example_en: She wore a diamond ring at the wedding.
senses.example_cn: 她在婚礼上戴了一枚钻石戒指。

senses.gloss_en: A shape with four equal sides, like ♦
senses.example_en: Draw a diamond on the paper with a pencil.
senses.example_cn: 用铅笔画一个菱形在纸上。

senses.gloss_en: The suit with red diamond symbols in playing cards
senses.example_en: He played the queen of diamonds and smiled.
senses.example_cn: 他打出了方块王后，然后笑了。

senses.gloss_en: The mixture of gases around the earth
senses.example_en: Smoke can pollute the atmosphere around big cities.
senses.example_cn: 烟雾会污染大城市周围的大气。

senses.gloss_en: The air in a room or place
senses.example_en: The kitchen had a warm and smoky atmosphere.
senses.example_cn: 厨房里有一股温热带烟的空气。

senses.gloss_en: The feeling in a place or situation
senses.example_en: The office had a relaxed atmosphere all day.
senses.example_cn: 办公室一整天都是轻松的氛围。

senses.gloss_en: A bad use of time, money, or energy
senses.example_en: Leaving lights on is a waste of energy.
senses.example_cn: 开着灯不关是浪费电。

senses.gloss_en: Unwanted material that is thrown away
senses.example_en: Please put the waste in the bin now.
senses.example_cn: 请现在把垃圾扔进桶里。

senses.gloss_en: To use time, money, or things carelessly
senses.example_en: Don't waste water when you wash your hands.
senses.example_cn: 洗手的时候别浪费水。

senses.gloss_en: Flying insect that can sting and make honey
senses.example_en: A bee landed on my hand and stung me.
senses.example_cn: 一只蜜蜂落在我手上，把我蛰了。

senses.gloss_en: Thick hair covering some animals
senses.example_en: The cat's fur was soft and warm today.
senses.example_cn: 今天猫的毛又软又暖。

senses.gloss_en: Animal skin with fur, used for clothing
senses.example_en: She wore a fur coat in the cold wind.
senses.example_cn: 在冷风里她穿了一件皮毛大衣。

senses.gloss_en: Part at the back of an animal's body
senses.example_en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
senses.example_cn: 我一回家，狗就摇起了尾巴。

senses.gloss_en: Back part of a plane or other long thing
senses.example_en: The plane's tail was damaged in the storm.
senses.example_cn: 飞机的尾部在暴风雨中受损了。

senses.gloss_en: Last part of a line, group, or period
senses.example_en: I stood at the tail of the line today.
senses.gloss_cn: 尾部（指队伍或队列的末尾）
senses.example_cn: 我排在队伍的末尾。

senses.gloss_en: Flat part on a plane that helps it fly
senses.example_en: The plane lost a wing and fell fast.
senses.example_cn: 飞机掉了一只机翼，很快就坠落了。

senses.gloss_en: Part of a bird or insect used for flying
senses.example_en: The bird hurt its wing and could not fly.
senses.example_cn: 这只鸟翅膀伤了，飞不起来。

senses.gloss_en: Part of a large building that sticks out
senses.example_en: The patient stayed in the west wing overnight.
senses.example_cn: 那位病人在西侧楼住了一晚。

senses.gloss_en: Chase wild animals to catch or kill them
senses.example_en: They hunt deer in the forest each fall.
senses.example_cn: 每年秋天他们都到林子里猎鹿。

senses.gloss_en: Search carefully for something hard to find
senses.example_en: I hunt for my keys every morning.
senses.example_cn: 我每天早上都要找钥匙。

senses.gloss_en: Search for someone or something difficult to find
senses.example_en: The hunt for a taxi took an hour.
senses.example_cn: 打车找了整整一小时。

senses.gloss_en: as you would expect, of course
senses.example_en: Naturally, I felt nervous before the test.
senses.example_cn: 考试前我当然会紧张。

senses.gloss_en: without special help or treatment
senses.example_en: The cut healed naturally without medicine.
senses.example_cn: 伤口没用药就自然愈合了。

senses.gloss_en: as a normal result of something
senses.example_en: Naturally, prices rise when demand is high.
senses.example_cn: 需求高时，价格自然会上涨。

senses.gloss_en: in the correct way, satisfactorily
senses.example_en: The door will not close properly now.
senses.example_cn: 这门现在关不严实了。

senses.gloss_en: in a socially acceptable way
senses.example_en: Please behave properly at the meeting today.
senses.example_cn: 今天开会时请举止得体。

senses.gloss_en: in a way that works well
senses.example_en: She managed the team effectively under pressure.
senses.example_cn: 她在压力下把团队带得很有成效。

senses.gloss_en: in reality, in fact
senses.example_en: The rule effectively banned all late arrivals.
senses.example_cn: 这条规定实际上禁止了任何迟到。

senses.gloss_en: in a way that achieves what you want
senses.example_en: They successfully fixed the problem before noon.
senses.example_cn: 他们中午之前就成功解决了问题。

senses.gloss_en: only, just, no more
senses.example_en: Simply add water and stir for two minutes.
senses.example_cn: 只需加水，再搅拌两分钟。

senses.gloss_en: in a simple way, easy to understand
senses.example_en: Explain it simply, with short words.
senses.example_cn: 用简短的词，讲得简单一点。

senses.gloss_en: used to emphasize a statement
senses.example_en: I simply cannot agree with that plan.
senses.example_cn: 那个计划我简直无法同意。

senses.gloss_en: without stopping, in a straight line
senses.example_en: He drove directly to the station after work.
senses.example_cn: 下班后他直接开车去了车站。

senses.gloss_en: with no person or thing between
senses.example_en: Please email me directly, not through your friend.
senses.example_cn: 请直接给我发邮件，不要通过你朋友转。

senses.gloss_en: exactly or immediately after, behind, or opposite
senses.example_en: She sat directly opposite me during lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭时她就坐在我正对面。

senses.gloss_en: for one particular purpose
senses.example_en: This tool is made specifically for beginners.
senses.example_cn: 这个工具是专门为初学者做的。

senses.gloss_en: clearly and exactly, in detail
senses.example_en: I asked specifically about the price and taxes.
senses.example_cn: 我明确问了价格和税费。

senses.gloss_en: used to make something more exact
senses.example_en: I spoke to the manager, specifically the night manager.
senses.example_cn: 我跟经理谈过，确切地说是夜班经理。

senses.gloss_en: by machine, without human control
senses.example_en: The doors open automatically when you press the button.
senses.example_cn: 你一按按钮，门就自动打开。

senses.gloss_en: without thinking, by habit
senses.example_en: I automatically said yes and then regretted it.
senses.example_cn: 我不由自主地答应了，之后就后悔了。

senses.gloss_en: as a result of a rule or situation
senses.example_en: You automatically get a refund if it breaks.
senses.example_cn: 如果坏了，你自动就能得到退款。

senses.gloss_en: To a very high degree
senses.example_en: This test is highly difficult for new students.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这个测试对新学生来说非常难。

senses.gloss_en: At a high level
senses.example_en: She is a highly paid worker in my city.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 在我们城市，她是个高薪的员工。

senses.gloss_en: With a very good opinion
senses.example_en: I speak highly of my teacher every day.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我天天都对我的老师赞不绝口。

senses.gloss_en: In a way that is hard to break
senses.example_en: The door was strongly built, so it stayed safe.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这扇门造得很坚固，所以很安全。

senses.gloss_en: Very much, with strong feelings
senses.example_en: I strongly disagree with that plan for tomorrow.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我强烈反对明天那个计划。

senses.gloss_en: Firmly, tightly, not easily moved
senses.example_en: Hold the rope strongly and do not let go.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 用力抓住绳子，别松手。

senses.gloss_en: Completely, in every way
senses.example_en: The answer is perfectly clear to me now.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 现在这个答案我完全清楚了。

senses.gloss_en: In a perfect way, without mistakes
senses.example_en: She danced perfectly during the show last night.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 昨晚演出时她跳得非常完美。

senses.gloss_en: Exactly, with no movement
senses.example_en: Please stand perfectly still and look at me.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 请一动不动地站着，看着我。

senses.gloss_en: In a serious way, not joking
senses.example_en: Are you seriously saying you will quit today?
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 你是认真的吗？今天就要辞职？

senses.gloss_en: Very badly or to a great degree
senses.example_en: He was seriously hurt in the crash last week.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 他上周在车祸中受了重伤。

senses.gloss_en: Used to show surprise or doubt
senses.example_en: Seriously, you forgot your phone again today?
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.gloss_cn: 不是吧（表示惊讶或怀疑）
senses.example_cn: 不是吧，你今天又把手机忘了？

senses.gloss_en: Completely, with no doubt
senses.example_en: I am absolutely sure the door is locked.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我完全确定门锁好了。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize a strong word
senses.example_en: That noise is absolutely terrible in this room.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这个房间里的噪音简直糟透了。

senses.gloss_en: A strong way to say yes
senses.example_en: Do you want to go? Absolutely, I want to go.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 你想去吗？当然想去。

senses.gloss_en: Completely, in every way
senses.example_en: The two rooms are totally different in size.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这两个房间的大小完全不一样。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize how strong something is
senses.example_en: This idea is totally crazy, I can't accept it.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这个主意简直太离谱了，我没法接受。

senses.gloss_en: Used to emphasize agreement or disagreement
senses.example_en: I totally agree with you about that movie.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 关于那部电影，我完全同意你的看法。

senses.gloss_en: Extremely, to a very high degree
senses.example_en: The view was incredibly beautiful from the hill.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 从山上望去，景色美极了。

senses.gloss_en: To some extent, but not very
senses.example_en: The test was fairly easy for most students.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这次考试对大多数学生来说还算容易。

senses.gloss_en: In a fair way, without bias
senses.example_en: The judge listened fairly to both sides today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 法官今天公平地听取了双方的说法。

senses.gloss_en: A little, to a small degree
senses.example_en: I feel slightly tired after the trip today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 今天出门回来，我觉得稍微有点累。

senses.gloss_en: To the same degree, just as much
senses.example_en: Both jobs are equally hard for me right now.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这两份工作对我来说一样难。

senses.gloss_en: In equal parts or amounts
senses.example_en: She shared the money equally among the four children.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 她把钱平均分给了四个孩子。

senses.gloss_en: Used to add another similar point
senses.example_en: Equally, we need time to rest each day.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 同样，我们每天也需要时间休息。

senses.gloss_en: Mostly, more than anything else
senses.example_en: I mainly watch movies at home on weekends.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 周末我主要在家看电影。

senses.gloss_en: Especially, more than usual or others
senses.example_en: I particularly like this soup in winter.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我冬天特别爱喝这种汤。

senses.gloss_en: Used with not to mean not very
senses.example_en: The movie was not particularly good for me.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这部电影我觉得不太好看。

senses.gloss_en: A lot, to a great degree
senses.example_en: It rained heavily all afternoon in the city.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 整个下午城里都下着大雨。

senses.gloss_en: With a lot of force or effort
senses.example_en: He pushed the door heavily with his shoulder.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 他用肩膀狠狠地推那扇门。

senses.gloss_en: In a slow, loud way when breathing
senses.example_en: After the run, she breathed heavily for minutes.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 跑完之后，她喘了好几分钟粗气。

senses.gloss_en: Almost not, only just
senses.example_en: I could hardly hear you on the phone today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 今天我在电话里几乎听不见你说话。

senses.gloss_en: Almost never
senses.example_en: We hardly ever see them during winter now.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 现在一到冬天我们几乎见不到他们。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say something is almost not true or not the case
senses.example_en: That story is hardly true at all today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 那个说法如今根本算不上是真的。

senses.gloss_en: Almost exact, but not completely correct
senses.example_en: The trip took approximately seven hours by bus.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 坐大巴这趟路大约花了七个小时。

senses.gloss_en: The money system of a country
senses.example_en: We changed currency at the airport bank.
senses.example_cn: 我们在机场的银行兑换了货币。

senses.gloss_en: General acceptance of an idea or story
senses.example_en: That story gained currency online last month.
senses.example_cn: 那种说法上个月在网上传开了。

senses.gloss_en: A small metal piece used as money
senses.example_en: I found a coin under the car seat.
senses.example_cn: 我在汽车座位下面找到一枚硬币。

senses.gloss_en: money in the form of coins, not paper bills
senses.example_en: Do you have any coins for the parking machine?
senses.example_cn: 你有硬币投停车缴费机吗？

senses.gloss_en: How much something is worth in money
senses.example_en: The value of my phone dropped last year.
senses.example_cn: 我手机的价值去年跌了。

senses.gloss_en: The importance or usefulness of something
senses.example_en: This class has value for my work.
senses.example_cn: 这门课对我的工作很有用。

senses.gloss_en: To think someone or something is important
senses.example_en: I value your time, so I start early.
senses.example_cn: 我很看重你的时间，所以我提早开始。

senses.gloss_en: An arrangement to keep money in a bank
senses.example_en: I opened an account at a local bank.
senses.example_cn: 我在当地一家银行开了个账户。

senses.gloss_en: A record of money a business receives and pays
senses.example_en: He checks the accounts before he pays anyone.
senses.example_cn: 他给别人付钱之前会先核对账目。

senses.gloss_en: A written or spoken description of an event
senses.example_en: Her account of the trip was very clear.
senses.example_cn: 她对这次旅行的描述非常清楚。

senses.gloss_en: The act of paying money
senses.example_en: Payment is due on Friday, not on Monday.
senses.example_cn: 付款期限是周五，不是周一。

senses.gloss_en: An amount of money that you pay
senses.example_en: My car payment is $200 each month.
senses.example_cn: 我每个月要付两百美元的车款。

senses.gloss_en: The money asked for a service or item
senses.example_en: There is a small charge for delivery today.
senses.example_cn: 今天送货要收一点费用。

senses.gloss_en: To ask someone to pay a price
senses.example_en: They charge me $5 for delivery.
senses.example_cn: 他们送货向我收五美元。

senses.gloss_en: To officially say someone did a crime
senses.example_en: Police charged him with theft, and he left.
senses.example_cn: 警方指控他盗窃，然后他就走了。

senses.gloss_en: a paper or email that proves you paid
senses.example_en: Keep the receipt after you pay for dinner.
senses.example_cn: 付了饭钱以后把收据留着。

senses.gloss_en: the act of receiving something
senses.example_en: We will ship on receipt of your payment.
senses.example_cn: 我们收到您的付款后就发货。

senses.gloss_en: money a business receives in a period
senses.example_en: Ticket receipts rose during the summer festival.
senses.gloss_cn: 进账（一段时间的营业收入）
senses.example_cn: 夏季音乐节期间，售票收入涨了。

senses.gloss_en: money used by a person, group, or government
senses.example_en: Government spending on health increased this year.
senses.example_cn: 政府今年在医疗上的开支增加了。

senses.gloss_en: money made after costs are paid
senses.example_en: The shop made a profit after paying costs.
senses.example_cn: 那家店付清成本后赚到了利润。

senses.gloss_en: an advantage you get from something
senses.example_en: There is profit in learning English every day.
senses.example_cn: 每天学英语是有好处的。

senses.gloss_en: the fact of no longer having something
senses.example_en: The loss of my phone ruined my day.
senses.example_cn: 手机丢了，把我一天都毁了。

senses.gloss_en: money lost in a business or deal
senses.example_en: The company reported a loss last year.
senses.example_cn: 那家公司去年报出了亏损。

senses.gloss_en: sadness when someone dies
senses.example_en: Her loss was hard for the whole family.
senses.example_cn: 她的去世让全家人都很难过。

senses.gloss_en: things that belong to a person or group
senses.example_en: Do not touch my property, please.
senses.example_cn: 请不要动我的东西。

senses.gloss_en: land or buildings that someone owns
senses.example_en: They bought property near the beach last year.
senses.example_cn: 他们去年在海边买了房产。

senses.gloss_en: a quality that something naturally has
senses.example_en: Water has the property of freezing at zero.
senses.example_cn: 水有零度结冰的特性。

senses.gloss_en: money you pay regularly to use a home
senses.example_en: I pay rent on the first of each month.
senses.example_cn: 我每月一号交房租。

senses.gloss_en: pay money regularly to use a house or room
senses.example_en: We rent a studio near the train station.
senses.example_cn: 我们在火车站附近租了一间单间公寓。

senses.gloss_en: let someone use your property for money
senses.example_en: They rent their extra room to students.
senses.example_cn: 他们把多余的房间出租给学生。

senses.gloss_en: A country and its people under one government
senses.example_en: The nation voted in May for a new leader.
senses.example_cn: 这个国家五月投票选出了新领导人。

senses.gloss_en: All the people of a country
senses.example_en: The president spoke to the nation on television tonight.
senses.example_cn: 总统今晚在电视上向全国人民讲话。

senses.gloss_en: A group with shared language, culture, and history
senses.example_en: The Jewish nation has a long history and culture.
senses.example_cn: 犹太民族有着悠久的历史和文化。

senses.gloss_en: Activities of government and power in public life
senses.example_en: She studies politics and votes in every election.
senses.example_cn: 她学政治，每次选举都去投票。

senses.gloss_en: Ideas and beliefs about how a country is governed
senses.example_en: His politics are different from mine at home.
senses.example_cn: 他的政治观点在家里和我不一样。

senses.gloss_en: Arguments in a group about power and decisions
senses.example_en: Office politics made the meeting tense all day.
senses.example_cn: 办公室里的权力斗争让整天的会都很紧张。

senses.gloss_en: A person whose job involves politics and government
senses.example_en: The politician spoke about schools and health care.
senses.example_cn: 这位政治家谈到了学校和医疗。

senses.gloss_en: A person who is good at using different situations in an organization to get power or advantage
senses.example_en: Some called him a politician, not a true leader.
senses.example_cn: 有人说他是个玩弄权术的人，不是真正的领袖。

senses.gloss_en: An official plan of action by a group
senses.example_en: The new policy reduced taxes for small businesses.
senses.example_cn: 新政策为小企业减了税。

senses.gloss_en: A rule or set of rules in an organization
senses.example_en: Company policy requires badges at the front desk.
senses.example_cn: 公司规定在前台要出示工牌。

senses.gloss_en: A time when people vote to choose a leader
senses.example_en: The election will be in May, after the debates.
senses.example_cn: 选举将在辩论之后的五月举行。

senses.gloss_en: The process of choosing someone by voting
senses.example_en: Fair election rules protect every voter in the nation.
senses.example_cn: 公正的选举规则保护全国每一位选民。

senses.gloss_en: A person trying to be elected or get a job
senses.example_en: Each candidate answered questions during the public debate.
senses.example_cn: 每位候选人都在公开辩论中回答了提问。

senses.gloss_en: A person likely to get a job, prize, or role
senses.example_en: She is a strong candidate for the manager role.
senses.example_cn: 她是经理这个职位的有力人选。

senses.gloss_en: A planned series of actions to reach a goal
senses.example_en: The campaign raised money for clean water in town.
senses.gloss_cn: 运动，有计划的一系列行动
senses.example_cn: 这场运动为镇上的干净饮水筹到了钱。

senses.gloss_en: Activities to win an election for a candidate
senses.example_en: Her election campaign lasted six weeks in spring.
senses.example_cn: 她的竞选活动在春天持续了六周。

senses.gloss_en: Work in an organized way for change or votes
senses.example_en: They campaign for safer roads in every city.
senses.example_cn: 他们在每座城市为道路更安全而奔走。

senses.gloss_en: Choose someone or something in an election or meeting
senses.example_en: We vote for the new leader this year.
senses.example_cn: 今年我们投票选新领导。

senses.gloss_en: Decide something together by voting
senses.example_en: They vote to close the store at noon.
senses.example_cn: 他们表决决定中午关店。

senses.gloss_en: A formal choice made in an election or meeting
senses.example_en: Her vote changed the plan at the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 她那一票在会上改变了计划。

senses.gloss_en: The power to control, give orders, or make decisions
senses.example_en: The teacher has authority in the classroom.
senses.example_cn: 老师在课堂上有权威。

senses.gloss_en: A government group responsible for a service or area
senses.example_en: The local authority fixed the road after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后当地部门修好了路。

senses.gloss_en: A person with expert knowledge on a subject
senses.example_en: She is an authority on road safety rules.
senses.example_cn: 她是道路安全规则方面的权威。

senses.gloss_en: A place where legal cases are heard and decided
senses.example_en: He went to court for the theft case.
senses.example_cn: 他因为那起盗窃案上了法院。

senses.gloss_en: The people who decide legal cases in a trial
senses.example_en: The court agreed and the trial ended.
senses.example_cn: 法庭表示同意，审判就结束了。

senses.gloss_en: An area marked for playing tennis, basketball, or other sports
senses.example_en: The kids played basketball on the outdoor court.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们在室外的球场上打篮球。

senses.gloss_en: A person in court who decides legal cases
senses.example_en: The judge read the sentence in the court.
senses.example_cn: 法官在法庭上宣读了判决。

senses.gloss_en: Form an opinion about someone or something
senses.example_en: Do not judge people by one bad day.
senses.example_cn: 不要因为一天表现不好就评判一个人。

senses.gloss_en: Decide the winner of a competition
senses.example_en: She will judge the photo contest at school.
senses.example_cn: 她将在学校担任摄影比赛的评委。

senses.gloss_en: Something done to make someone suffer for doing wrong
senses.example_en: My parents took my phone away as punishment for my mistake.
senses.example_cn: 我犯了错，父母没收了我的手机作为惩罚。

senses.gloss_en: A penalty given for breaking a law or rule
senses.example_en: The punishment for theft can be a year in prison.
senses.example_cn: 偷窃的处罚可以是一年监禁。

senses.gloss_en: An unpleasant thing that makes you suffer or feel bad
senses.example_en: That long walk in the rain felt like punishment.
senses.example_cn: 在雨里走那么远，简直像受折磨。

senses.gloss_en: A person kept in prison as punishment or for trial
senses.example_en: The prisoner waited in jail for the trial.
senses.example_cn: 那名犯人在监狱里等着受审。

senses.gloss_en: A person captured by an enemy and kept under guard
senses.example_en: The soldiers took a prisoner during the war.
senses.example_cn: 战争中士兵抓到了一名俘虏。

senses.gloss_en: A person who cannot escape a place or situation
senses.example_en: He felt like a prisoner in the small room.
senses.example_cn: 在那间小屋里，他觉得自己像个囚犯。

senses.gloss_en: The state of being safe, protected from harm or danger
senses.example_en: The child stayed close to me for safety.
senses.example_cn: 为了安全，孩子紧紧跟着我。

senses.gloss_en: The condition of not being dangerous or likely to harm
senses.example_en: We checked the safety of the water before swimming.
senses.example_cn: 下水前我们检查了这水的安全性。

senses.gloss_en: A place where you are safe from danger
senses.example_en: They ran to safety when the storm came.
senses.example_cn: 风暴来的时候他们跑到了安全的地方。

senses.gloss_en: the things done to keep someone or something safe
senses.example_en: Airport security was strict all morning.
senses.example_cn: 整个上午机场的安检都很严。

senses.gloss_en: a feeling of being safe and free from worry
senses.example_en: I felt a sense of security when I locked the door.
senses.example_cn: 锁上门以后，我有了一种安全感。

senses.gloss_en: protection from losing a job or money
senses.example_en: Job security is important for my family.
senses.example_cn: 工作有保障对我家来说很重要。

senses.gloss_en: a person whose job is to protect a place
senses.example_en: A guard stood by the gate all night.
senses.example_cn: 一名警卫在门口站了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: to protect someone or something from danger
senses.example_en: Soldiers guarded the bridge during the storm.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨期间士兵守卫着那座桥。

senses.gloss_en: to watch someone to stop them escaping
senses.example_en: Two officers guarded the prisoner in the room.
senses.example_cn: 两名警官在房间里看守着那个犯人。

senses.gloss_en: a statement or action showing strong disagreement
senses.example_en: There was a protest about the new law.
senses.example_cn: 有人对这部新法律提出了抗议。

senses.gloss_en: a meeting or march where people show disagreement
senses.example_en: The protest moved down the street slowly.
senses.example_cn: 抗议的队伍慢慢沿着街道前行。

senses.gloss_en: to show publicly that you disagree with something
senses.example_en: They protested outside the office for hours.
senses.example_cn: 他们在办公室外面抗议了好几个小时。

senses.gloss_en: money paid to the government on income or goods
senses.example_en: We pay tax on income every year.
senses.example_cn: 我们每年都要为收入交税。

senses.gloss_en: to make a person or business pay tax
senses.example_en: The city taxed fuel to fix the roads.
senses.example_cn: 市里对燃油征税，用来修路。

senses.gloss_en: to require a lot of effort or energy
senses.example_en: The long hike taxed us after lunch.
senses.example_cn: 午饭后那段长途徒步把我们累坏了。

senses.gloss_en: the line between two countries or areas
senses.example_en: We crossed the border at dawn.
senses.example_cn: 我们在天亮时越过了边界。

senses.gloss_en: the edge of something, a border around it
senses.example_en: The photo has a white border around it.
senses.example_cn: 这张照片四周有一道白边。

senses.gloss_en: to be next to and share a border with
senses.example_en: Canada borders the United States to the south.
senses.example_cn: 加拿大与美国南部接壤。

senses.gloss_en: an object used to fight or attack someone
senses.example_en: The police found the weapon in the car.
senses.example_cn: 警方在车里找到了那件武器。

senses.gloss_en: something used to harm someone, like words
senses.example_en: He used humor as a weapon in debate.
senses.example_cn: 他用幽默作为辩论的武器。

senses.gloss_en: a weapon that explodes and causes damage
senses.example_en: A bomb exploded near the station yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 昨天车站附近有一枚炸弹爆炸了。

senses.gloss_en: to attack a place by dropping or planting bombs
senses.example_en: Planes bombed the city during the war.
senses.example_cn: 战争期间飞机轰炸了这座城市。

senses.gloss_en: to fail a test or performance very badly
senses.example_en: I bombed the exam and felt awful.
senses.example_cn: 我考试考得一塌糊涂，心里特别难受。

senses.gloss_en: Sudden violent bursting, with loud noise
senses.example_en: A gas explosion damaged the kitchen wall.
senses.example_cn: 一场煤气爆炸损坏了厨房的墙。

senses.gloss_en: The act of deliberately making something explode
senses.example_en: The explosion of the bridge was planned by rebels.
senses.example_cn: 这座桥的爆破是叛军策划的。

senses.gloss_en: A sudden large increase in number or amount
senses.example_en: There was an explosion of traffic on Friday.
senses.example_cn: 周五车流量激增。

senses.gloss_en: The crime of killing someone deliberately and illegally
senses.example_en: He was found guilty of murder last year.
senses.example_cn: 他去年被判谋杀罪成立。

senses.gloss_en: Used after be to say something is very hard
senses.example_en: It's murder getting to the airport at this time.
senses.example_cn: 这个时间去机场真是件苦差事。

senses.gloss_en: To kill someone deliberately and illegally
senses.example_en: They said he murdered a man in 2019.
senses.example_cn: 他们说他在二〇一九年杀了一个人。

senses.gloss_en: An act of killing somebody deliberately
senses.example_en: The killing of civilians shocked the whole nation.
senses.example_cn: 平民遭到杀害的事震惊了全国。

senses.gloss_en: A person attacked, injured, or killed by a crime
senses.example_en: The victim was taken to the hospital.
senses.example_cn: 受害人被送去了医院。

senses.gloss_en: A person who is tricked by someone
senses.example_en: He was a victim of a phone scam.
senses.example_cn: 他是电话诈骗的受骗者。

senses.gloss_en: A person badly affected by a situation
senses.example_en: A small store became a victim of rising rents.
senses.example_cn: 一家小店成了房租上涨的牺牲品。

senses.gloss_en: A sudden serious situation needing immediate action
senses.example_en: In an emergency call the police right away.
senses.example_cn: 遇到紧急情况就马上报警。

senses.gloss_en: A statement telling you something bad may happen
senses.example_en: They gave a warning about the coming storm.
senses.example_cn: 他们就即将到来的风暴发出了警告。

senses.gloss_en: get free from a place you cannot leave
senses.example_en: Two men escaped from prison last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚有两个人越狱逃跑了。

senses.gloss_en: avoid something unpleasant or dangerous
senses.example_en: She escaped serious injury in the crash.
senses.example_cn: 她在这场车祸中幸免于重伤。

senses.gloss_en: a successful act of getting away
senses.example_en: His escape from the fire shocked everyone.
senses.example_cn: 他从那场大火中逃生，让所有人都很震惊。

senses.gloss_en: a sign or information that helps solve a problem
senses.example_en: Police found a clue near the broken window.
senses.example_cn: 警察在破了的窗户旁边发现了一条线索。

senses.gloss_en: any idea or knowledge about something, in not have a clue
senses.example_en: I have no clue where the bus goes.
senses.example_cn: 这辆公交车开到哪儿，我完全没头绪。

senses.gloss_en: a hint in a crossword or puzzle
senses.example_en: This clue is hard and I cannot answer it.
senses.example_cn: 这条提示很难，我答不出来。

senses.gloss_en: a fight between armies or groups in a war
senses.example_en: The battle lasted all night near the river.
senses.example_cn: 那场战斗在河边打了一整夜。

senses.gloss_en: a hard struggle against a problem or for something
senses.example_en: Her battle with cancer lasted three hard years.
senses.example_cn: 她与癌症抗争了三年，非常艰难。

senses.gloss_en: try very hard to deal with something difficult
senses.example_en: They battled all day to save the old house.
senses.gloss_cn: 奋力对付（指努力解决困难）
senses.example_cn: 他们整天都在奋力抢救那座老房子。

senses.gloss_en: In a way that is easy to see or understand
senses.example_en: He was obviously tired after the long walk.
senses.example_cn: 走了这么久，他明显累了。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say something is already clear to others
senses.example_en: Obviously, we cannot start without the key.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于点明大家早已清楚的事
senses.example_cn: 很显然，没有钥匙我们没法开始。

senses.gloss_en: Used to say you are almost certain something is true
senses.example_en: Surely you remember my name from yesterday?
senses.example_cn: 你想必还记得我昨天说的名字吧？

senses.gloss_en: Used to say you feel very sure something will happen
senses.example_en: She will surely finish the work on time.
senses.example_cn: 她肯定会按时完成这项工作。

senses.gloss_en: Used to show surprise, doubt, or disagreement
senses.example_en: Surely you did not say that to him?
senses.example_cn: 你难道真跟他那么说了？

senses.gloss_en: Perhaps, but not certain
senses.example_en: It will possibly rain later this afternoon.
senses.example_cn: 今天下午可能会下雨。

senses.gloss_en: Used in polite requests, especially with could
senses.example_en: Could you possibly open the window for me?
senses.gloss_cn: 用于礼貌请求，使语气更客气
senses.example_cn: 你能不能帮我把窗户打开？

senses.gloss_en: Used with can or could to emphasize that something seems impossible
senses.example_en: I cannot possibly finish this work today.
senses.gloss_cn: 与能愿动词连用，强调根本做不到
senses.example_cn: 这些活我今天怎么也做不完。

senses.gloss_en: Used in negatives to mean not always true
senses.example_en: Cheap does not necessarily mean bad quality.
senses.example_cn: 便宜并不一定就意味着质量差。

senses.gloss_en: As an expected result, unavoidably
senses.example_en: A long trip necessarily involves extra time and money.
senses.example_cn: 长途旅行必然要多花时间和钱。

senses.gloss_en: shows, movies, or activities that people enjoy
senses.example_en: We watched entertainment on TV after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们看了电视上的娱乐节目。

senses.gloss_en: something fun that is not serious
senses.example_en: The show was entertainment, not real news.
senses.example_cn: 那个节目是娱乐消遣，不是真正的新闻。

senses.gloss_en: free time, time not used for work or study
senses.example_en: I read in my leisure time on Sunday.
senses.example_cn: 星期天我在闲暇时间读书。

senses.gloss_en: the quality of giving pleasure to the senses
senses.example_en: We saw the beauty of the sunset today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天看到了日落的美。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing that is beautiful
senses.example_en: That old house is a beauty in spring.
senses.example_cn: 那座老房子到了春天真是一景。

senses.gloss_en: an excellent example of its type
senses.example_en: That goal was a beauty in the final.
senses.example_cn: 决赛里那个进球堪称精彩。

senses.gloss_en: writing, books, or plays valued as art
senses.example_en: I study literature at the local university now.
senses.example_cn: 我现在在本地的大学学文学。

senses.gloss_en: books and articles about a particular subject
senses.example_en: She read the literature on health and fitness.
senses.example_cn: 她读了关于健康和健身的文献资料。

senses.gloss_en: poems in general, a form of literature
senses.example_en: He writes poetry and reads it aloud.
senses.example_cn: 他写诗，还大声朗读出来。

senses.gloss_en: a beautiful, emotional quality in words or art
senses.example_en: Her speech had poetry and strong feeling.
senses.example_cn: 她的演讲很有诗意，也很有感情。

senses.gloss_en: a person who writes poems
senses.example_en: The poet wrote a poem for our class.
senses.example_cn: 那位诗人为我们班写了一首诗。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of writing in lines, often with rhyme
senses.example_en: I read a short poem before sleep.
senses.example_cn: 我睡前读了一首短诗。

senses.gloss_en: a story or description of events
senses.example_en: Her narrative described our long trip across town.
senses.example_cn: 她的叙述讲了我们穿城而过的那趟长途旅程。

senses.gloss_en: a particular way of explaining events
senses.example_en: The narrative of the accident changed after the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 开会之后，关于这次事故的说法变了。

senses.gloss_en: telling a story, describing events
senses.example_en: She wrote a narrative poem about a lost dog.
senses.example_cn: 她写了一首叙事诗，讲一只走失的狗。

senses.gloss_en: the events that make a story
senses.example_en: I love the plot of this short book.
senses.example_cn: 我很喜欢这本小书的情节。

senses.gloss_en: a secret plan to do something wrong
senses.example_en: Police stopped a plot to steal the money.
senses.example_cn: 警方阻止了一起偷钱的阴谋。

senses.gloss_en: a small piece of land for building or growing
senses.example_en: They bought a plot of land near the river.
senses.example_cn: 他们在河边买了一块地。

senses.gloss_en: the subject or main idea
senses.example_en: The theme of the talk was travel in Asia.
senses.example_cn: 这次演讲的主题是亚洲旅行。

senses.gloss_en: a short tune linked to a film or show
senses.example_en: The theme from the film stayed in my head.
senses.example_cn: 那部电影的主题曲一直在我脑子里转。

senses.gloss_en: a chosen subject for a party or event
senses.example_en: We chose a winter theme for the party.
senses.example_cn: 我们给派对定了一个冬天的主题。

senses.gloss_en: the place and time of a story
senses.example_en: The setting is London in the past.
senses.gloss_cn: 故事发生的时间和地点
senses.example_cn: 故事的背景是从前的伦敦。

senses.gloss_en: the surroundings, conditions where something happens
senses.example_en: A quiet setting helps me study after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 安静的环境让我晚饭后能安心学习。

senses.gloss_en: a chosen control position on a machine
senses.example_en: Change the setting to low before you start.
senses.example_cn: 开始之前先把挡位调到低档。

senses.gloss_en: the written words of a play or film
senses.example_en: I finished the script for the next video today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天写完了下一个视频的脚本。

senses.gloss_en: handwriting, the style of writing by hand
senses.example_en: Her script is neat and easy to read.
senses.example_cn: 她的字迹工整，很容易看懂。

senses.gloss_en: the letters used to write a language
senses.example_en: Japanese uses a different script from English.
senses.example_cn: 日语用的文字和英语不一样。

senses.gloss_en: a show for an audience
senses.example_en: The performance starts at seven in the theater.
senses.example_cn: 演出七点在剧院开始。

senses.gloss_en: how well someone does a job or task
senses.example_en: Her performance in class improved this month.
senses.example_cn: 她这个月在课上的表现进步了。

senses.gloss_en: how well a machine works
senses.example_en: The car's performance is better after the repair.
senses.example_cn: 修过之后，这辆车的性能好多了。

senses.gloss_en: the process of making goods in large quantities
senses.example_en: Production of cars increased last year in our city.
senses.example_cn: 去年我们市的汽车生产增加了。

senses.gloss_en: the making of a film, play, or show
senses.example_en: She works in television production and not on camera.
senses.example_cn: 她做电视制作，不出镜。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of something produced
senses.example_en: Daily production of milk drops in cold weather.
senses.example_cn: 天冷的时候每天的牛奶产量会下降。

senses.gloss_en: A person, company, or country that makes goods or food
senses.example_en: Canada is a wheat producer in North America.
senses.example_cn: 加拿大是北美的小麦生产国。

senses.gloss_en: A person in charge of making a movie or program
senses.example_en: The producer paid for the documentary and the studio.
senses.example_cn: 制片人出钱拍了这部纪录片，也付了摄影棚的费用。

senses.gloss_en: A room where TV, radio, or music is recorded
senses.example_en: We recorded the episode in a small studio.
senses.example_cn: 我们在一间小录音棚里录了这一集。

senses.gloss_en: A company or place where movies are made
senses.example_en: The movie studio made the documentary last year.
senses.example_cn: 这家电影公司去年拍了那部纪录片。

senses.gloss_en: A small apartment with one main room
senses.example_en: They rented a studio near the subway station.
senses.example_cn: 他们在地铁站附近租了一间单间公寓。

senses.gloss_en: A person who invites guests to a meal or party
senses.example_en: The host welcomed us and offered drinks.
senses.example_cn: 主人迎接了我们，还端上了饮料。

senses.gloss_en: A person who presents a TV or radio show
senses.example_en: The host introduced the guests on the radio.
senses.example_cn: 主持人在广播里介绍了几位嘉宾。

senses.gloss_en: To organize an event and take care of guests
senses.example_en: They will host an exhibition at the studio.
senses.gloss_cn: 主办（指组织活动并招待客人）
senses.example_cn: 他们将在工作室主办一场展览。

senses.gloss_en: One part of a TV or radio story series
senses.example_en: We watched one episode before bed.
senses.example_cn: 我们睡前看了一集。

senses.gloss_en: An important event or short time in someone's life
senses.example_en: That episode in my life still hurts.
senses.example_cn: 我人生中那段经历现在想起来还是难受。

senses.gloss_en: A movie or program that gives facts about something
senses.example_en: I watched a documentary about photography and travel.
senses.example_cn: 我看了一部关于摄影和旅行的纪录片。

senses.gloss_en: A public event where paintings, photos, or objects are shown
senses.example_en: The exhibition showed photography from the local studio.
senses.example_cn: 这次展览展出了本地工作室的摄影作品。

senses.gloss_en: A clear display of a feeling or quality
senses.example_en: Her talk was an exhibition of confidence.
senses.example_cn: 她的演讲充分展现了自信。

senses.gloss_en: The art or job of taking photographs or filming
senses.example_en: Photography helps me remember each episode of travel.
senses.example_cn: 摄影帮我记住旅行中的每一段经历。

senses.gloss_en: A person who takes photographs, often as a job
senses.example_en: The photographer took our portrait in the park.
senses.example_cn: 摄影师在公园里给我们拍了肖像照。

senses.gloss_en: A painting, drawing, or photograph of a person
senses.example_en: She hung a portrait of her father on Sunday.
senses.example_cn: 星期天她挂上了一幅她父亲的肖像。

senses.gloss_en: A detailed description of someone or something
senses.example_en: The book gives a portrait of life in 1920.
senses.example_cn: 这本书细致描绘了一九二零年的生活。

senses.gloss_en: A border that holds a picture, photo, or mirror
senses.example_en: He bought a frame for the photo yesterday.
senses.example_cn: 他昨天给那张照片买了个相框。

senses.gloss_en: The supporting structure of a building, vehicle, or machine
senses.example_en: The bike frame is strong, not heavy.
senses.example_cn: 这辆自行车的车架又结实又不重。

senses.gloss_en: To put a picture in a frame
senses.example_en: I will frame this portrait for my mother.
senses.example_cn: 我要把这张肖像装上框，送给我妈妈。

senses.gloss_en: A collection of songs released as one recording
senses.example_en: Their new album has ten songs, all in English.
senses.example_cn: 他们的新专辑有十首歌，全是英文的。

senses.gloss_en: A book for keeping photos, stamps, or other pictures
senses.example_en: I put the wedding photos in a new album.
senses.example_cn: 我把婚礼照片放进了一本新相册。

senses.gloss_en: A group of objects collected together, often the same type
senses.example_en: His coin collection is small, but very valuable.
senses.example_cn: 他的硬币收藏不多，但很值钱。

senses.gloss_en: The act of collecting money for a person or cause
senses.example_en: We made a collection for Tom after the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 散会后我们为汤姆凑了一笔钱。

senses.gloss_en: The process of collecting things such as data or taxes
senses.example_en: Data collection is hard when the internet is down.
senses.example_cn: 网络断了的时候，数据收集很难做。

senses.gloss_en: A solid art object made by carving or shaping material
senses.example_en: The sculpture of a bird is in the museum.
senses.example_cn: 那尊鸟的雕塑在博物馆里。

senses.gloss_en: The art of making sculptures
senses.example_en: She studies sculpture and makes clay animals at school.
senses.example_cn: 她在学校学雕塑，用泥做各种动物。

senses.gloss_en: Clothes worn to look like someone or something else
senses.example_en: He wore a pirate costume at the party.
senses.example_cn: 他在派对上穿了一身海盗装。

senses.gloss_en: Clothes worn by actors in a play or movie
senses.example_en: The costume was heavy, so the actor moved slowly.
senses.example_cn: 戏服很重，所以那位演员动作很慢。

senses.gloss_en: Traditional clothes of a place or a past period
senses.example_en: They showed national costume from Mexico in the gallery.
senses.example_cn: 展馆里展出了墨西哥的民族服装。

senses.gloss_en: a strong feeling of shock or fear
senses.example_en: I felt horror when the car hit the tree.
senses.example_cn: 车撞到树上的时候，我感到一阵恐惧。

senses.gloss_en: the very unpleasant, shocking nature of something
senses.example_en: The full horror of the accident became clear later.
senses.example_cn: 这场事故到底有多可怕，后来才完全清楚。

senses.gloss_en: a story or movie with frightening events
senses.example_en: We watched a horror movie after dinner at home.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们在家看了一部恐怖片。

senses.gloss_en: something difficult to understand or explain
senses.example_en: How he left so fast is a mystery.
senses.example_cn: 他怎么走得那么快，真是个谜。

senses.gloss_en: a story where the crime is explained at the end
senses.example_en: She read a mystery about a crime in Paris.
senses.example_cn: 她读了一本关于巴黎一桩罪案的推理小说。

senses.gloss_en: things that are difficult to understand or explain
senses.example_en: He told me the mysteries of his old job.
senses.example_cn: 他跟我讲了他以前那份工作里的种种奥秘。

senses.gloss_en: the spirit of a dead person
senses.example_en: Some people believe a ghost lives in this house.
senses.example_cn: 有些人相信这房子里住着鬼魂。

senses.gloss_en: the memory of something bad from the past
senses.example_en: The ghost of the war stayed in his mind.
senses.example_cn: 战争的幽灵萦绕在他心中。

senses.gloss_en: a faint sign of something that was there
senses.example_en: There was a ghost of a smile on her face.
senses.example_cn: 她脸上掠过一丝微笑。

senses.gloss_en: people in general, ordinary people
senses.example_en: The folk here are friendly and helpful.
senses.example_cn: 这里的人都很友好，也乐于帮忙。

senses.gloss_en: the members of your family, especially your parents
senses.example_en: My folks live near the river in Canada.
senses.example_cn: 我父母住在加拿大的一条河边。

senses.gloss_en: traditional, typical of ordinary people
senses.example_en: We listened to folk music at the street festival.
senses.example_cn: 我们在街头节庆上听了民间音乐。

senses.gloss_en: a large sports ground with rows of seats
senses.example_en: The fans filled the stadium for the night game.
senses.example_cn: 球迷们挤满了体育场，来看这场夜间比赛。

senses.gloss_en: a person who teaches people or animals a skill
senses.example_en: The trainer taught the horse to run fast.
senses.example_cn: 训练师教这匹马跑得更快。

senses.gloss_en: a light sports shoe, a sneaker
senses.example_en: I bought new trainers for running in the park.
senses.example_cn: 我买了新运动鞋，好在公园里跑步。

senses.gloss_en: a person or team that wins a competition
senses.example_en: She became the champion of the tennis event.
senses.example_cn: 她成了这次网球比赛的冠军。

senses.gloss_en: a person who strongly supports a belief or group
senses.example_en: She was a champion of the poor in her city.
senses.example_cn: 她是本市穷人的代言人。

senses.gloss_en: Person in charge of a ship or aircraft
senses.example_en: The captain spoke calmly and the plane landed safely.
senses.gloss_cn: 船长（指船舶或飞机的负责人）
senses.example_cn: 机长沉着地指挥着，飞机安全降落了。

senses.gloss_en: Officer rank in the military, police, or fire department
senses.example_en: The captain gave orders and the guards moved fast.
senses.example_cn: 上尉下达了命令，士兵们迅速行动。

senses.gloss_en: Leader of a sports team
senses.example_en: Our captain talked to the team after the match.
senses.example_cn: 比赛之后我们队长跟大家谈了话。

senses.gloss_en: Sport of races between animals or vehicles
senses.example_en: Racing is popular on TV, especially horse racing.
senses.example_cn: 竞速比赛在电视上很受欢迎，尤其是赛马。

senses.gloss_en: Material made of threads with holes
senses.example_en: A net covered the fruit, keeping insects away.
senses.example_cn: 水果上盖着一层网，防止虫子靠近。

senses.gloss_en: Tool of netting for catching fish, insects, or animals
senses.example_en: He caught fish with a net near the river.
senses.example_cn: 他在河边用网捕鱼。

senses.gloss_en: Sports net that stops or catches a ball
senses.example_en: The ball hit the net and went in.
senses.example_cn: 球碰到球网后进了。

senses.gloss_en: Hit someone or something with your foot
senses.example_en: He kicked the ball into the net.
senses.example_cn: 他把球踢进了球网。

senses.gloss_en: Stop a bad habit
senses.example_en: She kicked smoking last year and felt better.
senses.example_cn: 她去年戒烟了，感觉好多了。

senses.gloss_en: A hit with the foot
senses.example_en: He gave the door a hard kick.
senses.example_cn: 他狠狠踢了那扇门一脚。

senses.gloss_en: Arguments or a fight between people
senses.example_en: There was fighting in the street outside the store.
senses.example_cn: 店外的街上有人在打架。

senses.gloss_en: Combat, especially in a war
senses.example_en: Heavy fighting continued near the border all day.
senses.example_cn: 边境附近的激烈战斗持续了一整天。

senses.gloss_en: A long struggle to achieve something
senses.example_en: The fighting for better pay lasted two months.
senses.gloss_cn: 斗争（指长期的争取过程）
senses.example_cn: 争取加薪的斗争持续了两个月。

senses.gloss_en: Action meant to deceive someone
senses.example_en: His trick fooled my friend and everyone laughed.
senses.example_cn: 他的花招骗了我朋友，大家都笑了。

senses.gloss_en: A clever way to do something
senses.example_en: A simple trick helped me remember the word.
senses.example_cn: 一个简单的窍门帮我记住了这个单词。

senses.gloss_en: Deceive someone to make them do something
senses.example_en: They tricked him into paying more money.
senses.example_cn: 他们骗他多付了钱。

senses.gloss_en: Musical instrument you hit with sticks
senses.example_en: He played the drum and the room shook.
senses.example_cn: 他敲起鼓，整个房间都在震。

senses.gloss_en: Large barrel-shaped container for liquids or fuel
senses.example_en: A drum of fuel sat behind the garage.
senses.example_cn: 车库后面放着一桶燃油。

senses.gloss_en: Rotating cylinder in a machine, for example a washer
senses.example_en: The drum turned fast during the wash cycle.
senses.example_cn: 洗衣过程中滚筒转得很快。

senses.gloss_en: A traditional way of behaving in a group
senses.example_en: Taking off shoes is a local custom here.
senses.example_cn: 脱鞋是这里的当地风俗。

senses.gloss_en: Something you usually do, a personal habit
senses.example_en: It is my custom to drink tea at night.
senses.example_cn: 我习惯晚上喝茶。

senses.gloss_en: A formal event for an important occasion
senses.example_en: The graduation ceremony started at noon today.
senses.example_cn: 今天的毕业典礼中午开始。

senses.gloss_en: Formal actions and words used in an event
senses.example_en: The ceremony included songs and short speeches.
senses.example_cn: 仪式上有歌曲，还有简短的讲话。

senses.gloss_en: Formal behavior, polite actions in social situations
senses.example_en: He left without ceremony and closed the door.
senses.example_cn: 他没有任何客套就走了，还把门关上。

senses.gloss_en: A special event to celebrate something
senses.example_en: We had a celebration for her birthday last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚我们为她的生日办了庆祝活动。

senses.gloss_en: The act of celebrating something
senses.example_en: They danced in celebration after the team won.
senses.example_cn: 球队赢了以后，他们跳舞庆祝。

senses.gloss_en: Belief in a god or gods, and worship
senses.example_en: Religion is important to my family every Sunday.
senses.example_cn: 宗教信仰对我家人很重要，每个星期天都是这样。

senses.gloss_en: A particular system of religious belief and worship
senses.example_en: Buddhism is a religion with many traditions.
senses.example_cn: 佛教是一种传统很多的宗教。

senses.gloss_en: Words you say to God, asking for help
senses.example_en: She said a prayer before the meal.
senses.example_cn: 她在饭前做了个祷告。

senses.gloss_en: A fixed set of words said to God
senses.example_en: We learned a prayer in church last week.
senses.example_cn: 上周我们在教堂学了一段祷文。

senses.gloss_en: The act of praying to God
senses.example_en: He knelt in prayer for his sick mother.
senses.example_cn: 他跪下为生病的母亲祈祷。

senses.gloss_en: A person trained to perform religious duties and ceremonies
senses.example_en: The priest led a prayer in the church.
senses.example_cn: 神父在教堂里带领大家祈祷。

senses.gloss_en: The legal relationship between two married people
senses.example_en: Their marriage lasted ten years and stayed strong.
senses.example_cn: 他们的婚姻维持了十年，一直很稳固。

senses.gloss_en: The ceremony where two people get married
senses.example_en: The marriage was small, with family and friends.
senses.example_cn: 婚礼办得很小，只有家人和朋友。

senses.gloss_en: who someone is, their name and facts
senses.example_en: The police confirmed her identity after the test.
senses.example_cn: 化验之后，警方确认了她的身份。

senses.gloss_en: the qualities and beliefs that make you different
senses.example_en: Language is part of my identity in Canada.
senses.example_cn: 在加拿大，语言是我身份认同的一部分。

senses.gloss_en: connected with where you were born and raised
senses.example_en: He returned to his native city after five years.
senses.example_cn: 五年之后他回到了自己的家乡城市。

senses.gloss_en: your first language, learned as a child
senses.example_en: She speaks Spanish as her native language now.
senses.example_cn: 她现在说西班牙语，那是她的母语。

senses.gloss_en: growing naturally in an area, not brought in
senses.example_en: This tree is native to Malaysia, not Europe.
senses.example_cn: 这种树原产于马来西亚，不是欧洲。

senses.gloss_en: a person who comes to live in a new country
senses.example_en: My uncle is an immigrant in the United States.
senses.example_cn: 我叔叔是在美国的移民。

senses.gloss_en: all the people of about the same age
senses.example_en: This generation uses phones for school and work.
senses.example_cn: 这一代人用手机上学、工作。

senses.gloss_en: people in one stage of a family
senses.example_en: Three generations ate dinner together last night.
senses.example_cn: 昨晚一家三代人一起吃了饭。

senses.gloss_en: the time between parents and their children
senses.example_en: A generation is about thirty years in many countries.
senses.example_cn: 在很多国家，一代大约是三十年。

senses.gloss_en: a social group, often based on physical differences
senses.example_en: People should never judge others by race.
senses.example_cn: 永远不该以种族来评判别人。

senses.gloss_en: all humans, people in the world
senses.example_en: The human race has lived here for a long time.
senses.example_cn: 人类在这里已经生活了很久。

senses.gloss_en: a group of people with the same language and traditions, used especially in the past
senses.example_en: They once called the British an island race.
senses.example_cn: 过去人们把英国人称作一个海岛民族。

senses.gloss_en: a male royal family member, not the king
senses.example_en: The prince spoke to the crowd at the palace.
senses.example_cn: 王子在宫殿前向人群讲话。

senses.gloss_en: the ruler of a small country, a principality
senses.example_en: The prince ruled the small country for many years.
senses.example_cn: 这位亲王统治那个小国多年。

senses.gloss_en: a female royal family member, not the queen
senses.example_en: The princess waved and smiled from the balcony.
senses.example_cn: 公主在阳台上挥手微笑。

senses.gloss_en: the wife of a prince
senses.example_en: She became a princess after she married the prince.
senses.example_cn: 她嫁给王子之后成了王妃。

senses.gloss_en: a girl who expects special treatment, spoiled
senses.example_en: Stop acting like a princess and help me.
senses.example_cn: 别摆公主架子了，来帮我一把。

senses.gloss_en: Organization that represents workers and protects their rights
senses.example_en: The union asked for higher pay this year.
senses.example_cn: 工会今年要求提高工资。

senses.gloss_en: Act or state of being joined together
senses.example_en: Their union made the two companies much stronger.
senses.example_cn: 两家公司合并之后强大了很多。

senses.gloss_en: Political group of countries or states working together
senses.example_en: The European Union sets common rules for trade.
senses.example_cn: 欧盟为贸易制定统一的规则。

senses.gloss_en: Person who supports a person, plan, or group
senses.example_en: She is a strong supporter of the new plan.
senses.example_cn: 她是这个新方案的坚定支持者。

senses.gloss_en: Person who wants a sports team to win
senses.example_en: Thousands of supporters watched the team play at home.
senses.example_cn: 几千名球迷看了球队的主场比赛。

senses.gloss_en: a piece of clothing or device worn to support a part of the body
senses.example_en: He wore a knee supporter all day after the injury.
senses.example_cn: 受伤之后，他整天都戴着护膝。

senses.gloss_en: Person who works without pay to help others
senses.example_en: Each volunteer cleaned the beach after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，每位志愿者都去清理海滩。

senses.gloss_en: Offer to do something without being asked or paid
senses.example_en: I volunteered to help with the school event.
senses.example_cn: 我主动提出帮忙办学校的活动。

senses.gloss_en: Give information without being asked
senses.example_en: Don't volunteer details about the accident to police.
senses.example_cn: 不要主动向警方提供事故的细节。

senses.gloss_en: Piece of cloth that represents a country or group
senses.example_en: They raised the flag above the school gate.
senses.example_cn: 他们在校门上方升起了旗。

senses.gloss_en: Piece of cloth waved to signal, warn, or guide
senses.example_en: The guard waved a flag and the train left.
senses.example_cn: 列车员挥动信号旗，火车就开走了。

senses.gloss_en: Flag used as a warning signal
senses.example_en: A red flag on the beach means it is dangerous to swim.
senses.example_cn: 海滩上挂红旗，表示下水很危险。

senses.gloss_en: Condition of being very poor
senses.example_en: Many families live in poverty in the city.
senses.example_cn: 城里很多家庭生活贫困。

senses.gloss_en: Lack of something important or useful
senses.example_en: A poverty of ideas slowed the project.
senses.example_cn: 想法太少，拖慢了这个项目。

senses.gloss_en: Person legally owned and forced to work for others
senses.example_en: Slaves worked on farms without freedom or pay.
senses.example_cn: 奴隶在农场上干活，没有自由，也没有工钱。

senses.gloss_en: It is used instead of who as the object
senses.example_en: Whom did you invite to the party?
senses.example_cn: 你邀请了谁来参加派对？

senses.gloss_en: Protection from bad weather or danger
senses.example_en: We ran for shelter when the wind got strong.
senses.example_cn: 风刮大了，我们赶紧跑去躲避。

senses.gloss_en: A place that protects people or animals
senses.example_en: The dog stayed at a shelter for a week.
senses.gloss_cn: 收容所（供人或动物避身处）
senses.example_cn: 那只狗在收容所待了一个星期。

senses.gloss_en: To protect someone from weather or danger
senses.example_en: Tall trees shelter the house from winter wind.
senses.gloss_cn: 遮挡（保护不受风雨侵袭）
senses.example_cn: 高大的树木为房子遮挡冬天的寒风。

senses.gloss_en: A stack of things on top of each other
senses.example_en: A pile of clothes covered the chair.
senses.example_cn: 一堆衣服把椅子盖住了。

senses.gloss_en: A large amount of something, informal
senses.example_en: I have a pile of work tonight.
senses.example_cn: 我今晚有一大堆活儿要干。

senses.gloss_en: To put things on top of each other
senses.example_en: They pile books on the table after class.
senses.example_cn: 下课后他们把书堆在桌上。

senses.gloss_en: A strong elastic material used to make tires and boots
senses.example_en: The rubber ball bounced across the room.
senses.example_cn: 那个橡胶球在房间里弹来弹去。

senses.gloss_en: Made of rubber
senses.example_en: I wore rubber gloves to wash the dishes.
senses.example_cn: 我戴着橡胶手套洗碗。

senses.gloss_en: An eraser, in British English
senses.example_en: I used a rubber to rub out the wrong word.
senses.example_cn: 我用橡皮把写错的字擦掉了。

senses.gloss_en: Something that makes a place look more attractive
senses.example_en: We hung a decoration on the tree today.
senses.example_cn: 我们今天在树上挂了一个装饰品。

senses.gloss_en: The act or process of decorating a house or room, for example by painting it
senses.example_en: Decoration takes time, so we started early.
senses.example_cn: 装修很花时间，所以我们早早就动手了。

senses.gloss_en: A medal given for brave or honorable acts
senses.example_en: She received a decoration for service in the army.
senses.example_cn: 她因在军队服役而获得了一枚勋章。

senses.gloss_en: All the people who live together in one home
senses.example_en: Our household eats dinner together every night.
senses.example_cn: 我们一家人每天晚上都一起吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: Houses and apartments that people live in
senses.example_en: Housing is expensive in this city now.
senses.example_cn: 现在这座城市的住房很贵。

senses.gloss_en: To pull something apart, or make a hole in it
senses.example_en: Be careful, you can tear the paper.
senses.example_cn: 小心点，你会把纸撕破的。

senses.gloss_en: A hole in cloth or paper made by tearing
senses.example_en: There is a tear in my shirt.
senses.example_cn: 我衬衫上有个破口。
