senses.gloss_en: having a lot of money and possessions
senses.example_en: A wealthy woman lived in a quiet street.
senses.example_cn: 一个富有的女人住在一条安静的街道上。

senses.gloss_en: complete or total, often for emphasis
senses.example_en: It was absolute chaos in the hall today.
senses.example_cn: 大厅里一片混乱。

senses.gloss_en: definite, with no doubt
senses.example_en: There is no absolute proof of fraud here.
senses.example_cn: 这里没有确凿的欺诈证据。

senses.gloss_en: not limited, having total power or control
senses.example_en: The ruler had absolute power over the city.
senses.example_cn: 统治者拥有至高无上的权力。

senses.gloss_en: making you feel very sad and hopeless
senses.example_en: The news was depressing so we turned it off.
senses.gloss_cn: 让你感到非常悲伤和绝望
senses.example_cn: 这消息令人沮丧，所以我们把它关掉了。

senses.gloss_en: Things made or grown to sell
senses.example_en: The store sells goods from many countries.
senses.gloss_cn: 商品（生产出来卖的东西）
senses.example_cn: 这家店卖来自很多国家的商品。

senses.gloss_en: Personal property that can be moved
senses.example_en: His goods were in two small bags.
senses.gloss_cn: 个人财物（能搬走的东西）
senses.example_cn: 他的全部家当就装在两个小包里。

senses.gloss_en: Things carried by train, truck, or ship
senses.example_en: The goods traveled by train across the country.
senses.example_cn: 这批货物由火车运送，横穿全国。

senses.gloss_en: Buy something, often in a formal way
senses.example_en: You can purchase tickets online with a card.
senses.example_cn: 你可以在网上用银行卡买票。

senses.gloss_en: The act of buying something
senses.example_en: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
senses.example_cn: 请保留收据作为购买凭证。

senses.gloss_en: Something you buy, especially something expensive
senses.example_en: That laptop was my biggest purchase this year.
senses.example_cn: 那台笔记本电脑是我今年买的最贵的东西。

senses.gloss_en: The act of taking goods to someone
senses.example_en: Delivery is free on orders over fifty dollars.
senses.example_cn: 订单满五十美元就免费送货。

senses.gloss_en: The process of giving birth to a baby
senses.example_en: She had an easy delivery at the hospital.
senses.example_cn: 她在医院顺利分娩。

senses.gloss_en: The way you speak, especially in public
senses.example_en: His delivery was calm, clear, and confident.
senses.gloss_cn: 讲话方式（尤指公开场合）
senses.example_cn: 他的讲话方式平静、清晰又自信。

senses.gloss_en: get something, especially with effort
senses.example_en: We obtained a copy of the letter.
senses.example_cn: 我们弄到了一份信件副本。

senses.gloss_en: exist, continue to be accepted or used
senses.example_en: These rules obtain in our school today.
senses.example_cn: 这些规则至今仍在学校执行。

senses.gloss_en: gain a skill or knowledge by your effort
senses.example_en: He acquired good English from daily practice.
senses.gloss_cn: 通过努力获得技能或知识
senses.example_cn: 他通过日常练习掌握了良好的英语。

senses.gloss_en: get something by buying it or being given it
senses.example_en: They acquired a small house near the river.
senses.gloss_cn: 通过购买或被给予来获得某物
senses.example_cn: 他们在河边买了一栋小房子。

senses.gloss_en: have or own something
senses.example_en: She possesses a passport and a license.
senses.example_cn: 她持有护照和执照。

senses.gloss_en: have a quality, skill, or feature
senses.example_en: He possesses great patience with young children.
senses.gloss_cn: 具有某种品质、技能或特征
senses.example_cn: 他对小孩子很有耐心。

senses.gloss_en: keep something, continue to have it
senses.example_en: She retained control of the meeting.
senses.example_cn: 她保留了对会议的控制权。

senses.gloss_en: keep facts in your memory
senses.example_en: I retained the details for the test.
senses.example_cn: 我保留了测试的细节。

senses.gloss_en: hold water, heat, or other things inside
senses.example_en: This soil retains water after heavy rain.
senses.gloss_cn: 在里面装水、热或其他东西
senses.example_cn: 这种土壤在大雨后仍能保持水分。

senses.gloss_en: give things to many people
senses.example_en: They distributed food to the families.
senses.example_cn: 他们给这些家庭分发食物。

senses.gloss_en: send products to stores for sale
senses.example_en: The company distributes books to stores.
senses.example_cn: 这家公司向商店分发书籍。

senses.gloss_en: spread something over an area
senses.example_en: The wind distributed smoke across the valley.
senses.gloss_cn: 将某物散布于某一区域
senses.example_cn: 风把烟吹过山谷。

senses.gloss_en: give money, help, or ideas to a shared goal
senses.example_en: We contribute money to the school each month.
senses.gloss_cn: 为共同目标提供资金、帮助或想法
senses.example_cn: 我们每月向学校捐款。

senses.gloss_en: help cause something to happen
senses.example_en: Stress can contribute to sleep problems.
senses.example_cn: 压力会导致睡眠问题。

senses.gloss_en: write something for a newspaper, magazine, or book
senses.example_en: She contributes articles to a travel magazine.
senses.gloss_cn: 为报纸、杂志或书写点东西
senses.example_cn: 她为一家旅游杂志撰稿。

senses.gloss_en: need to pay money back
senses.example_en: I owe my friend twenty dollars.
senses.example_cn: 我欠我朋友二十美元。

senses.gloss_en: need to give or do something for someone
senses.example_en: I owe you an apology for yesterday.
senses.gloss_cn: 需要为某人付出或做某事
senses.example_cn: 我昨天欠你一个道歉。

senses.gloss_en: be caused by, or depend on, someone or something
senses.example_en: I owe my success to my parents.
senses.gloss_cn: 由某人或某事引起或依赖于某人或某事
senses.example_cn: 我的成功归功于我的父母。

senses.gloss_en: become healthy again after illness or injury
senses.example_en: He recovered quickly after the flu.
senses.gloss_cn: 生病或受伤后恢复健康
senses.example_cn: 流感过后，他很快康复了。

senses.gloss_en: return to a normal state after trouble or shock
senses.example_en: She recovered from the bad news slowly.
senses.gloss_cn: 在遇到麻烦或休克后恢复正常状态
senses.example_cn: 她慢慢从坏消息中恢复过来。

senses.gloss_en: get back something lost or stolen
senses.example_en: Police recovered the stolen bike last night.
senses.gloss_cn: 找回丢失或被盗的东西
senses.example_cn: 警方昨晚找回了被盗的自行车。

senses.gloss_en: leave someone you should care for, and not return
senses.example_en: He abandoned his family when the child was born.
senses.gloss_cn: 离开你应该关心的人，不要回来
senses.example_cn: 孩子出生时，他抛弃了家人。

senses.gloss_en: stop doing something, or stop using something
senses.example_en: They abandoned the plan after the meeting.
senses.gloss_cn: 停止做某事，或停止使用某物
senses.example_cn: 会后他们放弃了这个计划。

senses.gloss_en: leave a place or vehicle, often because it is unsafe
senses.example_en: We abandoned the car on the empty road.
senses.gloss_cn: 离开一个地方或车辆，通常是因为它不安全
senses.example_cn: 我们把车停在空荡荡的路上。

senses.gloss_en: risk money on the result of something
senses.example_en: He bet ten dollars on the game.
senses.example_cn: 他在这场比赛上赌了十美元。

senses.gloss_en: say you are almost sure something is true
senses.example_en: I bet the bus is late again.
senses.gloss_cn: 说你几乎可以肯定某事是真的
senses.example_cn: 我打赌公共汽车又晚点了。

senses.gloss_en: an agreement to risk money on a result
senses.example_en: We made a bet on the game.
senses.example_cn: 我们在比赛中打了个赌。

senses.gloss_en: Right or suitable for a particular situation
senses.example_en: That joke was not appropriate at a work meeting.
senses.example_cn: 在工作会上讲那个笑话不合适。

senses.gloss_en: Planned for a particular purpose or person
senses.example_en: This book is intended for young children, not adults.
senses.gloss_cn: 为特定目的或个人而计划
senses.example_cn: 这本书是给小孩子看的，不是给成年人看的。

senses.gloss_en: Working well without wasting time, money, or energy
senses.example_en: An efficient system saves time and reduces mistakes.
senses.example_cn: 高效的系统节省时间减少错误。

senses.gloss_en: Designed to fold into a smaller size
senses.example_en: We used a folding chair in the small room.
senses.example_cn: 我们在小房间里用了一把折叠椅。

senses.gloss_en: Lasting only a short time, not permanent
senses.example_en: I need temporary work for a month.
senses.example_cn: 我需要一份为期一个月的临时工。

senses.gloss_en: Lasting for a long time, not temporary
senses.example_en: She wants a permanent job in this city.
senses.example_cn: 她想在这座城市找份永久工作。

senses.gloss_en: Lasting for many years, or affecting the future
senses.example_en: We made a long-term plan for our work.
senses.example_cn: 我们为我们的工作制定了一个长期计划。

senses.gloss_en: For a long period, into the future
senses.example_en: This change will help us long-term, not today.
senses.gloss_cn: 在很长一段时间内，未来
senses.example_cn: 这一变化将长期帮助我们，而不是今天。

senses.gloss_en: Happening once every year
senses.example_en: Our annual meeting is in March.
senses.example_cn: 我们的年会在三月举行。

senses.gloss_en: Relating to one year, or lasting for one year
senses.example_en: I pay an annual fee for this service.
senses.gloss_cn: 与一年有关，或持续一年
senses.example_cn: 我为这项服务支付年费。

senses.gloss_en: Lasting only a short time
senses.example_en: We had a brief talk after dinner.
senses.example_cn: 晚饭后我们简短聊了几句。

senses.gloss_en: Using only a few words
senses.example_en: Give a brief answer today, please.
senses.example_cn: 请简单回答。

senses.gloss_en: Happening very quickly, in a short time
senses.example_en: Rapid change can cause stress at work.
senses.gloss_cn: 发生得很快，在短时间内
senses.example_cn: 快速变化会导致工作压力。

senses.gloss_en: Happening all the time, or very often
senses.example_en: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.
senses.example_cn: 噪音不断让人难以入睡。

senses.gloss_en: Not changing, staying the same
senses.example_en: Keep the temperature constant during the test.
senses.example_cn: 测试期间保持温度不变。

senses.gloss_en: Old, used as a polite word for people
senses.example_en: An elderly man walked slowly to the bus.
senses.gloss_cn: 旧，用作人们的礼貌用语
senses.example_cn: 一位老人慢慢地走向公共汽车。

senses.gloss_en: having a smooth, rounded shape
senses.example_en: The road followed a curved path by the beach.
senses.example_cn: 这条路沿着海滩边的一条弯曲的小路走。

senses.gloss_en: curved, not straight
senses.example_en: The bent nail would not go into wood.
senses.example_cn: 弯曲的钉子插不进木头里。

senses.gloss_en: unable to stand straight, usually from age or illness
senses.example_en: He walked home bent, tired, and sick.
senses.gloss_cn: 无法站直，通常是由于年龄或疾病
senses.example_cn: 他弯着腰走回家，又累又病。

senses.gloss_en: aimed clearly, often to criticize someone
senses.example_en: She made a pointed comment about his messy desk.
senses.example_cn: 她对他凌乱的办公桌说了句尖刻的话。

senses.gloss_en: having a thin, sharp end
senses.example_en: Use the pointed tool to open the small box.
senses.example_cn: 用尖头工具打开小盒子。

senses.gloss_en: rising or falling sharply, not gradually
senses.example_en: We climbed the steep hill before dinner.
senses.gloss_cn: 急剧上升或下降，而非逐渐上升或下降
senses.example_cn: 晚饭前我们爬上了陡峭的山坡。

senses.gloss_en: very high or great, hard to accept
senses.example_en: The steep fee surprised us at the door.
senses.gloss_cn: 非常高或很高，很难接受
senses.example_cn: 高昂的费用让我们大吃一惊。

senses.gloss_en: having an empty space inside, not solid
senses.example_en: A hollow log can hide small animals inside.
senses.gloss_cn: 里面是空的，不是实心的
senses.example_cn: 空心原木可以把小动物藏在里面。

senses.gloss_en: without real feeling or meaning, not sincere
senses.example_en: His hollow apology did not change her mind.
senses.gloss_cn: 没有真正的感觉或意义，不真诚
senses.example_cn: 他空洞的道歉并没有改变她的想法。

senses.gloss_en: sunken, curving inward, like a hole
senses.example_en: After the illness his eyes looked hollow.
senses.gloss_cn: 凹陷的，向内弯曲的，像个洞
senses.example_cn: 病后，他的眼睛看起来很空洞。

senses.gloss_en: Easy to see or understand
senses.example_en: It was plain that he was very tired.
senses.example_cn: 他显然非常疲惫。

senses.gloss_en: Simple and not decorated or complicated
senses.example_en: She wore a plain white shirt to work.
senses.example_cn: 她穿一件素白衬衫上班。

senses.gloss_en: Without anything added, not mixed
senses.example_en: I like plain yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
senses.example_cn: 早餐我喜欢配水果吃原味酸奶。

senses.gloss_en: either of the two organs used for breathing
senses.example_en: A lung helps you breathe in and breathe out.
senses.example_cn: 肺帮你把气吸进去、呼出来。

senses.gloss_en: a body or plant part with a special job
senses.example_en: The liver is an organ that cleans the blood.
senses.gloss_cn: 器官（有特定功能的身体部分）
senses.example_cn: 肝脏是净化血液的器官。

senses.gloss_en: a large keyboard instrument, often in churches
senses.example_en: The organ played loud music during the service.
senses.example_cn: 礼拜时管风琴奏出响亮的乐曲。

senses.gloss_en: formal a newspaper that speaks for an organization
senses.example_en: The party organ supported the new leader.
senses.gloss_cn: 机关报（代表某组织发声）
senses.example_cn: 该党的机关报支持这位新领导人。

senses.gloss_en: a fiber that carries messages in your body
senses.example_en: The nerve in my hand still hurts today.
senses.gloss_cn: 神经（体内传递信号的纤维）
senses.example_cn: 我手上那根神经今天还疼。

senses.gloss_en: nerves, feelings of worry or fear
senses.example_en: My nerves were bad before the interview.
senses.gloss_cn: 紧张情绪（担心害怕的感觉）
senses.example_cn: 面试前我特别紧张。

senses.gloss_en: informal rude confidence to do or say something
senses.example_en: He had the nerve to lie to me.
senses.gloss_cn: 脸皮厚（竟敢那么做的胆量）
senses.example_cn: 他居然有脸对我撒谎。

senses.gloss_en: either part of a woman's chest that makes milk
senses.example_en: The baby drank milk from his mother's breast.
senses.example_cn: 宝宝从妈妈的乳房吸奶。

senses.gloss_en: meat from the breast of a bird
senses.example_en: I ordered chicken breast with rice and vegetables.
senses.example_cn: 我点了鸡胸肉配米饭和蔬菜。

senses.gloss_en: the front part of a bird's body
senses.example_en: The bird's breast was white with a black line.
senses.example_cn: 那只鸟的胸部是白色的，还有一道黑线。

senses.gloss_en: the back part of your foot below the ankle
senses.example_en: My heel hurt after the long walk.
senses.example_cn: 走了那么久，我的脚跟疼了。

senses.gloss_en: the raised back part of a shoe
senses.example_en: Her heels made noise on the floor.
senses.gloss_cn: 鞋跟（鞋后部垫高的部分）
senses.example_cn: 她的鞋跟在地板上敲得咚咚响。

senses.gloss_en: the part of a sock that covers your heel
senses.example_en: The sock heel wore out and made a hole.
senses.gloss_cn: 袜跟（袜子包脚跟的部分）
senses.example_cn: 袜跟磨破了，出了个洞。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to hear sounds
senses.example_en: His hearing improved after the new medicine.
senses.example_cn: 用了新药之后，他的听力好转了。

senses.gloss_en: an official meeting to listen to evidence
senses.example_en: The judge scheduled a hearing for next week.
senses.example_cn: 法官把听证会安排在了下周。

senses.gloss_en: a chance to explain your ideas to others
senses.example_en: Give her a fair hearing before you decide.
senses.example_cn: 在你做决定之前，先给她一个把话说完的机会。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to see and what you can see
senses.example_en: Poor vision made driving at night very hard.
senses.example_cn: 视力不好，晚上开车就很困难。

senses.gloss_en: a clear idea of what the future should be
senses.example_en: Her vision for the school focused on safety.
senses.gloss_cn: 愿景（对未来的清晰构想）
senses.example_cn: 她对学校的构想把安全放在首位。

senses.gloss_en: a dream or experience of seeing something unreal
senses.example_en: He described a vision of light in the dark.
senses.gloss_cn: 幻象（梦中或虚幻的景象）
senses.example_cn: 他描述了黑暗中看到的一道光的幻象。

senses.gloss_en: a substance in food needed for health and growth
senses.example_en: This meal has vitamin C from fruit and vegetables.
senses.example_cn: 这顿饭里有水果和蔬菜提供的维生素C。

senses.gloss_en: the act or process of infecting, causing disease
senses.example_en: Wash your hands to prevent infection after travel.
senses.example_cn: 旅行回来要洗手，防止感染。

senses.gloss_en: a disease caused by bacteria or a virus
senses.example_en: He got an infection in his throat last week.
senses.gloss_cn: 感染性疾病（细菌或病毒引起）
senses.example_cn: 他上周喉咙发生了感染。

senses.gloss_en: tiny living things that can cause disease
senses.example_en: Bacteria can live in water, food, and soil.
senses.example_cn: 细菌能在水里、食物里和土里活下来。

senses.gloss_en: a serious disease with growths of abnormal cells in the body
senses.example_en: Doctors found cancer early so treatment started quickly.
senses.example_cn: 医生早期就发现了癌症，所以很快开始治疗。

senses.gloss_en: the zodiac sign called Cancer, from late June to late July
senses.example_en: She is a Cancer because she was born in July.
senses.example_cn: 她是巨蟹座，因为她是七月出生的。

senses.gloss_en: damage or injury caused by a person or event
senses.example_en: The storm did harm to homes, cars, and trees.
senses.example_cn: 那场暴风雨给房屋、汽车和树木都造成了损害。

senses.gloss_en: to hurt someone or damage something
senses.example_en: Smoking can harm your health, even in small amounts.
senses.gloss_cn: 危害（伤害人或损坏东西）
senses.example_cn: 吸烟会危害健康，哪怕抽得很少。

senses.gloss_en: an injury where skin is cut or broken
senses.example_en: The doctor cleaned the wound before he left.
senses.example_cn: 医生走之前清理了伤口。

senses.gloss_en: to injure someone, especially with a weapon
senses.example_en: The knife wounded his arm during the fight.
senses.gloss_cn: 使受伤（尤指用武器伤人）
senses.example_cn: 打架时那把刀伤了他的胳膊。

senses.gloss_en: to make someone feel upset or offended
senses.example_en: Her words wounded him and he left the room.
senses.example_cn: 她的话伤了他的心，他就走出了房间。

senses.gloss_en: a drop of liquid from your eye when you cry
senses.example_en: A tear rolled down his face during the movie.
senses.example_cn: 看电影时，一滴眼泪从他脸上滑下来。

senses.gloss_en: The state of not being strong or powerful
senses.example_en: His legs shook from weakness after the flu.
senses.example_cn: 得了流感后他浑身无力，腿都发抖。

senses.gloss_en: A weak point in a person, plan, or system
senses.example_en: This lock is a weakness in our security.
senses.gloss_cn: 弱点（人、计划或系统的短板）
senses.example_cn: 这把锁是我们安保上的一个弱点。

senses.gloss_en: Difficulty resisting something or someone you like a lot
senses.example_en: I have a weakness for chocolate at night.
senses.example_cn: 我晚上就是抵挡不住巧克力。

senses.gloss_en: Treatment that helps you feel better or get stronger
senses.example_en: After the accident, he needed therapy for months.
senses.gloss_cn: 康复治疗（帮人恢复变强）
senses.example_cn: 事故之后，他做了好几个月的康复治疗。

senses.gloss_en: Treatment for mental problems, usually by talking
senses.example_en: She started therapy to deal with her anxiety.
senses.example_cn: 她开始接受心理治疗，处理自己的焦虑。

senses.gloss_en: A specific treatment method for a health problem
senses.example_en: He goes to speech therapy at school twice.
senses.gloss_cn: 疗法（针对某个病症的方法）
senses.example_cn: 他每周在学校上两次言语治疗课。

senses.gloss_en: Medical treatment, cutting open the body to repair it
senses.example_en: The doctor said I need surgery tomorrow morning.
senses.example_cn: 医生说我明天早上得做手术。

senses.gloss_en: A doctor's office, where you get advice or treatment
senses.example_en: I waited at the surgery and saw the dentist.
senses.example_cn: 我在诊所等着，看了牙医。

senses.gloss_en: To make something longer or wider by pulling
senses.example_en: Stretch the rubber band, but do not snap it.
senses.example_cn: 把橡皮筋拉长，但别拉断。

senses.gloss_en: To straighten your body, arms, or legs
senses.example_en: I stretch my arms every morning after sleep.
senses.example_cn: 我每天早上睡醒后都伸展一下胳膊。

senses.gloss_en: A movement to make your muscles long and tight
senses.example_en: Do a stretch before you run fast.
senses.gloss_cn: 拉伸动作（拉紧肌肉的动作）
senses.example_cn: 快跑之前先做个拉伸。

senses.gloss_en: The scientific study of the mind and behavior
senses.example_en: He studied psychology in college for two years.
senses.example_cn: 他在大学学了两年心理学。

senses.gloss_en: The way a person or group thinks and acts
senses.example_en: Team psychology can change after a big loss.
senses.gloss_cn: 心理（个人或群体的想法做法）
senses.example_cn: 大败之后，全队的心理可能会变。

senses.gloss_en: A specialist who studies the mind and behavior, or helps people with mental health problems
senses.example_en: The psychologist asked me questions about my sleep.
senses.example_cn: 心理医生问了我一些关于睡眠的问题。

senses.gloss_en: Everything you see across an area of land
senses.example_en: The mountain landscape looks quiet in the morning.
senses.gloss_cn: 你在一片土地上看到的一切
senses.example_cn: 早晨，山景看起来很安静。

senses.gloss_en: A picture of the countryside, especially in art
senses.example_en: She painted a landscape with trees and a river.
senses.gloss_cn: 乡村的图画，尤指艺术品
senses.example_cn: 她画了一幅有树和河的风景画。

senses.gloss_en: The main features of a situation or activity
senses.example_en: The business landscape changed quickly after the new law.
senses.gloss_cn: 情况或活动的主要特征
senses.example_cn: 新法实施后，商业格局迅速发生了变化。

senses.gloss_en: A small narrow river
senses.example_en: A small stream runs behind our house.
senses.example_cn: 一条小溪从我家后面流过。

senses.gloss_en: A continuous flow of liquid or gas
senses.example_en: Water poured in a steady stream into the sink.
senses.example_cn: 水以稳定的流量流入水槽。

senses.gloss_en: A large number of things happening one after another
senses.example_en: A stream of emails arrived all morning.
senses.gloss_cn: 一连串（接连不断的事物）
senses.example_cn: 一上午邮件源源不断地涌来。

senses.gloss_en: A plant with many small branches, smaller than a tree
senses.example_en: We planted a rose bush beside the door.
senses.example_cn: 我们在门旁种了一丛玫瑰。

senses.gloss_en: Wild land, far from towns and farms
senses.example_en: They camped in the bush, far from town.
senses.example_cn: 他们在远离城镇的荒野露营。

senses.gloss_en: Something like a bush, especially thick hair or fur
senses.example_en: He has a bush of hair on his chin.
senses.example_cn: 他下巴上长着蓬乱的胡须。

senses.gloss_en: The part of a plant that grows underground
senses.example_en: The tree root broke the sidewalk near our house.
senses.example_cn: 树根撑裂了我们家旁的人行道。

senses.gloss_en: The main cause of something, especially a problem
senses.example_en: Stress was the root of his sleep problem.
senses.example_cn: 压力是他睡眠问题的根源。

senses.gloss_en: A person's roots, their family origin and culture
senses.example_en: Her roots are in Mexico, but she lives here.
senses.example_cn: 她祖籍墨西哥但住在这里。

senses.gloss_en: A plant grown in large amounts for food or sale
senses.example_en: Rice is an important crop in many countries.
senses.gloss_cn: 大量种植用于食用或销售的植物
senses.example_cn: 水稻是许多国家的重要作物。

senses.gloss_en: The amount of these plants grown in one season
senses.example_en: This year’s coffee crop was smaller than last year.
senses.gloss_cn: 这些植物在一个季节内生长的数量
senses.example_cn: 今年的咖啡收成比去年少。

senses.gloss_en: A crop of something, a group that appears together
senses.example_en: A new crop of young players joined the team.
senses.example_cn: 新一批年轻球员加入了球队。

senses.gloss_en: A natural substance in the earth, like gold or salt
senses.example_en: Coal is a mineral found deep under the ground.
senses.gloss_cn: 地球上的天然物质，如金或盐
senses.example_cn: 煤是一种在地下深处发现的矿物。

senses.gloss_en: An inorganic substance your body needs for good health
senses.example_en: Iron is a mineral your body needs every day.
senses.gloss_cn: 一种身体健康所需的无机物质
senses.example_cn: 铁是你身体每天都需要的矿物质。

senses.gloss_en: A sweet fizzy drink without alcohol
senses.example_en: He ordered a mineral with lunch at the café.
senses.gloss_cn: 不含酒精的甜味碳酸饮料
senses.example_cn: 他在咖啡馆点了一份矿物质午餐。

senses.gloss_en: Fine soft thread produced by silkworms
senses.example_en: Silk comes from silkworms, not from plants.
senses.example_cn: 丝绸来自蚕，而不是植物。

senses.gloss_en: Soft cloth made from silk thread
senses.example_en: She wore a silk shirt to the wedding.
senses.gloss_cn: 由丝线制成的柔软布料
senses.example_cn: 她穿着一件丝绸衬衫去参加婚礼。

senses.gloss_en: Silk thread used for sewing
senses.example_en: She repaired the dress with black silk.
senses.example_cn: 她用黑色丝绸修补了裙子。

senses.gloss_en: hot, bright burning gas from something on fire
senses.example_en: A small flame moved above the candle.
senses.gloss_cn: 从着火的东西中燃烧出来的炽热明亮的气体
senses.example_cn: 一团小火苗在蜡烛上方移动。

senses.gloss_en: a very strong feeling, especially passion or anger
senses.example_en: A flame of anger rose in his face.
senses.gloss_cn: 强烈的感觉，尤指激情或愤怒
senses.example_cn: 他脸上升起一阵怒火。

senses.gloss_en: a surface of land that is higher at one end
senses.example_en: The house sits on a steep slope.
senses.example_cn: 房子坐落在陡坡上。

senses.gloss_en: to be at an angle, higher at one end
senses.example_en: The roof slopes, higher at the back.
senses.example_cn: 屋顶向后倾斜得更高。

senses.gloss_en: to go down or up at an angle
senses.example_en: The road slopes down toward the river.
senses.gloss_cn: 以一定角度下降或上升
senses.example_cn: 这条路向河边倾斜。

senses.gloss_en: the distance from the top to the bottom
senses.example_en: The depth of the pool is two meters.
senses.example_cn: 泳池深度两米。

senses.gloss_en: the deepest parts, far below the surface
senses.example_en: Fish live in the depths of the lake.
senses.example_cn: 鱼儿生活在湖底深处。

senses.gloss_en: the strength and seriousness of a feeling or quality
senses.example_en: She spoke with depth, not just a few words.
senses.example_cn: 她言之有物，不敷衍。

senses.gloss_en: an area that is darker and cooler away from the sun
senses.example_en: We ate lunch in the shade of trees.
senses.example_cn: 我们在树荫下吃了午饭。

senses.gloss_en: a particular form of a color, light or dark
senses.example_en: This shade of blue looks dark in rain.
senses.gloss_cn: 颜色的一种特殊形式，浅色或深色
senses.example_cn: 这种蓝色在雨中看起来很暗。

senses.gloss_en: a slight difference in meaning or opinion
senses.example_en: There are several shades of meaning in that sentence.
senses.gloss_cn: 意思或观点上的细微差异
senses.example_cn: 那句话有几种含义。

senses.gloss_en: a dark shape on a surface where light is blocked
senses.example_en: His shadow fell across the wall.
senses.example_cn: 他的影子投在墙上。

senses.gloss_en: the state of getting less attention than someone else
senses.example_en: She lived in her sister's shadow for years.
senses.example_cn: 她多年来活在姐姐的阴影里。

senses.gloss_en: a very small amount, a hint
senses.example_en: There is not a shadow of doubt now.
senses.example_cn: 现在没有丝毫犹豫。

senses.gloss_en: a fence or other thing that stops movement
senses.example_en: A barrier stopped cars near the bridge.
senses.gloss_cn: 栅栏或其他阻止移动的东西
senses.example_cn: 一道障碍物挡住了桥附近的汽车。

senses.gloss_en: a problem or rule that makes something difficult
senses.example_en: Cost is a barrier to good health care.
senses.gloss_cn: 使某事变得困难的问题或规则
senses.example_cn: 成本是良好医疗保健的障碍。

senses.gloss_en: something that separates people, groups, or ideas
senses.example_en: Language barriers keep friends apart at work.
senses.gloss_cn: 分隔人、群体或思想的东西
senses.example_cn: 语言障碍让朋友在工作中分道扬镳。

senses.gloss_en: traveling through a place to learn what is there
senses.example_en: Their exploration of the island lasted three weeks.
senses.gloss_cn: 在一个地方旅行，了解那里有什么
senses.example_cn: 他们对该岛的探索持续了三周。

senses.gloss_en: searching for resources, such as oil or gas
senses.example_en: Oil exploration changed the quiet town.
senses.gloss_cn: 寻找资源，如石油或天然气
senses.example_cn: 石油勘探改变了这座宁静的小镇。

senses.gloss_en: careful study of a subject or idea
senses.example_en: Our exploration of this idea helped the class.
senses.gloss_cn: 对一个主题或想法的仔细研究
senses.example_cn: 我们对这个想法的探索帮助了全班同学。

senses.gloss_en: to fall down suddenly because of pressure or weakness
senses.example_en: The old roof collapsed during the storm.
senses.gloss_cn: 因压力或虚弱而突然跌倒
senses.example_cn: 旧屋顶在暴风雨中倒塌了。

senses.gloss_en: to fail suddenly and stop working or existing
senses.example_en: The plan collapsed after one bad meeting.
senses.gloss_cn: 突然失败，停止工作或存在
senses.example_cn: 一次糟糕的会议后，该计划失败了。

senses.gloss_en: a sudden fall or failure of something
senses.example_en: The collapse of the company shocked everyone.
senses.example_cn: 公司的倒闭震惊了所有人。

senses.gloss_en: One of the soft, light parts on a bird
senses.example_en: A feather fell on the wet ground.
senses.example_cn: 一根羽毛落在了湿地上。

senses.gloss_en: A living thing that can move, such as an animal
senses.example_en: The creature hid under a rock all day.
senses.example_cn: 那生物整天躲在岩石下。

senses.gloss_en: An imaginary animal in stories or movies
senses.example_en: The children drew a creature with three heads.
senses.gloss_cn: 故事或电影中虚构的动物
senses.example_cn: 孩子们画了一个有三个头的生物。

senses.gloss_en: A person, used to show pity or dislike
senses.example_en: That poor creature had no food or water.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个人，用来表示同情或厌恶
senses.example_cn: 那个可怜的家伙没有食物也没有水。

senses.gloss_en: A group of animals or plants that can breed
senses.example_en: This species lives in the forest near water.
senses.gloss_cn: 一群可以繁殖的动物或植物
senses.example_cn: 这个物种生活在靠近水域的森林里。

senses.gloss_en: Wild animals, birds, and insects living in nature
senses.example_en: The park protects wildlife from hunters every year.
senses.gloss_cn: 生活在自然界中的野生动物、鸟类和昆虫
senses.example_cn: 该公园每年都保护野生动物免受猎人的猎杀。

senses.gloss_en: to some degree, not completely
senses.example_en: The door was partly open, not fully closed.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.gloss_cn: 在某种程度上，并不完全
senses.example_cn: 门半开着，没有完全关上。

senses.gloss_en: to some degree, formal
senses.example_en: I was somewhat tired after the long walk.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 长走之后我有些疲惫。

senses.gloss_en: fairly, compared with similar things
senses.example_en: This phone is relatively cheap compared with others.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这款手机比其他的便宜得多。

senses.gloss_en: mostly or mainly, almost completely
senses.example_en: The project failed largely because the budget was small.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 项目失败主要是因为预算太少。

senses.gloss_en: in many places, or by many people
senses.example_en: His music is widely played in many countries.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 他的音乐在许多国家传唱。

senses.gloss_en: to be very different, by a large amount
senses.example_en: Prices vary widely from one store to another.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 价格从一家店到另一家差异很大。

senses.gloss_en: by a large amount, enough to be noticed
senses.example_en: My English improved significantly after daily practice.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我每天练习后英语显著提高。

senses.gloss_en: more and more over time
senses.example_en: People are increasingly using phones for everything.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.gloss_cn: 随着时间的推移，越来越多
senses.example_cn: 人们越来越多地使用手机做任何事情。

senses.gloss_en: completely, with nothing missing
senses.example_en: The form is fully complete and ready to sign.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 表格已完整填写，可供签署。

senses.gloss_en: as much as possible
senses.example_en: He cooperated fully with the police during interviews.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 他在采访中与警方充分合作。

senses.gloss_en: used to emphasize a large number or amount
senses.example_en: Fully 30 percent of voters said no today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 今天，整整30%的选民表示反对。

senses.gloss_en: completely, in every way
senses.example_en: The answer is entirely wrong, not partly wrong.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 答案完全错误，并非部分错误。

senses.gloss_en: in a sincere or honest way
senses.example_en: I truly believe you, and I will help.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 我真的相信你，我会帮助你的。

senses.gloss_en: used to emphasize that something is true
senses.example_en: This is truly the best day for us.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 这对我们来说真的是最好的一天。

senses.gloss_en: really existing, in fact
senses.example_en: We need truly independent advice before we sign.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 在签署之前，我们需要真正独立的建议。

senses.gloss_en: extremely or strongly
senses.example_en: She was deeply worried about her child today.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 她为孩子的安危深感担忧。

senses.gloss_en: a long way down or into something
senses.example_en: The diver went deeply into the dark water.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 潜水员潜入黑暗的水域深处。

senses.gloss_en: with a deep breath, taking in lots of air
senses.example_en: Breathe deeply, then count to ten slowly.
senses.sub_name: How strong or weak (Adverbs of degree)
senses.example_cn: 深吸一口气然后慢慢数到十。

senses.gloss_en: Slowly over time, little by little
senses.example_en: The pain gradually got better after a few days.
senses.example_cn: 几天后疼痛逐渐好转。

senses.gloss_en: Very quickly, at a great rate
senses.example_en: Prices rose rapidly after the storm.
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，物价迅速上涨。

senses.gloss_en: Carefully, paying attention to details
senses.example_en: Look closely at the label before you buy.
senses.example_cn: 购买前仔细查看标签。

senses.gloss_en: In a way directly connected or strongly related
senses.example_en: These two problems are closely related.
senses.example_cn: 这两个问题密切相关。

senses.gloss_en: Not far in time or position
senses.example_en: A second car followed closely behind us.
senses.example_cn: 第二辆车紧跟在我们后面。

senses.gloss_en: Intentionally, not by chance
senses.example_en: He deliberately ignored my message all day.
senses.example_cn: 他整天故意无视我的信息。

senses.gloss_en: Slowly and carefully
senses.example_en: She walked deliberately, step by step.
senses.example_cn: 她小心翼翼地一步一步地走着。

senses.gloss_en: a group of twelve (of the same thing)
senses.example_en: I bought a dozen eggs at the market.
senses.example_cn: 我在市场买了一打鸡蛋。

senses.gloss_en: used before a noun to mean about twelve
senses.example_en: She invited a dozen friends to dinner.
senses.example_cn: 她请了十来个朋友来吃晚饭。

senses.gloss_en: money you earn from work or investments
senses.example_en: His income dropped after he changed jobs.
senses.example_cn: 换工作以后他的收入减少了。

senses.gloss_en: a plan for earning and spending money
senses.example_en: We made a budget for food, rent, and travel.
senses.example_cn: 我们为吃饭、房租和出行做了预算。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of money available for something
senses.example_en: Our budget for the trip is five hundred dollars.
senses.example_cn: 我们这次旅行的预算是五百美元。

senses.gloss_en: a government’s plan for taxes and spending
senses.example_en: The budget raised taxes and cut services.
senses.example_cn: 这份财政预算提高了税收，还削减了公共服务。

senses.gloss_en: money you spend on something
senses.example_en: Travel expense was high during the busy month.
senses.example_cn: 那个旺季里的旅行开支很高。

senses.gloss_en: something that costs a lot of money
senses.example_en: A car is a big expense for students.
senses.gloss_cn: 花钱的东西（一大笔开销）
senses.example_cn: 对学生来说，车是一笔大开销。

senses.gloss_en: money you spend while doing your job that your employer pays back
senses.example_en: The company paid my hotel expenses after the trip.
senses.example_cn: 出差回来后，公司报销了我的住宿费。

senses.gloss_en: money you pay for a service or work
senses.example_en: The lawyer's fee was higher than we expected.
senses.example_cn: 律师的费用比我们预想的高。

senses.gloss_en: money you pay to enter a place or event
senses.example_en: We paid an entrance fee at the museum.
senses.example_cn: 我们在博物馆付了入场费。

senses.gloss_en: money a bank or company charges for something
senses.example_en: The bank charges a fee for this card.
senses.example_cn: 银行用这张卡要收一笔手续费。

senses.gloss_en: an amount of money or time you do not spend
senses.example_en: Buying in bulk made a saving of ten dollars.
senses.example_cn: 大批买下来省了十美元。

senses.gloss_en: the act of keeping money instead of spending it
senses.example_en: Saving helps me pay rent each month.
senses.example_cn: 平时存钱让我每个月都付得起房租。

senses.gloss_en: savings, money you have kept for the future
senses.example_en: Her savings paid for school and a small car.
senses.example_cn: 她的积蓄付了学费，还买了一辆小车。

senses.gloss_en: money that you owe someone
senses.example_en: He paid his debt to the bank.
senses.example_cn: 他还清了欠银行的钱。

senses.gloss_en: the state of owing money
senses.example_en: They are in debt after the medical bill.
senses.example_cn: 付了那笔医疗费之后，他们就欠债了。

senses.gloss_en: a feeling you should thank or repay someone
senses.example_en: I owe a debt of gratitude to my teacher.
senses.example_cn: 我欠老师一份感激之情。

senses.gloss_en: money that a bank lends and you repay
senses.example_en: She took out a loan to buy a car.
senses.example_cn: 她贷了一笔款去买车。

senses.gloss_en: the act of lending something for a short time
senses.example_en: Thanks for the loan of your bike today.
senses.example_cn: 谢谢你今天把自行车借给我。

senses.gloss_en: something that is lent and must be returned
senses.example_en: The painting is on loan from a local museum.
senses.example_cn: 这幅画是从本地一家博物馆借来的。

senses.gloss_en: The speed or frequency something happens
senses.example_en: Crime rates fell this year in my city.
senses.example_cn: 今年我所在城市的犯罪率下降了。

senses.gloss_en: A fixed amount of money paid for something
senses.example_en: The hotel rate includes breakfast and free parking.
senses.example_cn: 酒店的房价包含早餐和免费停车。

senses.gloss_en: To judge the quality or value of something
senses.example_en: Many people rate this phone as very good.
senses.example_cn: 很多人对这款手机评价很高。

senses.gloss_en: The act of making something smaller or less
senses.example_en: A reduction in price made the room cheaper.
senses.example_cn: 价格降了，这个房间就便宜了。

senses.gloss_en: An amount by which a price is made lower
senses.example_en: There is a reduction for children at this hotel.
senses.example_cn: 这家酒店对儿童有优惠。

senses.gloss_en: To get something wanted or needed
senses.example_en: She gained access to the office with a key.
senses.example_cn: 她凭一把钥匙获得了进入办公室的权限。

senses.gloss_en: To become larger, heavier, or greater
senses.example_en: The car gained speed on the long hill.
senses.example_cn: 车在长长的坡上速度越来越快。

senses.gloss_en: An increase in amount or extra money earned
senses.example_en: He sold the stock for a small gain.
senses.example_cn: 他卖掉那只股票，小赚了一笔。

senses.gloss_en: The act of putting money into something for profit
senses.example_en: Her investment in the company was risky.
senses.example_cn: 她对这家公司的投资风险很大。

senses.gloss_en: Money or property you put in to earn more
senses.example_en: This investment paid for my new camera.
senses.example_cn: 这笔投资帮我付了新相机的钱。

senses.gloss_en: Time or effort given to make something succeed
senses.example_en: The project needs more investment from our team.
senses.example_cn: 这个项目需要我们团队投入更多。

senses.gloss_en: A supply of goods for sale in a store
senses.example_en: This store keeps stock of rice and noodles.
senses.example_cn: 这家店备着大米和面条的库存。

senses.gloss_en: Shares that show part ownership in a company
senses.example_en: He bought stock in the company last year.
senses.example_cn: 他去年买了这家公司的股票。

senses.gloss_en: A liquid made from meat, bones, or vegetables
senses.example_en: I used chicken stock to make soup at home.
senses.example_cn: 我在家用鸡高汤做了汤。

senses.gloss_en: A close connection between people or groups
senses.example_en: Travel created a strong bond between the two friends.
senses.example_cn: 一路旅行让两个朋友之间结下了牢固的情谊。

senses.gloss_en: An official paper showing you lent money to someone
senses.example_en: She bought a bond to save money for school.
senses.example_cn: 她买了债券，为上学存钱。

senses.gloss_en: Money saved for a specific purpose
senses.example_en: We started a travel fund for next summer.
senses.example_cn: 我们为明年夏天的旅行设了一笔专项资金。

senses.gloss_en: Money available to be spent by a group
senses.example_en: The school used public funds to buy books.
senses.example_cn: 学校用公共经费买了书。

senses.gloss_en: To provide money for a project or activity
senses.example_en: The city funded the new park near our home.
senses.example_cn: 市里出资建了我家附近的新公园。

senses.gloss_en: money provided for a project, event, or activity
senses.example_en: Government funding helped our school buy new books.
senses.example_cn: 政府的资金帮我们学校买了新书。

senses.gloss_en: the management of money by governments or companies
senses.example_en: She works in finance at a large bank.
senses.example_cn: 她在一家大银行做金融工作。

senses.gloss_en: the money a person or organization has to use
senses.example_en: His finances were low after the long trip.
senses.example_cn: 那趟长途旅行之后，他手头的钱就不多了。

senses.gloss_en: provide money for a project or activity
senses.example_en: They financed the film with savings and loans.
senses.example_cn: 他们用积蓄和贷款为这部电影出资。

senses.gloss_en: an agreement to pay for loss, damage, or illness
senses.example_en: I bought travel insurance before the flight.
senses.example_cn: 上飞机前我买了旅行保险。

senses.gloss_en: the protection that insurance provides
senses.example_en: Her insurance covered the hospital costs.
senses.example_cn: 她的保险赔付了住院费用。

senses.gloss_en: something that reduces risk, extra protection
senses.example_en: A written contract is insurance against later problems.
senses.example_cn: 书面合同是防止以后出问题的保障。

senses.gloss_en: promise that something will happen or be true
senses.example_en: I guarantee the package will arrive on time.
senses.example_cn: 我保证包裹会按时送到。

senses.gloss_en: promise to repair or replace a product for free
senses.example_en: They guarantee the phone for two years.
senses.example_cn: 这部手机他们保修两年。

senses.gloss_en: a formal promise, often in writing
senses.example_en: The toaster came with a two-year guarantee.
senses.gloss_cn: 保修单（正式的书面保证）
senses.example_cn: 这台烤面包机附带两年保修单。

senses.gloss_en: agree to give someone what they ask for
senses.example_en: The office granted her request for a later meeting.
senses.example_cn: 办公室准予了她把会议改晚的请求。

senses.gloss_en: money given for a special purpose
senses.example_en: He got a grant to pay for school.
senses.example_cn: 他拿到一笔补助金来付学费。

senses.gloss_en: give money, usually from a government or organization
senses.example_en: They granted money to the clinic for new beds.
senses.example_cn: 他们给那家诊所拨了钱，用来添置新床位。

senses.gloss_en: an amount of money
senses.example_en: He paid a large sum for the camera.
senses.example_cn: 他花了一大笔钱买这台相机。

senses.gloss_en: the result when you add numbers together
senses.example_en: The sum of seven and twelve is nineteen.
senses.example_cn: 七加十二的和是十九。

senses.gloss_en: add numbers to find a total
senses.example_en: Please sum the costs before you pay.
senses.example_cn: 付款前请把各项费用加起来。

senses.gloss_en: the amount of space an object or substance fills
senses.example_en: We measured the volume of water in the tank.
senses.example_cn: 我们量了水箱里水的体积。

senses.gloss_en: the amount or number of something, especially a lot
senses.example_en: Sales volume rose after the new ad.
senses.example_cn: 新广告投放后，销量上升了。

senses.gloss_en: the level of sound from music, TV, or speakers
senses.example_en: Turn down the volume, the baby is sleeping.
senses.example_cn: 把音量调小点，宝宝在睡觉。

senses.gloss_en: a large amount of money, property, or valuable things
senses.example_en: Her wealth came from a small family business.
senses.example_cn: 她的财富来自一家小的家族企业。

senses.gloss_en: the state of being rich
senses.example_en: Education can bring wealth to a poor town.
senses.example_cn: 教育能让一个贫穷的小镇富起来。

senses.gloss_en: a large amount of something useful or good
senses.example_en: She has a wealth of teaching experience.
senses.gloss_cn: 大量（丰富的经验、知识等）
senses.example_cn: 她有丰富的教学经验。

senses.gloss_en: a very large amount of money or property
senses.example_en: He made a fortune from selling his house.
senses.example_cn: 他卖掉房子赚了一大笔钱。

senses.gloss_en: luck, good or bad, in your life
senses.example_en: By good fortune, we found a hotel near town.
senses.example_cn: 幸运的是，我们在镇子附近找到了一家酒店。

senses.gloss_en: the good and bad things that happen to you
senses.example_en: Their fortunes changed after the new job.
senses.example_cn: 换了新工作以后，他们的境遇变了。

senses.gloss_en: a group of things held or growing together
senses.example_en: He bought a bunch of grapes at the market.
senses.example_cn: 他在市场上买了一串葡萄。

senses.gloss_en: a group of people, often seen together
senses.example_en: A bunch of students waited outside the room.
senses.example_cn: 一群学生在房间外面等着。

senses.gloss_en: a large number or amount, informal
senses.example_en: I have a bunch of emails to answer today.
senses.example_cn: 我今天有一大堆邮件要回。

senses.gloss_en: a business or organization that provides a particular service, especially for other businesses or organizations
senses.example_en: She called a travel agency for a cheap flight.
senses.gloss_cn: 提供特定服务的企业或组织，尤其是为其他企业或组织
senses.example_cn: 她打电话给一家旅行社要廉价航班。

senses.gloss_en: A government organization for a specific job
senses.example_en: The agency checks food safety in many restaurants.
senses.example_cn: 该机构检查许多餐馆的食品安全。

senses.gloss_en: An official group to control or investigate something
senses.example_en: A commission studied the accident and reported its findings.
senses.gloss_cn: 控制或调查某事的官方团体
senses.example_cn: 一个委员会研究了事故并报告了调查结果。

senses.gloss_en: Money paid for sales, usually a percentage
senses.example_en: He earns commission on every car he sells.
senses.gloss_cn: 销售收入，通常按百分比计算
senses.example_cn: 他每卖出一辆车就赚佣金。

senses.gloss_en: To officially ask for a special piece of work
senses.example_en: They commissioned an artist to paint a family portrait.
senses.gloss_cn: 正式要求一件特殊的作品
senses.example_cn: 他们委托一位艺术家画一幅全家福。

senses.gloss_en: A group chosen to make decisions about something
senses.example_en: The committee meets today to plan the new event.
senses.gloss_cn: 被选中对某事做出决定的群体
senses.example_cn: 委员会今天开会策划新活动。

senses.gloss_en: A group elected to govern a town or area
senses.example_en: The council approved the plan for new housing.
senses.gloss_cn: 被选举来管理一个城镇或地区的团体
senses.example_cn: 议会批准了新住房计划。

senses.gloss_en: A group chosen to advise and decide for others
senses.example_en: She spoke to the council about safety rules.
senses.gloss_cn: 被选中为他人提供建议和决策的团体
senses.example_cn: 她向议会谈了安全规则。

senses.gloss_en: An area with its own local government
senses.example_en: This county has many farms and small towns.
senses.gloss_cn: 拥有自己地方政府的地区
senses.example_cn: 这个县有许多农场和小城镇。

senses.gloss_en: A large formal meeting of representatives
senses.example_en: Doctors met at a congress to share new research.
senses.gloss_cn: 代表们的大型正式会议
senses.example_cn: 医生们在一次大会上会面，分享新的研究成果。

senses.gloss_en: The law-making group in the United States
senses.example_en: Congress passed a new law after long debate.
senses.example_cn: 国会经过长时间辩论通过了一项新法律。

senses.gloss_en: One of two law-making groups in some countries
senses.example_en: The bill failed in the senate last week.
senses.gloss_cn: 一些国家的两个立法团体之一
senses.example_cn: 该法案上周在参议院未获通过。

senses.gloss_en: An elected member of a senate
senses.example_en: The senator visited our town and answered questions.
senses.example_cn: 参议员来到镇上回答了问题。

senses.gloss_en: the elected leader of a state or region
senses.example_en: The governor signed the new law today.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个州或地区的民选领导人
senses.example_cn: 州长今天签署了新法律。

senses.gloss_en: a person on a committee that controls a school or hospital
senses.example_en: A governor asked questions at the school meeting.
senses.gloss_cn: 控制学校或医院的委员会成员
senses.example_cn: 一位州长在学校会议上提问。

senses.gloss_en: a device that controls an engine's speed
senses.example_en: The car has a governor for safe speed.
senses.gloss_cn: 控制发动机转速的装置
senses.example_cn: 这辆车有一个安全速度调节器。

senses.gloss_en: a government member in charge of a department
senses.example_en: The minister announced a new education plan.
senses.gloss_cn: 负责某个部门的政府成员
senses.example_cn: 部长宣布了一项新的教育计划。

senses.gloss_en: a Protestant religious leader in a church
senses.example_en: The minister spoke to the family after church.
senses.gloss_cn: 教堂里的新教宗教领袖
senses.example_cn: 牧师在教堂后与家人交谈。

senses.gloss_en: a diplomat who represents a government abroad
senses.example_en: The minister met the ambassador at the embassy.
senses.gloss_cn: 在国外代表政府的外交官
senses.example_cn: 部长在大使馆会见了大使。

senses.gloss_en: a person chosen to speak or act for others
senses.example_en: Our representative answered questions for the whole group.
senses.example_cn: 我们代表回答了全组的问题。

senses.gloss_en: a person who sells products for a company
senses.example_en: A representative showed us the new phones.
senses.example_cn: 一位销售员向我们展示了新手机。

senses.gloss_en: typical of a group, showing its common features
senses.example_en: This photo is representative of my home city.
senses.example_cn: 这张照片代表了我的城市。

senses.gloss_en: a person who legally belongs to a country
senses.example_en: She became a citizen after five years.
senses.gloss_cn: 合法属于一个国家的人
senses.example_cn: 五年后，她成为了公民。

senses.gloss_en: a person who lives in a town or city
senses.example_en: Many citizens came to the meeting downtown.
senses.gloss_cn: 居住在城镇或城市的人
senses.example_cn: 许多市民来到市中心参加会议。

senses.gloss_en: the larger part of a group, more than half
senses.example_en: The majority of voters supported the plan.
senses.gloss_cn: 群体中的大部分，超过一半
senses.example_cn: 大多数选民支持该计划。

senses.gloss_en: the group with most votes or seats in an election
senses.example_en: A majority voted for the new leader.
senses.gloss_cn: 在选举中获得最多选票或席位的团体
senses.example_cn: 大多数人投票支持新领导人。

senses.gloss_en: the number of votes by which someone wins
senses.example_en: She won by a majority of 500 votes.
senses.example_cn: 她以500票的多数获胜。

senses.gloss_en: strong disagreement that tries to stop something
senses.example_en: There was opposition to the new road plan.
senses.example_cn: 新修路计划遭到反对。

senses.gloss_en: politicians who are against the government
senses.example_en: The opposition criticized the government in parliament.
senses.example_cn: 反对党在议会批评政府。

senses.gloss_en: the team or person you compete against
senses.example_en: Our opposition scored first in the game.
senses.example_cn: 对方在比赛中先得分。

senses.gloss_en: an official rule made by an authority
senses.example_en: New regulations limit smoking in public places.
senses.gloss_cn: 权威机构制定的官方规则
senses.example_cn: 新规定限制在公共场所吸烟。

senses.gloss_en: the control of an activity by rules
senses.example_en: Regulation of banks protects customers' money.
senses.example_cn: 银行监管保护客户的资金。

senses.gloss_en: an official document that gives permission
senses.example_en: He got a license to drive a taxi.
senses.example_cn: 他拿到了出租车驾驶执照。

senses.gloss_en: official permission to do something, not the document
senses.example_en: The store has a license to sell alcohol.
senses.example_cn: 商店有销售酒精的许可。

senses.gloss_en: to allow something to happen
senses.example_en: The school does not permit phones in class.
senses.example_cn: 学校不允许在课堂上使用手机。

senses.gloss_en: to make something possible
senses.example_en: Weather permitting we will walk to the beach.
senses.example_cn: 如果天气允许，我们将步行去海滩。

senses.gloss_en: an official document giving the right to do something
senses.example_en: He showed his parking permit to the officer.
senses.gloss_cn: 授权做某事的官方文件
senses.example_cn: 他向警察出示了停车许可证。

senses.gloss_en: a duty you must do because of a law or promise
senses.example_en: You have an obligation to pay the bill.
senses.gloss_cn: 因法律或承诺而必须履行的义务
senses.example_cn: 你有义务付账。

senses.gloss_en: something you must do for other people
senses.example_en: Work obligations kept her from the party.
senses.example_cn: 工作义务使她无法参加聚会。

senses.gloss_en: a strong feeling you should help or thank someone
senses.example_en: I felt an obligation to my parents after college.
senses.gloss_cn: 一种强烈的感觉，你应该帮助或感谢某人
senses.example_cn: 大学毕业后，我感到对父母有义务。

senses.gloss_en: fair treatment of people
senses.example_en: They asked for justice after the accident.
senses.example_cn: 事故发生后，他们要求伸张正义。

senses.gloss_en: the system of laws that judges and punishes people
senses.example_en: The justice system must protect everyone in court.
senses.gloss_cn: 审判和惩罚人民的法律体系
senses.example_cn: 司法系统必须保护法庭上的每个人。

senses.gloss_en: a judge in a court of law
senses.example_en: The justice spoke briefly then ended the hearing.
senses.example_cn: 法官简短发言后结束了听证会。

senses.gloss_en: the ability to make sensible decisions
senses.example_en: Good judgment helps you choose the safer route.
senses.example_cn: 良好的判断力可以帮助你选择更安全的路线。

senses.gloss_en: an opinion or decision after careful thought
senses.example_en: In my judgment, this plan will not work.
senses.gloss_cn: 深思熟虑后的意见或决定
senses.example_cn: 依我判断，这个计划行不通。

senses.gloss_en: a decision made by a court of law
senses.example_en: The judge announced the judgment in the morning.
senses.example_cn: 法官早上宣布了判决。

senses.gloss_en: a lawyer who represents people in court
senses.example_en: Her attorney spoke for her during the trial.
senses.gloss_cn: 在法庭上代表人民的律师
senses.example_cn: 她的律师在审判期间为她辩护。

senses.gloss_en: a court process to decide if someone is guilty
senses.example_en: The trial lasted two weeks in the city.
senses.gloss_cn: 决定某人是否有罪的法庭程序
senses.example_cn: 审判在该市持续了两周。

senses.gloss_en: a test to see if something works well
senses.example_en: The drug is in a trial at the hospital.
senses.gloss_cn: 测试某物是否正常工作
senses.example_cn: 该药物正在医院进行试验。

senses.gloss_en: an unpleasant experience that tests your patience
senses.example_en: Moving alone was a trial for him.
senses.gloss_cn: 考验你耐心的不愉快经历
senses.example_cn: 独自行动对他来说是一种考验。

senses.gloss_en: an official process to find out the facts
senses.example_en: The investigation found new evidence about the fire.
senses.example_cn: 调查发现了有关火灾的新证据。

senses.gloss_en: a request for information, a question
senses.example_en: I sent an inquiry about the class schedule.
senses.example_cn: 我发送了一份关于课程安排的询问。

senses.gloss_en: an official process to discover the facts
senses.example_en: The inquiry reported mistakes in the safety plan.
senses.example_cn: 调查报告了安全计划中的错误。

senses.gloss_en: the process of asking questions to find information
senses.example_en: The teacher encouraged inquiry during the science lesson.
senses.gloss_cn: 提问以查找信息的过程
senses.example_cn: 老师在科学课上鼓励探究。

senses.gloss_en: something that happens, usually unpleasant or unusual
senses.example_en: The incident stopped the game and everyone left.
senses.example_cn: 事件发生后比赛中断众人散去。

senses.gloss_en: a serious event such as a crime or accident
senses.example_en: The police reported an incident near the station last night.
senses.example_cn: 警方报告昨晚车站附近发生了事故。

senses.gloss_en: protection against attack, or something that protects
senses.example_en: Good defense kept our town safe during the storm.
senses.example_cn: 良好的防御使我们的城镇在风暴中保持安全。

senses.gloss_en: a statement or argument against a charge
senses.example_en: His defense was that he followed the rules.
senses.gloss_cn: 反对指控的陈述或论点
senses.example_cn: 他的辩护是他遵守了规则。

senses.gloss_en: the players who try to stop the other team scoring
senses.example_en: Our defense worked hard and the other team lost.
senses.gloss_cn: 试图阻止对方得分的球员
senses.example_cn: 我们的防守很努力，对方输了。

senses.gloss_en: connected with soldiers, armies, or war
senses.example_en: He works on a military base near the city.
senses.gloss_cn: 与士兵、军队或战争有关
senses.example_cn: 他在城市附近的一个军事基地工作。

senses.gloss_en: the armed forces of a country
senses.example_en: The military arrived and the streets became quiet.
senses.example_cn: 军队到达，街道变得安静。

senses.gloss_en: done with strict order and discipline
senses.example_en: They cleaned the room with military precision every day.
senses.example_cn: 他们每天都以军事般的精确度打扫房间。

senses.gloss_en: a large container for liquid or gas
senses.example_en: The water tank leaked and the floor got wet.
senses.example_cn: 水箱漏了地板湿了。

senses.gloss_en: a heavy armored military vehicle with guns
senses.example_en: A tank moved slowly across the field at night.
senses.example_cn: 夜间一辆坦克缓慢穿过田野。

senses.gloss_en: the act of keeping someone or something safe
senses.example_en: Parents want protection for their children at school.
senses.gloss_cn: 保护某人或某物安全的行为
senses.example_cn: 父母希望在学校保护他们的孩子。

senses.gloss_en: something that keeps you safe from harm
senses.example_en: A helmet is protection for your head on a bike.
senses.example_cn: 头盔是骑自行车时保护头部的工具。

senses.gloss_en: insurance against loss, damage, or injury
senses.example_en: Their policy offers protection against fire and theft.
senses.example_cn: 他们的保单提供防火和防盗保护。

senses.gloss_en: the state of being alone and not watched
senses.example_en: I need privacy so I close the door.
senses.gloss_cn: 独自一人，无人看管的状态
senses.example_cn: 我需要隐私，所以我关上门。

senses.gloss_en: the right to keep personal information secret
senses.example_en: Online privacy matters and you should protect your data.
senses.example_cn: 在线隐私很重要，你应该保护你的数据。

senses.gloss_en: an illegal act, a crime
senses.example_en: Driving too fast is a serious offense here.
senses.example_cn: 在这里开车太快是一种严重的违法行为。

senses.gloss_en: a rude act that upsets someone
senses.example_en: I meant no offense and I was just joking.
senses.example_cn: 我无意冒犯，只是开玩笑。

senses.gloss_en: the team or players who try to score points
senses.example_en: Their offense was strong and we could not stop it.
senses.gloss_cn: 试图得分的球队或球员
senses.example_cn: 他们的进攻很强，我们无法阻止。

senses.gloss_en: think something is probably true, without proof
senses.example_en: I suspect the price will rise again next month.
senses.example_cn: 我怀疑下个月物价会涨。

senses.gloss_en: think someone may have done something wrong
senses.example_en: Police suspect him of the theft at the store.
senses.example_cn: 警方怀疑他在商店偷窃。

senses.gloss_en: a person thought to be guilty of a crime
senses.example_en: The suspect ran away and officers followed quickly.
senses.gloss_cn: 嫌疑人（被认为犯罪的人）
senses.example_cn: 嫌疑人逃跑警察紧追不舍。

senses.gloss_en: a statement that you will hurt someone
senses.example_en: He sent a threat after the argument.
senses.example_cn: 争吵之后他发来威胁信息。

senses.gloss_en: the possibility of something bad happening
senses.example_en: The storm was a threat to our trip.
senses.example_cn: 风暴威胁了我们的行程。

senses.gloss_en: a person or thing likely to cause danger
senses.example_en: Drugs are a major threat to young people.
senses.example_cn: 毒品对年轻人构成重大威胁。

senses.gloss_en: behavior that uses physical force to hurt people
senses.example_en: The movie shows violence, and my kids look away.
senses.gloss_cn: 使用武力伤害他人的行为
senses.example_cn: 这部电影展示了暴力，我的孩子们把目光移开了。

senses.gloss_en: extreme force, especially in weather
senses.example_en: The storm hit with violence during the night.
senses.gloss_cn: 极端力量，尤其是在天气条件下
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨在夜里猛烈地袭来。

senses.gloss_en: an event when someone is shot with a gun
senses.example_en: The shooting happened outside the store last night.
senses.example_cn: 枪击事件昨晚发生在商店外。

senses.gloss_en: the act of shooting bullets from a gun
senses.example_en: We heard shooting in the street, then sirens.
senses.example_cn: 我们听到街上有枪声，然后是警笛声。

senses.gloss_en: the process of filming a movie
senses.example_en: Shooting began today, and the crew looked tired.
senses.example_cn: 今天开始射击，船员们看起来很累。

senses.gloss_en: the act of firing a gun
senses.example_en: We heard a shot, and everyone ran.
senses.example_cn: 我们听到一声枪响，大家都跑了。

senses.gloss_en: an attempt to hit or throw a ball
senses.example_en: Her shot missed the goal, but she smiled.
senses.example_cn: 她的射门没打中，但她笑了。

senses.gloss_en: a photograph taken with a camera
senses.example_en: I took a shot of the street food.
senses.example_cn: 我拍了一张街头小吃。

senses.gloss_en: weapons used for fighting, especially by soldiers
senses.example_en: They hid arms in the old house.
senses.gloss_cn: 用于战斗的武器，尤其是士兵使用的
senses.example_cn: 他们把武器藏在老房子里。

senses.gloss_en: a small metal object fired from a gun
senses.example_en: A bullet hit the wall, and dust fell.
senses.gloss_cn: 从枪里射出的小金属物体
senses.example_cn: 一颗子弹击中了墙壁，灰尘随之落下。

senses.gloss_en: an organized group of criminals
senses.example_en: The police arrested a gang after the robbery.
senses.example_cn: 警方破获了这起抢劫案中的团伙。

senses.gloss_en: a group of young people who cause trouble
senses.example_en: A gang of young men caused trouble at night.
senses.example_cn: 一群年轻男子深夜闹事。

senses.gloss_en: a group of friends who do things together
senses.example_en: The gang met for pizza after work.
senses.example_cn: 这群哥们儿下班后去吃披萨。

senses.gloss_en: money, food, or equipment given to help people
senses.example_en: They sent aid to families after the storm.
senses.gloss_cn: 为帮助他人而提供的金钱、食物或设备
senses.example_cn: 风暴过后，他们向受灾家庭提供了援助。

senses.gloss_en: help someone do something, making it easier
senses.example_en: These tools aid me, and save time.
senses.gloss_cn: 帮助某人做某事，使其更容易
senses.example_cn: 这些工具帮助我，节省时间。

senses.gloss_en: help or support in a difficult time
senses.example_en: She came to my aid when I fell.
senses.gloss_cn: 困难时期的帮助或支持
senses.example_cn: 我摔倒时，她来救我了。

senses.gloss_en: save someone from danger or harm
senses.example_en: Firefighters rescued the child from the burning house.
senses.example_cn: 消防员从火场中救出了孩子。

senses.gloss_en: an act of saving someone from danger
senses.example_en: The helicopter rescue took place before sunrise.
senses.example_cn: 直升机救援在日出前完成。

senses.gloss_en: help someone out of a difficult situation
senses.example_en: She rescued me from an awkward conversation.
senses.example_cn: 她帮我解了尴尬的围。

senses.gloss_en: a serious request for help, money, or information
senses.example_en: The police made an appeal for more witnesses.
senses.example_cn: 警方呼吁更多目击者提供线索。

senses.gloss_en: interest or attract someone
senses.example_en: Simple stories appeal to children and adults.
senses.example_cn: 简单的故事吸引儿童和成人。

senses.gloss_en: a request to a court to change a decision
senses.example_en: She filed an appeal after the judge's decision.
senses.example_cn: 法官裁决后她提起了上诉。

senses.gloss_en: the feeling that you like or accept something
senses.example_en: He nodded with approval at my new plan.
senses.example_cn: 他点头赞许我的新方案。

senses.gloss_en: official permission for a plan or project
senses.example_en: The city gave approval for the new bridge.
senses.example_cn: 市政府批准了新大桥建设。

senses.gloss_en: permission to do something
senses.example_en: You need approval before you enter the lab.
senses.example_cn: 进入实验室前需获批准。

senses.gloss_en: a violent change of government by the people
senses.example_en: The revolution ended the old government in one year.
senses.example_cn: 革命一年之内推翻了旧政权。

senses.gloss_en: a very big change in the way people live
senses.example_en: The internet caused a revolution in daily communication.
senses.example_cn: 互联网改变了日常通讯方式。

senses.gloss_en: one complete turn around a central point
senses.example_en: One revolution of the wheel took two seconds.
senses.example_cn: 车轮转一圈用了两秒。

senses.gloss_en: a person who sees an event happen
senses.example_en: A witness saw the crash from the corner.
senses.example_cn: 一位目击者在拐角看到了车祸。

senses.gloss_en: a person who gives evidence in court
senses.example_en: The witness answered questions in court all day.
senses.example_cn: 证人在法庭上回答了一整天问题。

senses.gloss_en: see something happen
senses.example_en: Several people witnessed the robbery on the street.
senses.example_cn: 多人目击了街上的抢劫案。

senses.gloss_en: Based on what you heard or read, not certain
senses.example_en: Apparently, they are moving to Canada next month.
senses.gloss_cn: 根据你听到或读到的，不确定
senses.example_cn: 显然，他们下个月要搬到加拿大。

senses.gloss_en: Seemingly true, based on what you can see
senses.example_en: He is apparently sick, so he stayed home.
senses.gloss_cn: 根据你所看到的，这似乎是真的
senses.example_cn: 他显然病了，所以他呆在家里。

senses.gloss_en: a large important organization with a particular purpose
senses.example_en: The bank is a trusted institution in our town.
senses.example_cn: 这家银行是我们镇上的老牌机构。

senses.gloss_en: a place where people are kept, cared for
senses.example_en: He lived in an institution for older people.
senses.example_cn: 他在养老院安度晚年。

senses.gloss_en: a long-established system or custom in society
senses.example_en: Marriage is an institution in many cultures.
senses.example_cn: 婚姻在许多文化中是一项传统制度。

senses.gloss_en: an official group formed for a shared purpose
senses.example_en: Our association meets monthly to help new workers.
senses.gloss_cn: 为共同目的而成立的官方团体
senses.example_cn: 我们协会每月开会帮助新工人。

senses.gloss_en: a connection between ideas, memories, or events
senses.example_en: I have an association between that song and summer.
senses.gloss_cn: 想法、记忆或事件之间的联系
senses.example_cn: 我把那首歌和夏天联系在一起。

senses.gloss_en: a relationship or partnership with a person or group
senses.example_en: Their association ended after the contract changed.
senses.gloss_cn: 与个人或团体的关系或伙伴关系
senses.example_cn: 合同变更后，他们的协会终止了。

senses.gloss_en: a person who lives in a particular place
senses.example_en: Local residents asked for a new crosswalk.
senses.example_cn: 当地居民要求修建一条新的人行横道。

senses.gloss_en: living in a place, not a visitor
senses.example_en: The resident population is smaller during winter.
senses.gloss_cn: 住在一个地方，而不是游客
senses.example_cn: 冬季常住人口较少。

senses.gloss_en: a doctor who is still training and works in a hospital
senses.example_en: She is a resident doctor at the hospital.
senses.gloss_cn: 仍在医院接受培训并工作的医生
senses.example_cn: 她是这家医院的住院医生。

senses.gloss_en: the conditions and facts affecting a situation
senses.example_en: Under these circumstances, we should wait until tomorrow.
senses.example_cn: 在这种情况下，我们该等到明天。

senses.gloss_en: a person's living conditions, especially their money
senses.example_en: His circumstances improved after he found steady work.
senses.example_cn: 找到稳定工作后，他的境况好转了。

senses.gloss_en: a detail that helps explain what happened
senses.example_en: She described the circumstances of the accident clearly.
senses.example_cn: 她清楚地描述了事故的经过。

senses.gloss_en: a serious disagreement between people or groups
senses.example_en: The conflict between neighbors ended after a calm talk.
senses.example_cn: 邻居间的争吵在平静交谈后结束了。

senses.gloss_en: a serious fight or war between groups or countries
senses.example_en: The conflict forced many families to leave their homes.
senses.gloss_cn: 战争（群体间的激烈争斗）
senses.example_cn: 战争迫使许多家庭离开家园。

senses.gloss_en: be so different that both cannot be true
senses.example_en: Their reports conflict and the facts are still unclear.
senses.example_cn: 两份报告说法不一，事实仍不明。

senses.gloss_en: a serious discussion with different opinions
senses.example_en: The debate about taxes lasted all evening at home.
senses.example_cn: 关于税收的辩论持续到深夜。

senses.gloss_en: a formal event where people argue for and against
senses.example_en: The class held a debate on school uniforms today.
senses.example_cn: 课堂举行了校服辩论赛。

senses.gloss_en: discuss something carefully before deciding
senses.example_en: They debated the plan and chose the safer route.
senses.example_cn: 他们讨论了方案后选择了安全的那条路。

senses.gloss_en: meet someone or experience something unexpectedly
senses.example_en: I encountered heavy rain on the mountain road.
senses.gloss_cn: 意外地遇到某人或经历某事
senses.example_cn: 我在山路上遇到了大雨。

senses.gloss_en: an unexpected meeting with someone
senses.example_en: Our encounter on the train felt friendly and short.
senses.example_cn: 我们在火车上的相遇感觉友好而短暂。

senses.gloss_en: a sudden fight or violent meeting between groups
senses.example_en: The encounter ended quickly after the first shot.
senses.gloss_cn: 群体之间的突然打斗或暴力集会
senses.example_cn: 第一枪打响后，比赛很快结束了。

senses.gloss_en: hit someone or something with force
senses.example_en: A falling branch can strike a car in storms.
senses.example_cn: 暴风雨中树枝可能砸到汽车。

senses.gloss_en: stop working to demand better pay or conditions
senses.example_en: Workers strike for better pay in the winter.
senses.example_cn: 工人们冬季罢工要求加薪。

senses.gloss_en: a period when workers stop working as protest
senses.example_en: The strike lasted three days and closed the airport.
senses.example_cn: 罢工持续三天关闭了机场。

senses.gloss_en: try very hard when something is difficult
senses.example_en: I struggled to open the heavy door alone.
senses.example_cn: 我一个人费力地打开了那扇厚重的门。

senses.gloss_en: a difficult effort or problem
senses.example_en: Learning these sounds was a struggle for me.
senses.example_cn: 学这些发音对我来说是个挣扎。

senses.gloss_en: fight with someone using physical force
senses.example_en: They struggled for minutes and the police came.
senses.example_cn: 他们搏斗了好几分钟警察才赶到。

senses.gloss_en: a time of great trouble or danger
senses.example_en: The company faced a crisis after the large fire.
senses.example_cn: 大火之后公司陷入危机。

senses.gloss_en: a moment when a situation becomes extremely serious
senses.example_en: At the crisis point, she called the doctor right away.
senses.example_cn: 到了危急关头她立刻叫了医生。

senses.gloss_en: the right to do what you want without control
senses.example_en: Freedom of speech matters in every democracy.
senses.gloss_cn: 不受控制地做自己想做的事的权利
senses.example_cn: 言论自由在每个民主国家都很重要。

senses.gloss_en: being free from control or imprisonment
senses.example_en: After ten years, he finally gained freedom.
senses.example_cn: 十年后，他终于获得了自由。

senses.gloss_en: the state of a country governing itself
senses.example_en: The country fought for freedom from foreign rule.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个国家自我治理的状态
senses.example_cn: 这个国家为摆脱外国统治而斗争。

senses.gloss_en: a small group in society different from others
senses.example_en: The law protects every minority in the country.
senses.example_cn: 法律保护该国所有少数民族。

senses.gloss_en: the smaller number or part of a group
senses.example_en: Only a minority agreed with the new rule.
senses.example_cn: 只有少数人同意新规。

senses.gloss_en: the period when someone is legally a child
senses.example_en: During his minority, he lived with his aunt.
senses.example_cn: 未成年期间他由姑母抚养。

senses.gloss_en: related to ideas of right and wrong behavior
senses.example_en: They had a moral debate about the new law.
senses.example_cn: 他们围绕新法律展开了道德辩论。

senses.gloss_en: a practical lesson from a story
senses.example_en: The moral of the story is be honest.
senses.example_cn: 这个故事告诉我们做人要诚实。

senses.gloss_en: standards of good behavior, especially about sex
senses.example_en: His parents worried about his morals at school.
senses.example_cn: 父母担心他在学校的品行。

senses.gloss_en: the opinion people have about someone or something
senses.example_en: The restaurant has a great reputation for service.
senses.example_cn: 这家餐厅的服务声誉极佳。

senses.gloss_en: being known for a particular quality
senses.example_en: She earned a reputation for honest work.
senses.gloss_cn: 声誉（因特定品质而出名）
senses.example_cn: 她赢得了诚实工作的声誉。

senses.gloss_en: the state of being liked by many people
senses.example_en: Her popularity grew after the new song.
senses.example_cn: 这首新歌之后，她的人气越来越高。

senses.gloss_en: a man with the title Lord in Britain
senses.example_en: Lord Harris spoke in Parliament this morning.
senses.gloss_cn: 英国一个有领主头衔的人
senses.example_cn: 哈里斯勋爵今天上午在议会发表了讲话。

senses.gloss_en: a man with great power in an area
senses.example_en: The police arrested the drug lord at night.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个在某个地区有很大权力的人
senses.example_cn: 警方在夜间逮捕了毒枭。

senses.gloss_en: God in the Christian religion
senses.example_en: She prayed to the Lord for peace.
senses.example_cn: 她向上帝祈祷和平。

senses.gloss_en: The place where good people go after they die
senses.example_en: She hopes to go to heaven when she dies.
senses.example_cn: 她希望死后能进天堂。

senses.gloss_en: The sky, the space above the earth
senses.example_en: Dark clouds filled heaven before the rain began.
senses.example_cn: 乌云密布天空，大雨将至。

senses.gloss_en: A place or time where you feel very happy
senses.example_en: For me, a quiet beach is heaven.
senses.example_cn: 对我而言，安静的海滩就是天堂。

senses.gloss_en: The place where bad people are punished after death
senses.example_en: He feared hell and prayed for forgiveness.
senses.gloss_cn: 坏人死后受到惩罚的地方
senses.example_cn: 他害怕地狱，祈求宽恕。

senses.gloss_en: An extremely unpleasant situation or experience
senses.example_en: The last week was hell for the whole team.
senses.gloss_cn: 极度不愉快的情况或经历
senses.example_cn: 上周对整个团队来说都是地狱。

senses.gloss_en: A type of art, music, or writing with shared features
senses.example_en: Horror is a popular genre in movies.
senses.gloss_cn: 一种具有共同特征的艺术、音乐或写作
senses.example_cn: 恐怖片是电影中一种流行的类型。

senses.gloss_en: The quality of a voice, showing feeling or meaning
senses.example_en: Her tone was calm, but she was angry.
senses.gloss_cn: 语调（声音所传达的情感）
senses.example_cn: 她语气平静但内心愤怒。

senses.gloss_en: The general feeling of speech or writing, friendly or serious
senses.example_en: The tone of the email was cold and short.
senses.example_cn: 邮件的基调冷淡而简短。

senses.gloss_en: A particular shade of a color
senses.example_en: This paint has a warm tone of red.
senses.example_cn: 这种漆带有一点暖红色调。

senses.gloss_en: A strong regular pattern of sounds or movements
senses.example_en: The song has a fast rhythm for dancing.
senses.gloss_cn: 声音或动作的强烈规则模式
senses.example_cn: 这首歌节奏很快，适合跳舞。

senses.gloss_en: A regular pattern of changes or events
senses.example_en: Jet lag breaks my sleep rhythm for days.
senses.example_cn: 时差打乱了我几天的睡眠节奏。

senses.gloss_en: A series of musical notes that form a song
senses.example_en: I can play that tune on my guitar.
senses.gloss_cn: 构成歌曲的一系列音符
senses.example_cn: 我可以用吉他弹奏那首曲子。

senses.gloss_en: An area of ground prepared for playing a sport
senses.example_en: The kids ran onto the pitch after school.
senses.example_cn: 孩子们放学后跑到球场上。

senses.gloss_en: A short talk meant to persuade someone to buy
senses.example_en: He gave a pitch for the new phone.
senses.example_cn: 他做了新手机的推销介绍。

senses.gloss_en: How high or low a sound is
senses.example_en: The pitch of his voice was very low.
senses.example_cn: 他的嗓音很低。

senses.gloss_en: The speed of walking, running, or moving
senses.example_en: I kept a slow pace up the hill.
senses.gloss_cn: 步行、跑步或移动的速度
senses.example_cn: 我慢慢地爬上山。

senses.gloss_en: The speed of progress or change over time
senses.example_en: The pace of work was too fast today.
senses.gloss_cn: 进展或随时间变化的速度
senses.example_cn: 今天的工作节奏太快了。

senses.gloss_en: To walk back and forth, often when worried
senses.example_en: She paced the room while she waited.
senses.gloss_cn: 来回走动，经常在担心的时候
senses.example_cn: 她一边等着，一边在房间里踱来踱去。

senses.gloss_en: All the actors in a play, movie, or show
senses.example_en: The cast met after the show for dinner.
senses.gloss_cn: 戏剧、电影或演出中的所有演员
senses.example_cn: 演出结束后，演员们共进晚餐。

senses.gloss_en: To choose an actor for a particular part
senses.example_en: She was cast as the doctor in the movie.
senses.example_cn: 她被选为电影中的医生。

senses.gloss_en: To throw something, especially with force
senses.example_en: He cast a stone into the water.
senses.gloss_cn: 投掷某物，尤指用力投掷
senses.example_cn: 他把一块石头扔进水里。

senses.gloss_en: A group of sports teams that play each other
senses.example_en: Our team joined a league last summer.
senses.gloss_cn: 一组相互比赛的运动队
senses.example_cn: 我们队去年夏天加入了一个联赛。

senses.gloss_en: A group of people or countries united for a purpose
senses.example_en: The league worked to protect animals in the city.
senses.gloss_cn: 为某一目的而联合起来的一群人或国家
senses.example_cn: 该联盟致力于保护该市的动物。

senses.gloss_en: a person you compete against in a game, contest, or argument
senses.example_en: Our opponent scored first, but we won.
senses.gloss_cn: 你在游戏、竞赛或争论中与之竞争的人
senses.example_cn: 我们的对手先得分，但我们赢了。

senses.gloss_en: a person who disagrees with a plan and fights it
senses.example_en: Her opponents argued, but the law still passed.
senses.gloss_cn: 不同意计划并与之抗争的人
senses.example_cn: 她的反对者争辩道，但法律还是通过了。

senses.gloss_en: a competition where people try to win something
senses.example_en: She entered the contest and won first place.
senses.example_cn: 她参加比赛获得第一名。

senses.gloss_en: to take part in an election and try to win
senses.example_en: Three women contested the seat in our city.
senses.example_cn: 三位女性竞选我市的席位。

senses.gloss_en: to say something is wrong and try to change it
senses.example_en: He contested the ticket in court and paid nothing.
senses.example_cn: 他起诉质疑罚单并拒付。

senses.gloss_en: success in a game, election, or war
senses.example_en: Their victory gave the team a new confidence.
senses.gloss_cn: 游戏、选举或战争中的成功
senses.example_cn: 他们的胜利给了球队新的信心。

senses.gloss_en: an important success after a hard effort
senses.example_en: Finishing the course was a victory for him.
senses.gloss_cn: 经过艰苦努力取得的重大成功
senses.example_cn: 完成这门课程对他来说是一场胜利。

senses.gloss_en: a person who publicly says someone or something is bad
senses.example_en: Her critics called the plan risky and unfair.
senses.gloss_cn: 公开说某人或某事不好的人
senses.example_cn: 她的批评者称该计划有风险且不公平。

senses.gloss_en: a person who writes opinions about books, movies, or music
senses.example_en: The critic praised the movie, but I disagreed.
senses.gloss_cn: 对书籍、电影或音乐发表意见的人
senses.example_cn: 评论家称赞了这部电影，但我不同意。

senses.gloss_en: the act of saying someone or something is bad
senses.example_en: He faced criticism for the mistake, but he stayed calm.
senses.example_cn: 他因失误受到批评却保持镇定。

senses.gloss_en: a comment that says what is bad about something
senses.example_en: Her criticism helped me fix the report quickly.
senses.example_cn: 她的批评帮我迅速修改了报告。

senses.gloss_en: careful judgment of books, music, or art
senses.example_en: She studies criticism and writes about modern art.
senses.example_cn: 她研究评论并撰写当代艺术文章。

senses.gloss_en: to show something publicly in a museum or show
senses.example_en: They will exhibit photos at the city museum.
senses.gloss_cn: 在博物馆或展览中公开展示某物
senses.example_cn: 他们将在城市博物馆展出照片。

senses.gloss_en: an object or collection of objects shown to the public in a museum or show
senses.example_en: This exhibit shows tools from early farm life.
senses.gloss_cn: 在博物馆或展览中向公众展示的物品或物品收藏
senses.example_cn: 这个展览展示了早期农场生活中的工具。

senses.gloss_en: to show a feeling, quality, or ability clearly
senses.example_en: The pilot exhibited calm, even in the storm.
senses.gloss_cn: 清楚地表现出一种感觉、品质或能力
senses.example_cn: 即使在暴风雨中，飞行员也表现得很冷静。

senses.gloss_en: the form a book or magazine is published in
senses.example_en: I bought the paperback edition, not the hardcover.
senses.gloss_cn: 书籍或杂志的出版形式
senses.example_cn: 我买的是平装本，不是精装本。

senses.gloss_en: one issue of a newspaper or magazine
senses.example_en: The morning edition had the story on page one.
senses.example_cn: 晨报在第一页刊登了这篇报道。

senses.gloss_en: a revised version of a book published again
senses.example_en: The new edition adds photos and corrects errors.
senses.gloss_cn: 一本书的修订版再次出版
senses.example_cn: 新版本添加了照片并纠正了错误。

senses.gloss_en: a picture in a book, magazine, or paper
senses.example_en: Each illustration shows a bird with bright colors.
senses.gloss_cn: 书、杂志或报纸上的图片
senses.example_cn: 每幅插图都显示了一只色彩鲜艳的鸟。

senses.gloss_en: an example that makes an idea clear
senses.example_en: This story is an illustration of real courage.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个使想法清晰的例子
senses.example_cn: 这个故事展示了真正的勇气。

senses.gloss_en: the act of drawing pictures for a book
senses.example_en: She studied illustration and now draws for children.
senses.example_cn: 她学习插画，现在为孩子们画画。

senses.gloss_en: The act of making something new or causing it to exist
senses.example_en: The creation of this app took six months.
senses.example_cn: 开发这款应用花了六个月。

senses.gloss_en: Something made, especially an artistic or unusual thing
senses.example_en: This painting is her best creation so far.
senses.example_cn: 这幅画是她至今最好的作品。

senses.gloss_en: In the Bible, the making of the world by God
senses.example_en: They learned about the Creation in school.
senses.example_cn: 他们在学校学了创世的故事。

senses.gloss_en: An invented story, often with adventure and action
senses.example_en: He told a tale about pirates and storms.
senses.gloss_cn: 虚构的故事，通常有冒险和动作
senses.example_cn: 他讲了一个关于海盗和风暴的故事。

senses.gloss_en: A story that may be untrue, used as an explanation
senses.example_en: She made up a tale about missing the bus.
senses.gloss_cn: 一个可能不真实的故事，用作解释
senses.example_cn: 她编造了一个关于错过公共汽车的故事。

senses.gloss_en: Chasing and killing wild animals as a sport or for food
senses.example_en: Hunting is not allowed in this national park.
senses.example_cn: 这片国家公园禁止狩猎。

senses.gloss_en: the activity of trying to find a job, home, etc., used in compounds like job-hunting
senses.example_en: Apartment hunting takes time and a lot of patience.
senses.example_cn: 找房需要时间和耐心。

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: a written or spoken account of something
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: She wrote a report about the class trip.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: give people information about something that happened
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: They reported the event on TV today.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: tell a person in authority about something wrong
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: We reported the theft to the police.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: something that happens because of something else
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: The result was good after a lot of practice.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: information or marks from a test or experiment
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: I got my test results this morning.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: happen because of something or cause something
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: The fight resulted from a small mistake.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: regular training to improve a skill
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: We need more practice before the test.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: a usual way of doing something
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: It is common practice to start at eight.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: do something regularly to improve a skill
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: She practices English every day after work.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: school work that you do at home
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: I did my homework after dinner today.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: the activity of learning about a subject
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: Study helps me learn English every day.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: a piece of research that examines a subject
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: The study shows good results for this practice.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: learn about a subject in a course
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: I study English at night after work.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: the activity of reading written words
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: Reading helps me learn new words every day.
He did a reading of the story.

dropped_duplicate_runs.gloss_en: the way you understand a text or situation
dropped_duplicate_runs.example_en: My reading of the report was different today.

dropped_ghost_lines.gloss_en: a period of 100 years in history
dropped_ghost_lines.example_en: He studies art from the 18th century.

dropped_ghost_lines.gloss_en: Make profit or interest from something
dropped_ghost_lines.example_en: This account earns interest every month.
